This file is a merged representation of a subset of the codebase, containing specifically included files and files not matching ignore patterns, combined into a single document by Repomix.

# File Summary

## Purpose
This file contains a packed representation of a subset of the repository's contents that is considered the most important context.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

## File Format
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A header with the file path (## File: path/to/file)
  b. The full contents of the file in a code block

## Usage Guidelines
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

## Notes
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Only files matching these patterns are included: src/**
- Files matching these patterns are excluded: **/*.test.*
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";

export default function AlumniDB({ schoolId: propSchoolId }) {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = propSchoolId || user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const [alumni, setAlumni] = useState([]);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [filterYear, setFilterYear] = useState("ALL");
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: "",
    gradYear: "2024",
    stream: "Science (PCM)",
    collegePlacement: "",
    currentRole: "",
    pledgedDonation: "",
    contactEmail: "",
    phone: "",
```

```javascript
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = propSchoolId || user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const [logs, setLogs] = useState([]);

    studentName: "",
    studentRoll: "",

    type: "Merit", // Merit | Demerit

    remarks: "",
  });

  const loadLogs = () => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_behavior_logs_${schoolId}`);
      if (saved) {
        setLogs(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setLogs([]);
      }
    } catch {
      setLogs([]);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadLogs();
    const handleUpdate = () => loadLogs();
    window.addEventListener("erp-behavior-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("erp-behavior-updated", handleUpdate);
  }, [schoolId]);

  const saveLogs = (updated) => {
    setLogs(updated);
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";

const CONDUCT_CATEGORIES = [
  "Merit Commendation",
  "Academic Integrity",
  "Attendance Warning",
  "Uniform & Dress Code",
  "Campus Behavior Incident",
  "Sportsmanship Award",
];

export default function DisciplinaryLogManager({ schoolId: propSchoolId }) {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = propSchoolId || user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const [records, setRecords] = useState([]);
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState("ALL");

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    studentName: "",
    rollNumber: "STU-101",
    category: "Merit Commendation",
    description: "",
    actionTaken: "Officially Recorded in Institutional Dossier",
    status: "Verified",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_conduct_log_${schoolId}`);
      if (saved) {
        setRecords(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setRecords([]);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setRecords([]);
    }
  }, [schoolId]);

  const handleAddRecord = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.studentName.trim() || !form.description.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide student name and record details.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const newRec = {
      id: `cond_${Date.now()}`,
      studentName: form.studentName.trim(),
      rollNumber: form.rollNumber.trim(),
      category: form.category,
      description: form.description.trim(),
      actionTaken: form.actionTaken.trim() || "Counseled by Class Teacher",
      status: form.status,
      date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    };

    const updated = [newRec, ...records];
    setRecords(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_conduct_log_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}

    logSecurityAction({
      action: `Student Conduct Entry Logged (${newRec.category})`,
      entityType: "CONDUCT",
      entityId: newRec.studentName,
      details: `${newRec.category} for ${newRec.studentName} (${newRec.rollNumber})`,
      user,
      schoolId,
    });

    showToast(`Conduct record logged for ${newRec.studentName}!`, "success");
    setForm({
      studentName: "",
      rollNumber: "STU-101",
      category: "Merit Commendation",
      description: "",
      actionTaken: "Officially Recorded in Institutional Dossier",
      status: "Verified",
    });
    setShowAddModal(false);
  };

  const handleDeleteRecord = (id, name) => {
    const updated = records.filter((r) => r.id !== id);
    setRecords(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_conduct_log_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}
    showToast(`Conduct record for "${name || "Scholar"}" archived.`, "info");
  };

  const filteredRecords = records.filter((r) => {
    if (filterType === "ALL") return true;
    return r.category === filterType;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* HEADER BANNER */}
      <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-teal-500/10 border border-teal-500/30 text-teal-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
            <span>⚖️</span> Behavioral Standing & Commendations
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white">Disciplinary & Conduct Log</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1 max-w-xl">
            Maintain institutional records of student merit awards, sportsmanship commendations, uniform compliance, and behavioral incidents.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAddModal(true)}
            className="bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-500 text-white font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-lg shadow-teal-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <span>➕</span>
            <span>Log Conduct Entry</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* TABLE */}
      <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-700/60 bg-slate-800/40 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">Student Behavioral Record Dossier</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Campus Node: {schoolId}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto max-w-full pb-1">
            <button
              onClick={() => setFilterType("ALL")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
                filterType === "ALL" ? "bg-teal-600 text-white" : "bg-slate-900 text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              All Records ({records.length})
            </button>
            {CONDUCT_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
              const count = records.filter((r) => r.category === cat).length;
              if (count === 0 && filterType !== cat) return null;
              return (
                <button
                  key={cat}
                  onClick={() => setFilterType(cat)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap ${
                    filterType === cat ? "bg-teal-600 text-white" : "bg-slate-900 text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
                  }`}
                >
                  {cat} ({count})
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>

        {records.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-12 text-center text-slate-400 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-5xl block opacity-60">⚖️</span>
            <h4 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">No Conduct Records Logged (Clean Slate)</h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">

            </p>
            <button

            >
              + Log Conduct Entry
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto w-full">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-slate-700/70 text-slate-400 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider bg-slate-900/40">
                  <th className="p-4 pl-6">Scholar Name & ID</th>
                  <th className="p-4">Classification</th>
                  <th className="p-4">Incident / Commendation Summary</th>
                  <th className="p-4">Administrative Action</th>
                  <th className="p-4 text-center">Date Logged</th>
                  <th className="p-4 pr-6 text-right">Actions</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 text-sm">
                {filteredRecords.map((r) => (
                  <tr key={r.id} className="hover:bg-slate-800/30 transition-colors">
                    <td className="p-4 pl-6">
                      <p className="font-bold text-white">{r.studentName}</p>
                      <span className="text-xs font-mono text-teal-400">{r.rollNumber}</span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-4">
                      <span
                        className={`inline-block px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold border ${
                          r.category.includes("Merit") || r.category.includes("Award")
                            ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30"
                            : "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {r.category}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-xs text-slate-200 max-w-sm">{r.description}</td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-xs text-slate-300 font-semibold">{r.actionTaken}</td>
                    <td className="p-4 text-center text-xs font-mono text-slate-400">{r.date}</td>
                    <td className="p-4 pr-6 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteRecord(r.id, r.studentName)}
                        className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 hover:bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        🗑️ Delete
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ADD CONDUCT MODAL */}
      {showAddModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="bg-[#1E293B] border border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl">

            <form onSubmit={handleAddRecord} className="space-y-4">

                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, studentName: e.target.value })}

                  required

                <button

                  onClick={() => setShowAddModal(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-500 text-white font-bold px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs shadow-lg transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Save to Dossier
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";
import { exportToCSV } from "../utils/exportUtils";

export default function ExpenseManager({ schoolId }) {
  const { user, tenant } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const activeSchoolId = (schoolId || user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || tenant?.code || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();

  // 3 Core Required Inputs + standard expense details
  const [expenseForm, setExpenseForm] = useState({
    title: "",
    category: "Utilities & Bills",
    vendor: "",
    totalBill: "",
    amountPaidNow: "",
    amountRemaining: 0,
    paymentMode: "UPI / Net Banking",
    paymentDate: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    receiptNo: `EXP-${Date.now().toString().slice(-5)}`,
    notes: "",
  });

  const [expenses, setExpenses] = useState([]);
  const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState("ALL");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Auto-calculate Amount Remaining when Total Bill or Amount Paid Now changes
  const handleAmountChange = (field, value) => {
    const updatedForm = { ...expenseForm, [field]: value };
    const bill = parseFloat(field === "totalBill" ? value : updatedForm.totalBill) || 0;
    const paid = parseFloat(field === "amountPaidNow" ? value : updatedForm.amountPaidNow) || 0;
    const remaining = Math.max(0, bill - paid);
    
    updatedForm.amountRemaining = remaining;
    setExpenseForm(updatedForm);
  };

  // Load expenses
  const loadExpenses = () => {
    try {
      const storageKey = `erp_expenses_${activeSchoolId}`;
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (raw) {
        setExpenses(JSON.parse(raw));
      } else {
        // Seed default institutional expenses if clean slate
        const now = new Date();
        const currentMonthStr = now.toISOString().split("T")[0];
        const defaults = [
          {
            id: `exp_101_${activeSchoolId}`,
            title: "Campus Optical Fiber Internet (Quarterly)",
            category: "Utilities & Bills",
            vendor: "Airtel Enterprise Telecom",
            totalBill: 12000,
            amountPaidNow: 12000,
            amountRemaining: 0,
            paymentMode: "Bank Transfer",
            paymentDate: currentMonthStr,
            receiptNo: "EXP-88912",
            notes: "1 Gbps dedicated campus leased line",
            createdAt: now.toISOString(),
          },
          {
            id: `exp_102_${activeSchoolId}`,
            title: "Science Lab Reagents & Physics Apparatus",
            category: "Laboratory & Academics",
            vendor: "Standard Scientific Supplies",
            totalBill: 28500,
            amountPaidNow: 15000,
            amountRemaining: 13500,
            paymentMode: "Cheque",
            paymentDate: currentMonthStr,
            receiptNo: "EXP-88913",
            notes: "Balance due on delivery of second batch",
            createdAt: now.toISOString(),
          },
          {
            id: `exp_103_${activeSchoolId}`,
            title: "Term-1 Question Paper & Exam Booklets Printing",
            category: "Printing & Stationery",
            vendor: "Navneet Offset Press",
            totalBill: 8400,
            amountPaidNow: 8400,
            amountRemaining: 0,
            paymentMode: "UPI / Net Banking",
            paymentDate: currentMonthStr,
            receiptNo: "EXP-88914",
            notes: "Sealed question packets for ICSE/CBSE batches",
            createdAt: now.toISOString(),
          },
        ];
        localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(defaults));
        setExpenses(defaults);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to load expenses:", err);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadExpenses();
    const handleUpdate = () => loadExpenses();
    window.addEventListener("erp-expenses-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("erp-expenses-updated", handleUpdate);
  }, [activeSchoolId]);

  // Record New Expense
  const handleRecordExpense = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    const bill = parseFloat(expenseForm.totalBill);
    const paid = parseFloat(expenseForm.amountPaidNow);

    if (!expenseForm.title.trim()) {
      showToast("Please enter an expense title or vendor name.", "error");
      return;
    }
    if (isNaN(bill) || bill <= 0) {
      showToast("Please enter a valid Total Bill amount.", "error");
      return;
    }
    if (isNaN(paid) || paid < 0) {
      showToast("Please enter a valid Amount Paid Now.", "error");
      return;
    }
    if (paid > bill) {
      showToast("Amount Paid cannot exceed the Total Bill.", "error");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);

    const remaining = Math.max(0, bill - paid);
    const newRecord = {
      id: `exp_${Date.now()}`,
      title: expenseForm.title.trim(),
      category: expenseForm.category,
      vendor: expenseForm.vendor.trim() || "Institutional Vendor",
      totalBill: bill,
      amountPaidNow: paid,
      amountRemaining: remaining,
      paymentMode: expenseForm.paymentMode,
      paymentDate: expenseForm.paymentDate,
      receiptNo: expenseForm.receiptNo.trim() || `EXP-${Date.now().toString().slice(-5)}`,
      notes: expenseForm.notes.trim(),
      schoolId: activeSchoolId,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    try {
      const updatedList = [newRecord, ...expenses];
      const storageKey = `erp_expenses_${activeSchoolId}`;
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(updatedList));
      setExpenses(updatedList);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-expenses-updated"));

      // Try Supabase Cloud Sync
      try {
        if (supabase) {
          await supabase.from("expenses").insert([
            {
              id: newRecord.id,
              school_id: activeSchoolId,
              title: newRecord.title,
              category: newRecord.category,
              vendor: newRecord.vendor,
              total_bill: newRecord.totalBill,
              amount_paid: newRecord.amountPaidNow,
              amount_remaining: newRecord.amountRemaining,
              payment_mode: newRecord.paymentMode,
              payment_date: newRecord.paymentDate,
              receipt_no: newRecord.receiptNo,
              notes: newRecord.notes,
            },
          ]);
        }
      } catch (cloudErr) {
        console.warn("Supabase expense sync notice:", cloudErr);
      }

      logSecurityAction({
        action: "EXPENSE_RECORDED",
        entityType: "FINANCE",
        entityId: newRecord.receiptNo,
        details: `Recorded expense "${newRecord.title}" - Total: ₹${bill}, Paid: ₹${paid}, Remaining: ₹${remaining}`,
        user,
        schoolId: activeSchoolId,
      });

      showToast(`Expense recorded successfully! (Receipt: ${newRecord.receiptNo})`, "success");

      // Reset form
      setExpenseForm({
        title: "",
        category: "Utilities & Bills",
        vendor: "",
        totalBill: "",
        amountPaidNow: "",
        amountRemaining: 0,
        paymentMode: "UPI / Net Banking",
        paymentDate: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
        receiptNo: `EXP-${Date.now().toString().slice(-5)}`,
        notes: "",
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Expense record error:", err);
      showToast("Failed to record expense.", "error");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Delete Expense
  const handleDeleteExpense = (id) => {
    const updated = expenses.filter((ex) => ex.id !== id);
    setExpenses(updated);
    localStorage.setItem(`erp_expenses_${activeSchoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    showToast("Expense record removed.", "info");
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-expenses-updated"));
  };

  const currentMonth = new Date().getMonth();
  const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();

  const totalPaidThisMonth = expenses
    .filter((ex) => {
      if (!ex.paymentDate) return false;
      const d = new Date(ex.paymentDate);
      return d.getMonth() === currentMonth && d.getFullYear() === currentYear;
    })
    .reduce((sum, ex) => sum + (parseFloat(ex.amountPaidNow) || 0), 0);

  const totalIncurredBills = expenses.reduce((sum, ex) => sum + (parseFloat(ex.totalBill) || 0), 0);
  const totalAmountRemaining = expenses.reduce((sum, ex) => sum + (parseFloat(ex.amountRemaining) || 0), 0);
  const totalAllTimePaid = expenses.reduce((sum, ex) => sum + (parseFloat(ex.amountPaidNow) || 0), 0);

  const filteredExpenses = expenses.filter((ex) => {
    if (filterCategory === "ALL") return true;
    return ex.category === filterCategory;
  });

  // Export Expenses to CSV
  const handleExportCSV = () => {
    if (filteredExpenses.length === 0) {
      showToast("No expenses to export.", "info");
      return;
    }
    const headers = [
      "Receipt No",
      "Date",
      "Expense Title",
      "Category",
      "Vendor",
      "Total Bill (INR)",
      "Amount Paid Now (INR)",
      "Amount Remaining (INR)",
      "Payment Mode",
      "Status",
      "Notes",
    ];
    const rows = filteredExpenses.map((ex) => [
      ex.receiptNo,
      ex.paymentDate,
      ex.title,
      ex.category,
      ex.vendor,
      ex.totalBill,
      ex.amountPaidNow,
      ex.amountRemaining,
      ex.paymentMode,
      ex.amountRemaining === 0 ? "Fully Paid" : "Partial / Pending",
      ex.notes || "",
    ]);
    exportToCSV(`Expense_Ledger_${activeSchoolId}_${new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]}`, headers, rows);
    showToast("Expense report exported to CSV successfully!", "success");
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-slate-200">

                      <td className="p-4 text-center">
                        <span
                          className={`inline-block px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase border ${
                            isPaidFull
                              ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30"
                              : "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30"
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isPaidFull ? "Fully Paid" : "Partial / Due"}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-4 text-right pr-6">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteExpense(ex.id)}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-500/10 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                          title="Remove expense record"
                        >
                          Delete
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";

export default function LeaveManager({ schoolId: propSchoolId }) {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = propSchoolId || user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const [leaves, setLeaves] = useState([]);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("ALL"); // ALL | Pending | Approved | Rejected
  const [showApplyModal, setShowApplyModal] = useState(false);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    applicantName: "",
    applicantRole: "Teacher", // Teacher | Non-Teaching Staff (NTS)
    personalCode: "",
    leaveType: "Casual Leave", // Casual Leave | Medical Leave | Unpaid Leave
    startDate: "",
    endDate: "",
    reason: "",
    isUnpaid: false,
  });

  const loadLeaves = () => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_leave_requests_${schoolId}`);
      if (saved) {
        setLeaves(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setLeaves([]);
      }
    } catch {
      setLeaves([]);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadLeaves();
    const handleUpdate = () => loadLeaves();
    window.addEventListener("erp-leaves-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("erp-leaves-updated", handleUpdate);
  }, [schoolId]);

  const saveLeaves = (updated) => {
    setLeaves(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_leave_requests_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-leaves-updated"));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Save leaves error:", e);
    }
  };

  const handleApplyLeave = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.applicantName.trim() || !form.startDate || !form.endDate) {
      showToast("Please provide applicant name and date range.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const start = new Date(form.startDate);
    const end = new Date(form.endDate);
    const diffTime = Math.abs(end - start);
    const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) + 1;

    const newRequest = {
      id: `leave_${Date.now()}`,
      applicantName: form.applicantName.trim(),
      applicantRole: form.applicantRole,
      personalCode: (form.personalCode || "STAFF-01").trim().toUpperCase(),
      leaveType: form.leaveType,
      startDate: form.startDate,
      endDate: form.endDate,
      durationDays: diffDays || 1,
      reason: form.reason.trim() || "Personal obligation",
      status: "Pending", // Pending | Approved | Rejected
      isUnpaidDeduction: form.isUnpaid || form.leaveType === "Unpaid Leave",
      payrollDeductionSynced: false,
      requestedAt: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    };

    const updated = [newRequest, ...leaves];
    saveLeaves(updated);

    logSecurityAction({
      action: "LEAVE_REQUEST_SUBMITTED",
      entityType: "LEAVE",
      entityId: newRequest.id,
      details: `${newRequest.applicantName} (${newRequest.applicantRole}) requested ${newRequest.durationDays} days ${newRequest.leaveType}`,
      schoolId,
    });

    showToast(`Leave request submitted for ${newRequest.applicantName}!`, "success");
    setForm({
      applicantName: "",
      applicantRole: "Teacher",
      personalCode: "",
      leaveType: "Casual Leave",
      startDate: "",
      endDate: "",
      reason: "",
      isUnpaid: false,
    });
    setShowApplyModal(false);
  };

  const handleDecision = (leaveId, decision, withDeduction = false) => {
    const targetLeave = leaves.find((l) => l.id === leaveId);
    if (!targetLeave) return;

    const updated = leaves.map((l) => {
      if (l.id === leaveId) {
        return {
          ...l,
          status: decision,
          isUnpaidDeduction: withDeduction || l.isUnpaidDeduction,
          payrollDeductionSynced: decision === "Approved" && (withDeduction || l.isUnpaidDeduction),
          decidedAt: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
          decidedBy: user?.name || "Executive Principal",
        };
      }
      return l;
    });

    saveLeaves(updated);

    // If approved with deduction, sync to payroll flags
    if (decision === "Approved" && (withDeduction || targetLeave.isUnpaidDeduction)) {
      try {
        const payrollKey = `erp_payroll_deductions_${schoolId}`;
        const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(payrollKey) || "[]");
        const deductionRecord = {
          id: `deduct_${Date.now()}`,
          leaveId,
          staffName: targetLeave.applicantName,
          personalCode: targetLeave.personalCode,
          role: targetLeave.applicantRole,
          days: targetLeave.durationDays,
          reason: `Unpaid Leave deduction: ${targetLeave.leaveType}`,
          approvedDate: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
          status: "Active Deduction",
        };
        localStorage.setItem(payrollKey, JSON.stringify([deductionRecord, ...existing]));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-payroll-updated"));
      } catch (pe) {
        console.warn("Payroll sync notice:", pe);
      }
    }

    logSecurityAction({
      action: `LEAVE_REQUEST_${decision.toUpperCase()}`,
      entityType: "LEAVE",
      entityId: leaveId,
      details: `Principal marked leave for ${targetLeave.applicantName} as ${decision}${withDeduction ? " with salary deduction flag" : ""}`,
      schoolId,
    });

    showToast(`Leave request marked as ${decision}${withDeduction ? " (Payroll deduction synced)" : ""}!`, "info");
  };

  const filteredLeaves = leaves.filter((l) => {
    if (filter === "ALL") return true;
    return l.status === filter;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-slate-100">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl shadow-cyan-500/10 flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out">
        <div>
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-400/30 text-cyan-300 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
            <span>🏖️</span> HR Operations & Payroll Bridge
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Staff Leave Approval Portal</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1 max-w-xl">
            Review and adjudicate faculty and non-teaching staff leave petitions. Approved unpaid leaves trigger automatic salary deduction flags in Payroll.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowApplyModal(true)}
          className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 via-indigo-600 to-purple-600 hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-purple-500 text-white font-black px-5 py-3 rounded-2xl text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/20 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:scale-[1.02] cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2 border border-white/20"
        >
          <span>➕</span>
          <span>Submit Leave Petition</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Metrics Row */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Total Petitions</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-white mt-1">{leaves.length}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Awaiting Decision</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-amber-400 mt-1">
            {leaves.filter((l) => l.status === "Pending").length}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Approved</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-400 mt-1">
            {leaves.filter((l) => l.status === "Approved").length}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">

                >
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";

  "09:00 AM - 09:15 AM",
  "09:15 AM - 09:30 AM",
  "09:30 AM - 09:45 AM",
  "10:00 AM - 10:15 AM",
  "10:15 AM - 10:30 AM",
  "11:30 AM - 11:45 AM",
  "02:00 PM - 02:15 PM",
  "02:15 PM - 02:30 PM",
  "03:00 PM - 03:15 PM",
  "03:15 PM - 03:30 PM",
];

export default function MeetingScheduler({ schoolId: propSchoolId }) {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = propSchoolId || user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const [meetings, setMeetings] = useState([]);
  const [filterDate, setFilterDate] = useState("");
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState("ALL");
  const [showBookModal, setShowBookModal] = useState(false);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    visitorName: "",
    visitorRole: "Parent", // Parent | Faculty / Staff | Trustee | External Visitor
    studentAffiliation: "",
    date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    timeSlot: TIME_SLOTS_15MIN[0],
    purpose: "",
    contactPhone: "",
  });

  const loadMeetings = () => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_principal_meetings_${schoolId}`);
      if (saved) {
        setMeetings(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setMeetings([]);
      }
    } catch {
      setMeetings([]);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadMeetings();
    const handleUpdate = () => loadMeetings();
    window.addEventListener("erp-meetings-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("erp-meetings-updated", handleUpdate);
  }, [schoolId]);

  const saveMeetings = (updated) => {
    setMeetings(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_principal_meetings_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-meetings-updated"));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Storage save error:", e);
    }
  };

  const handleBookSlot = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.visitorName.trim() || !form.date || !form.timeSlot) {
      showToast("Please provide visitor name, date, and appointment slot.", "error");
      return;
    }

    // Check collision for same date and time slot
    const collision = meetings.find(
      (m) => m.date === form.date && m.timeSlot === form.timeSlot && m.status === "Confirmed"
    );
    if (collision) {
      showToast(`Slot ${form.timeSlot} on ${form.date} is already booked! Please select another slot.`, "error");
      return;
    }

    const newMeeting = {
      id: `meet_${Date.now()}`,
      bookingRef: `SLOT-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      visitorName: form.visitorName.trim(),
      visitorRole: form.visitorRole,
      studentAffiliation: form.studentAffiliation.trim() || "N/A",
      date: form.date,
      timeSlot: form.timeSlot,
      purpose: form.purpose.trim() || "Executive academic consultation.",
      contactPhone: form.contactPhone.trim() || "+91 98000 00000",
      status: "Confirmed", // Confirmed | Completed | Cancelled
      bookedAt: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    };

    const updated = [newMeeting, ...meetings];
    saveMeetings(updated);

    logSecurityAction({
      action: "PRINCIPAL_MEETING_BOOKED",
      entityType: "APPOINTMENT",
      entityId: newMeeting.bookingRef,
      details: `Scheduled 15-min consultation with ${newMeeting.visitorName} (${newMeeting.visitorRole}) on ${newMeeting.date} at ${newMeeting.timeSlot}`,
      schoolId,
    });

    showToast(`15-Min appointment confirmed for ${newMeeting.visitorName}!`, "success");
    setForm({
      visitorName: "",
      visitorRole: "Parent",
      studentAffiliation: "",
      date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
      timeSlot: TIME_SLOTS_15MIN[0],
      purpose: "",
      contactPhone: "",
    });
    setShowBookModal(false);
  };

  const handleStatusChange = (id, newStatus) => {
    const updated = meetings.map((m) => (m.id === id ? { ...m, status: newStatus } : m));
    saveMeetings(updated);
    showToast(`Appointment status updated to ${newStatus}.`, "info");
  };

  const filteredMeetings = meetings.filter((m) => {
    const matchesDate = !filterDate || m.date === filterDate;
    const matchesStatus = filterStatus === "ALL" || m.status === filterStatus;
    return matchesDate && matchesStatus;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-slate-100">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl shadow-cyan-500/10 flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out">
        <div>
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-400/30 text-cyan-300 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
            <span>📅</span> Executive Agenda & Scheduling
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Principal 15-Min Meeting Scheduler</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1 max-w-xl">
            Streamlined calendar integration for parents, staff, and trustees to book dedicated 15-minute consultation slots with the Executive Principal.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowBookModal(true)}
          className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 via-indigo-600 to-purple-600 hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-purple-500 text-white font-black px-5 py-3 rounded-2xl text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/20 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:scale-[1.02] cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2 border border-white/20"
        >
          <span>➕</span>
          <span>Book Appointment Slot</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Total Bookings</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-white mt-1">{meetings.length}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-cyan-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Upcoming Confirmed</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-cyan-400 mt-1">
            {meetings.filter((m) => m.status === "Confirmed").length}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Concluded</p>

        <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">

              Clear
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {["ALL", "Confirmed", "Completed", "Cancelled"].map((s) => (
            <button
              key={s}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";

const STAFF_CATEGORIES = [
  "Driver",
  "Cleaner",
  "Gardener",
  "Security Guard",
  "Lab Assistant",
  "Administrative Helper",
  "Cafeteria Staff",
];

const CATEGORY_COLORS = {
  Driver: "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border-blue-500/30",
  Cleaner: "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30",
  Gardener: "bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-300 border-teal-500/30",
  "Security Guard": "bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border-purple-500/30",
  "Lab Assistant": "bg-indigo-500/20 text-indigo-300 border-indigo-500/30",
  "Administrative Helper": "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30",
  "Cafeteria Staff": "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/30",
};

export default function NonTeachingStaffManager({ schoolId: propSchoolId }) {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = propSchoolId || user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const [staffList, setStaffList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showAddForm, setShowAddForm] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState("ALL");

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    fullName: "",
    category: "Security Guard",
    phone: "",
    shiftTiming: "Morning Shift (06:30 AM - 02:30 PM)",
    joiningDate: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    salary: "₹18,000",
  });

  const loadStaff = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_non_teaching_staff_${schoolId}`);
      if (saved) {
        setStaffList(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setStaffList([]);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Non-teaching staff load notice:", e);
      setStaffList([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadStaff();
    const handleUpdate = () => loadStaff();
    window.addEventListener("erp-non-teaching-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("erp-non-teaching-updated", handleUpdate);
  }, [schoolId]);

  const handleAddStaff = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.fullName.trim() || !form.phone.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide staff full name and direct telephone number.", "error");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    const newStaff = {
      id: `staff_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 4)}`,
      school_id: schoolId,
      fullName: form.fullName.trim(),
      category: form.category,
      phone: form.phone.trim(),
      shiftTiming: form.shiftTiming.trim() || "Full Day Shift",
      joiningDate: form.joiningDate || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
      salary: form.salary.trim() || "₹15,000",
      status: "Active Duty",
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    // 1. Save to non-teaching local registry
    const updated = [newStaff, ...staffList];
    setStaffList(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_non_teaching_staff_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Also register in local institutional directory so other staff can see support contact
    try {
      const dirKey = `erp_directory_${schoolId}`;
      const existingDir = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(dirKey) || "[]");
      const dirRecord = {
        id: newStaff.id,
        name: newStaff.fullName,
        full_name: newStaff.fullName,
        role: "staff",
        role_code: `STAFF-${newStaff.category.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase()}-${Date.now().toString().slice(-3)}`,
        category: newStaff.category,
        dept: `${newStaff.category} (Support Services)`,
        phone: newStaff.phone,
        email: `${newStaff.fullName.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")}@${String(schoolId).toLowerCase()}.internal`,
        school_id: schoolId,
        institution_code: schoolId,
      };
      existingDir.push(dirRecord);
      localStorage.setItem(dirKey, JSON.stringify(existingDir));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-directory-updated"));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Directory sync notice:", e);
    }

    // 3. Security audit log
    logSecurityAction({
      action: "Non-Teaching Personnel Onboarded",
      entityType: "STAFF",
      entityId: newStaff.fullName,
      details: `Onboarded ${newStaff.category} "${newStaff.fullName}" (Shift: ${newStaff.shiftTiming})`,
      user,
      schoolId,
    });

    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-non-teaching-updated"));
    showToast(`Added ${newStaff.category} "${newStaff.fullName}" to institutional roster!`, "success");

    setForm({
      fullName: "",
      category: "Security Guard",
      phone: "",
      shiftTiming: "Morning Shift (06:30 AM - 02:30 PM)",
      joiningDate: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
      salary: "₹18,000",
    });
    setShowAddForm(false);
    setSubmitting(false);
  };

  const handleRemoveStaff = (id, staffName) => {
    const updated = staffList.filter((s) => s.id !== id);
    setStaffList(updated);

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_non_teaching_staff_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-non-teaching-updated"));

      // Also clean from erp_directory
      const dirKey = `erp_directory_${schoolId}`;
      const existingDir = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(dirKey) || "[]");
      const updatedDir = existingDir.filter((d) => d.id !== id);
      localStorage.setItem(dirKey, JSON.stringify(updatedDir));
```

```javascript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Download, Upload, X, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, FileSpreadsheet, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { getNextMemberId } from "../utils/idGenerator";

const SAMPLE_CSV = `name,role,class_name,phone,email,annual_fees
Aarav Mehta,student,Class 10-ICSE,+91 9820112233,aarav@school.edu,45000
Pooja Sharma,teacher,Mathematics,+91 9820112244,pooja@school.edu,
Rajesh Verma,accountant,Accounts,+91 9820112255,rajesh@school.edu,
Suresh Yadav,staff,Operations,+91 9820112266,suresh@school.edu,
Rohan Deshmukh,student,Class 9-A,+91 9820112277,rohan@school.edu,40000`;

export default function OnboardingWizard({ isOpen, onClose, schoolId, onComplete }) {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("upload"); // 'upload' | 'preview' | 'complete'
  const [targetType, setTargetType] = useState("student"); // 'student' | 'teacher' | 'accountant' | 'staff'
  const [parsedRows, setParsedRows] = useState([]);
  const [validationErrors, setValidationErrors] = useState([]);
  const [canCommit, setCanCommit] = useState(false);
  const [hasBackup, setHasBackup] = useState(false);
  const [preMigrationBackup, setPreMigrationBackup] = useState(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const activeSchoolCode = String(schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();

  const handleDownloadSample = () => {
    const blob = new Blob([SAMPLE_CSV], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.download = `${activeSchoolCode.toLowerCase()}_migration_template.csv`;
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    showToast("Downloaded sample migration template", "success");
  };

  const handleFileUpload = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (evt) => {
      try {
        const text = evt.target.result;
        parseAndValidateCsv(text);
      } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message || "Invalid CSV format", "error");
      }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  const parseAndValidateCsv = (text) => {
    const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (lines.length < 2) {
      throw new Error("CSV must include a header and at least one data row.");
    }

    const headers = lines[0].split(",").map((h) => h.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/['"]/g, ""));
    const errors = [];
    const rows = [];

    // Existing directory for duplicate roll number detection
    const dirKey = `erp_directory_${activeSchoolCode}`;
    let existingDir = [];
    try {
      existingDir = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(dirKey) || "[]");
    } catch {}

    const existingPhones = new Set(existingDir.map((m) => (m.phone || "").replace(/\s+/g, "")));

    lines.slice(1).forEach((line, idx) => {
      const rowIdx = idx + 2;
      const values = line.split(",").map((v) => v.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, ""));
      const rowObj = {};
      headers.forEach((h, i) => {
        rowObj[h] = values[i] || "";
      });

      const rowErrors = [];
      const name = rowObj.name || rowObj.full_name || "";
      const role = (rowObj.role || targetType).toLowerCase();
      const phone = (rowObj.phone || "").trim();
      const email = (rowObj.email || "").trim();
      const className = rowObj.class_name || rowObj.class || "General";
      const annualFees = rowObj.annual_fees ? Number(rowObj.annual_fees) : 45000;

      if (!name) rowErrors.push("Missing full name");
      if (!phone || phone.length < 8) rowErrors.push("Invalid phone number");
      if (email && !email.includes("@")) rowErrors.push("Malformed email address");
      if (existingPhones.has(phone.replace(/\s+/g, ""))) {
        rowErrors.push("Duplicate phone number (already registered)");
      }

      const assignedId = getNextMemberId(role, existingDir, []);
      existingDir.push({ roll_number: assignedId, role });

      const parsedItem = {
        rowNumber: rowIdx,
        id: assignedId,
        name,
        role,
        class_name: className,
        phone,
        email,
        annualFees,
        errors: rowErrors,
        isValid: rowErrors.length === 0,
      };

      if (rowErrors.length > 0) {
        errors.push({ row: rowIdx, errors: rowErrors });
      }

      rows.push(parsedItem);
    });

    setParsedRows(rows);
    setValidationErrors(errors);
    setCanCommit(errors.length === 0);
    setActiveTab("preview");

    if (errors.length > 0) {
      showToast(`Dry-run validation found ${errors.length} row error(s). Please review.`, "warning");
    } else {
      showToast(`Dry-run successful! ${rows.length} rows verified with zero errors.`, "success");
    }
  };

  const handleCommitMigration = () => {
    if (!canCommit) {
      showToast("Cannot commit data with validation errors.", "error");
      return;
    }

    try {
      const dirKey = `erp_directory_${activeSchoolCode}`;
      const currentDir = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(dirKey) || "[]");

      // Save pre-migration backup for 1-click rollback
      setPreMigrationBackup([...currentDir]);
      setHasBackup(true);

      const newMembers = parsedRows.map((r) => ({
        id: r.id,
        roll_number: r.id,
        name: r.name,
        full_name: r.name,
        role: r.role,
        class_name: r.class_name,
        phone: r.phone,
        email: r.email,
        totalFees: r.annualFees,
        paidFees: 0,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        institution_code: activeSchoolCode,
        school_id: activeSchoolCode,
      }));

      const merged = [...currentDir, ...newMembers];
      localStorage.setItem(dirKey, JSON.stringify(merged));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-directory-updated"));

      showToast(`Successfully enrolled ${newMembers.length} records! 🚀`, "success");
      setActiveTab("complete");
      if (onComplete) onComplete(newMembers);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Migration error:", err);
      showToast("Failed to commit migration", "error");
    }
  };

  const handleRollback = () => {
    if (!preMigrationBackup) return;
    try {
      const dirKey = `erp_directory_${activeSchoolCode}`;
      localStorage.setItem(dirKey, JSON.stringify(preMigrationBackup));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-directory-updated"));
      setHasBackup(false);
      showToast("Rollback executed! Directory reverted to pre-migration state.", "info");
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      showToast("Rollback failed", "error");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
        {/* MODAL HEADER */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-4">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-400">
              Zero-Touch Enterprise Onboarding
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>Dry-Run CSV Migration Wizard</span>
              <FileSpreadsheet className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-400" />
            </h2>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* BODY CONTENT */}
        <div className="py-4 flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-4">
          {activeTab === "upload" && (
            <div className="space-y-6">
              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-xs text-slate-300">
                <p className="font-bold text-white mb-1">Instant Bulk Onboarding with Pre-Commit Verification</p>
                <p>
                  Upload your legacy student, faculty, accountant, or operations staff spreadsheet. The engine will run a non-destructive dry-run, detect duplicates, and highlight validation issues before writing to storage.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleDownloadSample}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
                  <span>Download Sample CSV Template</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-white/20 hover:border-cyan-500/50 rounded-2xl p-8 text-center bg-white/5 transition-all">
                <input
                  type="file"
                  id="csvFileInput"
                  accept=".csv,text/csv"
                  onChange={handleFileUpload}
                  className="hidden"
                />
                <label
                  htmlFor="csvFileInput"
                  className="cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2"
                >
                  <Upload className="w-10 h-10 text-cyan-400" />
                  <p className="text-sm font-bold text-white">Click or drag CSV file to start dry-run validation</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Supported: UTF-8 standard comma-separated text</p>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === "preview" && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">Dry-Run Evaluation Preview</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                    Total: {parsedRows.length} rows | Errors:{" "}
                    <span className={validationErrors.length > 0 ? "text-rose-400 font-bold" : "text-emerald-400 font-bold"}>
                      {validationErrors.length}
                    </span>
                  </p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveTab("upload")}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 text-slate-300 text-xs font-bold hover:bg-white/10 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Upload Another File
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="overflow-x-auto w-full max-h-72 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl">
                <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-slate-400 uppercase">
                      <th className="p-3">Row</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Assigned ID</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Full Name</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Role</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Class/Batch</th>
                      <th className="p-3">Phone</th>
                      <th className="p-3 text-center">Validation</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5">
                    {parsedRows.map((row) => (
                      <tr
                        key={row.rowNumber}
                        className={row.isValid ? "hover:bg-white/5" : "bg-rose-950/20 hover:bg-rose-950/30"}
                      >
                        <td className="p-3 font-mono text-slate-400">#{row.rowNumber}</td>
                        <td className="p-3 font-mono text-cyan-400 font-bold">{row.id}</td>
                        <td className="p-3 font-semibold text-white">{row.name}</td>
                        <td className="p-3 uppercase text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-300">{row.role}</td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-slate-400">{row.class_name}</td>
                        <td className="p-3 font-mono text-slate-300">{row.phone}</td>
                        <td className="p-3 text-center">
                          {row.isValid ? (
                            <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold text-[11px] inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Ready
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span
                              className="text-rose-400 font-bold text-[11px] inline-flex items-center gap-1"
                              title={row.errors.join(", ")}
                            >
                              <AlertCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> {row.errors[0]}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === "complete" && (
            <div className="py-12 text-center space-y-4">
              <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-3xl">
                ✓
              </div>
              <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Migration Successfully Committed!</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
                All records have been synchronized to the institutional directory. If you made a mistake, you can trigger a 1-click rollback right now.
              </p>
              {hasBackup && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleRollback}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-rose-600/20 hover:bg-rose-600/30 border border-rose-500/40 text-rose-300 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>1-Click Rollback (Revert to Pre-Migration)</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* MODAL FOOTER */}
        <div className="border-t border-white/10 pt-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-300 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            {activeTab === "complete" ? "Close Wizard" : "Cancel"}
          </button>

          {activeTab === "preview" && (
            <button
              onClick={handleCommitMigration}
              disabled={!canCommit}
              className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-black transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2 ${
                canCommit
                  ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/30"
                  : "bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 cursor-not-allowed"
              }`}
            >
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Commit & Enroll Verified Records ({parsedRows.length})</span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
        throw new Error("Camera API not supported on this device/browser.");
      }
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        video: { facingMode: "environment" },
      });
      streamRef.current = stream;
      if (videoRef.current) {
        videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;
        videoRef.current.play();
      }
      setCameraActive(true);
      showToast("Camera feed active. Align student or equipment QR code.", "info");
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Camera access error:", err);
      setCameraError(err.message || "Camera access permission denied or unavailable.");
      setCameraActive(false);
    }
  };

  const stopCamera = () => {
    if (streamRef.current) {

      streamRef.current = null;

  };

  const handleResolveId = (codeToLookup = null) => {

      return;
    }

    try {

      );

      // 2. Check asset registry if asset mode
      const assetRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_assets_${cleanSchool}`);

      const asset = assets.find((a) => (a.code || a.id || "").toUpperCase() === rawId);

      if (member) {
        const result = {
          type: "MEMBER",

          date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],

          status: "Present",

        };
        localStorage.setItem(attKey, JSON.stringify([logEntry, ...existing]));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-attendance-updated"));
        showToast(`Gate Check-in Verified: ${res.name} (${res.id}) ✅`, "success");
      } else if (scanMode === "asset") {
        showToast(`Asset Custody Logged: ${res.name} (${res.id}) 📦`, "success");
      } else {

      }
    } catch (e) {

  };

  return (

          </div>
          <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-white mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">

                scanMode === m.id
                  ? "bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 shadow-md shadow-cyan-500/20"
                  : "bg-white/5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
```

```javascript
    misconceptionExplanation: "Students commonly confuse current flow with potential difference.",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    loadQuestions();
  }, [cleanSchool]);

  const loadQuestions = () => {
    try {
      const key = `erp_question_bank_${cleanSchool}`;

        setQuestions(JSON.parse(raw));
```

```javascript
            const matched = combinedRecords.find((r) => {
              const rRoll = String(r.roll_number || r.student_id || r.id || "").trim().toUpperCase();
              return rRoll === resolvedRoll;
            });
            studentStatus = matched ? (matched.status || "present") : "present";
          }

          const isPastWorkingDay = !isSunday && !holidayEvent && dateStr < todayStr;

      isUnmarked: unmarkedDates.includes(dateStr),
    });
  }

  // Next month leading days to complete 35 or 42 grid cells
  const remainingCells = (7 - (calendarGrid.length % 7)) % 7;
  for (let i = 1; i <= remainingCells; i++) {
    calendarGrid.push({
      day: i,
      isCurrentMonth: false,
      dateStr: "",
    });
  }

  const handleCellClick = (cell) => {
    if (!cell.isCurrentMonth) return;
    setSelectedDayDetails(cell);
    if (typeof onSelectDate === "function") {
      onSelectDate(cell.dateStr);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-7 shadow-xl transition-all ${className}`}>
      {/* CALENDAR HEADER & CONTROLS */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 mb-6 pb-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <span className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400 border border-cyan-500/20">
              <CalendarIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400">
              Academic OS Calendar
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
              {activeMode === "teacher" ? `Faculty View (${resolvedClass})` : "Student Scholar View"}
            </span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            {MONTH_NAMES[currentMonth]} {currentYear}
          </h2>
        </div>

        {/* Action Controls & Navigation */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={jumpToToday}
            className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm"
          >
            Today
          </button>
          <div className="flex items-center bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl p-1 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={prevMonth}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Previous Month"
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={nextMonth}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-lg text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-white dark:hover:bg-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Next Month"
            >
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* TEACHER CRITICAL ATTENDANCE ALERT BANNER */}
      {activeMode === "teacher" && unmarkedDates.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-6 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3 animate-fade-in shadow-lg shadow-rose-500/5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-500 dark:text-rose-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 animate-pulse" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold text-rose-800 dark:text-rose-200">
                🔴 Attendance Missing on {unmarkedDates.length} Past Working Day{unmarkedDates.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-300/80">
                Class register for <span className="font-semibold">{resolvedClass}</span> is pending submission. Unmarked dates are highlighted in red below.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => navigate(`/teacher/attendance?date=${unmarkedDates[0]}&batch=${encodeURIComponent(resolvedClass)}`)}
            className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-xl shadow-md transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
          >
            <span>Mark {formatDisplayDate(unmarkedDates[0])}</span>
            <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* STUDENT ATTENDANCE LEGEND (STUDENT VIEW) */}
      {activeMode === "student" && (
        <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/60 p-2.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/5">
          <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">Attendance Key:</span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>
              <span>Present</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500"></span>
              <span>Absent</span>
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500"></span>
              <span>Holiday / Weekend</span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* CALENDAR DAYS OF WEEK HEADER */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-2 mb-2 text-center">
        {DAYS_OF_WEEK.map((day, idx) => (
          <div
            key={day}
            className={`text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider py-1.5 ${
              idx === 0 ? "text-rose-500" : "text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"
            }`}
          >
            {day}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* CALENDAR 7-COLUMN GRID */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5 sm:gap-2.5">
        {calendarGrid.map((cell, idx) => {
          if (!cell.isCurrentMonth) {
            return (
              <div
                key={`empty-${idx}`}
                className="min-h-[70px] sm:min-h-[85px] p-2 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/20 border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/20 opacity-30 pointer-events-none"
              >
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">{cell.day}</span>

          return (
            <div
              key={cell.dateStr}
              onClick={() => handleCellClick(cell)}
              className={`min-h-[70px] sm:min-h-[85px] p-2 sm:p-2.5 rounded-2xl border transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer relative flex flex-col justify-between group hover:scale-[1.02] ${
                cell.isToday
                  ? "border-cyan-500/80 bg-cyan-500/5 dark:bg-cyan-500/10 shadow-md shadow-cyan-500/10"
                  : isUnmarkedTeacher
                  ? "border-rose-500/80 bg-rose-500/10 dark:bg-rose-950/30 animate-pulse"
                  : cell.isHoliday
                  ? "border-amber-400/40 bg-amber-500/5 dark:bg-amber-500/10"
                  : cell.isSunday
                  ? "border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/30 text-rose-400"
                  : "border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/80 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/40 hover:border-cyan-400/50"
              }`}
            >
              {/* Day Number & Status Badges */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <span

                {isUnmarkedTeacher && (
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-rose-500 bg-rose-500/20 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md border border-rose-500/40 shrink-0">

                {activeMode === "teacher" && cell.hasAttendance && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-500" title="Attendance register marked">

                  </span>
                )}

                {/* Student View: Status Indicator (Present / Absent / Holiday) */}
                {activeMode === "student" && (
                  <div>
                    {cell.isHoliday || cell.isSunday ? (
                      <span className="text-xs" title={cell.holidayName || "Weekend / Non-working day"}>
                        🏖️
                      </span>
                    ) : cell.studentStatus === "present" ? (
                      <span className="inline-block w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 shadow-sm shadow-emerald-500/50" title="Present"></span>
                    ) : cell.studentStatus === "absent" ? (
                      <span className="inline-block w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500 shadow-sm shadow-rose-500/50" title="Absent"></span>
                    ) : null}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Event / Holiday Title Pill */}
              <div className="mt-1">
                {cell.holidayName ? (
                  <p className="text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 truncate leading-tight">
                    {cell.holidayName}
                  </p>
                ) : isUnmarkedTeacher ? (
                  <p className="text-[9px] font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 truncate">
                    Mark Register
                  </p>
                ) : activeMode === "student" && cell.studentStatus ? (
                  <p
                    className={`text-[9px] font-bold truncate ${
                      cell.studentStatus === "present"
                        ? "text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                        : "text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {cell.studentStatus === "present" ? "🟢 Present" : "🔴 Absent"}
```
