  const newTest = {
    id: testId,
    school_id: cleanSchoolId,
    class_id: classId.trim(),
    section: section ? section.trim() : "",
    subject: subject.trim(),
    title: title.trim(),
    test_date: testDate || now.split("T")[0],
    max_score: numMax,
    passing_score: numPass,
    highest_score: null,
    status: "draft",
    created_by: actor?.name || actor?.id || "Faculty",
    created_by_role: actor?.role || "TCH",
    created_at: now,
    updated_by: actor?.name || "Faculty",
    updated_at: now,
    published_by: null,
    published_at: null,
  };

  // 1. Persist to Supabase if available
  if (supabase) {
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase.from("class_tests").insert([newTest]);
      if (error) console.warn("[ClassTestMarksService] Supabase class_tests insert warning:", error.message);
    } catch {
      // Non-blocking fallback
    }
  }

  // 2. Persist to tenant local storage
  if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const key = `erp_class_tests_${cleanSchoolId}`;
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || "[]");
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify([newTest, ...existing]));
    } catch {
      // Non-blocking
    }
  }

  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-tests-updated"));
  }

  return newTest;
}

/**
 * Saves and validates marks entered for a student roster
 * Supports saving as 'draft' or immediate 'published'
 */
export async function saveClassTestScores({
  schoolId,
  testId,
  scoresList,
  actor,
  publish = false,
}) {
  const cleanSchoolId = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();

  if (!testId) throw new Error("Test ID is required.");
  if (!Array.isArray(scoresList) || scoresList.length === 0) {
    throw new Error("No student scores provided to save.");
  }

  // 1. Fetch existing test header to verify permissions and ceiling
  let testHeader = await getClassTestDetails(cleanSchoolId, testId, actor);
  if (!testHeader) {
    throw new Error("Class test not found in institutional records.");
  }

  if (actor && !isTeacherAuthorizedForClass(actor, testHeader.class_id)) {
    throw new Error(`Unauthorized: You do not have permission to modify marks for ${testHeader.class_id}.`);
  }

  const maxScore = Number(testHeader.max_score) || 20;

  // 2. Validate and deduplicate marks
  const studentSeen = new Set();
  const validatedScores = [];
  let highestScore = 0;
  let hasValidPresentStudent = false;

  for (const s of scoresList) {
    if (!s.student_id) continue;

    if (studentSeen.has(s.student_id)) {
      throw new Error(`Duplicate entry detected for student ID: ${s.student_id}. Each student may only receive one score.`);
    }
    studentSeen.add(s.student_id);

    const isAbsent = Boolean(s.is_absent);
    let marksObtained = 0;

    if (!isAbsent) {
      marksObtained = validateMarksInput(s.marks_obtained, maxScore);
      if (marksObtained > highestScore) {
        highestScore = marksObtained;
      }
      hasValidPresentStudent = true;
    }

    validatedScores.push({
      id: s.id || (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : `score_${s.student_id}_${Date.now()}`),
      test_id: testId,
      school_id: cleanSchoolId,
      student_id: String(s.student_id).trim(),
      student_name: s.student_name ? s.student_name.trim() : "Student",
      roll_number: String(s.roll_number || s.student_id).trim(),
      marks_obtained: marksObtained,
      max_score: maxScore,
      is_absent: isAbsent,
      remarks: s.remarks ? s.remarks.trim() : (isAbsent ? "Absent" : "Completed"),
      created_at: s.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  }

  const finalHighest = hasValidPresentStudent ? highestScore : 0;
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const nextStatus = publish ? "published" : testHeader.status || "draft";

  // 3. Update test header
  const updatedHeader = {
    ...testHeader,
    highest_score: finalHighest,
    status: nextStatus,
    updated_by: actor?.name || "Faculty",
    updated_at: now,
    ...(publish ? { published_by: actor?.name || "Faculty", published_at: now } : {}),
  };

  // 4. Persist to Supabase
  if (supabase) {
    try {
      // Upsert test header
      await supabase.from("class_tests").upsert([updatedHeader]);

      // Upsert student scores
      await supabase.from("test_scores").upsert(validatedScores, { onConflict: "test_id,student_id" });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[ClassTestMarksService] Supabase scores save warning:", e);
    }
  }

  // 5. Persist to LocalStorage
  if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
    try {
      // Update tests list
      const testsKey = `erp_class_tests_${cleanSchoolId}`;
      const existingTests = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(testsKey) || "[]");
      const filteredTests = existingTests.filter((t) => t.id !== testId);
      localStorage.setItem(testsKey, JSON.stringify([updatedHeader, ...filteredTests]));

      // Update scores list
      const scoresKey = `erp_test_scores_${cleanSchoolId}`;
      const existingScores = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(scoresKey) || "[]");
      const filteredScores = existingScores.filter((sc) => sc.test_id !== testId);
      localStorage.setItem(scoresKey, JSON.stringify([...validatedScores, ...filteredScores]));
    } catch {
      // Non-blocking
    }
  }

  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-tests-updated"));
  }

  return {
    test: updatedHeader,
    scoresCount: validatedScores.length,
    highestScore: finalHighest,
    status: nextStatus,
  };
}

/**
 * Publishes an existing draft test
 */
export async function publishClassTest({ schoolId, testId, actor }) {
  const cleanSchoolId = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();
  const test = await getClassTestDetails(cleanSchoolId, testId, actor);
  if (!test) throw new Error("Test not found.");

  if (actor && !isTeacherAuthorizedForClass(actor, test.class_id)) {
    throw new Error(`Unauthorized: You cannot publish marks for ${test.class_id}.`);
  }

  const scores = await getScoresForTest(cleanSchoolId, testId);
  const present = scores.filter((s) => !s.is_absent);
  const highestScore = present.length > 0 ? Math.max(...present.map((p) => Number(p.marks_obtained) || 0)) : 0;
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const updated = {
    ...test,
    status: "published",
    highest_score: highestScore,
    published_by: actor?.name || "Faculty",
    published_at: now,
    updated_at: now,
  };

  if (supabase) {
    try {
      await supabase.from("class_tests").upsert([updated]);
    } catch {}
  }

  if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const testsKey = `erp_class_tests_${cleanSchoolId}`;
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(testsKey) || "[]");
      const filtered = existing.filter((t) => t.id !== testId);
      localStorage.setItem(testsKey, JSON.stringify([updated, ...filtered]));
    } catch {}
  }

  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-tests-updated"));
  }

  return updated;
}

/**
 * Get tests belonging to a teacher's assigned classes
 */
export async function getClassTestsForTeacher({ schoolId, classId = "", subject = "", actor }) {
  const cleanSchoolId = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();
  let tests = [];

  // 1. Supabase
  if (supabase) {
    try {
      let query = supabase
        .from("class_tests")
        .select("*")
        .eq("school_id", cleanSchoolId)
        .order("test_date", { ascending: false });

      if (classId) query = query.eq("class_id", classId);
      if (subject) query = query.eq("subject", subject);

      const { data, error } = await query;
      if (!error && data && data.length > 0) tests = data;
    } catch {}
  }

  // 2. Local storage
  if (tests.length === 0 && typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_class_tests_${cleanSchoolId}`);
      if (raw) {
        tests = JSON.parse(raw);
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  // Filter by teacher assignment if actor is faculty
  if (actor && actor.role && !["PRIN", "HOD", "ADMIN", "PRINCIPAL", "TRUSTEE"].some((r) => (actor.role || "").toUpperCase().includes(r))) {
    tests = tests.filter((t) => isTeacherAuthorizedForClass(actor, t.class_id));
  }

  if (classId) {
    tests = tests.filter((t) => String(t.class_id).toLowerCase() === classId.toLowerCase());
  }
  if (subject) {
    tests = tests.filter((t) => String(t.subject).toLowerCase() === subject.toLowerCase());
  }

  return tests.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.test_date || b.created_at) - new Date(a.test_date || a.created_at));
}

/**
 * Get all scores for a specific test (Teacher / Admin view)
 */
export async function getScoresForTest(schoolId, testId) {
  const cleanSchoolId = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();
  let scores = [];

  if (supabase) {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("test_scores")
        .select("*")
        .eq("school_id", cleanSchoolId)
        .eq("test_id", testId)
        .order("roll_number", { ascending: true });
      if (!error && data && data.length > 0) scores = data;
    } catch {}
  }

  if (scores.length === 0 && typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_test_scores_${cleanSchoolId}`);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        scores = parsed.filter((s) => s.test_id === testId);
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  return scores.sort((a, b) => String(a.roll_number).localeCompare(String(b.roll_number), undefined, { numeric: true }));
}

/**
 * Get test header and scores
 */
export async function getClassTestDetails(schoolId, testId, _actor) {
  const cleanSchoolId = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();
  let test = null;

  if (supabase) {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("class_tests")
        .select("*")
        .eq("school_id", cleanSchoolId)
        .eq("id", testId)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (!error && data) test = data;
    } catch {}
  }

  if (!test && typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_class_tests_${cleanSchoolId}`);
      if (raw) {
        const list = JSON.parse(raw);
        test = list.find((t) => t.id === testId) || null;
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  return test;
}

/**
 * CRITICAL PRIVACY REQUIREMENT:
 * Student Portal - Private Marks Retrieval
 * Returns ONLY the student's own marks and the class highest score.
 * NEVER returns other students' names, roll numbers, or individual mark sheets.
 * Excludes unpublished (draft) tests completely.
 */
export async function getStudentPublishedMarks({ schoolId, studentId, studentRoll }) {
  const cleanSchoolId = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();
  const cleanStudentId = String(studentId || "").trim();
  const cleanRoll = String(studentRoll || "").trim().toUpperCase();

  if (!cleanStudentId && !cleanRoll) {
    return [];
  }

  let publishedMarks = [];

  // 1. Try Supabase via RPC or Join with RLS
  if (supabase) {
    try {
      // Secure RPC call
      const { data: rpcData, error: rpcErr } = await supabase.rpc("get_student_published_test_marks", {
        p_school_id: cleanSchoolId,
        p_student_id: cleanStudentId || cleanRoll,
      });

      if (!rpcErr && rpcData && rpcData.length > 0) {
        return rpcData.map((d) => ({
          test_id: d.test_id,
          title: d.title,
          subject: d.subject,
          class_id: d.class_id,
          section: d.section,
          test_date: d.test_date,
          marks_obtained: Number(d.marks_obtained),
          max_score: Number(d.max_score),
          class_highest: Number(d.class_highest),
          is_absent: Boolean(d.is_absent),
          remarks: d.remarks || (d.is_absent ? "Absent" : "Evaluated"),
          status: "published",
        }));
      }

      // Direct RLS query: Only select test_scores joined with published class_tests
      const { data: scoreData, error: scoreErr } = await supabase
        .from("test_scores")
        .select(`
          id,
          test_id,
          student_id,
          roll_number,
          marks_obtained,
          max_score,
          is_absent,
          remarks,
          created_at,
          class_tests!inner (
            id,
            title,
            subject,
            class_id,
            section,
            test_date,
            max_score,
            highest_score,
            status
          )
        `)
        .eq("school_id", cleanSchoolId)
        .eq("class_tests.status", "published")
        .or(`student_id.eq.${cleanStudentId},roll_number.eq.${cleanRoll}`);

      if (!scoreErr && scoreData && scoreData.length > 0) {
        return scoreData.map((row) => {
          const ct = row.class_tests || {};
          const myMarks = Number(row.marks_obtained);
          const max = Number(ct.max_score || row.max_score) || 20;
          const highest = Number(ct.highest_score) || myMarks;

          return {
            test_id: row.test_id,
            title: ct.title || "Class Assessment",
            subject: ct.subject || "General",
            class_id: ct.class_id,
            section: ct.section,
            test_date: ct.test_date || row.created_at?.split("T")[0],
            marks_obtained: myMarks,
            max_score: max,
            class_highest: highest,
            is_absent: Boolean(row.is_absent),
            remarks: row.remarks || (row.is_absent ? "Absent" : "Evaluated"),
            status: "published",
          };
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[ClassTestMarksService] Supabase student marks fetch notice:", e);
    }
  }

  // 2. LocalStorage Fallback (with strict privacy filtering)
  if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const testsKey = `erp_class_tests_${cleanSchoolId}`;
      const scoresKey = `erp_test_scores_${cleanSchoolId}`;

      const allTests = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(testsKey) || "[]");
      const allScores = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(scoresKey) || "[]");

      // Filter tests to strictly PUBLISHED ones
      const publishedTestMap = new Map();
      allTests.forEach((t) => {
        if (t.status === "published") {
          publishedTestMap.set(t.id, t);
        }
      });

      // Filter scores to strictly THIS student's records for published tests
      const myRows = allScores.filter((sc) => {
        if (!publishedTestMap.has(sc.test_id)) return false;
        const matchesId = cleanStudentId && String(sc.student_id).trim() === cleanStudentId;
        const matchesRoll = cleanRoll && String(sc.roll_number).trim().toUpperCase() === cleanRoll;
        return matchesId || matchesRoll;
      });

      publishedMarks = myRows.map((sc) => {
        const test = publishedTestMap.get(sc.test_id);
        const myMarks = Number(sc.marks_obtained) || 0;
        const max = Number(test.max_score) || Number(sc.max_score) || 20;
        const highest = Number(test.highest_score) || myMarks;

        // SANITIZED OBJECT: Zero other student identities or peer marks
        return {
          test_id: sc.test_id,
          title: test.title,
          subject: test.subject,
          class_id: test.class_id,
          section: test.section,
          test_date: test.test_date,
          marks_obtained: myMarks,
          max_score: max,
          class_highest: highest,
          is_absent: Boolean(sc.is_absent),
          remarks: sc.remarks || (sc.is_absent ? "Absent" : "Evaluated"),
          status: "published",
        };
      });
    } catch {
      // Non-blocking
    }
  }

  return publishedMarks.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.test_date) - new Date(a.test_date));
}

import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";

/**
 * EXAMINATION CONTROL & ASSESSMENT ENGINE
 * Grade scale calculations (CBSE 9-Point & GPA), Marks Moderation,
 * Hall Seating Plans, and Result Finalization Protection.
 */

export const GRADING_SCALES = {
  CBSE_9_POINT: [
    { grade: "A1", minPct: 91, maxPct: 100, point: 10.0, remark: "Outstanding" },
    { grade: "A2", minPct: 81, maxPct: 90, point: 9.0, remark: "Excellent" },
    { grade: "B1", minPct: 71, maxPct: 80, point: 8.0, remark: "Very Good" },
    { grade: "B2", minPct: 61, maxPct: 70, point: 7.0, remark: "Good" },
    { grade: "C1", minPct: 51, maxPct: 60, point: 6.0, remark: "Satisfactory" },
    { grade: "C2", minPct: 41, maxPct: 50, point: 5.0, remark: "Acceptable" },
    { grade: "D", minPct: 33, maxPct: 40, point: 4.0, remark: "Marginal Pass" },
    { grade: "E", minPct: 0, maxPct: 32, point: 0.0, remark: "Essential Repeat / Needs Improvement" },
  ],
};

/**
 * Calculates letter grade based on percentage marks
 */
export function calculateGrade(marksObtained, maxMarks = 100) {
  const num = Number(marksObtained) || 0;
  const max = Number(maxMarks) || 100;
  const pct = Math.round((num / max) * 100);

  const scale = GRADING_SCALES.CBSE_9_POINT;
  const match = scale.find((s) => pct >= s.minPct && pct <= s.maxPct);
  return match || { grade: "E", point: 0.0, remark: "Needs Improvement" };
}

/**
 * Validates marks entry: prevents negative or over-the-ceiling scores
 */
export function validateMarksEntry(marks, maxMarks = 100) {
  const m = Number(marks);
  const max = Number(maxMarks);

  if (isNaN(m)) throw new Error("Marks must be a valid numeric quantity.");
  if (m < 0) throw new Error("Marks cannot be negative.");
  if (m > max) throw new Error(`Marks entered (${m}) exceed maximum allowable score (${max}).`);
  return true;
}

/**
 * Enterprise Offline-First Field & Classroom Queue Service
 * Allows teachers, accountants, and staff to perform attendance, marks, and fee operations offline.
 * Operations are assigned a unique operation ID and idempotency key, persisted locally,
 * and automatically synchronized with conflict resolution once connectivity is restored.
 */

const STORAGE_PREFIX = "erp_offline_queue_";

/**
 * Generate a cryptographically distinct UUID-like ID
 */
function generateUniqueId(prefix = "op") {
  return `${prefix}_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 9)}`;
}

/**
 * Retrieve the offline operation queue for a specific tenant
 */
export function getOfflineQueue(schoolCode = "CAMPUS-01") {
  try {
    const key = `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${schoolCode.toUpperCase()}`;
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to read offline queue:", err);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Get count of pending unsynced operations
 */
export function getPendingQueueCount(schoolCode = "CAMPUS-01") {
  const queue = getOfflineQueue(schoolCode);
  return queue.filter((item) => item.status === "pending").length;
}

/**
 * Enqueue an operation to the offline ledger
 * @param {string} schoolCode
 * @param {'ATTENDANCE_RECORD' | 'MARKS_ENTRY' | 'FEE_PAYMENT'} type
 * @param {object} payload
 * @param {object} metadata
 */
export function queueOfflineOperation(schoolCode = "CAMPUS-01", type, payload, metadata = {}) {
  const cleanSchool = schoolCode.toUpperCase();
  const key = `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${cleanSchool}`;
  const queue = getOfflineQueue(cleanSchool);

  const operation = {
    id: generateUniqueId("op"),
    idempotencyKey: generateUniqueId("idemp"),
    schoolCode: cleanSchool,
    type,
    payload,
    metadata: {
      ...metadata,
      queuedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      userAgent: typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.userAgent : "Node",
      networkStatus: typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.onLine ? "online" : "offline",
    },
    status: "pending", // 'pending' | 'synced' | 'failed'
    retryCount: 0,
    error: null,
  };

  const updated = [operation, ...queue];
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(updated));
    dispatchQueueUpdate(cleanSchool, updated);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to store offline operation:", err);
  }

  // Attempt instant background sync if currently online
  if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.onLine) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      syncOfflineQueue(cleanSchool);
    }, 100);
  }

  return operation;
}

/**
 * Remove an item from the queue
 */
export function removeQueueItem(schoolCode = "CAMPUS-01", operationId) {
  const cleanSchool = schoolCode.toUpperCase();
  const key = `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${cleanSchool}`;
  const queue = getOfflineQueue(cleanSchool);
  const updated = queue.filter((item) => item.id !== operationId);
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(updated));
    dispatchQueueUpdate(cleanSchool, updated);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to remove item from queue:", err);
  }
  return updated;
}

/**
 * Clear all synced items or entire queue
 */
export function clearOfflineQueue(schoolCode = "CAMPUS-01", onlySynced = false) {
  const cleanSchool = schoolCode.toUpperCase();
  const key = `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${cleanSchool}`;
  if (!onlySynced) {
    localStorage.removeItem(key);
    dispatchQueueUpdate(cleanSchool, []);
    return [];
  }
  const queue = getOfflineQueue(cleanSchool);
  const remaining = queue.filter((item) => item.status === "pending");
  localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(remaining));
  dispatchQueueUpdate(cleanSchool, remaining);
  return remaining;
}

/**
 * Dispatch DOM event so Navbar and UI components update reactively
 */
function dispatchQueueUpdate(schoolCode, queue) {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    const event = new CustomEvent("erp-offline-queue-updated", {
      detail: { schoolCode, count: queue.filter((i) => i.status === "pending").length, queue },
    });
    window.dispatchEvent(event);
  }
}

/**
 * Replay and synchronize pending offline items
 */
export async function syncOfflineQueue(schoolCode = "CAMPUS-01", customHandler = null) {
  const cleanSchool = schoolCode.toUpperCase();
  const queue = getOfflineQueue(cleanSchool);
  const pending = queue.filter((item) => item.status === "pending");

  if (pending.length === 0) return { synced: 0, failed: 0 };

  let syncedCount = 0;
  let failedCount = 0;

  const updatedQueue = [...queue];

  for (let i = 0; i < updatedQueue.length; i++) {
    const item = updatedQueue[i];
    if (item.status !== "pending") continue;

    try {
      if (customHandler) {
        await customHandler(item);
      } else {
        // Built-in sync handling by operation type
        await executeDefaultSync(item, cleanSchool);
      }
      item.status = "synced";
      item.syncedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      syncedCount++;
    } catch (err) {
      item.retryCount = (item.retryCount || 0) + 1;
      item.error = err.message || "Sync failed";
      if (item.retryCount >= 5) {
        item.status = "failed";
      }
      failedCount++;
    }
  }

  try {
    const key = `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${cleanSchool}`;
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(updatedQueue));
    dispatchQueueUpdate(cleanSchool, updatedQueue);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to update queue state post-sync:", err);
  }

  return { synced: syncedCount, failed: failedCount };
}

/**
 * Internal executor for syncing operations to local repositories
 */
async function executeDefaultSync(item, schoolCode) {
  const { type, payload } = item;

  switch (type) {
    case "ATTENDANCE_RECORD": {
      // Synchronize with tenant attendance store
      const storageKey = `erp_attendance_${schoolCode}`;
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "[]");
      const updated = [payload, ...existing.filter((e) => e.date !== payload.date || e.studentId !== payload.studentId)];
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
      break;
    }
    case "MARKS_ENTRY": {
      // Synchronize with exam marks store
      const storageKey = `erp_exam_marks_${schoolCode}`;
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "[]");
      const updated = [payload, ...existing.filter((m) => m.id !== payload.id)];
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
      break;
    }
    case "FEE_PAYMENT": {
      // Synchronize with fee ledger store
      const storageKey = `erp_fee_ledger_${schoolCode}`;
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "[]");
      const updated = [payload, ...existing.filter((f) => f.id !== payload.id)];
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
      break;
    }
    default:
      console.warn(`Unknown offline operation type: ${type}`);
  }
}

// Global window event listener to auto-trigger queue replay when coming online
if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  window.addEventListener("online", () => {
    try {
      // Scan all tenant offline queues and sync
      Object.keys(localStorage).forEach((key) => {
        if (key.startsWith(STORAGE_PREFIX)) {
          const schoolCode = key.replace(STORAGE_PREFIX, "");
          syncOfflineQueue(schoolCode);
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Online auto-sync trigger notice:", e);
    }
  });
}

    is_active: true,
  },

/**
 * Fetch live subscription tiers from Supabase (with fallback to canonical schema)
 */
export async function fetchSubscriptionTiers() {
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("subscription_tiers")
      .select("*")
      .order("monthly_price", { ascending: true });

    if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
      return data;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.info("[Pricing Engine] Using canonical subscription tiers fallback:", err.message);
  }

  return CANONICAL_SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS;
}

/**
 * Validates a promo discount code against Supabase / active registry
 */
export async function validatePromoCode(rawCode, tierId = "growth", baseAmount = 14999) {
  if (!rawCode || typeof rawCode !== "string") {
    return { valid: false, message: "Please provide a promo code." };
  }

  const cleanCode = rawCode.trim().toUpperCase();

  let promo = null;

  // 1. Try querying Supabase discount_codes table
  try {
    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from("discount_codes")
      .select("*")
      .ilike("code", cleanCode)
      .eq("is_active", true)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!error && data) {
      promo = data;
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.info("[Pricing Engine] Checking canonical discount codes cache:", err.message);
  }

  // 2. Check canonical discount codes if DB record not found
  if (!promo) {
    promo = CANONICAL_DISCOUNT_CODES.find((c) => c.code === cleanCode && c.is_active);
  }

  if (!promo) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      code: cleanCode,
      message: `Promo code "${cleanCode}" is invalid or expired. Try "LAUNCH2026" or "EARLYBIRD30".`,
    };
  }

  // Verify tier applicability
  if (promo.applicable_tiers && !promo.applicable_tiers.includes(tierId)) {
    return {
      valid: false,
      code: cleanCode,
      message: `Code "${cleanCode}" is only applicable to ${promo.applicable_tiers.join(", ")} plans.`,
    };
  }

  // Calculate discount amount
  let discountAmount = 0;
  if (promo.discount_percent > 0) {
    discountAmount = Math.round((baseAmount * promo.discount_percent) / 100);
  } else if (promo.discount_fixed > 0) {
    discountAmount = Math.min(baseAmount, promo.discount_fixed);
  }

  const finalAmount = Math.max(0, baseAmount - discountAmount);

  return {
    valid: true,
    code: cleanCode,
    description: promo.description,
    discountPercent: promo.discount_percent || 0,
    discountFixed: promo.discount_fixed || 0,
    discountAmount,
    baseAmount,
    finalAmount,
    savingsText: `Saved ₹${discountAmount.toLocaleString("en-IN")} (${promo.discount_percent ? `${promo.discount_percent}% OFF` : `₹${promo.discount_fixed} Flat OFF`})`,
  };
}

/**
 * Approves a purchase requisition applying strict Maker-Checker separation of duty
 */
export async function approvePurchaseRequisition({ requisition, approverName, schoolId, user }) {
  const cleanSchool = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();

  // Maker-Checker Hard Rule: Approver cannot be the same individual who requested it
  if (requisition.requested_by && approverName && requisition.requested_by.trim().toLowerCase() === approverName.trim().toLowerCase()) {
    throw new Error("Maker-Checker Violation: Separation of duties requires that purchase orders cannot be approved by the requester.");
  }

  const updatedPayload = {
    ...requisition,
    stage: "approved",
    approved_by: approverName || "Principal Executive",
    approved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  if (supabase) {
    try {
      await supabase
        .from("purchase_requisitions")
        .update({
          stage: "approved",
          approved_by: updatedPayload.approved_by,
          approved_at: updatedPayload.approved_at,
          updated_at: updatedPayload.updated_at,
        })
        .eq("id", requisition.id)
        .eq("school_id", cleanSchool);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[Procurement] Supabase update notice:", e);
    }
  }

  logSecurityAction({
    action: `Purchase Order Approved: ${requisition.po_number}`,
    entityType: "PROCUREMENT",
    entityId: requisition.id,
    details: `PO for ₹${requisition.estimated_amount} approved by ${approverName}`,
    user,
    schoolId: cleanSchool,
  });

  return updatedPayload;
}

 * Confirms delivery of goods into institutional inventory
 */
export async function confirmGoodsReceived({ requisition, schoolId, user }) {
  const cleanSchool = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();

  const updatedPayload = {

    stage: "goods_received",
    goods_received_at: new Date().toISOString(),

  };

  if (supabase) {

        .update({

          goods_received_at: updatedPayload.goods_received_at,

/**
 * Service Worker Registration Utility
 */

export function registerServiceWorker() {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && "serviceWorker" in navigator) {
    window.addEventListener("load", () => {
      navigator.serviceWorker
        .register("/sw.js")
        .then((registration) => {
          console.info("[PWA] Service Worker registered successfully with scope:", registration.scope);

          registration.onupdatefound = () => {
            const installingWorker = registration.installing;
            if (installingWorker == null) return;
            installingWorker.onstatechange = () => {
              if (installingWorker.state === "installed") {
                if (navigator.serviceWorker.controller) {
                  console.info("[PWA] New content is available; please refresh.");
                } else {
                  console.info("[PWA] Content is cached for offline use.");
                }
              }
            };
          };
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          console.warn("[PWA] Service Worker registration failed:", error);
        });
    });
  }
}

import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { logSecurityAction } from "./auditLogger";

/**
 * Loads study materials from Supabase or localStorage with strict school isolation
 * Returns empty array for clean slate if no faculty has uploaded materials.
 */
export async function getStudyMaterials(schoolId) {
  const cleanSchoolId = schoolId ? String(schoolId).trim().toUpperCase() : null;

  try {
    if (supabase) {
      let query = supabase.from("study_materials").select("*");
      if (cleanSchoolId) {
        query = query.eq("school_id", cleanSchoolId);
      }
      const { data, error } = await query.order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
        return data.map((d) => ({
          id: d.id,
          title: d.title,
          subject: d.subject || "General",
          className: d.class_name || "General Batch",
          type: d.file_type || d.type || "PDF",
          size: d.size || "1.5 MB",
          description: d.description || "",
          school_id: d.school_id,
          created_at: d.created_at,
          author: d.author || "Departmental Faculty",
        }));
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Study materials DB query notice:", err);
  }

  // Fallback to tenant-scoped localStorage
  try {
    if (cleanSchoolId) {
      const savedTenant = localStorage.getItem(`erp_study_materials_${cleanSchoolId}`);
      if (savedTenant) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(savedTenant);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
      }
    }

    const savedGlobal = localStorage.getItem("erp_study_materials");
    if (savedGlobal) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(savedGlobal);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        if (cleanSchoolId) {
          return parsed.filter(
            (m) => String(m.school_id || "").toUpperCase() === cleanSchoolId
          );
        }
        return parsed;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }

  // Clean Slate: zero default mock notes
  return [];
}

/**
 * Uploads/publishes new study material to Supabase & localStorage
 */
export async function publishStudyMaterial({
  title,
  subject,
  className,
  type = "PDF",
  size = "2.1 MB",
  description,
  schoolId,
  user,
}) {
  const cleanSchoolId = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();
  const newMaterial = {
    id: `mat_${Date.now()}`,
    title: title.trim(),
    subject: subject ? subject.trim() : "General",
    className: className ? className.trim() : "All Batches",
    type: type || "PDF",
    size: size || "2.1 MB",
    description: description ? description.trim() : "Faculty uploaded syllabus reference and notes.",
    school_id: cleanSchoolId,
    author: user?.name || user?.full_name || "Faculty Member",
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  // 1. Try Supabase insert
  try {
    if (supabase) {
      await supabase.from("study_materials").insert([
        {
          title: newMaterial.title,
          subject: newMaterial.subject,
          class_name: newMaterial.className,
          file_type: newMaterial.type,
          size: newMaterial.size,
          description: newMaterial.description,
          school_id: newMaterial.school_id,
          author: newMaterial.author,
        },
      ]);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Study materials DB insert notice:", err);
  }

  // 2. Save to tenant-scoped localStorage
  try {
    const tenantKey = `erp_study_materials_${cleanSchoolId}`;
    const rawTenant = localStorage.getItem(tenantKey);
    const tenantList = rawTenant ? JSON.parse(rawTenant) : [];
    const updatedTenant = [newMaterial, ...tenantList.filter((m) => m.id !== newMaterial.id)];
    localStorage.setItem(tenantKey, JSON.stringify(updatedTenant));

    // Also sync global cache
    const globalRaw = localStorage.getItem("erp_study_materials");
    const globalList = globalRaw ? JSON.parse(globalRaw) : [];
    const updatedGlobal = [newMaterial, ...globalList.filter((m) => m.id !== newMaterial.id)];
    localStorage.setItem("erp_study_materials", JSON.stringify(updatedGlobal));

    // Dispatch event for student LMS real-time sync
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-study-materials-updated"));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("LocalStorage study materials sync error:", e);
  }

  // 3. Audit log
  try {
    logSecurityAction({
      action: "STUDY_MATERIAL_PUBLISHED",
      entityType: "LMS_MATERIAL",
      entityId: newMaterial.id,
      details: `Faculty published ${newMaterial.type} study note "${newMaterial.title}" (${newMaterial.subject}) for ${newMaterial.className}`,
      user,
      schoolId: cleanSchoolId,
    });
  } catch {}

  return newMaterial;
}

/**
 * Delete a study material
 */
export async function deleteStudyMaterial(id, schoolId) {
  const cleanSchoolId = schoolId ? String(schoolId).trim().toUpperCase() : null;

  try {
    if (supabase) {
      await supabase.from("study_materials").delete().eq("id", id);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Study materials DB delete notice:", err);
  }

  try {
    if (cleanSchoolId) {
      const tenantKey = `erp_study_materials_${cleanSchoolId}`;
      const savedTenant = localStorage.getItem(tenantKey);
      if (savedTenant) {
        const filtered = JSON.parse(savedTenant).filter((m) => m.id !== id);
        localStorage.setItem(tenantKey, JSON.stringify(filtered));
      }
    }

    const saved = localStorage.getItem("erp_study_materials");
    if (saved) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
      const filtered = parsed.filter((m) => m.id !== id);
      localStorage.setItem("erp_study_materials", JSON.stringify(filtered));
    }

    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-study-materials-updated"));
  } catch {}
}

import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { dispatchParentNotification } from "./notifications";

/**
 * SUBSTITUTE TEACHER RELIEF MATRIX ENGINE
 * Detects affected periods from teacher leaves/absences,
 * identifies qualified and available substitute educators,
 * prevents schedule clashes, and coordinates 1-click duty dispatch.
 */

/**
 * Resolves affected timetable periods for an absent educator on a specific date
 */
export async function getAffectedPeriodsForTeacher({ teacherName, date, schoolId }) {
  const cleanSchool = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();
  const dayOfWeek = new Date(date).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { weekday: "long" });

  let fullSchedule = [];
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_master_timetable_${cleanSchool}`);
    if (raw) fullSchedule = JSON.parse(raw);
  } catch (e) {}

  if (fullSchedule.length === 0 && supabase) {
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from("timetable")
        .select("*")
        .eq("school_id", cleanSchool)
        .eq("day", dayOfWeek);
      if (data) fullSchedule = data;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  const cleanTarget = (teacherName || "").trim().toLowerCase();

  return fullSchedule.filter((slot) => {
    const slotDay = (slot.day || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    const slotTeacher = (slot.teacher || slot.teacher_name || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    return slotDay === dayOfWeek.toLowerCase() && slotTeacher.includes(cleanTarget);
  });
}

/**
 * Finds eligible substitute teachers for a specific period
 * Guarantees zero schedule conflicts.
 */
export async function getEligibleSubstitutes({ day, periodNo, subject, absentTeacher, schoolId, date }) {
  const cleanSchool = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();
  const cleanAbsent = (absentTeacher || "").trim().toLowerCase();

  let directory = [];
  let schedule = [];
  let existingAssignments = [];

  try {
    const rawDir = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${cleanSchool}`);
    if (rawDir) directory = JSON.parse(rawDir);
    const rawSched = localStorage.getItem(`erp_master_timetable_${cleanSchool}`);
    if (rawSched) schedule = JSON.parse(rawSched);
    const rawAssigned = localStorage.getItem(`erp_substitute_assignments_${cleanSchool}`);
    if (rawAssigned) existingAssignments = JSON.parse(rawAssigned);
  } catch (e) {}

  // Filter all teachers in directory
  const allTeachers = directory.filter(
    (m) =>
      (m.role || "").toLowerCase() === "teacher" &&
      (m.name || m.full_name || "").trim().toLowerCase() !== cleanAbsent
  );

  const cleanPeriod = (periodNo || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  const cleanDay = (day || "").trim().toLowerCase();

  // Find busy teachers in that period
  const busyTeachers = new Set();
  schedule.forEach((s) => {
    if (
      (s.day || "").trim().toLowerCase() === cleanDay &&
      (s.periodNo || s.period || "").trim().toLowerCase() === cleanPeriod
    ) {
      busyTeachers.add((s.teacher || s.teacher_name || "").trim().toLowerCase());
    }
  });

  // Find teachers already assigned as substitute on that date and period
  existingAssignments.forEach((ea) => {
    if (
      ea.date === date &&
      (ea.period_no || "").trim().toLowerCase() === cleanPeriod &&
      ea.status !== "declined"
    ) {
      busyTeachers.add((ea.substitute_teacher_name || "").trim().toLowerCase());
    }
  });

  // Evaluate candidates
  const candidates = [];
  const targetSubj = (subject || "").trim().toLowerCase();

  allTeachers.forEach((t) => {
    const tName = t.name || t.full_name || "Faculty Member";
    const isBusy = busyTeachers.has(tName.trim().toLowerCase());

    if (!isBusy) {
      const tSubj = (t.subject || t.department || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      const isSubjectMatch = tSubj && (tSubj.includes(targetSubj) || targetSubj.includes(tSubj));

      candidates.push({
        id: t.role_code || t.id,
        name: tName,
        phone: t.phone || "+91 98200 00000",
        subject: t.subject || "General Faculty",
        isSubjectMatch,
        qualificationScore: isSubjectMatch ? 95 : 75,
      });
    }
  });

  // Sort: matching subject faculty first
  candidates.sort((a, b) => b.qualificationScore - a.qualificationScore);
  return candidates;
}

/**
 * Assign substitute duty and persist
 */
export async function assignSubstituteDuty({
  schoolId,
  date,
  periodNo,
  className,
  subject,
  room,
  absentTeacherName,
  substituteTeacherName,
  substitutePhone,
  assignedBy = "Principal",
}) {
  const cleanSchool = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();

  const payload = {
    id: `sub_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 4)}`,
    school_id: cleanSchool,
    date,
    period_no: periodNo,
    class_name: className,
    subject,
    room: room || "Assigned Classroom",
    absent_teacher_name: absentTeacherName,
    substitute_teacher_name: substituteTeacherName,
    assignment_reason: `Coverage for ${absentTeacherName} (Approved Leave)`,
    status: "assigned",
    assigned_by: assignedBy,
    notified_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  if (supabase) {
    try {
      await supabase.from("substitute_assignments").insert([payload]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[SubstituteEngine] Supabase insert notice:", e);
    }
  }

  // Local fallback
  const storageKey = `erp_substitute_assignments_${cleanSchool}`;
  try {
    const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "[]");
    localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify([payload, ...existing]));
  } catch (e) {}

  window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-substitutes-updated"));
  return payload;
}

/**
 * Fetches daily relief schedule for today
 */
export async function getDailyReliefSchedule(date, schoolId) {
  const cleanSchool = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();
  const queryDate = date || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];

  if (supabase) {
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from("substitute_assignments")
        .select("*")
        .eq("school_id", cleanSchool)
        .eq("date", queryDate)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });
      if (data && data.length > 0) return data;
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  try {
    const all = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`erp_substitute_assignments_${cleanSchool}`) || "[]");
    return all.filter((a) => a.date === queryDate);
  } catch (e) {
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Returns real GPS status (never synthetic or fabricated)
 */
export function getGpsTrackingStatus() {
  const isGpsConnected = Boolean(import.meta.env.VITE_GPS_TRACKER_ENDPOINT);
  return {
    isLive: isGpsConnected,
    statusText: isGpsConnected ? "Live Telemetry Connected" : "GPS Tracker Disconnected (Awaiting IoT OBD Device Pairing)",
    providerName: isGpsConnected ? "AIS-140 Certified GPS Feed" : "Hardware Device Not Linked",
  };
}

/**
 * Computes fleet metrics and document expiry warnings
 */
export function calculateFleetMetrics(vehicles = [], routes = [], allocations = []) {
  const totalVehicles = vehicles.length;
  const totalSeats = vehicles.reduce((sum, v) => sum + Number(v.capacity || 0), 0);
  const totalStudentsTransported = allocations.length;
  const capacityUtilization = totalSeats > 0 ? Math.round((totalStudentsTransported / totalSeats) * 100) : 0;

  // Scan expiring documents within 30 days
  const now = new Date();
  const expiringVehicles = [];

  vehicles.forEach((v) => {
    const checks = [
      { doc: "Fitness Certificate", dateStr: v.fitness_expiry },
      { doc: "Insurance Policy", dateStr: v.insurance_expiry },
      { doc: "PUC Pollution Check", dateStr: v.pollution_expiry },
    ];

    checks.forEach((c) => {
      if (c.dateStr) {
        const d = new Date(c.dateStr);
        const diffDays = Math.ceil((d - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        if (diffDays <= 30) {
          expiringVehicles.push({
            vehicleNumber: v.vehicle_number,
            driverName: v.driver_name,
            document: c.doc,
            expiryDate: c.dateStr,
            daysRemaining: diffDays,
          });
        }
      }
    });
  });

  return {
    totalVehicles,
    totalRoutes: routes.length,
    totalSeats,
    totalStudentsTransported,
    capacityUtilization,
    expiringVehicles,
  };
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { X, Calendar, ArrowRight, GraduationCap, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";

export default function AcademicRolloverModal({ isOpen, onClose, schoolId, onRolloverSuccess }) {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [currentAcademicYear, setCurrentAcademicYear] = useState("2025-2026");
  const [targetAcademicYear, setTargetAcademicYear] = useState("2026-2027");
  const [finalGradeBatch, setFinalGradeBatch] = useState("Class 12");
  const [students, setStudents] = useState([]);
  const [promotionsPreview, setPromotionsPreview] = useState([]);
  const [graduationsPreview, setGraduationsPreview] = useState([]);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [isDone, setIsDone] = useState(false);

  const cleanSchool = String(schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();

  const loadStudentsAndBuildPreview = React.useCallback(() => {
    try {
      const dirKey = `erp_directory_${cleanSchool}`;
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(dirKey);
      const directory = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      const studentList = directory.filter((m) => (m.role || "student").toLowerCase() === "student");
      setStudents(studentList);

      const promotions = [];
      const graduations = [];

      studentList.forEach((st) => {
        const currentClass = st.class_name || st.class || "Class 9";
        const isGraduating = currentClass.toLowerCase().includes(finalGradeBatch.toLowerCase());

        // Arrears calculation
        const total = Number(st.totalFees || 45000);
        const paid = Number(st.paidFees || 0);
        const arrears = Math.max(0, total - paid);

        if (isGraduating) {
          graduations.push({
            id: st.id || st.roll_number,
            name: st.name || st.full_name,
            currentClass,
            rollNumber: st.roll_number || st.id,
            arrears,
            graduationYear: new Date().getFullYear(),
          });
        } else {
          // Promote by incrementing class number if possible
          const classNumMatch = currentClass.match(/\d+/);
          let nextClass;
          if (classNumMatch) {
            const currentNum = parseInt(classNumMatch[0], 10);
            nextClass = currentClass.replace(String(currentNum), String(currentNum + 1));
          } else {
            nextClass = `${currentClass} (Promoted)`;
          }

          promotions.push({
            id: st.id || st.roll_number,
            name: st.name || st.full_name,
            currentClass,
            nextClass,
            rollNumber: st.roll_number || st.id,
            carriedArrears: arrears,
          });
        }
      });

      setPromotionsPreview(promotions);
      setGraduationsPreview(graduations);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not calculate rollover preview:", e);
    }
  }, [cleanSchool, finalGradeBatch]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadStudentsAndBuildPreview();
    }
  }, [isOpen, loadStudentsAndBuildPreview]);

  const handleExecuteRollover = () => {
    if (students.length === 0) {
      showToast("No active students found to rollover.", "info");
      return;
    }

    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      const dirKey = `erp_directory_${cleanSchool}`;
      const alumniKey = `erp_alumni_${cleanSchool}`;

      const currentDir = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(dirKey) || "[]");
      const currentAlumni = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(alumniKey) || "[]");

      // 1. Move graduating scholars into Alumni DB
      const newAlumniEntries = graduationsPreview.map((g) => ({
        id: `alum_${Date.now()}_${g.rollNumber}`,
        name: g.name,
        rollNumber: g.rollNumber,
        graduationYear: g.graduationYear,
        stream: g.currentClass,
        currentPlacement: "Higher Education / University",
        contactEmail: "",
        status: "Graduated",
        pendingDuesCarried: g.arrears,
      }));

      const updatedAlumni = [...currentAlumni, ...newAlumniEntries];
      localStorage.setItem(alumniKey, JSON.stringify(updatedAlumni));

      // 2. Update directory: remove graduated scholars and promote continuing students
      const graduatingIds = new Set(graduationsPreview.map((g) => g.rollNumber));
      const promotionMap = new Map(promotionsPreview.map((p) => [p.rollNumber, p]));

      const updatedDir = currentDir
        .filter((member) => !graduatingIds.has(member.roll_number || member.id))
        .map((member) => {
          const promo = promotionMap.get(member.roll_number || member.id);
          if (promo) {
            return {
              ...member,
              class_name: promo.nextClass,
              class: promo.nextClass,
              academic_year: targetAcademicYear,
              // Carry forward unpaid fee arrears as opening balance
              openingArrears: promo.carriedArrears,
              totalFees: (Number(member.totalFees) || 45000) + promo.carriedArrears,
              paidFees: 0,
            };
          }
          return member;
        });

      localStorage.setItem(dirKey, JSON.stringify(updatedDir));
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_academic_year_${cleanSchool}`, targetAcademicYear);

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-directory-updated"));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-alumni-updated"));

      setIsDone(true);
      showToast(`Academic Year Rollover to ${targetAcademicYear} Completed! 🎓`, "success");
      if (onRolloverSuccess) onRolloverSuccess();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Rollover execution error:", err);
      showToast("Rollover execution failed", "error");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-white/10 rounded-3xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
        {/* HEADER */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-4">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-400">
              Institutional Lifecycle Engine
            </span>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>Academic-Year Rollover & Batch Promotion</span>
              <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-400" />
            </h2>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1 rounded-xl text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* BODY */}
        <div className="py-4 flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-5">
          {!isDone ? (
            <>
              {/* CONFIG ROW */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10">
                  <label className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase block mb-1">
                    Current Session
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={currentAcademicYear}
                    onChange={(e) => setCurrentAcademicYear(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10">

                  />

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { queryExecutiveAssistant } from "../utils/aiIntelligenceEngine";
import {
  Sparkles,
  Bot,
  Send,
  X,
  Minimize2,
  Maximize2,
  RefreshCw,
  TrendingDown,
  DollarSign,
  AlertTriangle,
  Users,
  CheckCircle2,
  ArrowRight,
  MessageSquare,
} from "lucide-react";

const PRESET_CHIPS = [
  "Which class has the lowest attendance?",
  "Show fee defaults for this month",
  "Identify at-risk students this term",
  "What is today's total fee collection?",
];

export default function AIPrincipalAssistantChat() {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const userRole = (user?.role || "").toLowerCase();
  const schoolId = (user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();

  // Only render for Executive Leadership (Principal, Trustee, HOD, SuperAdmin)
  const isAuthorized = ["principal", "trustee", "hod", "admin", "super_admin"].includes(userRole);

  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [inputMessage, setInputMessage] = useState("");
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([
    {
      id: "m_welcome",
      role: "assistant",
      text: `Good day, Principal ${user?.name ? user.name.split(" ")[0] : ""}. I am your Institutional AI Copilot, indexed against campus fee registers, daily attendance telemetry, and continuous test evaluations. How may I assist your administration today?`,
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
    },
  ]);
  const [isTyping, setIsTyping] = useState(false);
  const messagesEndRef = useRef(null);

  // Auto-scroll chat to bottom
  const scrollToBottom = () => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      scrollToBottom();
    }
  }, [messages, isOpen, isTyping]);

  if (!isAuthorized) return null;

  // AI Response Generator wired to live Supabase / local cached records
  const handleQuery = async (queryText) => {
    const cleanPrompt = queryText.trim();
    if (!cleanPrompt) return;

    // 1. Add user message
    const userMsg = {
      id: `u_${Date.now()}`,
      role: "user",
      text: cleanPrompt,
      timestamp: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }),
    };

    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setInputMessage("");

import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";

const ASSET_CATEGORIES = [
  "All Categories",
  "Laboratory Apparatus & Chemicals",
  "IT Hardware & Laptops",
  "Library Books & Volumes",
  "Smart Classroom Projectors & AV",
  "Athletics & Sports Gear",
  "Classroom Furniture & Fixtures",
];

export default function AssetRegistry({ schoolId: propSchoolId }) {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = propSchoolId || user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const [assets, setAssets] = useState([]);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState("All Categories");
  const [selectedCondition, setSelectedCondition] = useState("ALL");
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: "",
    category: "IT Hardware & Laptops",
    quantity: "1",
    unit: "Units",
    assignedTo: "",
    location: "Main Computer Lab",
    condition: "Good Condition", // Brand New | Good Condition | Needs Repair | Decommissioned
    serialNumber: "",
    purchaseValue: "",
  });

  const loadAssets = () => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_asset_registry_${schoolId}`);
      if (saved) {
        setAssets(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setAssets([]);
      }
    } catch {
      setAssets([]);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadAssets();
    const handleUpdate = () => loadAssets();
    window.addEventListener("erp-assets-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("erp-assets-updated", handleUpdate);
  }, [schoolId]);

  const saveAssets = (updated) => {
    setAssets(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_asset_registry_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-assets-updated"));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Storage save error:", e);
    }
  };

  const handleAddAsset = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.name.trim() || !form.assignedTo.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide asset name and designated custodian.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const newAsset = {
      id: `asset_${Date.now()}`,
      name: form.name.trim(),
      category: form.category,
      quantity: `${form.quantity || 1} ${form.unit || "Units"}`,
      totalCount: Number(form.quantity) || 1,
      assignedTo: form.assignedTo.trim(),
      location: form.location.trim() || "Campus Main",
      condition: form.condition,
      serialNumber: form.serialNumber.trim() || `AST-${Date.now().toString().slice(-5)}`,
      purchaseValue: form.purchaseValue ? `₹${Number(form.purchaseValue).toLocaleString("en-IN")}` : "N/A",
      lastAudited: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    };

    const updated = [newAsset, ...assets];
    saveAssets(updated);

    logSecurityAction({
      action: "ASSET_REGISTERED",
      entityType: "ASSET",
      entityId: newAsset.id,
      details: `Registered asset "${newAsset.name}" (${newAsset.quantity}) assigned to ${newAsset.assignedTo}`,
      schoolId,
    });

    showToast(`Asset "${newAsset.name}" registered successfully!`, "success");
    setForm({
      name: "",
      category: "IT Hardware & Laptops",
      quantity: "1",
      unit: "Units",
      assignedTo: "",
      location: "Main Computer Lab",
      condition: "Good Condition",
      serialNumber: "",
      purchaseValue: "",
    });
    setShowAddModal(false);
  };

  const handleDeleteAsset = (id) => {
    const updated = assets.filter((a) => a.id !== id);
    saveAssets(updated);
    showToast("Asset record removed.", "info");
  };

  const filteredAssets = assets.filter((a) => {
    const matchesCat = selectedCategory === "All Categories" || a.category === selectedCategory;
    const matchesCond = selectedCondition === "ALL" || a.condition === selectedCondition;
    const matchesSearch =
      (a.name || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (a.assignedTo || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (a.serialNumber || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    return matchesCat && matchesCond && matchesSearch;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-slate-100">

        <div>
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-400/30 text-cyan-300 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">

          <select

                  />

                    className="w-full bg-slate-950/60 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-400"
                  />

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">

                  >

                    <option value="Good Condition">Good Condition</option>
                    <option value="Needs Repair">Needs Repair</option>
                    <option value="Decommissioned">Decommissioned</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                    Serial Tag / Plate #
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g., AST-84920"
                    value={form.serialNumber}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, serialNumber: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950/60 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-400 font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowAddModal(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:text-white text-xs font-bold"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-indigo-500 text-white font-black px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/20 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:scale-[1.02]"
                >
                  Add to Ledger 📦
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";

import {

export default function AttendanceStreak({
  studentRoll = "",
  className = "",
}) {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const schoolId = (user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();
  const currentRoll = String(studentRoll || user?.role_code || user?.roll_number || user?.personal_code || "STU-101").trim().toUpperCase();
  const currentStudentName = user?.name || user?.full_name || "Scholar Member";
  const studentBatch = user?.class_name || "Class 10-A";

  const [currentStreak, setCurrentStreak] = useState(0);
  const [longestStreak, setLongestStreak] = useState(0);
  const [attendanceRate, setAttendanceRate] = useState(0);
  const [leaderboard, setLeaderboard] = useState([]);
  const [myRank, setMyRank] = useState(1);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    const calculateStreaksAndLeaderboard = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        // 1. Fetch Students in current batch from directory or Supabase
        let batchStudents = [];
        try {
          const rawDir = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${schoolId}`);
          if (rawDir) {
            const allMembers = JSON.parse(rawDir);
            batchStudents = allMembers.filter((m) => (m.role || "student").toLowerCase() === "student");
          }
        } catch {}

        if (batchStudents.length === 0 && supabase) {
          try {
            const { data } = await supabase
              .from("students")
              .select("id, name, roll_number, class_name")
              .eq("school_id", schoolId)
              .limit(25);
            if (data && data.length > 0) {
              batchStudents = data;
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        // 2. Fetch Recent Attendance Records
        let attendanceRecords = [];
        if (supabase) {
          try {
            const { data } = await supabase
              .from("attendance")
              .select("date, records")
              .eq("school_id", schoolId)
              .order("date", { ascending: false })
              .limit(60);
            if (data) attendanceRecords = data;
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        // Also merge local storage records
        try {
          const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
          const localToday = localStorage.getItem(`erp_attendance_${schoolId}_${today}`);
          if (localToday) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(localToday);
            attendanceRecords = [{ date: today, records: parsed }, ...attendanceRecords];
          }
        } catch {}

        // Helper function to calculate unbroken streak for a given roll number
        const computeStudentStreak = (roll) => {
          let streak = 0;
          let presentCount = 0;
          let markedDays = 0;
          let streakBroken = false;

          const sorted = [...attendanceRecords].sort((a, b) => (b.date || "").localeCompare(a.date || ""));

          for (const day of sorted) {
            const list = day.records || [];
            const entry = list.find((r) => {
              const rRoll = String(r.roll_number || r.student_id || r.id || "").trim().toUpperCase();
              return rRoll === roll;
            });

            if (entry) {
              markedDays++;
              const isPresent = (entry.status || "present").toLowerCase() === "present";
              if (isPresent) {
                presentCount++;
                if (!streakBroken) streak++;
              } else {
                streakBroken = true;
              }
            }
          }

          const rate = markedDays > 0 ? Math.round((presentCount / markedDays) * 100) : 0;
          return { streak, rate, markedDays };
        };

        // 3. Compute student's unbroken streak
        const currentStats = computeStudentStreak(currentRoll);
        const effectiveStreak = currentStats.streak;
        const effectiveRate = currentStats.rate;

        // 4. Construct Leaderboard from real batch students
        const studentStreaks = batchStudents.map((s, idx) => {
          const roll = String(s.roll_number || s.personal_code || s.id || `STU-${idx + 1}`).trim().toUpperCase();
          const isCurrent = roll === currentRoll;
          const stats = isCurrent ? currentStats : computeStudentStreak(roll);

          return {
            roll,
            name: s.name || s.full_name || `Scholar ${idx + 1}`,
            streak: stats.streak,
            rate: parseFloat(Number(stats.rate).toFixed(1)),
            isCurrent,
          };
        });

        // Ensure current student is in the list
        if (!studentStreaks.some((s) => s.isCurrent)) {
          studentStreaks.push({
            roll: currentRoll,
            name: currentStudentName,
            streak: effectiveStreak,
            rate: parseFloat(Number(effectiveRate).toFixed(1)),
            isCurrent: true,
          });
        }

        // Sort by streak descending, then attendance rate
        studentStreaks.sort((a, b) => b.streak - a.streak || b.rate - a.rate);

        const currentRankIndex = studentStreaks.findIndex((s) => s.isCurrent);
        const resolvedRank = currentRankIndex !== -1 ? currentRankIndex + 1 : 1;

        if (!isMounted) return;
        setCurrentStreak(effectiveStreak);
        setLongestStreak(effectiveStreak);
        setAttendanceRate(effectiveRate);
        setLeaderboard(studentStreaks.slice(0, 5));
        setMyRank(resolvedRank);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Streak & leaderboard calculation error:", err);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    calculateStreaksAndLeaderboard();
  }, [schoolId, currentRoll, currentStudentName]);

  const getMedalEmoji = (rank) => {
    if (rank === 1) return "🥇";
    if (rank === 2) return "🥈";
    if (rank === 3) return "🥉";

  const getStreakTier = (streak) => {
    if (streak >= 25) return { label: "Legendary Scholar", color: "from-amber-400 to-orange-500", icon: "⚡" };
    if (streak >= 15) return { label: "Campus Champion", color: "from-cyan-400 to-blue-500", icon: "🔥" };
    if (streak >= 7) return { label: "Consistent Warrior", color: "from-emerald-400 to-teal-500", icon: "🌟" };
    return { label: "Momentum Builder", color: "from-indigo-400 to-purple-500", icon: "🚀" };
  };

  const tier = getStreakTier(currentStreak);

  return (
    <div className={`space-y-6 ${className}`}>
      {/* 1. PERSONAL UNBROKEN STREAK CARD */}
      <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-7 bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/50 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 shadow-xl transition-all">
        {/* Ambient Glow */}
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-48 h-48 bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500/15 via-orange-500/10 to-transparent rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none"></div>

        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 relative z-10">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
              <span className="p-1 rounded-lg bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-500 dark:text-orange-400 border border-orange-500/20">
                <Flame className="w-4 h-4 fill-orange-500 animate-bounce" />
              </span>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400">
                Unbroken Attendance Streak
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold bg-orange-500/10 text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-300 border border-orange-500/20">
                {tier.icon} {tier.label}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-3">
              <h2 className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">
                {currentStreak}
              </h2>
              <span className="text-sm sm:text-base font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Consecutive Present Days
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1">
              Weekends & official institutional holidays do not break your streak! Keep it up.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Metrics Badges */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full sm:w-auto">
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/5 text-center flex-1 sm:flex-initial min-w-[100px]">

              <span className="text-lg font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200">
                {longestStreak} Days
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/60 border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-white/5 text-center flex-1 sm:flex-initial min-w-[100px]">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-extrabold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                Class Rate
              </span>
              <span className="text-lg font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">

import React, { useState, useContext, useEffect } from "react";

  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const schoolName = resolveInstitutionName({
    ...tenant,
    institution_name: user?.institution_name || user?.school_name || tenant?.name,
  });

  const [schoolLogo, setSchoolLogo] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadLogo = () => {
      try {
        const stored =
          localStorage.getItem(`erp_logo_${activeSchoolId}`) ||
          localStorage.getItem(`erp_school_logo_${activeSchoolId}`) ||
          tenant?.logoUrl ||
          null;
        setSchoolLogo(stored);
      } catch {
        setSchoolLogo(null);
      }
    };
    loadLogo();
    window.addEventListener("erp-logo-updated", loadLogo);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("erp-logo-updated", loadLogo);
  }, [activeSchoolId, tenant?.logoUrl]);

  // Phase 3: Async PDF Batch Queue State

      const cleanup = listenToPDFBatchJob(job.id, activeSchoolId, (updated) => {
        setBatchJob(updated);
        if (updated.status === "Processing") {

import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";

export default function CctvFeedManager({ schoolId: propSchoolId }) {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = propSchoolId || user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const [cameras, setCameras] = useState([]);
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCam, setSelectedCam] = useState(null);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: "",
    location: "Main Gate Entrance",
    streamUrl: "",
    status: "Online",
    resolution: "1080p FHD (30 FPS)",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_cctv_feeds_${schoolId}`);
      if (saved) {
        setCameras(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setCameras([]);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setCameras([]);
    }
  }, [schoolId]);

  const handleAddCamera = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.name.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide camera name / identifier.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const newCam = {
      id: `cam_${Date.now()}`,
      name: form.name.trim(),
      location: form.location,
      streamUrl: form.streamUrl.trim() || "rtsp://192.168.1.100:554/live/ch0",
      status: form.status,
      resolution: form.resolution,
      installedOn: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    };

    const updated = [newCam, ...cameras];
    setCameras(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_cctv_feeds_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}

    logSecurityAction({
      action: "CCTV Surveillance Node Registered",
      entityType: "SECURITY",
      entityId: newCam.name,
      details: `Installed camera node "${newCam.name}" at location ${newCam.location}`,
      user,
      schoolId,
    });

    showToast(`Camera feed "${newCam.name}" connected successfully!`, "success");
    setForm({
      name: "",
      location: "Main Gate Entrance",
      streamUrl: "",
      status: "Online",
      resolution: "1080p FHD (30 FPS)",
    });
    setShowAddModal(false);
  };

  const handleRemoveCamera = (id, name) => {
    const updated = cameras.filter((c) => c.id !== id);
    setCameras(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_cctv_feeds_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}

    logSecurityAction({
      action: "CCTV Surveillance Node Removed",
      entityType: "SECURITY",
      entityId: id,
      details: `Archived camera node: ${name || id}`,
      user,
      schoolId,
    });

    showToast(`Camera node "${name || "Camera"}" unlinked from hub.`, "info");
    if (selectedCam?.id === id) setSelectedCam(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* HEADER BANNER */}
      <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 text-rose-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500 animate-pulse"></span>
            Campus Surveillance & Guard Hub
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white">Live Campus CCTV Feed Hub 📹</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1 max-w-xl">
            Configure institutional IP/RTSP camera streams, gate entrance cameras, and classroom examination feeds.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAddModal(true)}
            className="bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-lg shadow-rose-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <span>➕</span>
            <span>Connect Camera Node</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* CAMERA GRID */}
      {cameras.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/80 border border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl p-12 text-center text-slate-400 space-y-3 shadow-xl">
          <span className="text-5xl block opacity-60">📹</span>
          <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">No CCTV Camera Feeds Configured (Clean Slate)</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
            Your surveillance hub is ready. Click "Connect Camera Node" above to register IP stream URLs or physical camera locations.
          </p>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAddModal(true)}
            className="bg-rose-600/20 hover:bg-rose-600/30 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/30 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer mt-2"
          >
            + Register First Camera
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {cameras.map((cam) => (
            <div

            >
              {/* VIDEO STREAM SIMULATION SCREEN */}
              <div className="relative bg-slate-950 h-48 flex items-center justify-center border-b border-slate-800">

                  {cam.location}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* CARD DETAILS */}
              <div className="p-5 flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900/40">
                <div>
                  <h4 className="font-bold text-white text-base">{cam.name}</h4>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Node ID: {cam.id.slice(-6)} &bull; {cam.location}</p>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleRemoveCamera(cam.id, cam.name)}
                  className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-300 hover:bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  title="Disconnect camera"
                >
                  🗑️ Unlink
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ADD CAMERA MODAL */}
      {showAddModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50 animate-fade-in">
          <div className="bg-[#1E293B] border border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-white mb-1">Connect CCTV Surveillance Node 📹</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-6">Register camera network streaming link or IP camera checkpoint.</p>

            <form onSubmit={handleAddCamera} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Camera Identifier *</label>
                <input

                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}

                />
