```javascript
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Physical Location</label>

                  className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-rose-500"
                >
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import {
  fetchStudentsForClass,
  createClassTest,
  saveClassTestScores,
  getClassTestsForTeacher,
  getScoresForTest,
} from "../utils/classTestMarksService";
import {
  AlertCircle,
  X,
  BookOpen,
  Layers,
  Save,
  Check,
  Send,
  Plus,
  UserX,
  UserCheck,
  ChevronRight,
} from "lucide-react";

export default function ClassTestEntry({ isOpen = true, onClose, onTestSaved, isStandalone = false }) {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const schoolId = (user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();

  // Tab State: 'entry' (New/Edit Test) vs 'history' (Previously Entered Tests)
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("entry");

  // Assigned Classes & Subjects resolution
  const [assignedClasses, setAssignedClasses] = useState(["Class 10-A", "Class 10-B", "Class 9-A"]);
  const [assignedSubjects] = useState([
    "Mathematics",
    "Physics",
    "Chemistry",
    "Biology",
    "English Literature",
    "Computer Science",
    "Social Studies",
  ]);

  // Test Header Form
  const [selectedClass, setSelectedClass] = useState("Class 10-A");
  const [selectedSection] = useState("A");
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState("Mathematics");
  const [testTitle, setTestTitle] = useState("Mathematics Unit Test 1");
  const [testDate, setTestDate] = useState(() => new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]);
  const [maxScore, setMaxScore] = useState(20);
  const [passingScore, setPassingScore] = useState(8);

  // Active Test ID if editing an existing test
  const [editingTestId, setEditingTestId] = useState(null);
  const [testStatus, setTestStatus] = useState("draft");

  // Roster & Marks
  const [students, setStudents] = useState([]);
  const [scores, setScores] = useState({}); // { [studentId]: { marks: number | string, isAbsent: boolean, remarks: string, rollNumber: string, name: string } }
  const [loadingRoster, setLoadingRoster] = useState(false);
  const [savingState, setSavingState] = useState("idle"); // 'idle' | 'saving' | 'saved' | 'error'

  // History Tab State
  const [historyTests, setHistoryTests] = useState([]);
  const [loadingHistory, setLoadingHistory] = useState(false);
  const [historyFilterClass, setHistoryFilterClass] = useState("ALL");

  // Confirmation Modal for Publishing
  const [showPublishConfirm, setShowPublishConfirm] = useState(false);

  // Ref array for keyboard navigation (Roll No. input jumps)
  const inputRefs = useRef([]);

  // Resolve faculty assigned classes & subjects
  useEffect(() => {
    const classesSet = new Set();
    if (user?.assigned_classes) {
      const arr = Array.isArray(user.assigned_classes)
        ? user.assigned_classes
        : String(user.assigned_classes).split(",");
      arr.forEach((c) => c.trim() && classesSet.add(c.trim()));
    }
    if (user?.class_name && user.class_name !== "Faculty") {
      classesSet.add(user.class_name.trim());
    }

    // Try reading classes from local directory
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${schoolId}`);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        parsed.forEach((item) => {
          if (item.class_name && (item.role || "").toLowerCase() === "student") {
            classesSet.add(item.class_name.trim());
          }
        });
      }
    } catch {}

    const resolved = Array.from(classesSet);
    if (resolved.length > 0) {
      setAssignedClasses(resolved);
      if (!resolved.includes(selectedClass)) {
        setSelectedClass(resolved[0]);
      }
    }

    if (user?.subject) {
      setSubject(user.subject);
    }
  }, [user, schoolId]);

  // Load student roster when class changes or when creating a new test
  const loadRoster = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingRoster(true);
    setSavingState("idle");
    try {
      const roster = await fetchStudentsForClass(schoolId, selectedClass);
      setStudents(roster);

      // If we are editing an existing test, load its saved scores
      if (editingTestId) {
        const existingScores = await getScoresForTest(schoolId, editingTestId);
        const map = {};
        roster.forEach((s) => {
          const found = existingScores.find((sc) => String(sc.student_id) === String(s.id) || String(sc.roll_number) === String(s.roll_number));
          if (found) {
            map[s.id] = {
              marks: found.is_absent ? "" : found.marks_obtained,
              isAbsent: Boolean(found.is_absent),
              remarks: found.remarks || "",
              rollNumber: s.roll_number,
              name: s.name,
            };
          } else {
            map[s.id] = {
              marks: "",
              isAbsent: false,
              remarks: "",
              rollNumber: s.roll_number,
              name: s.name,
            };
          }
        });
        setScores(map);
      } else {
        // New test: initialize clean empty inputs (No mock random marks)
        const initial = {};
        roster.forEach((s) => {
          initial[s.id] = {
            marks: "",
            isAbsent: false,
            remarks: "",
            rollNumber: s.roll_number,
            name: s.name,
          };
        });
        setScores(initial);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[ClassTestEntry] Error loading student roster:", err);
      showToast("Unable to load student roster for selected class.", "error");
    } finally {
      setLoadingRoster(false);
    }
  }, [schoolId, selectedClass, editingTestId, showToast]);

      loadRoster();

  const loadHistory = useCallback(async () => {

      console.error("[ClassTestEntry] Error loading test history:", err);

    if (activeTab === "history") {

          marks: rawValue,
          isAbsent: false,
        },
      };
    });
  };

  // Toggle student absent status
  const handleToggleAbsent = (studentId) => {
    setSavingState("idle");
    setScores((prev) => {
      const current = prev[studentId] || {};
      const nextAbsent = !current.isAbsent;
      return {
        ...prev,
        [studentId]: {
          ...current,
          isAbsent: nextAbsent,
          marks: nextAbsent ? "" : current.marks,
        },
      };
    });
  };

  // Keyboard Navigation: Enter or Down Arrow jumps to next row, Up Arrow jumps to previous
  const handleKeyDown = (e, index) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === "ArrowDown") {
      e.preventDefault();
      const nextIndex = index + 1;
      if (nextIndex < students.length && inputRefs.current[nextIndex]) {
        inputRefs.current[nextIndex].focus();
        inputRefs.current[nextIndex].select();
      }
    } else if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {

        inputRefs.current[prevIndex].focus();
        inputRefs.current[prevIndex].select();
      }
    }
  };

  // Save Marks (Draft or Published)
  const handleSaveMarks = async (publish = false) => {
    if (!testTitle.trim()) {
      showToast("Please enter a test title (e.g. 'Mathematics Unit Test 1').", "error");
      return;
    }

    setSavingState("saving");

    try {
      // 1. Ensure test record exists or create one
      let targetTestId = editingTestId;

      if (!targetTestId) {
        const created = await createClassTest({
          schoolId,
          classId: selectedClass,
          section: selectedSection,
          subject,
          title: testTitle.trim(),
          testDate,
          maxScore,
          passingScore,
          actor: user,
        });
        targetTestId = created.id;
        setEditingTestId(created.id);
      }

      // 2. Prepare score list
      const scorePayload = students.map((s) => {
        const sc = scores[s.id] || {};
        return {
          student_id: s.id,

          is_absent: Boolean(sc.isAbsent),

        };

                  2. Student Evaluation Register
                </h4>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                  Use Up/Down arrows or Enter to navigate between student score inputs.
                </p>

              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500">
                Max Ceiling: {maxScore} pts
              </span>
            </div>

            {loadingRoster ? (
              <div className="p-8 text-center space-y-3">
                <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-cyan-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mx-auto"></div>

              </div>
            ) : students.length === 0 ? (

                <AlertCircle className="w-8 h-8 text-amber-500 mx-auto opacity-60" />

                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 max-w-sm mx-auto">
                  No scholars are registered under {selectedClass}. Please verify the class admissions register.
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto max-h-[420px] overflow-y-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                  <thead className="sticky top-0 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase text-[10px] font-black tracking-wider z-10 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4 w-24">Roll No.</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4">Student Name</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4 w-44">Marks ({maxScore})</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4 w-32 text-center">Attendance</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-4 w-28 text-right">Status</th>

                      const val = studentScore.marks;
                      const numVal = Number(val);
                      const isOverCeiling = val !== "" && !isNaN(numVal) && numVal > maxScore;
                      const isNegative = val !== "" && !isNaN(numVal) && numVal < 0;
                      const hasError = isOverCeiling || isNegative;
                      const isPassed = !studentScore.isAbsent && val !== "" && !isNaN(numVal) && numVal >= passingScore;

                      return (
                        <tr
                          key={student.id}
                          className={`transition-colors ${
                            studentScore.isAbsent
                              ? "bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/20 opacity-75"
                              : "hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40"
                          }`}
                        >
                          <td className="py-2 px-4 font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {student.roll_number || `0${idx + 1}`}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2 px-4 text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-semibold">
                            {student.name}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2 px-4">
                            {studentScore.isAbsent ? (
                              <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/30 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/40 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 text-xs font-bold font-mono">
                                <UserX className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                <span>ABSENT</span>
                              </div>
                            ) : (
                              <div className="relative">
                                <input
                                  ref={(el) => (inputRefs.current[idx] = el)}
                                  type="number"
                                  min="0"
                                  max={maxScore}
                                  step="0.5"
                                  placeholder="0.0"
                                  value={val}
                                  onChange={(e) => handleScoreChange(student.id, e.target.value)}
                                  onKeyDown={(e) => handleKeyDown(e, idx)}
                                  className={`w-28 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 border rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 transition-all ${
                                    hasError
                                      ? "border-rose-500 focus:ring-rose-500 bg-rose-50/40 text-rose-600"
                                      : "border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 focus:ring-cyan-500"
                                  }`}
                                />
                                {hasError && (
                                  <span className="block text-[10px] text-rose-500 font-semibold mt-0.5">
                                    {isOverCeiling ? `Max is ${maxScore}` : "Cannot be < 0"}
                                  </span>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2 px-4 text-center">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => handleToggleAbsent(student.id)}
                              className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                                studentScore.isAbsent
                                  ? "bg-amber-500 text-white shadow-xs"
                                  : "bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300"
                              }`}
                            >
                              {studentScore.isAbsent ? (
                                <>
                                  <UserCheck className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  <span>Mark Present</span>
                                </>
                              ) : (
                                <>
                                  <UserX className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  <span>Mark Absent</span>
                                </>
                              )}
                            </button>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2 px-4 text-right">
                            {studentScore.isAbsent ? (
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-500 uppercase">Excluded</span>
                            ) : val === "" ? (
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 font-mono">Pending</span>
                            ) : isPassed ? (
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-extrabold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                                Pass ({Math.round((numVal / maxScore) * 100)}%)
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-extrabold text-rose-500">
                                Retake ({Math.round((numVal / maxScore) * 100)}%)
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* ACTION TOOLBAR & CONFIRMATION */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
              {savingState === "saving" && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400 font-bold">
                  <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border-2 border-cyan-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
                  <span>Saving marks to institutional records...</span>

              {savingState === "saved" && (

                  <span>Marks saved securely.</span>
                </span>

              {savingState === "error" && (
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-rose-500 font-bold">
                  <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Error saving marks. Check inputs.</span>
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
              {/* SAVE AS DRAFT */}
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={savingState === "saving" || students.length === 0}
                onClick={() => handleSaveMarks(false)}
                className="flex-1 sm:flex-none inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Save as Draft</span>
              </button>

              {/* PUBLISH RESULTS (TRIGGERS CONFIRMATION) */}
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={savingState === "saving" || students.length === 0}
                onClick={() => setShowPublishConfirm(true)}
                className="flex-1 sm:flex-none inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-400 hover:to-blue-500 text-white text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-cyan-500/20 disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Publish Marks</span>

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* TAB 2: PREVIOUSLY ENTERED TESTS & HISTORY                            */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {activeTab === "history" && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-900 dark:text-white">

              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                View previously created class tests, review publication status, or edit draft marks.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500">Filter Class:</span>
              <select
                value={historyFilterClass}
                onChange={(e) => setHistoryFilterClass(e.target.value)}
                className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="ALL">All Classes</option>
                {assignedClasses.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c} value={c}>
                    {c}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {loadingHistory ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center space-y-3">
              <div className="w-6 h-6 border-2 border-cyan-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin mx-auto"></div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Loading test records...</p>
            </div>
          ) : historyTests.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-8 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-center space-y-2 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-slate-950/40">
              <BookOpen className="w-8 h-8 text-slate-400 mx-auto" />
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">No Class Tests Recorded Yet</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 max-w-sm mx-auto">
                You have not entered any class tests yet. Click "New Marks Entry" to start recording marks.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {historyTests
                .filter((t) => historyFilterClass === "ALL" || t.class_id === historyFilterClass)
                .map((test) => {
                  const isPub = test.status === "published";
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={test.id}
                      className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/80 hover:border-cyan-500/40 transition-all flex flex-col justify-between space-y-3 shadow-xs"
                    >
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-1.5">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                            {test.class_id} • {test.subject}
                          </span>
                          <span
                            className={`text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full uppercase ${
                              isPub
                                ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-300"
                                : "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-300"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {isPub ? "Published" : "Draft"}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white leading-snug">
                          {test.title}
                        </h4>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 font-mono">
                          <span>📅 {test.test_date}</span>
                          <span>Max: {test.max_score} pts</span>
                          {test.highest_score !== null && (
                            <span className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                              🏆 Class High: {test.highest_score}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800">
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                          {isPub ? `Published by ${test.published_by || "Faculty"}` : "Unpublished Draft"}
                        </span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => handleEditExistingTest(test)}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          <span>{isPub ? "View / Edit" : "Continue Entry"}</span>
                          <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* CONFIRMATION MODAL: PUBLISH MARKS                                   */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {showPublishConfirm && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl p-6 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-2xl space-y-4">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-cyan-50 dark:bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-200 dark:border-cyan-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400">
              <Send className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Publish Marks for {testTitle}?
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                Publishing makes results immediately visible in students' private portals. Each student will be able to
                view their own score and the class highest score. No peer marks or names will ever be shown.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-[11px] space-y-1 font-mono">
              <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                <span>Class & Subject:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{selectedClass} ({subject})</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                <span>Total Evaluated:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400">{presentCount} scholars</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                <span>Class Highest:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{highestCalculated} / {maxScore}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowPublishConfirm(false)}
                className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleSaveMarks(true)}
                className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 text-white text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-cyan-500/20"
              >
                Confirm & Publish
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  // Standalone Full-Page Mode vs Modal Mode
  if (isStandalone) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 transition-colors duration-200">
        <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200/90 dark:border-slate-800/80 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-sm dark:shadow-2xl">
          {content}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto">
      <div className="max-w-5xl w-full bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-2xl my-auto max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto">
        {content}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import BrandLogo from "./BrandLogo";

export default function CustomLogoUploader({ schoolCode, onLogoUpdated }) {
  const { user, tenant } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const activeCode = (
    schoolCode ||
    user?.institution_code ||
    user?.school_id ||
    tenant?.code ||
    "CAMPUS-01"
  )
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase();

  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const stored =
        localStorage.getItem(`erp_logo_${activeCode}`) ||
        localStorage.getItem(`erp_school_logo_${activeCode}`);
      if (stored) {
        setPreview(stored);
      } else {
        setPreview(null);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Error reading stored logo:", e);
    }
  }, [activeCode]);

  const handleFileChange = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) {
      showToast("Please select a valid image file (PNG, JPG, SVG, or WEBP).", "error");
      return;
    }

    if (file.size > 3 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showToast("Image size must be less than 3 MB.", "error");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = async (event) => {
      const base64 = event.target?.result;
      if (!base64) {
        showToast("Failed to process image.", "error");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      try {
        // Persist to both required keys
        localStorage.setItem(`erp_logo_${activeCode}`, base64);
        localStorage.setItem(`erp_school_logo_${activeCode}`, base64);
        setPreview(base64);

        // Try Supabase cloud sync
        try {
          if (supabase) {
            await supabase
              .from("schools")
              .update({ logo_url: base64 })
              .eq("code", activeCode);
          }
        } catch (dbErr) {
          console.warn("Supabase logo sync notice:", dbErr);
        }

        // Dispatch real-time event
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent("erp-logo-updated", {
            detail: { logoUrl: base64, schoolCode: activeCode },
          })
        );

        showToast("Institution logo uploaded & applied across portal!", "success");
        if (onLogoUpdated) onLogoUpdated(base64);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Logo save error:", err);
        showToast("Failed to save logo.", "error");
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    reader.onerror = () => {
      showToast("Failed to read image file.", "error");
      setLoading(false);
    };

    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleResetDefault = async () => {
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(`erp_logo_${activeCode}`);
      localStorage.removeItem(`erp_school_logo_${activeCode}`);
      setPreview(null);

      try {
        if (supabase) {
          await supabase
            .from("schools")
            .update({ logo_url: null })
            .eq("code", activeCode);
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      window.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent("erp-logo-updated", {
          detail: { logoUrl: null, schoolCode: activeCode },
        })
      );

      showToast("Reset to default EduSaaS institutional crest.", "info");
      if (onLogoUpdated) onLogoUpdated(null);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Reset logo error:", err);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-[#1E293B] border border-slate-700/80 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-xl space-y-5 text-slate-200">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-700/60 pb-3">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <span>🎨</span> Custom Institutional Branding & Crest
          </h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            Active Node: <span className="font-mono text-emerald-400 font-bold">{activeCode}</span> &bull; Replaces default logos across headers, login & ID cards
          </p>
        </div>
        {preview && (
          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30">
            Custom Crest Active
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-6">
        {/* Crest Preview */}
        <div className="relative group shrink-0">
          <div className="w-24 h-24 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900 border-2 border-dashed border-slate-600 flex items-center justify-center p-2 overflow-hidden shadow-inner">
            {preview ? (
              <img
                src={preview}
                alt="Uploaded Crest"
                className="w-full h-full object-contain rounded-xl"
              />
            ) : (
              <BrandLogo size="lg" />
            )}
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 text-center block mt-1.5 font-medium">
            {preview ? "Active Logo" : "Default Crest"}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Controls */}
        <div className="space-y-3 flex-1 w-full text-center sm:text-left">
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 leading-relaxed">
            Upload your school or coaching center's official emblem, seal, or logo in high resolution (PNG, JPG, or SVG). Changes reflect instantly without page reload.
          </p>

          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 justify-center sm:justify-start">
            <label className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-indigo-500 text-white font-bold px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>📤</span>
              <span>{loading ? "Processing..." : "Upload New Crest"}</span>
              <input
                type="file"
                accept="image/*"
                className="hidden"
                disabled={loading}
                onChange={handleFileChange}
              />
            </label>

            {preview && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleResetDefault}
                className="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 hover:text-white border border-slate-600 font-bold px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >

        </div>

    </div>
  );
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useContext } from "react";

import { exportToCSV } from "../utils/exportUtils";

export default function CustomReportBuilder({ schoolId: propSchoolId }) {

      storageKey: `erp_directory_${schoolId}`,
      headers: ["Roll / ID", "Full Name", "Role", "Class Batch", "Email", "Phone"],
      formatter: (data) =>
        (data || [])
          .filter((m) => (m.role || "").toLowerCase() === "student")
          .map((m) => [m.roll_number || m.role_code || "ID", `"${m.full_name || m.name || "Student"}"`, "Student", `"${m.class_name || "Class 10"}"`, m.email || "", m.phone || ""]),
    },
    {
      id: "fees",
      title: "Fee Treasury & Tax Compliance Audit",
      icon: "💰",
      desc: "Complete accounting log of settled tuition installments, Razorpay transaction IDs, and pending defaulter balances.",
      storageKey: `erp_fee_ledger_${schoolId}`,
      headers: ["Transaction ID", "Student Name", "Class", "Amount (INR)", "Payment Mode", "Status", "Date"],
      formatter: (data) =>
        (data || []).map((t) => [t.id || t.utr || "TXN", `"${t.student_name || "Student"}"`, `"${t.class_name || "Batch"}"`, t.amount || 0, t.payment_mode || "Online", t.status || "Paid", t.date || "Today"]),
    },
    {
      id: "staff",
      title: "Faculty & Operations Payroll Audit",
      icon: "🧹",
      desc: "Verified personnel registry of teaching faculty, campus drivers, security guards, cleaners, and monthly wage allocations.",
      storageKey: `erp_non_teaching_staff_${schoolId}`,
      headers: ["Staff ID", "Full Name", "Category / Role", "Shift Hours", "Monthly Salary", "Joining Date"],
      formatter: (data) =>
        (data || []).map((s) => [s.id || "STF", `"${s.fullName || "Staff"}"`, s.category || "Staff", `"${s.shiftTiming || "Full Day"}"`, `"${s.salary || "₹18,000"}"`, s.joiningDate || "2026"]),
    },
    {
      id: "audit",
      title: "Cryptographic Security & Activity Trail",
      icon: "⚙️",
      desc: "Immutable system activity log recording administrative admissions, fee verifications, and user role updates.",
      storageKey: "erp_audit_trail",
      headers: ["Timestamp", "User & Role", "Action Performed", "IP Address", "Security Status"],
      formatter: (data) =>
        (data || [])
          .filter((a) => !a.school_id || a.school_id === schoolId)
          .map((a) => [a.created_at || "Recent", `"${a.user_name || "Admin"}"`, `"${a.action || "Action"}"`, a.ip_address || "192.168.1.1", a.status || "Verified"]),
    },
  ];

  const handleExportCSV = (report) => {
    let rawData = [];
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(report.storageKey);
      if (saved) rawData = JSON.parse(saved);
    } catch (e) {}

    const rows = report.formatter(rawData);
    if (rows.length === 0) {
      showToast(`No records found for ${report.title} to export (Clean Slate).`, "info");
      return;
    }

    exportToCSV({
      filename: `${report.id}_report_${schoolId}_${new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]}`,
      headers: report.headers,

      entityType: "AUDIT_EXPORT",

  };

  const handleDownloadCertifiedSummary = () => {

    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* HEADER BANNER */}
      <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">

            <span>📑</span> Official Compliance & Governance
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white">Custom Report & Government Audit Builder</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1 max-w-xl">
            Generate certified government audit datasets, school census records, tax compliance registries, and printable PDF audit sheets.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={handleDownloadCertifiedSummary}
            disabled={generating}
            className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <span>🖨️</span>
            <span>{generating ? "Preparing Summary..." : "Print Certified Audit PDF"}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* REPORT MODULE CARDS */}

          <div
            key={rep.id}
            className="bg-[#1E293B]/80 border border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-7 shadow-2xl flex flex-col justify-between space-y-4 hover:border-emerald-500/40 transition-all"
          >
            <div>

                <span className="text-3xl p-3 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl">{rep.icon}</span>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">{rep.title}</h3>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-emerald-400 font-bold uppercase">Certified Standard Export</span>
                </div>
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";

export default function GrievanceTicketing({ schoolId: propSchoolId }) {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = propSchoolId || user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const [tickets, setTickets] = useState([]);
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState("ALL"); // ALL | Open | Assigned | Resolved
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    complainantName: "",
    relationship: "Parent / Guardian", // Parent | Student | Staff
    category: "Academic Support", // Academic Support | Fee Query | Infrastructure & Labs | Facilities & Safety
    priority: "High", // Urgent | High | Normal
    subject: "",
    description: "",
    contactPhone: "",
  });

  const loadTickets = () => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_grievances_${schoolId}`);
      if (saved) {
        setTickets(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setTickets([]);
      }
    } catch {
      setTickets([]);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadTickets();
    const handleUpdate = () => loadTickets();
    window.addEventListener("erp-grievances-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("erp-grievances-updated", handleUpdate);
  }, [schoolId]);

  const saveTickets = (updated) => {
    setTickets(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_grievances_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-grievances-updated"));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Storage save error:", e);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateTicket = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.complainantName.trim() || !form.subject.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide complainant name and query subject.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const newTicket = {
      id: `ticket_${Date.now()}`,
      ticketNumber: `GRV-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      complainantName: form.complainantName.trim(),
      relationship: form.relationship,
      category: form.category,
      priority: form.priority,
      subject: form.subject.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim() || "Query submitted to executive administration.",
      contactPhone: form.contactPhone.trim() || "+91 98000 00000",
      assignedStaff: "Unassigned",
      status: "Open", // Open | Assigned | Resolved
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
      resolutionNotes: "",
    };

    const updated = [newTicket, ...tickets];
    saveTickets(updated);

    logSecurityAction({
      action: "GRIEVANCE_TICKET_CREATED",
      entityType: "GRIEVANCE",
      entityId: newTicket.ticketNumber,
      details: `Created grievance ticket ${newTicket.ticketNumber} from ${newTicket.complainantName}: ${newTicket.subject}`,
      schoolId,
    });

    showToast(`Grievance ticket #${newTicket.ticketNumber} registered!`, "success");
    setForm({
      complainantName: "",
      relationship: "Parent / Guardian",
      category: "Academic Support",
      priority: "High",
      subject: "",
      description: "",
      contactPhone: "",
    });
    setShowAddModal(false);
  };

  const handleAssignStaff = (ticketId, staffName) => {
    const updated = tickets.map((t) =>
      t.id === ticketId ? { ...t, assignedStaff: staffName, status: "Assigned" } : t
    );
    saveTickets(updated);
    showToast(`Ticket assigned to ${staffName}!`, "info");
  };

  const handleResolveTicket = (ticketId) => {
    const updated = tickets.map((t) =>
      t.id === ticketId
        ? {
            ...t,
            status: "Resolved",
            resolvedAt: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
            resolvedBy: user?.name || "Executive Principal",
          }
        : t
    );
    saveTickets(updated);
    showToast("Grievance ticket marked as Resolved! 🎉", "success");
  };

  const handleDeleteTicket = (ticketId) => {
    const updated = tickets.filter((t) => t.id !== ticketId);
    saveTickets(updated);
    showToast("Ticket removed.", "info");
  };

  const filteredTickets = tickets.filter((t) => {
    const matchesStatus = filterStatus === "ALL" || t.status === filterStatus;
    const matchesSearch =
      (t.ticketNumber || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (t.complainantName || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (t.subject || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      (t.category || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    return matchesStatus && matchesSearch;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-slate-100">
      {/* Header Banner */}
      <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl shadow-cyan-500/10 flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out">
        <div>
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-400/30 text-cyan-300 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
            <span>📩</span> Stakeholder Communication Hub
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">Grievance Ticketing System</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs sm:text-sm mt-1 max-w-xl">
            Official parent and student redressal inbox. Delegate investigation to faculty, accountants, or facility managers and track resolution.
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowAddModal(true)}
          className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 via-indigo-600 to-purple-600 hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-purple-500 text-white font-black px-5 py-3 rounded-2xl text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/20 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:scale-[1.02] cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2 border border-white/20"
        >
          <span>➕</span>
          <span>Log Stakeholder Query</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* KPI Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Total Queries</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-white mt-1">{tickets.length}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-rose-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Open & Unassigned</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-rose-400 mt-1">
            {tickets.filter((t) => t.status === "Open").length}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Under Investigation</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-amber-400 mt-1">
            {tickets.filter((t) => t.status === "Assigned").length}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Resolved</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-400 mt-1">
            {tickets.filter((t) => t.status === "Resolved").length}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Filter and Search Bar */}
      <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3 items-center justify-between shadow-xl shadow-cyan-500/5">
        <div className="flex-1 w-full md:w-auto">
          <input
            type="text"
            placeholder="Search ticket #, parent name, or subject..."
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            className="w-full bg-slate-950/60 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-400 transition-all"
          />
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {["ALL", "Open", "Assigned", "Resolved"].map((s) => (
            <button
              key={s}
              onClick={() => setFilterStatus(s)}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:scale-[1.02] cursor-pointer ${
                filterStatus === s
                  ? "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-400/40 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/20"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5"
              }`}
            >
              {s}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tickets Table */}
      <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl shadow-cyan-500/10 overflow-hidden">
        {filteredTickets.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-12 text-center text-slate-400 space-y-3">
            <span className="text-4xl block opacity-60">📬</span>
            <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-white">No Grievance Tickets (Inbox Zero)</h4>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
              No parent or student concerns are pending. Click "Log Stakeholder Query" if a parent contacts administration.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto w-full">
            <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse min-w-[750px]">
              <thead>
                <tr className="border-b border-white/10 text-slate-400 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider bg-white/5">
                  <th className="p-4 pl-6">Ticket & Stakeholder</th>
                  <th className="p-4">Subject & Details</th>
                  <th className="p-4">Priority & Dept</th>

                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5 text-sm">
                {filteredTickets.map((t) => (
                  <tr
                    key={t.id}
                    className="hover:bg-white/5 transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out hover:scale-[1.005]"
                  >
                    <td className="p-4 pl-6 font-bold text-white">
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs text-cyan-400 font-extrabold block">

                      </span>
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";
import {
  DEFAULT_VENDORS,
  DEFAULT_REQUISITIONS,
  approvePurchaseRequisition,
  confirmGoodsReceived,
} from "../utils/procurementService";
import {
  Box,
  ShoppingCart,
  Building2,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  ShieldCheck,
  AlertTriangle,
  Plus,
  ArrowRight,
  Filter,
  DollarSign,
  Phone,
  Mail,
  Truck,
  X,
} from "lucide-react";

const INVENTORY_CATEGORIES = [
  "Uniforms & Apparel",
  "Textbooks & Syllabi",
  "Library Books & Volumes",
  "Laboratory Apparatus & Chemicals",
  "Sports & Athletic Gear",
  "Computer Hardware & IT",
];

export default function InventoryAssetManager({ schoolId: propSchoolId }) {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = propSchoolId || user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const [items, setItems] = useState([]);
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
  const [filterCat, setFilterCat] = useState("ALL");
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("inventory"); // 'inventory' | 'procurement' | 'vendors'

  const [requisitions, setRequisitions] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_requisitions_${schoolId}`);
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : DEFAULT_REQUISITIONS;
    } catch {
      return DEFAULT_REQUISITIONS;
    }
  });

  const [vendors, setVendors] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_vendors_${schoolId}`);
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : DEFAULT_VENDORS;
    } catch {
      return DEFAULT_VENDORS;
    }
  });

  const handleApprovePO = async (po) => {
    try {
      const approverName = user?.name || "Executive Principal";
      const updated = await approvePurchaseRequisition({
        requisition: po,
        approverName,
        schoolId,
        user,
      });

      const nextList = requisitions.map((r) => (r.id === po.id ? updated : r));
      setRequisitions(nextList);
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_requisitions_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(nextList));
      showToast(`Purchase Order ${po.po_number} approved! Maker-Checker verified.`, "success");
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.message, "error");
    }
  };

  const handleReceiveGoods = async (po) => {
    try {
      const updated = await confirmGoodsReceived({
        requisition: po,
        schoolId,
        user,
      });

      const nextList = requisitions.map((r) => (r.id === po.id ? updated : r));
      setRequisitions(nextList);
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_requisitions_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(nextList));
      showToast(`Goods received confirmed for ${po.po_number}! Stock updated.`, "success");
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.message, "error");
    }
  };

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: "",
    category: "Laboratory Apparatus & Chemicals",
    quantity: "25 Units",
    location: "Physics Lab Cabinet 2",
    condition: "Good / Available",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_inventory_${schoolId}`);
      if (saved) {
        setItems(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setItems([]);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setItems([]);
    }
  }, [schoolId]);

  const handleAddItem = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.name.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide asset item name.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const newItem = {
      id: `asset_${Date.now()}`,
      name: form.name.trim(),
      category: form.category,
      quantity: form.quantity.trim() || "1 Unit",
      location: form.location.trim() || "Main Campus Store",
      condition: form.condition,
      lastAudited: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    };

    const updated = [newItem, ...items];
    setItems(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_inventory_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}

    logSecurityAction({
      action: "Campus Asset / Inventory Registered",
      entityType: "INVENTORY",
      entityId: newItem.name,
      details: `Added ${newItem.quantity} of "${newItem.name}" to ${newItem.location}`,
      user,
      schoolId,
    });

    showToast(`Asset "${newItem.name}" added to campus inventory!`, "success");
    setForm({
      name: "",
      category: "Laboratory Apparatus & Chemicals",
      quantity: "25 Units",
      location: "Physics Lab Cabinet 2",
      condition: "Good / Available",
    });
    setShowAddModal(false);
  };

  const handleDeleteItem = (id, name) => {
    const updated = items.filter((i) => i.id !== id);
    setItems(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_inventory_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}
    showToast(`Item "${name || "Asset"}" removed from inventory.`, "info");
  };

    return i.category === filterCat;

        <div>

          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAddModal(true)}
            className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <span>➕</span>
            <span>Add Inventory Asset</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* NAVIGATION TABS */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab("inventory")}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === "inventory"
              ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-indigo-500/20"
              : "text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60"
          }`}
        >
          <Box className="w-4 h-4" />
          Physical Asset Inventory ({items.length})
        </button>

        <button

          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === "procurement"
              ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-emerald-500/20"
              : "text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60"
          }`}
        >
          <ShoppingCart className="w-4 h-4" />
          Procurement & Purchase Orders ({requisitions.length})
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab("vendors")}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === "vendors"
              ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-cyan-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-500/20"
              : "text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60"
          }`}
        >
          <Building2 className="w-4 h-4" />
          Vendor Directory ({vendors.length})
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* PROCUREMENT TAB */}
      {activeTab === "procurement" && (
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { getPendingOfflineCount, flushOfflineMutationQueue } from "../utils/offlineSyncQueue";

/**
 * OfflineBanner Component
 * Monitors navigator.onLine and renders a persistent amber warning banner
 * during network disruptions or degraded Palghar 3G connectivity.
 * Displays the real-time count of pending offline records in erp_offline_mutation_queue.
 */
export default function OfflineBanner() {
  const [isOnline, setIsOnline] = useState(() =>
    typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.onLine : true
  );
  const [pendingCount, setPendingCount] = useState(() => getPendingOfflineCount());
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleOnline = async () => {
      setIsOnline(true);
      setIsSyncing(true);
      try {
        await flushOfflineMutationQueue();
      } finally {
        setIsSyncing(false);
        setPendingCount(getPendingOfflineCount());
      }
    };

    const handleOffline = () => {
      setIsOnline(false);
      setPendingCount(getPendingOfflineCount());
    };

    const handleQueueUpdated = (e) => {
      const count = e?.detail?.pendingCount ?? getPendingOfflineCount();
      setPendingCount(count);
    };

    window.addEventListener("online", handleOnline);
    window.addEventListener("offline", handleOffline);
    window.addEventListener("erp-offline-queue-updated", handleQueueUpdated);
    window.addEventListener("erp-offline-sync-completed", handleQueueUpdated);

    // Initial check
    setPendingCount(getPendingOfflineCount());

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("online", handleOnline);
      window.removeEventListener("offline", handleOffline);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-offline-queue-updated", handleQueueUpdated);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-offline-sync-completed", handleQueueUpdated);
    };
  }, []);

  // When online and no pending syncs, don't show the banner
  if (isOnline && !isSyncing && pendingCount === 0) return null;

  // If online but flushing pending records
  if (isOnline && (isSyncing || pendingCount > 0)) {
    return (
      <div
        role="alert"
        className="bg-blue-600/95 text-white backdrop-blur-xl px-4 py-2 text-center text-xs font-bold tracking-wide fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-[9999] shadow-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 border-b border-blue-400 animate-in slide-in-from-top duration-300"
      >
        <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-white animate-ping"></span>
        <span>
          Reconnected! Synchronizing {pendingCount} durable offline mutation(s) to cloud ledger...
        </span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Offline amber banner
  return (
    <div
      role="alert"
      className="bg-amber-500/95 text-slate-950 backdrop-blur-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-center text-xs font-black tracking-wide fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-[9999] shadow-2xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2 border-b border-amber-400 animate-in slide-in-from-top duration-300 flex-wrap"
    >
      <span className="text-sm">⚠️</span>
      <span>
        Connection lost. Showing cached data —{" "}
        {pendingCount > 0
          ? `${pendingCount} offline record(s) queued in durable store (will auto-sync on reconnect).`
          : "reconnect to sync."}
      </span>
      {pendingCount > 0 && (
        <span className="bg-slate-950 text-amber-300 text-[10px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-amber-400/40 font-bold ml-1">
          {pendingCount} Pending
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
