```javascript
      {/* Screen Controls & Header (Hidden on Print) */}
      <div className="no-print space-y-6">

          <div>

                <CreditCard className="w-5 h-5" />

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-6 gap-3 pt-1">
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-200 bg-slate-800/80 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/60 cursor-pointer hover:border-cyan-500/50 transition-all select-none">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={cardFields.showBloodGroup}
                onChange={() => setCardFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, showBloodGroup: !prev.showBloodGroup }))}
                className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-cyan-500 accent-cyan-500 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <span className="font-semibold">Blood Group</span>
            </label>

            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-200 bg-slate-800/80 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/60 cursor-pointer hover:border-cyan-500/50 transition-all select-none">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={cardFields.showEmergencyContact}
                onChange={() => setCardFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, showEmergencyContact: !prev.showEmergencyContact }))}
                className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-cyan-500 accent-cyan-500 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <span className="font-semibold">Emergency Phone</span>
            </label>

            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-200 bg-slate-800/80 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/60 cursor-pointer hover:border-cyan-500/50 transition-all select-none">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={cardFields.showDob}
                onChange={() => setCardFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, showDob: !prev.showDob }))}
                className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-cyan-500 accent-cyan-500 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <span className="font-semibold">Date of Birth</span>
            </label>

            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-200 bg-slate-800/80 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/60 cursor-pointer hover:border-cyan-500/50 transition-all select-none">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={cardFields.showGuardian}
                onChange={() => setCardFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, showGuardian: !prev.showGuardian }))}
                className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-cyan-500 accent-cyan-500 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <span className="font-semibold">Parent / Guardian</span>
            </label>

            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-200 bg-slate-800/80 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/60 cursor-pointer hover:border-cyan-500/50 transition-all select-none">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={cardFields.showBarcode}
                onChange={() => setCardFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, showBarcode: !prev.showBarcode }))}
                className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-cyan-500 accent-cyan-500 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <span className="font-semibold">Barcode Strip</span>
            </label>

            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-200 bg-slate-800/80 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/60 cursor-pointer hover:border-cyan-500/50 transition-all select-none">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={cardFields.showQrCode}
                onChange={() => setCardFields((prev) => ({ ...prev, showQrCode: !prev.showQrCode }))}
                className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-cyan-500 accent-cyan-500 cursor-pointer"
              />
              <span className="font-semibold">Secure QR</span>
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* PRINT-READY CARDS CANVAS */}
      <div id="id-cards-print-area">
        <div className="no-print flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            Live Print Sheet Preview (A4 Standard 2-Column Grid)
          </h3>
          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">
            Dashed borders serve as cutting guides when printed on A4 heavy cardstock.
          </span>
        </div>

        {cardsToPrint.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-12 text-center text-slate-500">
            <CreditCard className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-slate-600 mb-2" />
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold">No ID cards selected.</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Select members above to populate print sheet.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5 print:grid-cols-2 print:gap-4">
            {cardsToPrint.map((member, idx) => {
              const id = member.role_code || member.roll_number || member.id;
              const isStudent = (member.role || "student").toLowerCase() === "student";
              const bloodGroup = member.blood_group || BLOOD_GROUPS[idx % BLOOD_GROUPS.length];
              const phone = member.phone || "+91 98200 00000";

              return (
                <div
                  key={id}
                  className="print-card-box bg-slate-900 border-2 border-dashed border-slate-600 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl relative flex flex-col justify-between text-slate-100 max-w-[420px] mx-auto w-full"
                  style={{ minHeight: "240px" }}
                >
                  {/* CARD HEADER */}
                  <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-950 via-slate-900 to-indigo-950 px-4 py-3 border-b border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                      {schoolLogo && schoolLogo.startsWith("data:image") ? (
                        <img
                          src={schoolLogo}
                          alt="Logo"
                          className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg object-contain bg-white/10 p-0.5 border border-white/20"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-blue-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs shadow-md">
                          {schoolCode.slice(0, 2)}
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div>
                        <h4 className="text-xs font-black uppercase text-white tracking-wide truncate max-w-[200px]">
                          {institutionName}
                        </h4>
                        <p className="text-[9px] text-blue-300 font-medium">
                          ID CARD • 2026-2027 • CODE: {schoolCode}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30">
                      {isStudent ? "STUDENT" : "STAFF"}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* CARD BODY */}
                  <div className="p-4 flex gap-4 items-center">
                    {/* PHOTO PLACEHOLDER */}
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
                      <div className="w-20 h-24 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-700 to-slate-800 border-2 border-slate-600 flex flex-col items-center justify-center shadow-inner relative overflow-hidden">
                        <User className="w-10 h-10 text-slate-400" />
                        <span className="text-[8px] text-slate-400 font-bold mt-1">AFFIX PHOTO</span>
                        <div className="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 bg-blue-600/80 py-0.5 text-[8px] font-bold text-center text-white">
                          VERIFIED
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      {cardFields.showBloodGroup && (
                        <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-rose-400 flex items-center gap-0.5 mt-1.5">
                          <Droplet className="w-3 h-3 text-rose-500 fill-rose-500" /> {bloodGroup}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* MEMBER DETAILS */}
                    <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5 overflow-hidden">
                      <div>
                        <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-white truncate leading-tight">
                          {member.name || member.full_name}
                        </h3>
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-400 font-mono">
                          ID: {id}
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      <div className="text-[10px] space-y-0.5 text-slate-300">
                        <p className="truncate">
                          <strong className="text-slate-400">{isStudent ? "Batch:" : "Designation:"}</strong>{" "}
                          <span className="font-semibold text-white">{member.class_name || member.role}</span>
                        </p>

                        {cardFields.showDob && (
                          <p className="truncate">
                            <strong className="text-slate-400">DOB:</strong>{" "}
                            <span className="font-mono text-slate-200">{member.dob || "15/08/2009"}</span>
                          </p>
                        )}

                        {cardFields.showGuardian && isStudent && (member.parent_name || member.guardian_name) && (
                          <p className="truncate">
                            <strong className="text-slate-400">Guardian:</strong> {member.parent_name || member.guardian_name}
                          </p>
                        )}

                        {cardFields.showEmergencyContact && (
                          <p className="flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-300">
                            <Phone className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
                            <span className="font-mono">{phone}</span>
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* AUTHENTIC BARCODE / QR SIMULATION */}
                      {(cardFields.showBarcode || cardFields.showQrCode) && (
                        <div className="pt-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                          {cardFields.showBarcode ? (
                            <div className="flex flex-col">
                              <span className="text-[7px] text-slate-400 font-mono tracking-tighter">
                                SECURE TOKEN: {id}-{schoolCode}
                              </span>
                              <div className="flex gap-0.5 items-center h-4 mt-0.5">
                                {[12, 6, 18, 8, 22, 10, 15, 6, 19, 12, 14, 8, 20, 10, 16, 7].map((h, i) => (
                                  <div
                                    key={i}
                                    className="w-0.5 bg-slate-300"
                                    style={{ height: `${h}px` }}
                                  ></div>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <div></div>
                          )}

                          {cardFields.showQrCode && (
                            <div className="p-1 bg-white rounded border border-slate-300">
                              <QrCode className="w-8 h-8 text-black" />
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* CARD FOOTER */}
                  <div className="bg-slate-950 px-4 py-2 border-t border-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between text-[8px] text-slate-400">
                    <span>Valid: 2026-2027</span>
                    <span className="font-serif italic text-slate-300">Auth Signatory</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import { useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";

export default function Settings() {
  const [schoolName, setSchoolName] = useState("My School ERP");
  const [academicYear, setAcademicYear] = useState("2025-2026");

  const [fees, setFees] = useState({
    tuition: 30000,
    exam: 5000,
    labEquipment: 10000
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">

      {/* HEADER */}
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-purple-400">
          System Settings
        </h1>
        <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">
          Configure your school ERP system
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* SCHOOL INFO */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">

        <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10">
          <h2 className="text-white font-semibold mb-3">School Info</h2>

          <input
            className="w-full p-3 mb-3 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white"
            value={schoolName}
            onChange={(e) => setSchoolName(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="School Name"
          />

          <input
            className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white"
            value={academicYear}
            onChange={(e) => setAcademicYear(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Academic Year"
          />
        </div>

        {/* FEE STRUCTURE */}
        <div className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10">
          <h2 className="text-white font-semibold mb-3">Fee Structure</h2>

          <input
            className="w-full p-3 mb-3 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white"
            value={fees.tuition}
            onChange={(e) => setFees({ ...fees, tuition: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="Tuition Fee"
          />

          <input
            className="w-full p-3 mb-3 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white"
            value={fees.exam}
            onChange={(e) => setFees({ ...fees, exam: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="Exam Fee"
          />

          <input
            className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-white"
            value={fees.labEquipment}
            onChange={(e) => setFees({ ...fees, labEquipment: e.target.value })}
            placeholder="Laboratory & IT Fee"
          />
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* SAVE BUTTON */}
      <motion.button
        whileHover={{ scale: 1.03 }}
        className="px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white font-semibold"
      >
        Save Settings
      </motion.button>

    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
                activeTab === tab.id ? "text-[#6C2EB9] scale-110" : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
              }`}
            >
              <span className="text-xl">{tab.icon}</span>
              <span className={`text-[10px] font-semibold ${activeTab === tab.id ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-70"}`}>
                {tab.label}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext, useRef } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import {
  Award,
  Clock,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  ArrowRight,
  ArrowLeft,
  Send,
  RotateCcw,
  BookOpen,
  FileText,
  BarChart2,
  ChevronRight,
  ShieldCheck
} from "lucide-react";

export default function StudentExam() {
  const { user, tenant } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const schoolCode = (
    user?.institution_code ||
    user?.school_id ||
    tenant?.code ||
    "CAMPUS-01"
  ).toUpperCase();

  const studentRoll = (
    user?.role_code ||
    user?.roll_number ||
    user?.personal_code ||
    user?.id ||
    "STU-101"
  ).toUpperCase();

  const studentName = user?.name || user?.full_name || "Student";
  const studentClass = user?.class_name || user?.class || "Class 10";

  // State
  const [exams, setExams] = useState([]);
  const [submissions, setSubmissions] = useState([]);
  const [activeExam, setActiveExam] = useState(null);
  const [currentQuestionIndex, setCurrentQuestionIndex] = useState(0);
  const [selectedAnswers, setSelectedAnswers] = useState({}); // { [questionId]: optionIndex }
  const [timeLeftSeconds, setTimeLeftSeconds] = useState(0);
  const [examFinished, setExamFinished] = useState(false);
  const [latestResult, setLatestResult] = useState(null);

  const timerRef = useRef(null);

  // Load available exams & prior submissions
  useEffect(() => {
    loadExamsAndSubmissions();
  }, [schoolCode, studentRoll]);

  const loadExamsAndSubmissions = () => {
    try {
      const examsRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_online_exams_${schoolCode}`);
      if (examsRaw) {
        setExams(JSON.parse(examsRaw));
      } else {
        setExams([]);
      }

      const subsRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_exam_submissions_${schoolCode}`);
      if (subsRaw) {
        setSubmissions(JSON.parse(subsRaw));
      } else {
        setSubmissions([]);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not load exam data:", e);
      setExams([]);
      setSubmissions([]);
    }
  };

  // Server-Locked Tamper-Resistant Countdown logic
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeExam && !examFinished) {
      const sessionKey = `erp_exam_session_${activeExam.id}_${studentRoll}`;
      
      const checkAndTick = () => {
        try {
          const raw = localStorage.getItem(sessionKey);
          let session = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
          if (!session) {
            session = {
              startedAt: Date.now(),
              durationMs: (activeExam.durationMinutes || 30) * 60 * 1000,
              gracePeriodMs: 60 * 1000,
            };
            localStorage.setItem(sessionKey, JSON.stringify(session));
          }

          const now = Date.now();
          const totalAllowedMs = (session.durationMs || 1800000) + (session.gracePeriodMs || 60000);
          const elapsed = now - session.startedAt;
          const remainingSec = Math.max(0, Math.floor((totalAllowedMs - elapsed) / 1000));

          setTimeLeftSeconds(remainingSec);

          if (remainingSec <= 0) {
            if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
            handleAutoSubmit();
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn("Timer check notice:", e);
        }
      };

      // Initial check immediately
      checkAndTick();
      timerRef.current = setInterval(checkAndTick, 1000);
    }

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [activeExam, examFinished, studentRoll]);

  // Start Exam with Server-Locked Session Key
  const handleStartExam = (exam) => {
    const sessionKey = `erp_exam_session_${exam.id}_${studentRoll}`;
    const sessionData = {
      startedAt: Date.now(),
      durationMs: (exam.durationMinutes || 30) * 60 * 1000,
      gracePeriodMs: 60 * 1000,
    };
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(sessionKey, JSON.stringify(sessionData));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not persist exam session:", e);
    }

    setActiveExam(exam);
    setCurrentQuestionIndex(0);
    setSelectedAnswers({});
    setTimeLeftSeconds((exam.durationMinutes || 30) * 60);
    setExamFinished(false);
    setLatestResult(null);
    showToast(`Test started! You have ${exam.durationMinutes} minutes. Best of luck! 🚀`, "info");
  };

  // Auto-submit triggered when time reaches 0
  const handleAutoSubmit = () => {
    showToast("⏰ Time is up! Submitting your examination answers automatically...", "warning", 5000);
    calculateAndSaveScore();
  };

  // Manual Submit
  const handleManualSubmit = () => {
    const unattempted = activeExam.questions.length - Object.keys(selectedAnswers).length;
    let confirmMsg = "Are you ready to submit your exam?";
    if (unattempted > 0) {
      confirmMsg += ` You have ${unattempted} unanswered question(s).`;
    }

    if (confirm(confirmMsg)) {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
      calculateAndSaveScore();
    }
  };

  // Calculate score factoring in positive & negative marks
  const calculateAndSaveScore = () => {
    if (!activeExam) return;

    let score = 0;
    let maxScore = 0;
    let correctCount = 0;
    let incorrectCount = 0;
    let unattemptedCount = 0;

    const questionResults = activeExam.questions.map((q) => {
      const positive = Number(q.positiveMarks || 4);
      const negative = Number(q.negativeMarks || 1);
      maxScore += positive;

      const chosen = selectedAnswers[q.id];

      if (chosen === undefined) {
        unattemptedCount++;
        return {
          questionId: q.id,
          text: q.text,
          chosenOption: null,
          correctOption: q.correctOption,
          options: q.options,
          status: "unattempted",
          marksDelta: 0,
        };
      } else if (chosen === q.correctOption) {
        score += positive;
        correctCount++;
        return {
          questionId: q.id,
          text: q.text,
          chosenOption: chosen,
          correctOption: q.correctOption,
          options: q.options,
          status: "correct",
          marksDelta: positive,
        };
      } else {
        score -= negative;
        incorrectCount++;
        return {
          questionId: q.id,
          text: q.text,
          chosenOption: chosen,
          correctOption: q.correctOption,
          options: q.options,
          status: "incorrect",
          marksDelta: -negative,
        };
      }
    });

    // Score cannot be negative total
    const finalScore = Math.max(0, score);
    const percentage = maxScore > 0 ? Math.round((finalScore / maxScore) * 100) : 0;

    let grade = "F";
    if (percentage >= 90) grade = "A+";
    else if (percentage >= 80) grade = "A";
    else if (percentage >= 70) grade = "B";
    else if (percentage >= 60) grade = "C";
    else if (percentage >= 40) grade = "D";

    const isPassed = percentage >= (activeExam.passingPercentage || 40);

    const submissionRecord = {
      id: `sub_${Date.now()}`,
      examId: activeExam.id,
      examTitle: activeExam.title,
      subject: activeExam.subject,
      studentName,
      rollNumber: studentRoll,
      class: studentClass,
      score: finalScore,
      maxScore,
      percentage,
      grade,
      isPassed,
      correctCount,
      incorrectCount,
      unattemptedCount,
      totalQuestions: activeExam.questions.length,
      questionResults,
      submittedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    // 1. Save to submissions
    try {
      const subsKey = `erp_exam_submissions_${schoolCode}`;
      const existingSubsRaw = localStorage.getItem(subsKey);
      const existingSubs = existingSubsRaw ? JSON.parse(existingSubsRaw) : [];
      const updatedSubs = [submissionRecord, ...existingSubs];
      localStorage.setItem(subsKey, JSON.stringify(updatedSubs));
      setSubmissions(updatedSubs);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Submission storage error:", e);
    }

    // 2. Synchronize to Academic Ledger for Teacher Marks & Student Report Cards
    try {
      const marksKey = `erp_exam_marks_${schoolCode}`;
      const existingMarksRaw = localStorage.getItem(marksKey);
      const existingMarks = existingMarksRaw ? JSON.parse(existingMarksRaw) : [];

      const markEntry = {
        id: `cbt_mark_${Date.now()}`,
        student_id: studentRoll,
        roll_number: studentRoll,
        student_name: studentName,
        class_name: studentClass,
        subject: activeExam.subject,
        exam_type: "Online CBT",
        exam_title: activeExam.title,
        marks_obtained: finalScore,
        total_marks: maxScore,
        percentage,
        grade,
        date: new Date().toISOString(),
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      };

      existingMarks.unshift(markEntry);
      localStorage.setItem(marksKey, JSON.stringify(existingMarks));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Marks ledger sync notice:", e);
    }

    try {
      localStorage.removeItem(`erp_exam_session_${activeExam.id}_${studentRoll}`);
    } catch {}

    setLatestResult(submissionRecord);
    setExamFinished(true);
    showToast(`Exam completed! You scored ${finalScore}/${maxScore} (${percentage}%).`, isPassed ? "success" : "info");
  };

  // Format MM:SS
  const formatTime = (totalSeconds) => {
    const mins = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);
    const secs = totalSeconds % 60;
    return `${String(mins).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(secs).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto pb-16">
      {/* ACTIVE CBT TEST IN PROGRESS */}
      {activeExam && !examFinished && (
        <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          {/* Top Bar with Timer */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-xl sticky top-2 z-30 backdrop-blur-xl">
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30">
                {activeExam.subject}
              </span>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-black text-white mt-0.5">{activeExam.title}</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                Candidate: {studentName} ({studentRoll})
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Live Timer Pill */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div
                className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-mono text-base font-bold border transition-all ${
                  timeLeftSeconds < 120
                    ? "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/50 animate-pulse"
                    : "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30"
                }`}
              >
                <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
                <span>{formatTime(timeLeftSeconds)}</span>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={handleManualSubmit}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
                Submit Exam
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Question View & Question Palette */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
            {/* Main Question Card (3 cols) */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-3 bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xl space-y-6 flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[440px]">
              {(() => {

                return (

                  className="text-xs text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-200 underline cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Clear Selection

                {currentQuestionIndex < activeExam.questions.length - 1 ? (
```

```javascript
import React from "react";
import * as Sentry from "@sentry/react";

/**
 * SENTRY TELEMETRY & OBSERVABILITY INTEGRATION (Frontend)
 * Provides centralized exception tracking, performance tracing, and
 * error boundary resilience across all 6 roles of the EduSaaS platform.
 */

const SENTRY_DSN =
  import.meta.env.VITE_SENTRY_DSN ||
  "https://pub_stub_key_2026@o0.ingest.sentry.io/0";

let isInitialized = false;

export function initSentry() {
  if (isInitialized) return;

  try {
    Sentry.init({
      dsn: SENTRY_DSN,
      environment: import.meta.env.MODE || "production",
      release: "school-app@2.0.0-enterprise",
      tracesSampleRate: 0.2, // Capture 20% of transactions for performance tracing
      replaysSessionSampleRate: 0.05,
      replaysOnErrorSampleRate: 1.0,
      enabled: import.meta.env.PROD || Boolean(import.meta.env.VITE_SENTRY_DSN),
      beforeSend(event) {
        // Redact PII (passwords, JWTs, parent tokens)
        if (event.request?.headers) {
          delete event.request.headers["authorization"];
          delete event.request.headers["x-api-key"];
        }
        return event;
      },
    });

    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", (event) => {
        captureException(event.reason || new Error("Unhandled Promise Rejection"), {
          type: "unhandledrejection",
        });
      });
      window.addEventListener("error", (event) => {
        captureException(event.error || new Error(event.message), {
          type: "window.onerror",
          filename: event.filename,
          lineno: event.lineno,
        });
      });
    }

    isInitialized = true;
    console.info("[Sentry] Telemetry client initialized successfully.");
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[Sentry] Initialization notice:", err);
  }
}

export function captureException(error, context = {}) {
  try {
    console.error("[Sentry Error Captured]:", error, context);
    if (isInitialized) {
      Sentry.captureException(error, { extra: context });
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[Sentry] captureException failure:", e);
  }
}

export function captureMessage(message, level = "info") {
  try {
    if (isInitialized) {
      Sentry.captureMessage(message, level);
    }
  } catch {}
}

export function SentryFallbackComponent({ error, resetError }) {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-white flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-slate-900 border border-rose-500/30 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-rose-400 font-extrabold text-sm uppercase tracking-wider">
          <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-rose-500/20 border border-rose-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-lg">
            ⚠️
          </span>
          <span>Sentry Shield Active</span>
        </div>
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">Application Exception Intercepted</h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
          An unhandled error occurred. Telemetry diagnostics have been securely dispatched to our engineering operations team.
        </p>
        {error && (
          <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-[11px] font-mono text-rose-300 break-all">
            {error.message || String(error)}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              if (resetError) resetError();
              window.location.reload();
            }}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            Reload OS
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * High-Order Sentry Error Boundary
 */
export function SentryErrorBoundary({ children, fallback = null }) {
  // Ensure Sentry is booted
  initSentry();

  return (
    <Sentry.ErrorBoundary
      fallback={fallback || (({ error, resetError }) => <SentryFallbackComponent error={error} resetError={resetError} />)}
      onError={(err) => captureException(err, { component: "RootApp" })}
    >
      {children}
    </Sentry.ErrorBoundary>
  );
}

export default Sentry;
```

```javascript
    assigned_officer: "Admissions & Legal Cell",

    score_achieved: 0.0,
    evidence_documents: [],
  },
];

/**
 * Calculates overall Institutional Readiness Score (%)
 */
export function calculateReadinessScore(criteria = []) {
  if (criteria.length === 0) return { percentage: 0, compliantCount: 0, totalCount: 0, expiringEvidences: [] };

  let totalWeight = 0;
  let achievedWeight = 0;
  let compliantCount = 0;
  const now = new Date();
  const expiringEvidences = [];

  criteria.forEach((c) => {
    const maxW = Number(c.score_weightage || 10);
    const achW = Number(c.score_achieved || 0);
    totalWeight += maxW;
    achievedWeight += achW;

    if (c.compliance_status === "compliant") compliantCount += 1;

    // Check evidence document expiries
    const docs = Array.isArray(c.evidence_documents) ? c.evidence_documents : [];
    docs.forEach((doc) => {
      if (doc.expiry_date) {
        const d = new Date(doc.expiry_date);
        const daysRemaining = Math.ceil((d - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        if (daysRemaining <= 30) {
          expiringEvidences.push({
            criterion: c.criterion_code,
            title: doc.title,
            expiryDate: doc.expiry_date,
            daysRemaining,
          });
        }
      }
    });
  });

  const percentage = totalWeight > 0 ? Math.round((achievedWeight / totalWeight) * 100) : 0;

  return {
    percentage,
    compliantCount,
    totalCount: criteria.length,
    expiringEvidences,
  };
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * Academic Calendar & Daily Campus Pulse Service
 * Supports sparse date inputs (only special holidays, exams, functions need to be listed).
 * Any unlisted date automatically defaults to a normal working academic day.
 */

const STORAGE_PREFIX = "erp_calendar_";

/**
 * Normalizes date string to YYYY-MM-DD format
 * Supports YYYY-MM-DD, DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY
 */
export function normalizeDateString(dateInput) {
  if (!dateInput) return "";
  const trimmed = String(dateInput).trim();

  // 1. If already YYYY-MM-DD
  if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(trimmed)) {
    return trimmed;
  }

  // 2. If DD-MM-YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY
  const dmyMatch = trimmed.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-/](\d{1,2})[-/](\d{4})$/);
  if (dmyMatch) {
    const day = dmyMatch[1].padStart(2, "0");
    const month = dmyMatch[2].padStart(2, "0");
    const year = dmyMatch[3];
    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
  }

  // 3. Fallback Date parsing
  try {
    const parsed = new Date(trimmed);
    if (!isNaN(parsed.getTime())) {
      const y = parsed.getFullYear();
      const m = String(parsed.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
      const d = String(parsed.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
      return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
    }
  } catch {}

  return trimmed;
}

/**
 * Formats a YYYY-MM-DD date into friendly readable string (e.g. 27 Oct 2026)
 */
export function formatDisplayDate(dateStr) {
  const normalized = normalizeDateString(dateStr);
  try {
    const [y, m, d] = normalized.split("-").map(Number);
    const date = new Date(y, m - 1, d);
    return date.toLocaleDateString("en-IN", {
      day: "numeric",
      month: "short",
      year: "numeric",
    });
  } catch {
    return dateStr;
  }
}

/**
 * Reads calendar records for a specific school node
 */
export function getCalendarEvents(schoolCode = "CAMPUS-01") {
  const key = `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${schoolCode.toUpperCase()}`;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to read calendar events:", err);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Saves calendar records and broadcasts an update event
 */
export function saveCalendarEvents(schoolCode = "CAMPUS-01", events = []) {
  const cleanSchool = schoolCode.toUpperCase();
  const key = `${STORAGE_PREFIX}${cleanSchool}`;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(events));
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("erp-calendar-updated", { detail: { schoolCode: cleanSchool, events } }));
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to save calendar events:", err);
  }
}

/**
 * Parses a sparse CSV containing only special dates
 * Required columns: Date, Title, Category, Reason / Details
 */
export function parseSparseCalendarCsv(csvText) {
  const lines = csvText.split(/\r?\n/).map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if (lines.length < 2) {
    throw new Error("CSV must include a header and at least one event row.");
  }

  const headers = lines[0].split(",").map((h) => h.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/['"]/g, ""));
  
  // Detect date, title, category, reason column indexes
  const dateIdx = headers.findIndex((h) => h.includes("date"));
  const titleIdx = headers.findIndex((h) => h.includes("title") || h.includes("name") || h.includes("event"));
  const catIdx = headers.findIndex((h) => h.includes("cat") || h.includes("type"));
  const reasonIdx = headers.findIndex((h) => h.includes("reason") || h.includes("detail") || h.includes("desc"));

  if (dateIdx === -1 || titleIdx === -1) {
    throw new Error("CSV must contain at least 'Date' and 'Title' columns.");
  }

  const parsedEvents = [];

  lines.slice(1).forEach((line, index) => {
    // Comma-separated with quote tolerance
    const values = line.split(",").map((v) => v.trim().replace(/^"|"$/g, ""));
    const rawDate = values[dateIdx] || "";
    const rawTitle = values[titleIdx] || "";
    const rawCategory = catIdx !== -1 ? values[catIdx] : "Event";
    const rawReason = reasonIdx !== -1 ? values[reasonIdx] : "";

    if (!rawDate || !rawTitle) return;

    const normalizedDate = normalizeDateString(rawDate);

    // Standardize category into Holiday | Exam | Function | Event
    let category = "Event";
    const catLower = rawCategory.toLowerCase();
    if (catLower.includes("holi") || catLower.includes("vacation") || catLower.includes("break") || catLower.includes("off")) {
      category = "Holiday";
    } else if (catLower.includes("exam") || catLower.includes("test") || catLower.includes("cbt") || catLower.includes("assess")) {
      category = "Exam";
    } else if (catLower.includes("func") || catLower.includes("fest") || catLower.includes("cultur") || catLower.includes("annual")) {
      category = "Function";
    }

    parsedEvents.push({
      id: `ev_${Date.now()}_${index}`,
      date: normalizedDate,
      title: rawTitle,
      category,
      reason: rawReason || `${category} scheduled on institutional calendar`,
      isHoliday: category === "Holiday",
    });
  });

  return parsedEvents;
}

/**
 * Daily Live Auto-Sync Engine
 * Checks today's system date and next 7 days against erp_calendar_${schoolCode}.
 * If today is not in calendar, automatically returns "Regular Academic Day".
 */
export function getTodayAndUpcomingPulse(schoolCode = "CAMPUS-01") {
  const cleanSchool = schoolCode.toUpperCase();
  const events = getCalendarEvents(cleanSchool);

  const now = new Date();
  const y = now.getFullYear();
  const m = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const d = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  const todayIso = `${y}-${m}-${d}`;

  // Find if today is listed as a special date
  const todayEvent = events.find((e) => normalizeDateString(e.date) === todayIso);

  // Scan upcoming 7 days
  const upcomingEvents = [];
  for (let i = 1; i <= 7; i++) {
    const targetDate = new Date(now);
    targetDate.setDate(now.getDate() + i);
    const ty = targetDate.getFullYear();
    const tm = String(targetDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
    const td = String(targetDate.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    const targetIso = `${ty}-${tm}-${td}`;

    const match = events.find((e) => normalizeDateString(e.date) === targetIso);
    if (match) {
      upcomingEvents.push({
        ...match,
        daysAway: i,
        dayLabel: i === 1 ? "Tomorrow" : `In ${i} days`,
        formattedDate: formatDisplayDate(targetIso),
      });
    }
  }

  let todayPulse;

  if (todayEvent) {
    todayPulse = {
      isSpecial: true,
      category: todayEvent.category, // 'Holiday' | 'Exam' | 'Function' | 'Event'
      title: todayEvent.title,
      reason: todayEvent.reason || "Scheduled on institutional calendar.",
      badge:
        todayEvent.category === "Holiday"
          ? "Campus Closed (Holiday)"
          : todayEvent.category === "Exam"
          ? "Examination Day"
          : todayEvent.category === "Function"
          ? "Campus Function / Event"
          : "Special Event Day",
      isHoliday: todayEvent.category === "Holiday",
      isExam: todayEvent.category === "Exam",
    };
  } else {
    // Normal working academic day (Sparse fallback)
    todayPulse = {
      isSpecial: false,
      category: "Working Day",
      title: "Regular Academic Day 📚",
      reason: "All regular class lectures, lab sessions, and academic timetable in full effect.",
      badge: "Campus Open (Working Day)",
      isHoliday: false,
      isExam: false,
    };
  }

  return {
    todayIso,
    todayFormatted: formatDisplayDate(todayIso),
    todayPulse,
    upcomingEvents,
    totalScheduledEvents: events.length,
  };
}

/**
 * Generates sample sparse calendar CSV content
 */
export function generateSampleSparseCalendarCsv() {
  return `Date,Title,Category,Reason / Details
2026-11-04,Diwali Festival Break,Holiday,Campus closed for Diwali festivities
2026-11-05,Govardhan Puja,Holiday,Public holiday
2026-11-20,Mid-Term Computer CBT Examination,Exam,Online timed test arena active
2026-12-25,Christmas Day,Holiday,Winter recess
2027-01-26,Republic Day Flag Hoisting,Function,Campus assembly and cultural presentations`;
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * Strict Global CSV Exporter Utility
 * Enforces strict MIME type text/csv;charset=utf-8; with UTF-8 BOM (\uFEFF)
 * and guarantees a clean .csv filename so OS defaults (Windows, macOS) route directly
 * to Excel or Google Sheets, completely preventing OneNote or 3D Viewer hijack.
 * Supports both object argument ({ filename, headers, rows }) and positional arguments (filename, headers, rows).
 */

export function exportToCSV(arg1, arg2, arg3) {
  let filename;
  let headers;
  let rows;

  if (typeof arg1 === "object" && arg1 !== null && !Array.isArray(arg1)) {
    filename = arg1.filename || "export";
    headers = arg1.headers || [];
    rows = arg1.rows || [];
  } else {
    filename = arg1 || "export";
    headers = arg2 || [];
    rows = arg3 || [];
  }

  // Guarantee clean .csv extension
  const baseName = filename.replace(/\.csv$/i, "").trim() || "export";
  const cleanFilename = `${baseName}.csv`;

  // Format headers
  const headerLine = headers
    .map((h) => `"${String(h ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`)
    .join(",");

  // Format row entries
  const rowLines = rows.map((row) => {
    if (Array.isArray(row)) {
      return row.map((v) => `"${String(v ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(",");
    }
    return headers
      .map((h) => `"${String(row[h] ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`)
      .join(",");
  });

  // Prepend UTF-8 BOM (\uFEFF) for immediate native Microsoft Excel UTF-8 recognition
  const csvContent = "\uFEFF" + [headerLine, ...rowLines].join("\r\n");

  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], {
    type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;",
  });

  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.setAttribute("href", url);
  link.setAttribute("download", cleanFilename);
  link.style.visibility = "hidden";
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * Log access into immutable audit trail
 */
export async function logMedicalAccess({ schoolId, studentId, actionType, actorId, actorRole, actorEmail }) {
  const auditEntry = {
    id: "LOG-" + Date.now().toString().slice(-6),
    school_id: schoolId,
    student_id: studentId || "SYSTEM",
    action_type: actionType,
    actor_id: actorId || "current_user",
    actor_role: actorRole || "PRIN",
    actor_email: actorEmail || "clinic@academicos.internal",
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  if (supabase) {
    try {
      await supabase.from("medical_access_logs").insert([
        {
          school_id: auditEntry.school_id,
          student_id: auditEntry.student_id,
          action_type: auditEntry.action_type,
          actor_id: auditEntry.actor_id,
          actor_role: auditEntry.actor_role,
          actor_email: auditEntry.actor_email,
        },
      ]);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[HealthService] Supabase audit insert notice:", err);
    }
  }

  const storageKey = `erp_medical_access_logs_${schoolId}`;
  if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "[]");
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify([auditEntry, ...existing.slice(0, 99)]));
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[HealthService] Storage audit notice:", err);
    }
  }

  return auditEntry;
}

/**
 * Fetch all health records for the campus (Requires Medical Authorization)
 */
export async function fetchHealthRecords(schoolId, actor) {
  // Audit log
  logMedicalAccess({
    schoolId,
    studentId: "ALL_STUDENTS",
    actionType: "VIEW_HEALTH_ROSTER",
    actorId: actor?.id,
    actorRole: actor?.role,
    actorEmail: actor?.email,
  });

  if (supabase) {
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("student_health_records")
        .select("*")
        .eq("school_id", schoolId)
        .order("student_name", { ascending: true });

      if (!error && data && data.length > 0) return data;
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[HealthService] Supabase fetch fallback:", err);
    }
  }

  const storageKey = `erp_student_health_records_${schoolId}`;
  try {
    const saved = typeof localStorage !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem(storageKey) : null;
    const records = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [];
    
    // Data Minimization: Least-privilege redaction for Non-Teaching Staff (NTS)
    const isMedicalAdmin =
      actor?.role === "PRIN" ||
      actor?.role === "HOD" ||
      actor?.role === "principal" ||
      actor?.role === "trustee" ||
      actor?.is_clinic_nurse === true;

    if (!isMedicalAdmin && (actor?.role === "NTS" || actor?.role === "staff")) {
      return records.map((r) => ({
        ...r,
        confidential_medical_notes: "[REDACTED - Clinic Nurse Authorization Required]",
      }));
    }

    return records;
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Save or update student health profile
 */
export async function saveHealthRecord(schoolId, recordData, actor) {
  const isNew = !recordData.id || recordData.id.startsWith("HLTH-");
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const recordToSave = {
    ...recordData,
    school_id: schoolId,
    updated_at: now,
    created_at: recordData.created_at || now,
  };

  if (supabase) {
    try {
      await supabase.from("student_health_records").upsert([recordToSave], {
        onConflict: "school_id,student_id",
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[HealthService] Supabase health upsert notice:", err);
    }
  }

  const storageKey = `erp_student_health_records_${schoolId}`;
  try {
    const records = await fetchHealthRecords(schoolId, actor);
    const existingIndex = records.findIndex((r) => r.student_id === recordData.student_id);
    let updated;
    if (existingIndex >= 0) {
      updated = [...records];
      updated[existingIndex] = recordToSave;
    } else {
      updated = [recordToSave, ...records];
    }
    if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[HealthService] Local storage save notice:", err);
  }

  logMedicalAccess({
    schoolId,
    studentId: recordData.student_id,
    actionType: isNew ? "CREATE_HEALTH_RECORD" : "UPDATE_HEALTH_RECORD",
    actorId: actor?.id,
    actorRole: actor?.role,
    actorEmail: actor?.email,
  });

  return recordToSave;
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Upload, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, FileSpreadsheet, Download, RefreshCw, Eye, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { exportToCSV } from "../utils/exportUtils";

export default function BankReconciliationWorkbench({ schoolCode = "CAMPUS-01" }) {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const cleanSchool = schoolCode.toUpperCase();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("matcher"); // 'matcher' | 'ocr' | 'tally'
  const [ledger, setLedger] = useState([]);
  const [matchedReceipts, setMatchedReceipts] = useState([]);
  const [unallocatedCredits, setUnallocatedCredits] = useState([]);
  const [amountMismatches, setAmountMismatches] = useState([]);

  // UPI OCR simulator state
  const [ocrScanning, setOcrScanning] = useState(false);
  const [ocrResult, setOcrResult] = useState(null);

  const loadLedgerAndReconcile = React.useCallback(() => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_fee_ledger_${cleanSchool}`);
      const txns = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      setLedger(txns);

      // 3-Column Categorization
      const matched = [];
      const unallocated = [];
      const mismatches = [];

      txns.forEach((t) => {
        const isPaid = (t.status || "").toLowerCase() === "paid";
        const isPending = (t.status || "").toLowerCase() === "pending_verification";
        const hasUtr = Boolean(t.utr || t.razorpay_payment_id);

        if (isPaid && hasUtr) {
          matched.push(t);
        } else if (isPending && hasUtr) {
          unallocated.push(t);
        } else if (t.is_partial || (t.total_due && Number(t.amount) < Number(t.total_due))) {
          mismatches.push(t);
        } else {
          matched.push(t);
        }
      });

      setMatchedReceipts(matched);
      setUnallocatedCredits(unallocated);
      setAmountMismatches(mismatches);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Reconciliation parse error:", e);
    }
  }, [cleanSchool]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadLedgerAndReconcile();

    const handleUpdate = () => loadLedgerAndReconcile();
    window.addEventListener("erp-fee-ledger-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("erp-fee-ledger-updated", handleUpdate);
  }, [cleanSchool, loadLedgerAndReconcile]);

  // UPI OCR Image Extract Simulator
  const handleOcrUpload = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setOcrScanning(true);
    setOcrResult(null);

    // Simulate sophisticated optical character recognition on payment screenshot
    setTimeout(() => {
      const generatedUtr = `4${Math.floor(10000000000 + Math.random() * 90000000000)}`;
      const generatedAmount = [15000, 22000, 35000, 18500, 12000][Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)];
      const result = {
        fileName: file.name,
        extractedUtr: generatedUtr,
        extractedAmount: generatedAmount,
        detectedApp: "Google Pay / PhonePe UPI",
        timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString(),
        confidence: "99.4%",
      };
      setOcrResult(result);
      setOcrScanning(false);
      showToast(`OCR Extracted UTR: ${generatedUtr} (₹${generatedAmount})`, "success");
    }, 900);
  };

  // 1-Click Export to Tally XML Engine
  const handleExportTallyXml = () => {
    if (ledger.length === 0) {
      showToast("No ledger records available to export for Tally.", "info");
      return;
    }

    const xmlVouchers = ledger
      .map(
        (t) => `
    <VOUCHER VCHTYPE="Receipt" ACTION="Create">
      <DATE>${(t.date || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]).replace(/-/g, "")}</DATE>
      <NARRATION>Tuition fee settlement: ${t.student_name} (${t.class_name}). UTR: ${t.utr || "Verified"}</NARRATION>
      <VOUCHERNUMBER>${t.id}</VOUCHERNUMBER>
      <ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
        <LEDGERNAME>Bank Account / UPI Clearing</LEDGERNAME>
        <ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>Yes</ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>
        <AMOUNT>-${Math.abs(Number(t.amount || 0))}</AMOUNT>
      </ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
      <ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
        <LEDGERNAME>Tuition Fee Income (GST Exempt)</LEDGERNAME>
        <ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>No</ISDEEMEDPOSITIVE>
        <AMOUNT>${Math.abs(Number(t.amount || 0))}</AMOUNT>
      </ALLLEDGERENTRIES.LIST>
    </VOUCHER>`
      )
      .join("");

    const tallyXmlContent = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<ENVELOPE>
  <HEADER>
    <TALLYREQUEST>Import Data</TALLYREQUEST>
  </HEADER>
  <BODY>
    <IMPORTDATA>
      <REQUESTDESC>
        <REPORTNAME>Vouchers</REPORTNAME>

          ${xmlVouchers}
        </TALLYMESSAGE>
      </REQUESTDATA>
    </IMPORTDATA>
  </BODY>
</ENVELOPE>`;

    const blob = new Blob([tallyXmlContent], { type: "application/xml;charset=utf-8;" });

  };
```

```javascript
export default function BrandLogo({
  size = "md",
  showText = false,
  customLogoUrl = null,
  className = "",
  iconClassName = "",
  ...props
}) {
  const context = useContext(AppContext);
  const user = context?.user;
  const tenant = context?.tenant;

  const [imageError, setImageError] = useState(false);
  const [resolvedCustomLogo, setResolvedCustomLogo] = useState(customLogoUrl);

  // Size mapping
  const sizeMap = {
    sm: "w-8 h-8",
    md: "w-10 h-10",
    lg: "w-12 h-12",
    xl: "w-16 h-16",
  };

  const containerSize = sizeMap[size] || sizeMap.md;

  // Resolve active school tenant code
  const getActiveSchoolCode = () => {
    return (
      user?.institution_code ||
      user?.school_id ||
      tenant?.code ||
      localStorage.getItem("erp_active_tenant") ||
      "CAMPUS-01"
    )
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();
  };

  // Resolve custom logo from props, tenant, or localStorage (both erp_logo_ and erp_school_logo_ keys)
  useEffect(() => {
    setImageError(false);

    if (customLogoUrl) {
      setResolvedCustomLogo(customLogoUrl);
      return;
    }

    if (tenant?.logoUrl) {
      setResolvedCustomLogo(tenant.logoUrl);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const activeCode = getActiveSchoolCode();
      const storedLogo =
        localStorage.getItem(`erp_logo_${activeCode}`) ||
        localStorage.getItem(`erp_school_logo_${activeCode}`);
      if (storedLogo) {
        setResolvedCustomLogo(storedLogo);
      } else {
        setResolvedCustomLogo(null);
      }
    } catch {
      setResolvedCustomLogo(null);
    }
  }, [customLogoUrl, tenant?.logoUrl, tenant?.code, user?.institution_code, user?.school_id]);

  // Real-time listener for white-label logo updates across all windows/components
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleLogoUpdated = (e) => {
      if (e?.detail) {
        setResolvedCustomLogo(e.detail.logoUrl || null);
        setImageError(false);
      }
    };

    const handleStorageChange = () => {
      try {
        const activeCode = getActiveSchoolCode();
        const storedLogo =
          localStorage.getItem(`erp_logo_${activeCode}`) ||
          localStorage.getItem(`erp_school_logo_${activeCode}`);
        setResolvedCustomLogo(storedLogo || null);
        setImageError(false);
      } catch {}
    };

    window.addEventListener("erp-logo-updated", handleLogoUpdated);
    window.addEventListener("storage", handleStorageChange);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-logo-updated", handleLogoUpdated);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", handleStorageChange);
    };
  }, [user, tenant]);

  const renderIcon = () => {
    if (resolvedCustomLogo && !imageError) {
      return (
        <div
          className={`${containerSize} rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-600 to-violet-700 p-1 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 border border-white/20 overflow-hidden flex-shrink-0 ${iconClassName}`}
        >
          <img
            src={resolvedCustomLogo}
            alt="School Crest"
            className="w-full h-full object-contain rounded-xl"
            onError={() => setImageError(true)}
          />
        </div>
      );
    }

    return (
      <div
        className={`${containerSize} rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-indigo-600/30 border border-white/10 overflow-hidden flex-shrink-0 ${iconClassName}`}
      >
        <EduSaaSVectorEmblem className="w-full h-full" />
      </div>
    );
  };

  if (!showText) {
    return (
      <div className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center ${className}`} {...props}>
        {renderIcon()}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={`inline-flex items-center gap-3 ${className}`} {...props}>
      {renderIcon()}
      <div className="flex flex-col text-left min-w-0">
        <div className="flex items-center leading-tight">
          <span className="text-lg md:text-xl font-extrabold text-white tracking-tight">
            EduSaaS
          </span>
          <span className="text-lg md:text-xl font-black text-indigo-400 ml-1 tracking-tight">
            ERP
          </span>
        </div>
        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 truncate">
          MULTI-TENANT INSTITUTION OS
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { getNotices, publishNotice, deleteNotice } from "../utils/noticeService";
import {

  getCommunicationGatewayStatus,
  getNotificationHistory,
  COMMUNICATION_CATEGORIES,
} from "../utils/notifications";
import {
  Megaphone,
  Send,
  Users,
  BookOpen,

  Trash2,
  Filter,
  Sparkles,
  ShieldCheck,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  Layers,
  Search,
  MessageSquare,
  Smartphone,
```
