```javascript
} from "lucide-react";

const CATEGORIES = [
  { id: "Administrative", label: "Administrative Circular", icon: "🏛️" },
  { id: "Academic", label: "Academic Schedule", icon: "📚" },
  { id: "Examination", label: "Examination Notice", icon: "📝" },
  { id: "Holiday", label: "Holiday & Vacation", icon: "🎉" },
  { id: "Emergency", label: "🚨 Emergency Alert", icon: "🚨" },
  { id: "Fee", label: "Fee & Dues Notice", icon: "💰" },
];

export default function BroadcastManager({ institutionCode: propSchoolCode }) {
  const { user, tenant } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const schoolCode = (
    propSchoolCode ||
    user?.institution_code ||
    user?.school_id ||
    tenant?.code ||
    "CAMPUS-01"
  ).toUpperCase();

  const [notices, setNotices] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState("all");

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("notices"); // 'notices' | 'parent_outbound'
  const [outboundLogs, setOutboundLogs] = useState([]);
  const [gatewayStatus, setGatewayStatus] = useState(() => getCommunicationGatewayStatus());

  // Parent Notification Form State
  const [parentNotifData, setParentNotifData] = useState({
    recipientPhone: "",
    recipientName: "",
    category: "announcement",
    channel: "whatsapp",
    message: "",
  });
  const [sendingParentNotif, setSendingParentNotif] = useState(false);

  // Form State
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    title: "",
    category: "Administrative",
    audienceType: "all", // 'all' | 'students' | 'teachers' | 'class'
    targetClass: "",
    content: "",
    date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
  });

  // Dynamic Class/Batch List mapped directly from Students Directory
  const [availableClasses, setAvailableClasses] = useState([]);

  // Map students directory to extract unique classes/batches automatically
  const loadDynamicClasses = React.useCallback(() => {
    try {
      let dir = [];
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${schoolCode}`);
      if (raw) {
        dir = JSON.parse(raw);
      }

      const uniqueClasses = new Set();

      (dir || []).forEach((m) => {
        if (!m) return;
        const role = (m.role || "student").toLowerCase();
        const code = (m.role_code || m.roll_number || m.id || "").toUpperCase();
        const isStudent = role === "student" || code.startsWith("STU-");

        if (isStudent) {
          const className = (m.class_name || m.class || m.batch || "").trim();
          if (className) {
            uniqueClasses.add(className);
          }
        }
      });

      const classList = Array.from(uniqueClasses).sort();
      setAvailableClasses(classList);

      // If class is currently selected but not in list, auto-select first available
      if (classList.length > 0 && !formData.targetClass) {
        setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, targetClass: classList[0] }));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not load dynamic classes from directory:", e);
      setAvailableClasses([]);
    }
  }, [schoolCode, formData.targetClass]);

  const loadParentLogs = React.useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const history = getNotificationHistory();
      setOutboundLogs(history);
    } catch (e) {}
  }, []);

  const loadNotices = React.useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const list = await getNotices(schoolCode);
      setNotices(list);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Error fetching notices:", e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [schoolCode]);

  // Load Directory and Notices
  useEffect(() => {
    loadDynamicClasses();
    loadNotices();
    loadParentLogs();

    const handleNoticesUpdate = () => loadNotices();
    const handleDirUpdate = () => loadDynamicClasses();

    window.addEventListener("erp-notices-updated", handleNoticesUpdate);
    window.addEventListener("erp-directory-updated", handleDirUpdate);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-notices-updated", handleNoticesUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-directory-updated", handleDirUpdate);
    };
  }, [schoolCode, loadDynamicClasses, loadNotices, loadParentLogs]);

  const handleSendParentNotification = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!parentNotifData.recipientPhone.trim() || !parentNotifData.message.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide recipient phone number and notification message.", "error");
      return;
    }

    setSendingParentNotif(true);
    try {
      const result = await dispatchParentNotification({
        schoolId: schoolCode,
        recipientPhone: parentNotifData.recipientPhone.trim(),
        recipientName: parentNotifData.recipientName.trim() || "Parent / Guardian",
        category: parentNotifData.category,
        channel: parentNotifData.channel,
        message: parentNotifData.message.trim(),
      });

      const statusMsg = result.delivery_status === "delivered" 
        ? "✅ Message delivered via WhatsApp Gateway!"
        : "ℹ️ Message queued in Parent Communication Hub.";

      showToast(statusMsg, result.delivery_status === "delivered" ? "success" : "info");
      loadParentLogs();
      setParentNotifData({
        recipientPhone: "",
        recipientName: "",
        category: "announcement",
        channel: "whatsapp",
        message: "",
      });
    } catch (err) {
      showToast("Dispatch error: " + err.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setSendingParentNotif(false);
    }
  };

  // Submit Targeted Notice
  const handlePublish = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!formData.title.trim() || !formData.content.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide notice headline and message content.", "error");
      return;
    }

    // Determine target audience string
    let audienceString = "All Students & Staff";
    if (formData.audienceType === "students") {
      audienceString = "All Students";
    } else if (formData.audienceType === "teachers") {
      audienceString = "All Teachers";
    } else if (formData.audienceType === "class") {
      const chosenClass = formData.targetClass.trim() || availableClasses[0] || "General Batch";
      audienceString = `Class: ${chosenClass}`;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await publishNotice({
        title: formData.title.trim(),
        category: formData.category,
        audience: audienceString,
        content: formData.content.trim(),
        date: formData.date || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
        schoolId: schoolCode,
        user,
      });

      showToast(`📢 Official broadcast dispatched to "${audienceString}"!`, "success");

      // Reset Form
      setFormData({
        title: "",
        category: "Administrative",
        audienceType: "all",
        targetClass: availableClasses[0] || "",
        content: "",
        date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
      });

      loadNotices();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Publish error:", err);
      showToast("Could not broadcast notice. Please retry.", "error");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Delete Notice
  const handleDelete = async (noticeId) => {
    if (confirm("Are you sure you want to dismiss and delete this broadcast circular?")) {
      await deleteNotice(noticeId, schoolCode);
      showToast("Notice circular removed from all dashboards.", "info");
      loadNotices();
    }
  };

  // Filtered Notices
  const filteredNotices = useMemo(() => {
    return notices.filter((n) => {
      const matchesSearch =
        (n.title || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
        (n.content || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
        (n.audience || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());

      const matchesCat = filterCategory === "all" || (n.category || "").toLowerCase() === filterCategory.toLowerCase();

      return matchesSearch && matchesCat;
    });
  }, [notices, searchQuery, filterCategory]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* MODULE NAVIGATION TABS */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab("notices")}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === "notices"
              ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-500/20"
              : "text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60"
          }`}
        >
          <Megaphone className="w-4 h-4" />
          In-App Circulars & Broadcasts
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab("parent_outbound")}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === "parent_outbound"
              ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-emerald-500/20"
              : "text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60"
          }`}
        >
          <Smartphone className="w-4 h-4" />
          Parent Communication Hub (WhatsApp & SMS)
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* PARENT OUTBOUND COMMUNICATION HUB */}
      {activeTab === "parent_outbound" && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Gateway Status Banner */}
          <div className="bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
                Parent Communication Gateway Telemetry
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                Multi-channel event triggers for Attendance Absence, Fee Dues, and Exam Results.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
              <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${gatewayStatus.whatsappConfigured ? "bg-emerald-400" : "bg-amber-400"}`} />
                {gatewayStatus.whatsappGateway}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick Dispatch Composer */}
          <div className="bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/80 p-6 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-xl space-y-4">
            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <Send className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
              Automated Parent Advisory Dispatcher
            </h4>

            <form onSubmit={handleSendParentNotification} className="space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                    Notification Trigger Category
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={parentNotifData.category}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      const cat = e.target.value;
                      let defaultMsg = "";
                      if (cat === "absence") defaultMsg = "🚨 Absence Alert: Your ward was marked absent for roll call today.";
                      if (cat === "fee_reminder") defaultMsg = "💰 Fee Advisory: Term fee installment is pending. Pay online via school portal.";
                      if (cat === "exam_result") defaultMsg = "📊 Term Exam Results have been approved and published to the Student Portal.";
                      if (cat === "homework") defaultMsg = "📚 Daily Assignment: Today's homework has been posted to the Student LMS.";
                      if (cat === "event") defaultMsg = "📅 Calendar Notice: School will observe a declared holiday tomorrow.";
                      setParentNotifData({ ...parentNotifData, category: cat, message: defaultMsg });
                    }}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                  >
                    {COMMUNICATION_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                      <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.icon} {c.label}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                    Parent Phone Number <span className="text-rose-400">*</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="tel"
                    required
                    placeholder="+91 98200 12345"
                    value={parentNotifData.recipientPhone}
                    onChange={(e) => setParentNotifData({ ...parentNotifData, recipientPhone: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                    Outbound Channel
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={parentNotifData.channel}
                    onChange={(e) => setParentNotifData({ ...parentNotifData, channel: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                  >
                    <option value="whatsapp">📱 WhatsApp Gateway</option>
                    <option value="sms">💬 SMS REST Route</option>
                    <option value="in_app">🔔 In-App Push Only</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                  Advisory Message Payload <span className="text-rose-400">*</span>
                </label>
                <textarea
                  rows={3}
                  required
                  value={parentNotifData.message}
                  onChange={(e) => setParentNotifData({ ...parentNotifData, message: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="Type official notification message..."
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl p-3 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2">
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                  Deliveries respect parent communication preferences and audit every dispatch.
                </span>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={sendingParentNotif}
                  className="px-5 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-md shadow-emerald-500/20 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  {sendingParentNotif ? "Dispatching..." : "Dispatch to Parent"}
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Outbound Logs History Table */}
          <div className="bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl p-5 space-y-4">
            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
              Parent Communication Outbound Log ({outboundLogs.length})
            </h4>

            {outboundLogs.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 py-6 text-center">No outbound notifications logged yet.</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 font-bold">
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Recipient</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Channel</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Category</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Status</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Message Snippet</th>
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-3">Time</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                    {outboundLogs.slice(0, 15).map((log, idx) => (
                      <tr key={log.id || idx}>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold">{log.recipient_phone || log.recipient}</td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 uppercase text-[10px] font-bold">{log.channel}</td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3">{log.category || "Alert"}</td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3">
                          <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                            log.delivery_status === "delivered" || log.status === "delivered"
                              ? "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
                              : "bg-blue-500/15 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400"
                          }`}>
                            {log.delivery_status || log.status || "queued"}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 truncate max-w-xs text-slate-500">{log.message}</td>
                        <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-slate-400 text-[10px]">
                          {log.timestamp ? new Date(log.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }) : "Just now"}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Broadcast Composer Card */}
      {activeTab === "notices" && (
      <>
      <div className="bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#1E293B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl space-y-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-slate-700/60">
          <div>
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 border border-blue-500/30 text-blue-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
              <Megaphone className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              Targeted Broadcast Hub &bull; Node {schoolCode}
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white">Dynamic Notice Board Dispatcher</h2>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs sm:text-sm mt-0.5">
              Deliver official announcements directly to student & faculty dashboards with zero SMS/WhatsApp spam.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-bold self-start sm:self-center">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Secure In-App Delivery</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handlePublish} className="space-y-5">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {/* Notice Title */}
            <div className="sm:col-span-2">
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Notice Headline / Subject <span className="text-rose-400">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                placeholder="e.g. Annual Term 2 Examination Timetable Released"
                value={formData.title}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, title: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition-colors"
              />
            </div>

            {/* Notice Category */}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Category
              </label>
              <select
                value={formData.category}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, category: e.target.value })}
                className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-xs sm:text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
              >
                {CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {c.icon} {c.label}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* DYNAMIC AUDIENCE SELECTOR & AUTO-UPDATING CLASS DROPDOWN */}
          <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl space-y-3">
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Target Audience
            </label>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2.5">
              {[
                { id: "all", label: "All Members", icon: "🌐" },
                { id: "students", label: "All Students", icon: "🎓" },
                { id: "teachers", label: "All Teachers", icon: "👨‍🏫" },
                { id: "class", label: "Specific Class / Batch", icon: "🏫" },
              ].map((aud) => (
                <button
                  key={aud.id}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setFormData({ ...formData, audienceType: aud.id })}
                  className={`flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all border cursor-pointer ${
                    formData.audienceType === aud.id
                      ? "bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-500 shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20"
                      : "bg-slate-800/80 text-slate-400 border-slate-700 hover:text-white"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>{aud.icon}</span>
                  <span className="truncate">{aud.label}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* AUTO-UPDATING CLASS / BATCH DROPDOWN (Shown when 'Specific Class / Batch' is selected) */}
            {formData.audienceType === "class" && (
              <div className="pt-2 animate-in fade-in duration-150">
                <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-blue-300 mb-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  Select Target Classroom Batch (Dynamically Loaded from Active Roster)
                </label>

                {availableClasses.length > 0 ? (
                  <select
                    value={formData.targetClass}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, targetClass: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full sm:w-80 bg-slate-900 border border-blue-500/40 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs sm:text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-400"
                  >
                    {availableClasses.map((cls) => (
                      <option key={cls} value={cls}>
                        {cls}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                ) : (
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center gap-2">
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="e.g. Class 10-A or JEE Repeater"
                      value={formData.targetClass}
                      onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, targetClass: e.target.value })}
                      className="w-full sm:w-80 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white"
                    />
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-amber-400">
                      ℹ️ Directory currently has no student classes. Type batch manually.
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Message Content */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
              Notice Content / Circular Details <span className="text-rose-400">*</span>
            </label>
            <textarea
              rows={4}
              required
              placeholder="Type official notification message to display inside student and faculty dashboards..."
              value={formData.content}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, content: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl p-4 text-xs sm:text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500"
            ></textarea>
          </div>

          {/* Action Footer */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-700/60">
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              Notices immediately synchronize across all open user sessions without page reload.
            </p>

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting}
              className="w-full sm:w-auto flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-6 py-2.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/30 transition-all hover:scale-105 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
              {submitting ? "Broadcasting..." : "Publish Broadcast Circular"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>

      {/* Active Broadcasts History List */}
      <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden space-y-4 p-6">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b border-slate-700/60">
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <Megaphone className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-400" />
              Active Institutional Circulars ({filteredNotices.length})
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
              Broadcasts actively streaming to target student and faculty portals
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 w-full sm:w-auto">
            <div className="relative flex-1 sm:w-60">
              <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search notices..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl pl-8 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none"
              />
            </div>

            <select
              value={filterCategory}
              onChange={(e) => setFilterCategory(e.target.value)}
              className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 text-xs rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1.5 focus:outline-none"
            >
              <option value="all">All Categories</option>
              {CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.label}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {filteredNotices.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="py-12 text-center text-slate-500 space-y-2">
            <Megaphone className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto text-slate-600 mb-1" />
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-300">No active circulars found.</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Publish a targeted broadcast above to notify your students or staff.</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3.5 max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {filteredNotices.map((notice) => (
              <div
                key={notice.id}
                className="bg-slate-900/70 border border-slate-700/60 hover:border-slate-600 rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 transition-all"
              >
                <div className="space-y-1.5 flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">

                  title="Delete Circular"
```

```javascript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { useAppContext } from "../context/AppContext";

export default function CreateClassModal({ isOpen, onClose, onRefresh }) {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const { user } = useAppContext?.() || {};
  const activeSchoolId = (user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({ grade: "", section: "" });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);

    // Auto-generate the class name (e.g. "10-A")
    const className = `${formData.grade}-${formData.section}`;

    try {
      const { error } = await supabase.from("classes").insert([{
        school_id: activeSchoolId,
        grade: formData.grade,
        section: formData.section,
        name: className
      }]);

      if (error) throw error;

      showToast(`Class ${className} created successfully!`, "success");
      onRefresh(); // Updates the dashboard stats instantly
      onClose();   // Closes the popup
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Database Error:", error);
      showToast("Failed to create class. Please verify database connectivity.", "error");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setFormData({ grade: "", section: "" });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm p-4">
      <div className="bg-[#1E293B] border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-md shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        
        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="bg-slate-800/50 p-6 border-b border-slate-700 flex justify-between items-center">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Create New Class</h2>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors text-2xl leading-none">
            &times;
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body / Form */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-6 space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Grade / Standard</label>
            <input 
              type="text" 
              required
              placeholder="e.g., 10" 
              className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 transition-all"
              value={formData.grade}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({...formData, grade: e.target.value})}
            />
          </div>
          
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Section</label>
            <input 
              type="text" 
              required
              placeholder="e.g., A" 
              className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 transition-all"
              value={formData.section}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({...formData, section: e.target.value})}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="pt-4 flex gap-3">
            <button 
              type="button" 
              onClick={onClose}
              className="flex-1 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white font-bold py-3 px-4 rounded-lg transition-colors border border-slate-700"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button 
              type="submit" 
              disabled={loading}
              className="flex-1 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold py-3 px-4 rounded-lg transition-colors shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/20 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {loading ? "Saving..." : "Save Class"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { AlertTriangle, Send, Search, ShieldAlert, CheckCircle2, DollarSign } from "lucide-react";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";

export default function FeeRiskRadar({ schoolCode = "CAMPUS-01" }) {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [riskList, setRiskList] = useState([]);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState("");
  const [filterTier, setFilterTier] = useState("all"); // 'all' | 'high' | 'moderate' | 'low'

  const cleanSchool = schoolCode.toUpperCase();

  useEffect(() => {
    calculateRiskRadar();

    const handleUpdate = () => calculateRiskRadar();
    window.addEventListener("erp-directory-updated", handleUpdate);
    window.addEventListener("erp-fee-ledger-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-directory-updated", handleUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-fee-ledger-updated", handleUpdate);
    };
  }, [cleanSchool]);

  const calculateRiskRadar = () => {
    try {
      const dirRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${cleanSchool}`);
      const dir = dirRaw ? JSON.parse(dirRaw) : [];
      const students = dir.filter((m) => (m.role || "student").toLowerCase() === "student");

      const ledgerRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_fee_ledger_${cleanSchool}`);
      const ledger = ledgerRaw ? JSON.parse(ledgerRaw) : [];

      const scored = students.map((st) => {
        const studentCode = (st.roll_number || st.id || "").toUpperCase();
        const studentName = st.name || st.full_name || "Scholar";
        const total = Number(st.totalFees || st.total_fees || st.fee_amount || 0);
        const initialPaid = Number(st.paidFees || 0);

        // Find transactions for this student
        const txns = ledger.filter((t) => {
          const tRoll = (t.roll_number || t.student_roll || "").toUpperCase();
          const tName = (t.student_name || "").toLowerCase();
          return (studentCode && tRoll === studentCode) || (tName && tName === studentName.toLowerCase());
        });

        const additionalPaid = txns
          .filter((t) => (t.status || "").toLowerCase() === "paid")
          .reduce((sum, t) => sum + (Number(t.amount) || 0), 0);

        const totalPaid = initialPaid + additionalPaid;
        const overdue = Math.max(0, total - totalPaid);
        const rejectedCount = txns.filter((t) => (t.status || "").toLowerCase() === "rejected").length;
        const hasPartial = txns.some((t) => t.is_partial || Number(t.amount) < total * 0.5);

        // Compute 0-100 Risk Score
        let score = 0;
        if (overdue > 0) {
          score += Math.round((overdue / total) * 50);
        }
        if (rejectedCount > 0) {
          score += Math.min(30, rejectedCount * 15);
        }
        if (hasPartial) {
          score += 15;
        }

        score = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, score));

        let tier = "Low";
        if (score >= 75) tier = "High";
        else if (score >= 45) tier = "Moderate";

        return {
          id: studentCode,
          name: studentName,
          rollNumber: studentCode,
          className: st.class_name || "General",
          phone: st.phone || "+91 9800000000",
          totalFees: total,
          paidFees: totalPaid,
          overdueBalance: overdue,
          riskScore: score,
          riskTier: tier,
          rejectedCount,
        };
      });

      scored.sort((a, b) => b.riskScore - a.riskScore);
      setRiskList(scored);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Fee Risk Radar calculation error:", e);
      setRiskList([]);
    }
  };

  const handleSendWhatsApp = (item) => {
    const text = encodeURIComponent(
      `*Institutional Tuition Notice - Action Required*\n` +
      `Scholar: ${item.name} (${item.rollNumber})\n` +
      `Class: ${item.className}\n` +
      `Overdue Balance: ₹${item.overdueBalance.toLocaleString()}\n` +
      `Risk Assessment: Early payment assistance notice.\n` +
      `Please clear dues via portal or contact accounts desk.`
    );
    const cleanPhone = (item.phone || "").replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
    const waUrl = cleanPhone ? `https://wa.me/${cleanPhone}?text=${text}` : `https://wa.me/?text=${text}`;
    window.open(waUrl, "_blank");
    showToast(`WhatsApp reminder dispatched for ${item.name}! 📲`, "success");
  };

  const filtered = riskList.filter((item) => {

      item.rollNumber.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      item.className.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );
  });

            >

                <th className="p-3">Overdue Balance</th>
                <th className="p-3">Risk Assessment</th>
                <th className="p-3 text-right">Early Intervention</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-white/5">
              {filtered.map((item) => (
                <tr key={item.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-white/5 transition-all">
                  <td className="p-3 font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                    {item.name}
                    <span className="block font-mono text-[10px] text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400">{item.rollNumber}</span>

                  <td className="p-3 font-mono font-bold text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">

                            : "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {item.riskScore}/100 ({item.riskTier})
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">

                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-600/20 dark:hover:bg-emerald-600/30 dark:border-emerald-500/40 dark:text-emerald-300 text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                    >
                      <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Trigger Early WhatsApp</span>
                    </button>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))}

          </table>
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";
import { Plus, Trash2, CheckCircle2, ShieldCheck, IndianRupee, Layers } from "lucide-react";

export default function FeeStructureConfigurator({ schoolId = "CAMPUS-01", institutionName = "Institutional Campus" }) {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const activeCode = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();
  const storageKey = `erp_fee_structure_${activeCode}`;

  const [feeComponents, setFeeComponents] = useState([]);
  const [classesList, setClassesList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Form State with Target Class / Batch
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    title: "",
    term: "Term 1",
    targetClass: "ALL",
    gstStatus: "GST_EXEMPT",
    amount: "",
    description: "",
  });

  const loadFeeStructures = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    let loaded = [];

    // 1. Read from localStorage
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) loaded = parsed;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Fee structure local load notice:", e);
    }

    // 2. Read from Supabase if online
    try {
      if (supabase) {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from("fee_structures")
          .select("*")
          .eq("school_id", activeCode);

        if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
          const map = new Map();
          data.forEach((d) => map.set(d.id, {
            id: d.id,
            title: d.title || d.component_name,
            term: d.term || d.category || "Term Fee",
            amount: Number(d.amount) || 0,
            description: d.description || "",
            school_id: d.school_id,
          }));
          loaded.forEach((l) => {
            if (!map.has(l.id)) map.set(l.id, l);
          });
          loaded = Array.from(map.values());
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Supabase fee structure notice:", err);
    }

    setFeeComponents(loaded);
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const loadUniqueClasses = () => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${activeCode}`);
      if (raw) {
        const dir = JSON.parse(raw);
        const unique = Array.from(
          new Set(
            dir
              .filter((m) => (m.role || "student").toLowerCase() === "student" && (m.class_name || m.class))
              .map((m) => (m.class_name || m.class).trim())
          )
        ).filter(Boolean);
        if (unique.length > 0) {
          setClassesList(unique);
          return;
        }
      }
    } catch {}
    setClassesList(["Class 9-A", "Class 10-A", "Class 10-ICSE", "Class 11-Science", "Class 12-Science", "General Batch"]);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadFeeStructures();
    loadUniqueClasses();
    const handleUpdate = () => {
      loadFeeStructures();
      loadUniqueClasses();
    };
    window.addEventListener("erp-fee-structure-updated", handleUpdate);
    window.addEventListener("erp-directory-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-fee-structure-updated", handleUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-directory-updated", handleUpdate);
    };
  }, [activeCode]);

  const handleAddFeeComponent = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cleanTitle = form.title.trim();
    const numAmount = Number(form.amount);

    if (!cleanTitle) {
      showToast("Please enter a fee component title.", "error");
      return;
    }
    if (!numAmount || numAmount <= 0) {
      showToast("Please enter a valid fee amount in ₹.", "error");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    const targetClassesPayload = form.targetClass === "ALL" ? ["ALL"] : [form.targetClass];
    const newComponent = {
      id: `fee-comp-${Date.now()}`,
      title: cleanTitle,
      term: form.term,
      targetClass: form.targetClass,
      target_classes: targetClassesPayload,
      gstStatus: form.gstStatus || "GST_EXEMPT",
      amount: numAmount,
      description: form.description.trim() || `${form.term} Official Institutional Dues`,
      school_id: activeCode,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      status: "Active",
    };

    // 1. Try Supabase insert
    try {
      if (supabase) {
        await supabase.from("fee_structures").insert([
          {
            school_id: activeCode,
            title: newComponent.title,
            term: newComponent.term,
            amount: newComponent.amount,
            description: newComponent.description,
          },
        ]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Fee structure Supabase insert notice:", err);
    }

    // 2. Save to tenant-scoped localStorage
    try {
      const updated = [newComponent, ...feeComponents.filter((f) => f.id !== newComponent.id)];
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
      setFeeComponents(updated);

      // Dispatch global broadcast event for /student/pay live update
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-fee-structure-updated"));
    } catch (storageErr) {
      console.warn("LocalStorage fee structure sync notice:", storageErr);
    }

    // 3. Security audit log
    try {
      logSecurityAction({
        action: "FEE_HEAD_CREATED",
        entityType: "FEE_STRUCTURE",
        entityId: newComponent.id,
        details: `Published fee head "${newComponent.title}" (${newComponent.term}) of ₹${newComponent.amount} for ${activeCode}`,
        schoolId: activeCode,
      });
    } catch {}

    showToast(`Published "${newComponent.title}" (₹${newComponent.amount.toLocaleString()}) to student payment portal!`, "success");
    setForm({ title: "", term: "Term 1", targetClass: "ALL", gstStatus: "GST_EXEMPT", amount: "", description: "" });
    setSubmitting(false);
  };

  const handleDeleteFeeComponent = async (id) => {
    try {
      if (supabase) {
        await supabase.from("fee_structures").delete().eq("id", id);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Supabase fee delete notice:", err);
    }

    try {
      const updated = feeComponents.filter((f) => f.id !== id);
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
      setFeeComponents(updated);
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-fee-structure-updated"));
      showToast("Fee head removed from student payment portal.", "info");
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("LocalStorage fee delete notice:", err);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl space-y-6">
      {/* HEADER */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
            <Layers className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Master Institutional Fee Configurator</span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <span>Official School Fee Structure</span>
            <span className="text-xs bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-emerald-400 font-mono px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg">
              {activeCode}
            </span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1 max-w-xl">
            Configure tuition, laboratory, and annual fee components. All fee heads published here stream directly into the Student Settlement Portal (<code className="text-emerald-400 font-mono">/student/pay</code>).
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="text-right bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 p-3.5 rounded-2xl">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Active Published Heads</p>
          <p className="text-xl font-black text-emerald-400">{feeComponents.length} Components</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* FORM: ADD NEW FEE COMPONENT */}
      <div className="bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white uppercase tracking-wider mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
          <span>Define & Publish New Fee Component</span>
        </h3>
        <form onSubmit={handleAddFeeComponent} className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
              Component Title *
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="e.g. Second Term Tuition Fee (2026-27)"
              value={form.title}
              onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
              className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
              required
            />
          </div>

          <div>

                        className="text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1"
                        title="Remove fee component"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Delete</span>
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useContext } from "react";
import Sidebar from "./Sidebar";
import BrandLogo from "./BrandLogo";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";

export default function ResponsiveLayout({ children, title, subtitle }) {
  const { tenant } = useContext(AppContext) || {};

  return (
    <div className="h-[100dvh] w-screen overflow-hidden flex bg-slate-950 font-sans relative">
      <Sidebar />
      <main className="flex-1 h-full overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 pt-20 md:pt-8 pb-24 md:pb-8">
        {(title || subtitle) && (
          <div className="mb-6 flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-4">
            <div>
              {title && <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-white tracking-tight">{title}</h1>}
              {subtitle && <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">{subtitle}</p>}
            </div>
            <BrandLogo size="md" customLogoUrl={tenant?.logoUrl} />
          </div>
        )}
        {children}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";
import {
  getAffectedPeriodsForTeacher,
  getEligibleSubstitutes,
  assignSubstituteDuty,
  getDailyReliefSchedule,
} from "../utils/substituteEngine";
import {
  Calendar,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  Clock,
  Plus,
  Filter,
  Sparkles,
  UserCheck,
  ShieldAlert,
  ArrowRight,
  BookOpen,
  Send,
  X,
  Users,
} from "lucide-react";

export default function StaffLeaveManager({ schoolId: propSchoolId }) {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = propSchoolId || user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const [leaves, setLeaves] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("ALL"); // 'ALL' | 'Pending' | 'Approved' | 'Rejected'
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("leaves"); // 'leaves' | 'relief_matrix'

  // Relief Matrix State
  const [reliefSchedule, setReliefSchedule] = useState([]);
  const [reliefModalOpen, setReliefModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedAbsentTeacher, setSelectedAbsentTeacher] = useState("");
  const [affectedSlots, setAffectedSlots] = useState([]);
  const [eligibleMap, setEligibleMap] = useState({}); // slotIndex -> candidates[]
  const [selectedSubstitutes, setSelectedSubstitutes] = useState({}); // slotIndex -> teacherName
  const [assigningDuty, setAssigningDuty] = useState(false);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    applicantName: "",
    category: "Faculty / Teaching Staff",
    leaveType: "Casual Leave",
    startDate: "",
    endDate: "",
    reason: "",
  });

  const loadLeaves = () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_leave_requests_${schoolId}`);
      if (saved) {
        setLeaves(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setLeaves([]);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setLeaves([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const loadRelief = async () => {
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
    const data = await getDailyReliefSchedule(today, schoolId);
    setReliefSchedule(data);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadLeaves();
    loadRelief();
    const handleUpdate = () => {
      loadLeaves();
      loadRelief();
    };
    window.addEventListener("erp-leaves-updated", handleUpdate);
    window.addEventListener("erp-substitutes-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-leaves-updated", handleUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-substitutes-updated", handleUpdate);
    };
  }, [schoolId]);

  const checkForSubstitutes = async (applicant, leaveRecord) => {
    const date = leaveRecord?.startDate || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
    const affected = await getAffectedPeriodsForTeacher({ teacherName: applicant, date, schoolId });

    if (affected.length > 0) {
      setSelectedAbsentTeacher(applicant);
      setAffectedSlots(affected);

      // Find candidates for each affected slot
      const candidateMap = {};
      const preselected = {};
      const dayName = new Date(date).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { weekday: "long" });

      for (let i = 0; i < affected.length; i++) {
        const slot = affected[i];
        const candidates = await getEligibleSubstitutes({
          day: dayName,
          periodNo: slot.periodNo || slot.period,
          subject: slot.subject,
          absentTeacher: applicant,
          schoolId,
          date,
        });
        candidateMap[i] = candidates;
        if (candidates.length > 0) {
          preselected[i] = candidates[0].name;
        }
      }

      setEligibleMap(candidateMap);
      setSelectedSubstitutes(preselected);
      setReliefModalOpen(true);
      showToast(`⚠️ ${affected.length} teaching periods affected by this leave! Review substitute matrix.`, "info");
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmSubstitutes = async () => {
    setAssigningDuty(true);
    const date = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];

    try {
      for (let i = 0; i < affectedSlots.length; i++) {
        const slot = affectedSlots[i];
        const subName = selectedSubstitutes[i];
        if (subName) {
          await assignSubstituteDuty({
            schoolId,
            date,
            periodNo: slot.periodNo || slot.period,
            className: slot.className || slot.class_name,
            subject: slot.subject,
            room: slot.room,
            absentTeacherName: selectedAbsentTeacher,
            substituteTeacherName: subName,
            assignedBy: user?.name || "Academic Principal",
          });
        }
      }

      showToast("✅ Substitute duty assignments dispatched and published to Daily Relief Schedule!", "success");
      setReliefModalOpen(false);
      loadRelief();
      setActiveTab("relief_matrix");
    } catch (err) {
      showToast("Notice assigning relief: " + err.message, "error");
    } finally {
      setAssigningDuty(false);
    }
  };

  const handleStatusChange = (id, newStatus, applicant) => {
    const targetLeave = leaves.find((l) => l.id === id);
    const updated = leaves.map((l) => (l.id === id ? { ...l, status: newStatus } : l));
    setLeaves(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_leave_requests_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-leaves-updated"));
    } catch (e) {}

    logSecurityAction({
      action: `Staff Leave Request ${newStatus}`,
      entityType: "LEAVE",
      entityId: id,
      details: `${newStatus} leave application for ${applicant || "Staff Member"}`,
      user,
      schoolId,
    });

    showToast(`Leave application marked as ${newStatus}!`, newStatus === "Approved" ? "success" : "info");

    if (newStatus === "Approved" && targetLeave?.category?.includes("Faculty")) {
      checkForSubstitutes(applicant, targetLeave);
    }
  };

  const handleAddLeave = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!form.applicantName.trim() || !form.startDate || !form.endDate || !form.reason.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide applicant name, dates, and reason.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const newReq = {
      id: `leave_${Date.now()}`,
      schoolId,
      applicantName: form.applicantName.trim(),
      category: form.category,
      leaveType: form.leaveType,
      startDate: form.startDate,
      endDate: form.endDate,
      reason: form.reason.trim(),
      status: "Pending Principal Review",
      appliedOn: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    };

    const updated = [newReq, ...leaves];
    setLeaves(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_leave_requests_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-leaves-updated"));
    } catch (e) {}

    showToast(`Leave application recorded for ${newReq.applicantName}!`, "success");
    setForm({
      applicantName: "",
      category: "Faculty / Teaching Staff",
      leaveType: "Casual Leave",
      startDate: "",
      endDate: "",
      reason: "",
    });
    setShowAddModal(false);
  };

  const filteredLeaves = leaves.filter((l) => {
    if (filter === "ALL") return true;
    if (filter === "Pending") return l.status.includes("Pending");
    return l.status === filter;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* HEADER BANNER */}
      <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-amber-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
            <span>📝</span> Institutional HR & Attendance
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white">Staff Leave Rules & Approvals</h2>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1 max-w-xl">
            Review faculty and non-teaching personnel leave applications, grant approvals, and manage institutional leave balance rules.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAddModal(true)}
            className="bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-lg shadow-amber-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2"
          >
            <span>➕</span>
            <span>Record Leave Application</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* NAVIGATION TABS */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab("leaves")}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === "leaves"
              ? "bg-amber-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-amber-500/20"
              : "text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60"
          }`}
        >
          <Calendar className="w-4 h-4" />
          Staff Leave Applications
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setActiveTab("relief_matrix")}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
            activeTab === "relief_matrix"
              ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-blue-500/20"
              : "text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/60"
          }`}
        >
          <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
          Daily Relief Schedule & Substitute Matrix ({reliefSchedule.length})
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* DAILY RELIEF SCHEDULE & SUBSTITUTE MATRIX VIEW */}
      {activeTab === "relief_matrix" && (
        <div className="bg-white/90 dark:bg-[#1E293B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden p-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/60">
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
                Today's Faculty Substitute Relief Schedule
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                Periods where regular faculty are on approved leave, with qualified substitute teachers assigned.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {reliefSchedule.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-400 mx-auto mb-2" />
              All faculty teaching assignments are active today. No substitute coverage required.

          ) : (

                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Period</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Class & Room</th>

                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Status</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                  {reliefSchedule.map((item) => (
                    <tr key={item.id}>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{item.period_no}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4">

                        <span className="block text-[10px] text-slate-400">{item.room}</span>

                      <td className="py-3 px-4">{item.subject}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-rose-500 font-medium">{item.absent_teacher_name}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-emerald-500 font-bold">{item.substitute_teacher_name}</td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4">
                        <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">

                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

        </div>
      )}

      {/* TABLE */}
      {activeTab === "leaves" && (
      <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">

          <div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                  filter === f ? "bg-amber-600 text-white" : "bg-slate-900 text-slate-400 hover:text-white"

              >

                              {c.name} ({c.subject}) {c.isSubjectMatch ? "— ⭐ Subject Specialist" : "— Available"}

                Skip Substitutes

              <button

                className="px-5 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-md shadow-blue-500/20 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50"
              >

              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

          <div className="bg-[#1E293B] border border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl">
            <h3 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-white mb-1">Record Staff Leave Application 📝</h3>

            <form onSubmit={handleAddLeave} className="space-y-4">

                >
                  <option value="Casual Leave">Casual Leave</option>

                  <option value="Maternity / Paternity Leave">Maternity / Paternity Leave</option>
                  <option value="Emergency Leave">Emergency Leave</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Start Date *</label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={form.startDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, startDate: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
                    required

                <div>

                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
                    required

              <div>
```

```javascript
import { useState } from "react";
import { Outlet, NavLink } from "react-router-dom";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  LayoutDashboard,
  Users,
  Calendar,
  IndianRupee,
  Settings,
  Menu
} from "lucide-react";

export default function MainLayout() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const linkClass = ({ isActive }) =>
    `flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl font-medium
    transition-all duration-200
    ${isActive
      ? "bg-purple-600/20 text-purple-300"
      : "text-gray-300 hover:bg-white/5"
    }`;

  return (
    <div className="h-[100dvh] w-screen overflow-hidden flex bg-[#0B0F1A] text-white">

      {/* MOBILE TOP BAR */}
      <div className="md:hidden fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 h-14 bg-[#0F1424] border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between px-4 z-50">
        <h1 className="text-purple-400 font-bold">ERP</h1>

        <button onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>
          <Menu />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* SIDEBAR */}
      <div
        className={`
        fixed md:static top-0 left-0 h-full w-64 bg-[#0F1424]
        border-r border-white/5 p-5 z-40
        transform transition-transform duration-300
        ${open ? "translate-x-0" : "-translate-x-full md:translate-x-0"}
        `}
      >

        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-purple-400 mb-8 mt-10 md:mt-0">
          School ERP
        </h1>

        <div className="space-y-2">

          <NavLink to="/" className={linkClass} end onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
            <LayoutDashboard size={18} />
            Dashboard
          </NavLink>

          <NavLink to="/students" className={linkClass} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
            <Users size={18} />
            Students
          </NavLink>

          <NavLink to="/attendance" className={linkClass} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
            <Calendar size={18} />
            Attendance
          </NavLink>

          <NavLink to="/fees" className={linkClass} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
            <IndianRupee size={18} />
            Fees
          </NavLink>

          <NavLink to="/settings" className={linkClass} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
            <Settings size={18} />
            Settings
          </NavLink>

        </div>
      </div>

      {/* OVERLAY (mobile only) */}
      {open && (
        <div
          onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
          className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 md:hidden"
        />
      )}

      {/* MAIN AREA */}
      <div className="flex-1 h-full flex flex-col md:ml-64 overflow-hidden">

        {/* TOP BAR (desktop only) */}
        <div className="hidden md:flex h-16 px-6 items-center justify-between border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0B0F1A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl">

          <div className="flex items-center bg-white/5 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl w-80 border border-white/10">
            <input
              placeholder="Search students..."
              className="bg-transparent outline-none w-full text-sm"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-4 items-center">
            <div className="text-xl">🔔</div>
            <div className="px-3 py-2 bg-white/5 rounded-lg">Admin</div>
          </div>

        </div>

        {/* PAGE CONTENT */}
        <div className="flex-1 p-4 md:p-6 pt-16 md:pt-6 overflow-auto">
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          >
            <Outlet />
          </motion.div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
