import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { useAppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import CampusPulseCard from "../Components/CampusPulseCard";
import SchoolCalendar from "../Components/SchoolCalendar";
import {
  getCalendarEvents,
  saveCalendarEvents,
  parseSparseCalendarCsv,
  generateSampleSparseCalendarCsv,
  normalizeDateString,
  formatDisplayDate,
} from "../utils/calendarService";

export default function AcademicCalendar() {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const { institutionCode: appSchoolCode } = useAppContext?.() || {};

  // Resolve school code
  const [schoolCode, setSchoolCode] = useState(() => {
    if (appSchoolCode) return appSchoolCode;
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem("erp_session_user");
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        return parsed.schoolCode || parsed.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";
      }
    } catch {}
    return "CAMPUS-01";
  });

  const [events, setEvents] = useState([]);
  const [filterCategory, setFilterCategory] = useState("ALL");
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);

  // Manual event form state
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    date: "",
    title: "",
    category: "Holiday",
    reason: "",
  });

  const fileInputRef = useRef(null);

  // Load events
  useEffect(() => {
    const list = getCalendarEvents(schoolCode);
    setEvents(list);
  }, [schoolCode]);

  const handleManualAdd = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!formData.date || !formData.title.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide both Date and Title for the event.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const normalizedDate = normalizeDateString(formData.date);
    const newEvent = {
      id: `ev_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 4)}`,
      date: normalizedDate,
      title: formData.title.trim(),
      category: formData.category,
      reason: formData.reason.trim() || `${formData.category} scheduled on campus calendar`,
      isHoliday: formData.category === "Holiday",
    };

    // Filter out duplicate date if same event title or overwrite
    const existingFiltered = events.filter(
      (ev) => !(ev.date === normalizedDate && ev.title.toLowerCase() === newEvent.title.toLowerCase())
    );

    const updated = [newEvent, ...existingFiltered].sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
    saveCalendarEvents(schoolCode, updated);
    setEvents(updated);
    setFormData({ date: "", title: "", category: "Holiday", reason: "" });
    showToast(`Added '${newEvent.title}' for ${formatDisplayDate(newEvent.date)}`, "success");
  };

  const handleDeleteEvent = (id) => {
    const updated = events.filter((ev) => ev.id !== id);
    saveCalendarEvents(schoolCode, updated);
    setEvents(updated);
    showToast("Special calendar entry removed.", "info");
  };

  const handleClearAll = () => {
    if (window.confirm("Are you sure you want to clear all custom calendar entries? Dates will revert to regular working days.")) {
      saveCalendarEvents(schoolCode, []);
      setEvents([]);
      showToast("Institutional calendar cleared to default academic days.", "info");
    }
  };

  const handleCsvFileUpload = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setIsUploading(true);
    try {
      const text = await file.text();
      const parsed = parseSparseCalendarCsv(text);
      if (parsed.length === 0) {
        throw new Error("No valid dates found in file.");
      }

      // Merge with existing events, avoiding duplicate date + title
      const existingMap = new Map();
      events.forEach((ev) => existingMap.set(`${ev.date}__${ev.title.toLowerCase()}`, ev));
      parsed.forEach((ev) => existingMap.set(`${ev.date}__${ev.title.toLowerCase()}`, ev));

      const merged = Array.from(existingMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));

      saveCalendarEvents(schoolCode, merged);
      setEvents(merged);
      showToast(`Successfully imported ${parsed.length} special calendar events!`, "success");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Calendar CSV import error:", err);
      showToast(err.message || "Failed to parse CSV calendar file.", "error");
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = "";
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadSampleCsv = () => {
    const csvContent = generateSampleSparseCalendarCsv();
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.setAttribute("download", `sparse_academic_calendar_template.csv`);
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
    showToast("Downloaded sparse calendar CSV template.", "info");
  };

  // Filtered events
  const filteredEvents = events.filter((ev) => {
    const matchesCat = filterCategory === "ALL" || ev.category.toUpperCase() === filterCategory.toUpperCase();
    const matchesSearch =
      !searchQuery ||
      ev.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      ev.date.includes(searchQuery) ||
      (ev.reason && ev.reason.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()));
    return matchesCat && matchesSearch;
  });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto">
      {/* Top Banner */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-gradient-to-r from-slate-900 via-indigo-950 to-slate-900 border border-white/10 p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden">
        <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-80 h-80 bg-cyan-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl pointer-events-none"></div>
        <div className="relative z-10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
            <span className="p-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-500/20 text-2xl">
              📅
            </span>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest text-cyan-400 bg-cyan-500/10 px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-cyan-400/20">
                Institutional Academic Hub
              </span>
              <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-white tracking-tight mt-1">
                Sparse Academic Calendar & Daily Pulse
              </h1>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs sm:text-sm max-w-2xl">
            Upload only special institutional dates (Holidays, Examinations, Annual Functions, Events).
            Any date not listed automatically functions as a <span className="text-emerald-400 font-semibold">Regular Academic Working Day</span>.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 relative z-10">
          <button
            onClick={handleDownloadSampleCsv}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-950/80 hover:bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 hover:text-white border border-white/10 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-lg cursor-pointer"
          >
            <span>📥</span>
            <span>Sample CSV</span>
          </button>
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-600 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-500 hover:to-blue-500 text-white px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/20 cursor-pointer">
            <span>{isUploading ? "⏳" : "📊"}</span>
            <span>{isUploading ? "Importing..." : "Upload Sparse CSV"}</span>
            <input
              ref={fileInputRef}
              type="file"
              accept=".csv,.txt"
              className="hidden"
              onChange={handleCsvFileUpload}
              disabled={isUploading}
            />
          </label>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Live Campus Pulse Preview */}
      <CampusPulseCard schoolCode={schoolCode} />

      {/* Global Interactive Academic Calendar Grid */}
      <SchoolCalendar viewMode="global" className="mb-8" />

      {/* Two Column Layout: Add Event Form & Calendar Directory */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
        {/* Left Column: Manual Glass Form */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-1 bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl h-fit">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
            <span className="text-lg">✨</span>
            <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold text-white">Add Special Date</h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-5">
            Add a single holiday, exam window, or campus function. Normal working days don't need entry.
          </p>

          <form onSubmit={handleManualAdd} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Event Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
              </label>
              <input
                type="date"
                required
                className="w-full bg-slate-950/60 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-400 transition-all"
                value={formData.date}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, date: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Category
              </label>
              <select
                className="w-full bg-slate-950/60 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-400 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                value={formData.category}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, category: e.target.value })}
              >
                <option value="Holiday" className="bg-slate-900 text-white">Holiday (Campus Closed)</option>
                <option value="Exam" className="bg-slate-900 text-white">Examination / CBT Window</option>
                <option value="Function" className="bg-slate-900 text-white">Annual Function / Festival</option>
                <option value="Event" className="bg-slate-900 text-white">Special Campus Event</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-300 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                Event Title
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                placeholder="e.g. Diwali Vacation / Mid-Term CBT"

                value={formData.title}

              />
            </div>

                value={formData.reason}
                onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, reason: e.target.value })}
              />
            </div>

              className="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-600 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-500 hover:to-blue-500 text-white font-bold py-3 px-4 rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/20 text-sm transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >

              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-white mb-1">No Special Dates Found</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-sm mx-auto">
                {events.length === 0

              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-white/10 bg-slate-950/80 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Date</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Event Title</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Category</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4">Reason / Details</th>
                    <th className="py-3 px-4 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5 text-xs text-slate-200">
                  {filteredEvents.map((ev) => {
                    const badgeClass =
                      ev.category === "Holiday"
                        ? "bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-300 border-rose-500/30"
                        : ev.category === "Exam"
                        ? "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30"
                        : ev.category === "Function"
                        ? "bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-300 border-purple-500/30"
                        : "bg-cyan-500/15 text-cyan-300 border-cyan-500/30";

                    return (
                      <tr key={ev.id || ev.date} className="hover:bg-white/[0.02] transition-colors">
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-mono font-bold text-white whitespace-nowrap">
                          {formatDisplayDate(ev.date)}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-bold text-white whitespace-nowrap">
                          {ev.title}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                          <span className={`text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${badgeClass}`}>
                            {ev.category}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-slate-400 max-w-xs truncate" title={ev.reason}>
                          {ev.reason || "—"}
                        </td>
                        <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleDeleteEvent(ev.id)}
                            className="text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-500/10 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            Delete
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    );
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import {
  calculateGrade,
  validateMarksEntry,
  DEFAULT_EXAM_SESSIONS,
  DEFAULT_EXAM_RESULTS,
  finalizeAndPublishSession,
} from "../utils/examinationEngine";
import {
  FileSpreadsheet,
  PlusCircle,
  Clock,
  Award,
  CheckCircle2,
  XCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  Trash2,
  Eye,
  Check,
  AlertCircle,
  BookOpen,
  Users,
  Search,
  Sparkles,
  BarChart2,
  Calendar,
  Lock,
  Printer,
  FileCheck,
} from "lucide-react";

const SUBJECTS = [
  "Mathematics",
  "Physics",
  "Chemistry",
  "Biology",
  "Computer Science",
  "English",
  "Social Science",
  "General Aptitude & Reasoning"
];

const BATCHES = [
  "Class 9",
  "Class 10",
  "Class 11 - Science",
  "Class 11 - Commerce",
  "Class 12 - Science",
  "Class 12 - Commerce",
  "NEET Foundation",
  "JEE Advanced Track"
];

export default function OnlineExams() {
  const { user, tenant } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const schoolCode = (
    user?.institution_code ||
    user?.school_id ||
    tenant?.code ||
    "CAMPUS-01"
  ).toUpperCase();

  const [exams, setExams] = useState([]);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("cbt"); // 'cbt' | 'formal_sessions' | 'marks_ledger'
  const [examSessions, setExamSessions] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_exam_sessions_${schoolCode}`);
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : DEFAULT_EXAM_SESSIONS;
    } catch {
      return DEFAULT_EXAM_SESSIONS;
    }
  });

  const [examResults, setExamResults] = useState(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_exam_results_${schoolCode}`);
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : DEFAULT_EXAM_RESULTS;
    } catch {
      return DEFAULT_EXAM_RESULTS;
    }
  });

  const handleUpdateMarks = (resultId, newMarks, maxMarks = 100) => {
    try {
      validateMarksEntry(newMarks, maxMarks);
      const gradeObj = calculateGrade(newMarks, maxMarks);
      const updated = examResults.map((r) =>
        r.id === resultId
          ? {
              ...r,
              marks_obtained: Number(newMarks),
              final_marks: Number(newMarks) + Number(r.moderation_marks || 0),
              grade: gradeObj.grade,
            }
          : r
      );
      setExamResults(updated);
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_exam_results_${schoolCode}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      showToast(`Marks updated. Auto-graded as ${gradeObj.grade} (${gradeObj.remark})`, "success");
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.message, "error");
    }
  };

  const handlePublishResults = async (session) => {
    try {
      await finalizeAndPublishSession({
        sessionId: session.id,
        schoolId: schoolCode,
        user,
      });

      const updatedSessions = examSessions.map((s) => (s.id === session.id ? { ...s, status: "published" } : s));
      const updatedResults = examResults.map((r) => ({ ...r, is_finalized: true }));

      setExamSessions(updatedSessions);
      setExamResults(updatedResults);

      localStorage.setItem(`erp_exam_sessions_${schoolCode}`, JSON.stringify(updatedSessions));
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_exam_results_${schoolCode}`, JSON.stringify(updatedResults));

      showToast(`🎉 Results finalized and published to all Student Portals! Locked against modification.`, "success");
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(err.message, "error");
    }
  };

  const [submissions, setSubmissions] = useState([]);
  const [isCreateModalOpen, setIsCreateModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeSubmissionsExam, setActiveSubmissionsExam] = useState(null);

  // New Exam Form State
  const [examForm, setExamForm] = useState({
    title: "",
    subject: "Mathematics",
    targetClass: "Class 10",
    durationMinutes: 30,
    passingPercentage: 40,
    instructions: "All questions are compulsory. Negative marks apply for wrong answers.",
    questions: [
      {
        id: `q_1`,
        text: "",
        options: ["", "", "", ""],
        correctOption: 0,
        positiveMarks: 4,
        negativeMarks: 1,
      },
    ],
  });

  // Load existing exams & submissions
  useEffect(() => {
    loadExamsAndSubmissions();
  }, [schoolCode]);

  const loadExamsAndSubmissions = () => {
    try {
      const examsRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_online_exams_${schoolCode}`);
      if (examsRaw) {
        setExams(JSON.parse(examsRaw));
      } else {
        // Starter sample exam
        const sampleExam = {
          id: `exam_${Date.now() - 100000}`,
          title: "Unit Test 1: Calculus & Trigonometry",
          subject: "Mathematics",
          targetClass: "Class 10",
          durationMinutes: 20,
          passingPercentage: 40,
          createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
          status: "published",
          questions: [
            {
              id: "q_1",
              text: "What is the derivative of sin(x) with respect to x?",
              options: ["-cos(x)", "cos(x)", "-sin(x)", "tan(x)"],
              correctOption: 1,
              positiveMarks: 4,
              negativeMarks: 1,
            },
            {
              id: "q_2",
              text: "If sin(θ) = 1/2, what is the value of θ in degrees for the principal acute angle?",
              options: ["45°", "60°", "30°", "90°"],
              correctOption: 2,
              positiveMarks: 4,
              negativeMarks: 1,
            },
            {
              id: "q_3",
              text: "Which of the following is equivalent to 1 + tan²(θ)?",
              options: ["cot²(θ)", "sec²(θ)", "cosec²(θ)", "cos²(θ)"],
              correctOption: 1,
              positiveMarks: 4,
              negativeMarks: 1,
            },
          ],
        };
        setExams([sampleExam]);
        localStorage.setItem(`erp_online_exams_${schoolCode}`, JSON.stringify([sampleExam]));
      }

      const subsRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_exam_submissions_${schoolCode}`);
      if (subsRaw) {
        setSubmissions(JSON.parse(subsRaw));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not load exams:", e);
    }
  };

  const saveExamsToStorage = (updated) => {
    setExams(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_online_exams_${schoolCode}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Storage error:", e);
    }
  };

  // Add Question to Form
  const handleAddQuestion = () => {
    setExamForm((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      questions: [
        ...prev.questions,
        {
          id: `q_${Date.now()}_${prev.questions.length + 1}`,
          text: "",
          options: ["", "", "", ""],
          correctOption: 0,
          positiveMarks: 4,
          negativeMarks: 1,
        },
      ],
    }));
  };

  // Remove Question from Form
  const handleRemoveQuestion = (idx) => {
    if (examForm.questions.length <= 1) {
      showToast("An exam must have at least one question.", "error");
      return;
    }
    setExamForm((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      questions: prev.questions.filter((_, i) => i !== idx),
    }));
  };

  // Update Question Content
  const handleUpdateQuestion = (qIndex, field, value) => {
    setExamForm((prev) => {
      const qList = [...prev.questions];
      qList[qIndex] = { ...qList[qIndex], [field]: value };
      return { ...prev, questions: qList };
    });
  };

  // Update Question Option
  const handleUpdateOption = (qIndex, optIndex, value) => {
    setExamForm((prev) => {
      const qList = [...prev.questions];
      const newOpts = [...qList[qIndex].options];
      newOpts[optIndex] = value;
      qList[qIndex] = { ...qList[qIndex], options: newOpts };
      return { ...prev, questions: qList };
    });
  };

  // Submit Exam Form
  const handleCreateExam = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!examForm.title.trim()) {
      showToast("Please enter an Exam Title.", "error");
      return;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < examForm.questions.length; i++) {
      const q = examForm.questions[i];
      if (!q.text.trim()) {
        showToast(`Please write question text for Question #${i + 1}`, "error");
        return;
      }
      for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
        if (!q.options[j].trim()) {
          showToast(`Please provide Option ${String.fromCharCode(65 + j)} for Question #${i + 1}`, "error");
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    const newExam = {
      id: `exam_${Date.now()}`,
      title: examForm.title.trim(),
      subject: examForm.subject,
      targetClass: examForm.targetClass,
      durationMinutes: Number(examForm.durationMinutes) || 30,
      passingPercentage: Number(examForm.passingPercentage) || 40,
      instructions: examForm.instructions,

  return (

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-purple-600 to-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-purple-500/20 text-white font-bold shrink-0">
            <Award className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
              Timed Online Exams & Auto-Scoring
              <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30 font-medium">

                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleRemoveQuestion(qIdx)}
                            className="text-slate-500 hover:text-rose-400 p-1 cursor-pointer"
                            title="Remove Question"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Question Text */}
                      <textarea
                        rows={2}
                        required
                        placeholder="Write question statement here..."
                        value={q.text}
                        onChange={(e) => handleUpdateQuestion(qIdx, "text", e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500"
                      ></textarea>

                      {/* 4 Options Grid */}
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        {q.options.map((opt, optIdx) => (
                          <div
                            key={optIdx}
                            className={`flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg border transition-all ${
                              q.correctOption === optIdx
                                ? "bg-emerald-950/40 border-emerald-500/60"
                                : "bg-slate-900/60 border-slate-800"
                            }`}
                          >
                            <input
                              type="radio"
                              name={`correct_${q.id}`}
                              checked={q.correctOption === optIdx}
                              onChange={() => handleUpdateQuestion(qIdx, "correctOption", optIdx)}
                              className="cursor-pointer text-emerald-500"
                              title="Mark as correct answer"
                            />
                            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">
                              {String.fromCharCode(65 + optIdx)}:
                            </span>
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              required
                              placeholder={`Option ${String.fromCharCode(65 + optIdx)}`}
                              value={opt}
                              onChange={(e) => handleUpdateOption(qIdx, optIdx, e.target.value)}
                              className="flex-1 bg-transparent border-none text-xs text-white focus:outline-none"
                            />
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                        * Radio button selected indicates the correct answer for automated scoring.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Action Buttons */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-800">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-6 py-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-indigo-600 hover:from-purple-500 hover:to-indigo-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-lg shadow-purple-600/30 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Publish Online Exam
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* VIEW SUBMISSIONS MODAL */}
      {activeSubmissionsExam && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 shadow-2xl space-y-5 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-slate-800">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Award className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-400" />
                  Submissions: {activeSubmissionsExam.title}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                  {activeSubmissionsExam.subject} • {activeSubmissionsExam.targetClass}
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveSubmissionsExam(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-800"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Submissions Table */}
            <div className="bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl overflow-hidden">
              <div className="overflow-x-auto w-full">
                <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="bg-slate-800/80 text-slate-300 border-b border-slate-700 font-bold">
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">Student Name</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">Roll Number</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">Correct / Total</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">Auto-Score</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">Percentage</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">Result</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4">Submitted At</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800 text-slate-300">
                    {submissions.filter((s) => s.examId === activeSubmissionsExam.id).length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={7} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-500">
                          No student submissions recorded for this exam yet.
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      submissions
                        .filter((s) => s.examId === activeSubmissionsExam.id)
                        .map((sub, i) => (
                          <tr key={i} className="hover:bg-slate-800/40">
                            <td className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-white">{sub.studentName}</td>
                            <td className="py-3 px-4 font-mono text-slate-400">{sub.rollNumber}</td>
                            <td className="py-3 px-4">
                              {sub.correctCount} / {sub.totalQuestions}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-white">
                              {sub.score} / {sub.maxScore}
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3 px-4 font-semibold text-blue-400">
                              {sub.percentage}%
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3 px-4">
                              <span
                                className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                                  sub.percentage >= activeSubmissionsExam.passingPercentage
                                    ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30"
                                    : "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30"
                                }`}
                              >
                                {sub.percentage >= activeSubmissionsExam.passingPercentage ? "PASSED" : "FAILED"}
                              </span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="py-3 px-4 text-slate-400">
                              {new Date(sub.submittedAt).toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        ))
                    )}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end pt-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveSubmissionsExam(null)}
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold cursor-pointer"
              >
                Close Window
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext, useMemo } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { generatePayslipPDF } from "../utils/pdfGenerator";
import {

const MONTHS = [
  "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
  "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"
];

const YEARS = ["2025", "2026", "2027"];

export default function PayrollManager() {
  const { user, tenant } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const schoolCode = (
    user?.institution_code ||
    user?.school_id ||
    tenant?.code ||
    "CAMPUS-01"
  ).toUpperCase();

  const institutionName =
    tenant?.name ||
    user?.institution_name ||
    user?.institutionName ||
    "Institutional Campus";

  // Selected Pay Period
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState("October");
  const [selectedYear, setSelectedYear] = useState("2026");
  const currentPayPeriod = `${selectedMonth} ${selectedYear}`;

  const [staffList, setStaffList] = useState([]);
  const [salaryStructures, setSalaryStructures] = useState({});
  const [payrollRuns, setPayrollRuns] = useState({});
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [processingPayroll, setProcessingPayroll] = useState(false);

  // Salary Edit Modal
  const [editingStaff, setEditingStaff] = useState(null);
  const [editSalaryForm, setEditSalaryForm] = useState({
    basic: 35000,
    hra: 10500,
    da: 3500,
    special: 3000,
    pf: 1800,
    professionalTax: 200,
    tds: 1500,
    leaveDeduction: 0,
  });

  // Load staff & structures
  useEffect(() => {
    loadStaffAndPayroll();
  }, [schoolCode, currentPayPeriod]);

  const loadStaffAndPayroll = () => {
    try {
      // 1. Load directory to discover staff
      let dir = [];
      const rawDir = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${schoolCode}`);
      if (rawDir) dir = JSON.parse(rawDir);

      let eligibleStaff = dir.filter((m) => {
        const r = (m.role || "").toLowerCase();
        return (
          r === "teacher" ||
          r === "accountant" ||
          r === "staff" ||
          r === "non_teaching" ||
          r === "principal" ||
          r === "trustee"
        );
      });

      if (eligibleStaff.length === 0) {
        // Fallback starter faculty if fresh slate
        eligibleStaff = [
          {
            id: "TCH-01",
            role_code: "TCH-01",
            name: "Dr. Vikram Joshi",
            role: "teacher",
            class_name: "Senior Physics Faculty",
            phone: "+91 98111 22334",
            email: "vikram.joshi@school.edu",
          },
          {
            id: "TCH-02",
            role_code: "TCH-02",
            name: "Sunita Rao",
            role: "teacher",
            class_name: "Mathematics Department Head",
            phone: "+91 98222 33445",
            email: "sunita.rao@school.edu",
          },
          {
            id: "ACC-01",
            role_code: "ACC-01",
            name: "Ramesh Kulkarni",
            role: "accountant",
            class_name: "Chief Treasury Officer",
            phone: "+91 98333 44556",
            email: "kulkarni.accounts@school.edu",
          },
          {
            id: "NON-01",
            role_code: "NON-01",
            name: "Mahesh Shinde",
            role: "staff",
            class_name: "Campus Operations Supervisor",
            phone: "+91 98444 55667",
            email: "mahesh.ops@school.edu",
          },
        ];
      }

      setStaffList(eligibleStaff);

      // 2. Load configured salary structures
      const rawStructures = localStorage.getItem(`erp_salary_structures_${schoolCode}`);
      let structures = {};
      if (rawStructures) {
        structures = JSON.parse(rawStructures);
      }
      setSalaryStructures(structures);

      // 3. Load payroll run for selected month
      const rawRun = localStorage.getItem(`erp_payroll_${schoolCode}_${currentPayPeriod.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}`);
      if (rawRun) {
        setPayrollRuns((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          [currentPayPeriod]: JSON.parse(rawRun),
        }));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not load staff payroll data:", e);
    }
  };

  const getStaffSalaryPackage = (staffId) => {
    if (salaryStructures[staffId]) {
      return salaryStructures[staffId];
    }
    // Default package
    return {
      basic: 35000,
      hra: 10500,
      da: 3500,
      special: 3000,
      pf: 1800,
      professionalTax: 200,
      tds: 1500,
      leaveDeduction: 0,
    };
  };

  // Open Salary Edit Modal
  const handleOpenEdit = (staff) => {
    const id = staff.role_code || staff.roll_number || staff.id;
    setEditingStaff(staff);
    setEditSalaryForm(getStaffSalaryPackage(id));
  };

  // Save Salary Structure
  const handleSaveSalaryStructure = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!editingStaff) return;

    const id = editingStaff.role_code || editingStaff.roll_number || editingStaff.id;
    const updated = {
      ...salaryStructures,
      [id]: {
        basic: Number(editSalaryForm.basic) || 0,

      console.error(err);

    setEditingStaff(null);
    showToast(`✅ Salary structure updated for ${editingStaff.name || id}`, "success");
  };

  // Process Payroll Run for Month
  const handleRunPayroll = () => {
    setProcessingPayroll(true);

    setTimeout(() => {
      const records = staffList.map((st) => {
        const id = st.role_code || st.roll_number || st.id;
        const salary = getStaffSalaryPackage(id);
        const gross =
          salary.basic + salary.hra + salary.da + salary.special;
        const deductions =
          salary.pf +
          salary.professionalTax +
          salary.tds +
          salary.leaveDeduction;
        const net = gross - deductions;

        return {
          staffId: id,
          name: st.name || st.full_name,
          role: st.role,
          designation: st.class_name || st.role,
          basic: salary.basic,
          hra: salary.hra,
          da: salary.da,
          special: salary.special,
          grossEarnings: gross,
          pf: salary.pf,
          professionalTax: salary.professionalTax,
          tds: salary.tds,
          leaveDeduction: salary.leaveDeduction,
          totalDeductions: deductions,
          netSalary: net,
          status: "Disbursed",
          payDate: new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-IN"),
          refNo: `SAL-${selectedMonth.toUpperCase().slice(0, 3)}${selectedYear}-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
        };
      });

      const payrollPayload = {
        period: currentPayPeriod,
        runDate: new Date().toISOString(),
        status: "Disbursed",
        records,
      };

      const storageKey = `erp_payroll_${schoolCode}_${currentPayPeriod.replace(/\s+/g, "_")}`;
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(payrollPayload));

      setPayrollRuns((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        [currentPayPeriod]: payrollPayload,
      }));

      setProcessingPayroll(false);
      showToast(`🎉 Payroll processed & disbursed for ${currentPayPeriod}!`, "success");
    }, 600);
  };

  // Download PDF Payslip
  const handleDownloadPayslip = (staff, payrollRecord) => {
    try {
      const id = staff.role_code || staff.roll_number || staff.id;
      const salary = payrollRecord || getStaffSalaryPackage(id);

      generatePayslipPDF({
        tenant: {
          name: institutionName,
          code: schoolCode,
          address: tenant?.address,
          email: tenant?.email,
          logoUrl: tenant?.logoUrl,
        },
        staff: {
          ...staff,
          id,
        },
        payroll: {
          ...salary,
          payDate: payrollRecord?.payDate || new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-IN"),
          refNo: payrollRecord?.refNo || `SAL-${currentPayPeriod.replace(/\s+/g, "")}-${id}`,
        },
        monthYear: currentPayPeriod,
      });

      showToast(`📄 Downloaded official payslip for ${staff.name || id}`, "success");
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Payslip PDF error:", e);
      showToast("Could not generate payslip PDF. Please check data.", "error");
    }
  };

  // Filtered staff
  const filteredStaff = useMemo(() => {
    return staffList.filter((s) => {

      const id = (s.role_code || s.roll_number || s.id || "").toLowerCase();
      const role = (s.role || "").toLowerCase();

  }, [staffList, searchQuery]);

        return acc + (pkg.pf + pkg.professionalTax + pkg.tds + pkg.leaveDeduction);
      }, 0);

            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/80 text-slate-300">
              {filteredStaff.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={8} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-500">

                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filteredStaff.map((staff) => {
                  const id = staff.role_code || staff.roll_number || staff.id;
                  const pkg = getStaffSalaryPackage(id);
                  const allowances = pkg.hra + pkg.da + pkg.special;
                  const deductions = pkg.pf + pkg.professionalTax + pkg.tds + pkg.leaveDeduction;
                  const net = pkg.basic + allowances - deductions;

                  const runRecord = activeRun?.records.find((r) => r.staffId === id);

                  return (
                    <tr key={id} className="hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4">
                        <p className="font-bold text-white text-sm">{staff.name || staff.full_name}</p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-mono">{id}</p>

                        ₹{pkg.basic.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono text-emerald-400">
                        +₹{allowances.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono text-rose-400">
                        -₹{deductions.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-right font-mono font-black text-white text-sm">
                        ₹{net.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3.5 px-4 text-center">
                        <span
                          className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                            activeRun
                              ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30"
                              : "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30"
                          }`}
                        >

                      </td>

                          onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(staff)}

                        >
                          <Sliders className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>

                        {/* Download Payslip Button */}
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleDownloadPayslip(staff, runRecord)}
                          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-indigo-500 text-white rounded-lg font-bold text-xs shadow-md shadow-blue-500/20 transition-all cursor-pointer"
                          title="Download Official PDF Payslip"

                          Payslip
                        </button>

                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

                >

                <button

                >
                  Save Salary Package
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>

import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext, useRef, useMemo } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import {
  MessageSquare,
  Send,
  Search,
  ShieldAlert,
  ShieldCheck,
  User,
  Users,
  CheckCheck,
  Check,
  Clock,
  ArrowLeft,
  Sparkles,
  Lock,
  Phone,
  Briefcase
} from "lucide-react";

const CANNED_RESPONSES = [
  "Noted, working on it now.",
  "Please check the student attendance register.",
  "Fee ledger transaction verified.",
  "Exam paper draft uploaded to portal.",
  "Approved for administrative processing."
];

export default function StaffMessenger() {
  const { user, tenant } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const schoolCode = (
    user?.institution_code ||
    user?.school_id ||
    tenant?.code ||
    "CAMPUS-01"
  ).toUpperCase();

  const userCode = (
    user?.role_code ||
    user?.roll_number ||
    user?.personal_code ||
    user?.id ||
    "HOD-01"
  ).toUpperCase().trim();

  const userName = user?.name || user?.full_name || "Faculty Member";
  const userRole = (user?.role || "").toLowerCase().trim();

  // 1. STRICT SECURITY GATE FOR STUDENTS
  const isStudent = userRole === "student" || userCode.startsWith("STU-");
  const isNTS =
    userRole === "staff" ||
    userRole === "nts" ||
    userRole === "non_teaching" ||
    userCode.startsWith("NTS-") ||
    userCode.startsWith("NON-") ||
    userCode.startsWith("STF-");

  // State
  const [contacts, setContacts] = useState([]);
  const [activeContactId, setActiveContactId] = useState(null);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);
  const [inputText, setInputText] = useState("");
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
  const [mobileShowChat, setMobileShowChat] = useState(false);

  const messagesEndRef = useRef(null);

  // Load Contacts and Message Thread
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isStudent) return;
    loadStaffContacts();
    loadMessages();

    const handleMessagesUpdate = () => loadMessages();
    const handleDirUpdate = () => loadStaffContacts();

    window.addEventListener("erp-staff-messages-updated", handleMessagesUpdate);
    window.addEventListener("erp-directory-updated", handleDirUpdate);
    window.addEventListener("storage", handleMessagesUpdate);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-staff-messages-updated", handleMessagesUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-directory-updated", handleDirUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", handleMessagesUpdate);
    };
  }, [schoolCode, userCode, isStudent]);

  // Auto-scroll to bottom of active conversation
  useEffect(() => {
    if (messagesEndRef.current) {
      messagesEndRef.current.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
    }
  }, [messages, activeContactId, mobileShowChat]);

  // Load and Filter Staff Directory (Strictly excluding students)
  const loadStaffContacts = () => {
    try {
      let dir = [];
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${schoolCode}`);
      if (raw) dir = JSON.parse(raw);

      // Filter only staff, teachers, accountants, principals/trustees
      const staffOnly = (dir || []).filter((m) => {
        if (!m) return false;
        const code = (m.role_code || m.roll_number || m.personal_code || m.id || "").toUpperCase().trim();
        const role = (m.role || "").toLowerCase().trim();

        // Exclude current user
        if (code === userCode) return false;

        // Exclude students
        if (role === "student" || code.startsWith("STU-")) return false;

        return (
          code.startsWith("HOD-") ||
          code.startsWith("PRIN-") ||
          code.startsWith("TR-") ||
          code.startsWith("ACC-") ||
          code.startsWith("TCH-") ||
          code.startsWith("FAC-") ||
          code.startsWith("NON-") ||
          code.startsWith("NTS-") ||
          code.startsWith("STF-") ||
          role === "teacher" ||
          role === "principal" ||
          role === "trustee" ||
          role === "accountant" ||
          role === "staff" ||
          role === "admin"
        );
      });

      // Starter fallback nodes if newly provisioned clean-slate institution
      let finalContacts = staffOnly;
      if (finalContacts.length === 0) {
        finalContacts = [
          {
            id: userCode.startsWith("HOD-") ? "TCH-01" : "HOD-01",
            role_code: userCode.startsWith("HOD-") ? "TCH-01" : "HOD-01",
            name: userCode.startsWith("HOD-") ? "Dr. Vikram Joshi" : "Principal & Executive Trustee",
            role: userCode.startsWith("HOD-") ? "teacher" : "trustee",
            class_name: userCode.startsWith("HOD-") ? "Senior Physics Faculty" : "Head of Institution",
            phone: "+91 98111 22334",
          },
          {
            id: "ACC-01",
            role_code: "ACC-01",
            name: "Ramesh Kulkarni",
            role: "accountant",
            class_name: "Chief Treasury Officer",
            phone: "+91 98222 33445",
          },
        ].filter((c) => c.role_code !== userCode);
      }

      setContacts(finalContacts);

      // Select first contact by default on wide screens
      if (!activeContactId && finalContacts.length > 0) {
        setActiveContactId(finalContacts[0].role_code || finalContacts[0].id);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not load staff contacts:", e);
      setContacts([]);
    }
  };

  // Load Messages from Storage
  const loadMessages = () => {
    try {
      const storageKey = `erp_staff_messages_${schoolCode}`;
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (raw) {
        setMessages(JSON.parse(raw));
      } else {
        // Initial welcome coordination message if thread is empty
        const initialSeed = [
          {
            id: "seed_1",
            senderId: "HOD-01",
            senderName: "Principal / HOD",
            recipientId: "TCH-01",
            recipientName: "Dr. Vikram Joshi",
            text: "Welcome to the internal faculty coordination channel. All academic memos and approvals are logged here.",
            timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 3600000).toISOString(),
            read: true,
          },
        ];
        setMessages(initialSeed);
        localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(initialSeed));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Could not load staff messages:", e);
    }
  };

  // Active Contact Object
  const activeContact = useMemo(() => {
    return contacts.find(
      (c) => (c.role_code || c.roll_number || c.id) === activeContactId
    );
  }, [contacts, activeContactId]);

  // Current Thread Messages (1-to-1 between userCode and activeContactId)
  const currentThread = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeContactId) return [];
    return messages.filter(
      (m) =>
        (m.senderId === userCode && m.recipientId === activeContactId) ||
        (m.senderId === activeContactId && m.recipientId === userCode)
    );
  }, [messages, userCode, activeContactId]);

  // Send Message (Supports direct targeted delivery for NTS workflows)
  const handleSendMessage = (textToSend, targetRecipientId) => {
    const text = (textToSend || inputText).trim();
    const recipient = targetRecipientId || activeContactId;
    if (!text || !recipient) return;

    const targetContact = contacts.find((c) => (c.role_code || c.id) === recipient) || activeContact;

    const newMsg = {
      id: `msg_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
      senderId: userCode,
      senderName: userName,
      senderRole: userRole,
      recipientId: recipient,
      recipientName: targetContact?.name || "Staff Member",
      text,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      read: false,
    };

    const updated = [...messages, newMsg];
    setMessages(updated);
    setInputText("");

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_staff_messages_${schoolCode}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-staff-messages-updated"));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Storage error:", e);
    }
  };

  // NTS Workflow: Dedicated reporting to Principal or HOD
  const findExecutiveContact = () => {
    return contacts.find((c) => {
      const code = (c.role_code || c.roll_number || c.id || "").toUpperCase();
      const r = (c.role || "").toLowerCase();
      return code.startsWith("PRIN") || code.startsWith("HOD") || code.startsWith("TR") || r === "principal" || r === "trustee";
    });
  };

  const handleNtsQuickReport = (reportType) => {
    const exec = findExecutiveContact() || contacts[0];
    if (!exec) {
      showToast("No administrative contact found in staff roster.", "error");
      return;
    }
    const execId = exec.role_code || exec.id;
    setActiveContactId(execId);
    setMobileShowChat(true);

    const now = new Date();
    const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
    const dateStr = now.toISOString().split("T")[0];

    let reportMsg = "";
    if (reportType === "duty_checkin") {
      reportMsg = `📋 [NTS DAILY ATTENDANCE]: Logged on-duty at ${timeStr} (${dateStr}). Routine campus operations and facility management underway.`;
    } else if (reportType === "leave_request") {
      reportMsg = `🏖️ [NTS LEAVE NOTICE]: Requesting official leave of absence for ${dateStr}. Assigned operational tasks have been coordinated.`;
    } else if (reportType === "maintenance") {
      reportMsg = `🛠️ [NTS FACILITY REPORT]: Daily campus inspection conducted at ${timeStr}. All security, classroom, and utility infrastructure inspected.`;
    }

    handleSendMessage(reportMsg, execId);
    showToast(`Dispatched ${reportType.replace(/_/g, " ")} report to ${exec.name || execId}!`, "success");
  };

  // Switch Active Contact & Mark Messages as Read
  const handleSelectContact = (contactId) => {
    setActiveContactId(contactId);
    setMobileShowChat(true);

    // Mark unread messages from this contact as read
    const updated = messages.map((m) => {
      if (m.senderId === contactId && m.recipientId === userCode && !m.read) {
        return { ...m, read: true };
      }
      return m;
    });

    setMessages(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_staff_messages_${schoolCode}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  // Role Badge Styling Helper
  const getRoleBadge = (roleStr = "", code = "") => {
    const r = roleStr.toLowerCase();
    const c = code.toUpperCase();
    if (c.startsWith("HOD") || c.startsWith("PRIN") || r === "principal" || r === "trustee") {
      return { label: "HOD / Principal", bg: "bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border-purple-500/30" };
    }
    if (c.startsWith("ACC") || r === "accountant") {
      return { label: "Accountant", bg: "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30" };
    }
    if (c.startsWith("NON") || c.startsWith("NTS") || c.startsWith("STF") || r === "staff") {
      return { label: "Operations Staff", bg: "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30" };
    }
    return { label: "Faculty / Teacher", bg: "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border-blue-500/30" };
  };

  // 1. ACCESS DENIED SCREEN FOR STUDENTS
  if (isStudent) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-2xl mx-auto py-16 px-4 text-center space-y-6">
        <div className="w-20 h-20 bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30 rounded-3xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-center shadow-2xl">
          <ShieldAlert className="w-10 h-10" />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white">Access Restricted: Staff-Only Communications</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
            Direct personal messaging is strictly restricted to institutional personnel (HOD, Teachers, and Accountants). Student accounts are restricted from accessing faculty channels.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="pt-4">
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate("/student/dashboard")}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30 transition-all cursor-pointer"
          >
            ← Return to Student Dashboard
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Filter contacts by search query
  const filteredContacts = contacts.filter((c) => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    const name = (c.name || c.full_name || "").toLowerCase();
    const code = (c.role_code || c.roll_number || c.id || "").toLowerCase();
    const role = (c.role || "").toLowerCase();
    return name.includes(q) || code.includes(q) || role.includes(q);
  });

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-4 pb-12">
      {/* Top Header */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-slate-900/80 p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-blue-600 via-indigo-600 to-purple-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/20">
            <MessageSquare className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-white tracking-tight flex items-center gap-2">
              Staff-Only Internal Messenger
              <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30 font-medium">
                {schoolCode}
              </span>
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
              Secure 1-to-1 direct messaging exclusively for HODs, Principals, Faculty, Accounts, and Operations Staff.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-center">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/10 border border-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 text-xs font-bold">
            <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Logged in as: {userCode} ({userName})</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* NTS OPERATIONS WORKFLOW BAR */}
      {isNTS && (
        <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500/10 via-amber-600/10 to-orange-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-xl">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold text-sm">🛠️ NTS Operations Workflow</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 font-mono font-bold">
                  Direct Principal / HOD Channel
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                Instant daily duty check-in, maintenance logs, and leave requests routed to executive leadership.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleNtsQuickReport("duty_checkin")}
                className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600/20 hover:bg-emerald-600/30 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5"

                <span>📋</span>

              <button

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";

export default function StudentConduct() {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const schoolId = user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";
  const [records, setRecords] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(`erp_conduct_${schoolId}`);
      if (stored) {
        setRecords(JSON.parse(stored));
      } else {
        setRecords([]);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setRecords([]);
    }
  }, [schoolId]);

  return (

          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">Review behavioral standing, commendations, and discipline history</p>
        </div>

        {/* STATUS CARD */}
        <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600/25 to-teal-600/10 border border-emerald-500/30 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl mb-8 flex justify-between items-center">
          <div>
            <span className="text-xs font-extrabold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-widest">Behavioral Standing</span>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-white mt-1">
              {records.length === 0 ? "Exemplary Clean Record (Grade A+) ⭐" : "Official Standing Evaluated"}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-slate-300 text-sm mt-1">
              {records.length === 0
                ? "No disciplinary infractions or conduct penalties recorded. Keep up the outstanding discipline!"
                : `${records.length} official behavioral entries logged on institutional file.`}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="text-4xl">🛡️</div>
        </div>

        {/* RECORDS TABLE */}
        <div className="bg-[#1E293B] border border-slate-700 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
          <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 flex justify-between items-center">

                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-700/50 text-sm">
                  {records.map((rec) => (
                    <tr key={rec.id} className="hover:bg-slate-800/30 transition-colors">

        </div>

import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";

export default function TeacherPlanner() {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("planner");
  const [lessons, setLessons] = useState([]);
  const [tasks, setTasks] = useState([]);

  // Modal States
  const [showLessonModal, setShowLessonModal] = useState(false);
  const [showTaskModal, setShowTaskModal] = useState(false);

  // Form States
  const [lessonForm, setLessonForm] = useState({
    subject: "Mathematics",
    chapter: "",
    objective: "",
    status: "Planned",
  });

  const [taskForm, setTaskForm] = useState({
    title: "",
    due: "",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const storedLessons = localStorage.getItem(`erp_lessons_${schoolId}`);
      if (storedLessons) {
        setLessons(JSON.parse(storedLessons));
      } else {
        setLessons([]);
      }

      const storedTasks = localStorage.getItem(`erp_tasks_${schoolId}`);
      if (storedTasks) {
        setTasks(JSON.parse(storedTasks));
      } else {
        setTasks([]);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Planner storage load error:", e);
      setLessons([]);
      setTasks([]);
    }
  }, [schoolId]);

  const handleAddLesson = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!lessonForm.chapter.trim() || !lessonForm.objective.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide chapter topic and learning objectives.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const newLesson = {
      id: `lesson_${Date.now()}`,
      subject: lessonForm.subject,
      chapter: lessonForm.chapter.trim(),
      objective: lessonForm.objective.trim(),
      status: lessonForm.status,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    const updated = [newLesson, ...lessons];
    setLessons(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_lessons_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}

    showToast(`Lesson plan for "${newLesson.chapter}" added!`, "success");
    setLessonForm({ subject: "Mathematics", chapter: "", objective: "", status: "Planned" });
    setShowLessonModal(false);
  };

  const handleDeleteLesson = (id) => {
    const updated = lessons.filter((l) => l.id !== id);
    setLessons(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_lessons_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}
    showToast("Lesson plan removed.", "info");
  };

  const handleAddTask = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!taskForm.title.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide task title / description.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const newTask = {
      id: `task_${Date.now()}`,
      title: taskForm.title.trim(),
      due: taskForm.due.trim() || "Pending Scheduling",
      completed: false,
    };

    const updated = [newTask, ...tasks];
    setTasks(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_tasks_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}

    showToast(`Reminder "${newTask.title}" scheduled!`, "success");
    setTaskForm({ title: "", due: "" });
    setShowTaskModal(false);
  };

  const toggleTask = (id) => {
    const updated = tasks.map((t) => (t.id === id ? { ...t, completed: !t.completed } : t));
    setTasks(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_tasks_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  const handleDeleteTask = (id) => {
    const updated = tasks.filter((t) => t.id !== id);
    setTasks(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_tasks_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}
    showToast("Reminder task removed.", "info");
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative text-slate-200 min-h-full pb-10 font-sans">
      <div className="fixed top-0 right-10 w-96 h-96 bg-blue-600/10 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none"></div>

      <div className="relative z-10 max-w-5xl mx-auto">
        <div className="mb-8 flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-blue-300 text-sm font-semibold mb-1 uppercase tracking-widest">Faculty Operations</p>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-white">Lesson Planner & Reminders 📝</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">Manage syllabus milestones, academic schedules, and faculty reminders</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2 bg-slate-800/80 p-1.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("planner")}
              className={`px-5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === "planner" ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg" : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              Lesson Planner ({lessons.length})
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("tasks")}
              className={`px-5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === "tasks" ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg" : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              Tasks & Reminders ({tasks.length})
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {activeTab === "planner" ? (
          <div className="bg-[#1E293B] border border-slate-700 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
            <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50 flex justify-between items-center">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">Syllabus & Lesson Planner Schedule</h2>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Faculty curriculum goals and lesson objectives</p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowLessonModal(true)}
                className="bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/30 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <span>➕</span>
                <span>Add Lesson Plan</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            {lessons.length === 0 ? (

                <div className="text-4xl mb-3">📚</div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white mb-1">No Lesson Plans Created (Clean Slate)</h3>
                <p className="text-sm max-w-md mx-auto text-slate-400 mb-6">

                </p>

                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-700/50 text-sm">
                    {lessons.map((l) => (
                      <tr key={l.id} className="hover:bg-slate-800/30 transition-colors">
                        <td className="p-5 font-bold text-blue-400">{l.subject}</td>

import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient.js";

/**
 * AI SCHOOL INTELLIGENCE & EXECUTIVE COPILOT ENGINE
 * Real-time institutional telemetry, explainable risk radar,
 * and deterministic query routing over authorized multi-tenant data.
 */

export async function fetchLiveInstitutionalTelemetry(schoolId) {
  const cleanId = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();

  let students = [];
  let teachers = [];
  let classes = [];
  let attendance = [];
  let feeRecords = [];
  let testScores = [];

  // 1. Fetch from live Supabase tables
  if (supabase) {
    try {
      const [stuRes, tchRes, clsRes, attRes, feeRes, scoreRes] = await Promise.all([
        supabase.from("students").select("id, name, roll_number, class_name, phone").eq("school_id", cleanId),
        supabase.from("teachers").select("id, name, subject, email").eq("school_id", cleanId),
        supabase.from("classes").select("id, name, grade, section").eq("school_id", cleanId),
        supabase.from("attendance").select("id, student_id, class_name, status, date").eq("school_id", cleanId).limit(500),
        supabase.from("fees").select("id, student_id, amount, status, due_date").eq("school_id", cleanId).limit(500),
        supabase.from("test_scores").select("id, student_id, test_id, marks_obtained, is_absent").eq("school_id", cleanId).limit(500),
      ]);

      if (stuRes.data && stuRes.data.length > 0) students = stuRes.data;
      if (tchRes.data && tchRes.data.length > 0) teachers = tchRes.data;
      if (clsRes.data && clsRes.data.length > 0) classes = clsRes.data;
      if (attRes.data && attRes.data.length > 0) attendance = attRes.data;
      if (feeRes.data && feeRes.data.length > 0) feeRecords = feeRes.data;
      if (scoreRes.data && scoreRes.data.length > 0) testScores = scoreRes.data;
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[AIEngine] Supabase live fetch notice:", err);
    }
  }

  // 2. Fallback to cached local directory & ledger if Supabase returns empty
  if (students.length === 0) {
    try {
      const rawDir = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${cleanId}`);
      if (rawDir) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawDir);
        students = parsed.filter((m) => (m.role || "").toLowerCase() === "student");
        teachers = parsed.filter((m) => (m.role || "").toLowerCase() === "teacher");
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  if (feeRecords.length === 0) {
    try {
      const rawFees = localStorage.getItem(`erp_fee_ledger_${cleanId}`);
      if (rawFees) feeRecords = JSON.parse(rawFees);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  // 3. Compute Attendance Telemetry
  let totalAttPresent = 0;
  let totalAttMarked = attendance.length;
  const classAttendanceMap = {};

  attendance.forEach((rec) => {
    const cName = rec.class_name || "General";
    if (!classAttendanceMap[cName]) {
      classAttendanceMap[cName] = { present: 0, total: 0 };
    }
    classAttendanceMap[cName].total += 1;
    if (String(rec.status).toLowerCase() === "present") {
      classAttendanceMap[cName].present += 1;
      totalAttPresent += 1;
    }
  });

  const overallAttendanceRate = totalAttMarked > 0 
    ? Math.round((totalAttPresent / totalAttMarked) * 100) 
    : 0;

  let lowestClass = { name: "N/A", rate: 0 };
  let highestClass = { name: "N/A", rate: 0 };

  const classRateEntries = Object.entries(classAttendanceMap).map(([cls, stat]) => ({
    name: cls,
    rate: stat.total > 0 ? Math.round((stat.present / stat.total) * 100) : 0,
  }));

  if (classRateEntries.length > 0) {
    classRateEntries.sort((a, b) => a.rate - b.rate);
    lowestClass = classRateEntries[0];
    highestClass = classRateEntries[classRateEntries.length - 1];
  }

  // 4. Compute Financial & Fee Telemetry
  let totalFeesBilled = 0;
  let totalFeesCollected = 0;
  let totalFeesOverdue = 0;
  let highRiskDefaultCount = 0;

  const studentFeeAggregates = {};

  feeRecords.forEach((f) => {
    const amt = Number(f.amount || 0);
    const st = String(f.status || "").toLowerCase();
    totalFeesBilled += amt;

    const sId = f.student_id || f.roll_number || "GEN";
    if (!studentFeeAggregates[sId]) studentFeeAggregates[sId] = { billed: 0, paid: 0, due: 0 };
    studentFeeAggregates[sId].billed += amt;

    if (st === "paid" || st === "cleared") {
      totalFeesCollected += amt;
      studentFeeAggregates[sId].paid += amt;
    } else {
      totalFeesOverdue += amt;
      studentFeeAggregates[sId].due += amt;
    }
  });

  Object.values(studentFeeAggregates).forEach((s) => {
    if (s.due >= 25000) highRiskDefaultCount += 1;
  });

  const collectionVelocity = totalFeesBilled > 0 
    ? Math.round((totalFeesCollected / totalFeesBilled) * 100) 
    : 0;

  // 5. Early Warning Radar Identification (Attendance < 75% OR Test Marks < 40%)
  const earlyWarningStudents = [];
  students.forEach((stu) => {
    const sId = stu.id || stu.roll_number;
    const stuAtt = attendance.filter((a) => (a.student_id === sId || a.student_id === stu.roll_number));
    const attPresent = stuAtt.filter((a) => String(a.status).toLowerCase() === "present").length;
    const attRate = stuAtt.length > 0 ? Math.round((attPresent / stuAtt.length) * 100) : null;

    const stuScores = testScores.filter((s) => s.student_id === sId || s.student_id === stu.roll_number);
    const scoreAvg = stuScores.length > 0
      ? Math.round(stuScores.reduce((sum, sc) => sum + Number(sc.marks_obtained || 0), 0) / stuScores.length)
      : null;

    const dueAmount = studentFeeAggregates[stu.roll_number]?.due || studentFeeAggregates[sId]?.due || 0;

    if ((attRate !== null && attRate < 75) || (scoreAvg !== null && scoreAvg < 40)) {
      earlyWarningStudents.push({
        id: stu.id || `risk_${stu.roll_number}`,
        name: stu.name || stu.full_name || "Enrolled Student",
        roll_number: stu.roll_number || "STU-GEN",
        class_name: stu.class_name || "General Batch",
        attendanceRate: attRate !== null ? attRate : 0,
        testAverage: scoreAvg !== null ? scoreAvg : 0,
        feeOverdue: dueAmount,
        parentPhone: stu.phone || stu.guardian_phone || "Not on file",
        riskLevel: (attRate !== null && attRate < 65) || (scoreAvg !== null && scoreAvg < 35) ? "CRITICAL" : "HIGH",
        riskScore: Math.round(100 - ((attRate || 50) * 0.5 + (scoreAvg || 50) * 0.5)),
        primaryReason: `${attRate !== null && attRate < 75 ? `Attendance ${attRate}% (<75%)` : ""}${attRate !== null && attRate < 75 && scoreAvg !== null && scoreAvg < 40 ? " & " : ""}${scoreAvg !== null && scoreAvg < 40 ? `Test Average ${scoreAvg}% (<40%)` : ""}`,
      });
    }
  });

  const ptr = teachers.length > 0 ? (students.length / teachers.length).toFixed(1) : "0.0";

  return {
    schoolId: cleanId,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    studentsCount: students.length,
    teachersCount: teachers.length,
    classesCount: classes.length,
    ptr,
    overallAttendanceRate,
    lowestClass,
    highestClass,
    totalFeesBilled,
    totalFeesCollected,
    totalFeesOverdue,
    collectionVelocity,
    highRiskDefaultCount,
    earlyWarningStudents,
    atRiskCount: earlyWarningStudents.length,
  };
}

/**

 */
export async function queryExecutiveAssistant(prompt, schoolId, userRole = "principal") {
  const cleanPrompt = (prompt || "").trim();

      `• **Punctuality Leader:** **${telemetry.highestClass.name}** at **${telemetry.highestClass.rate}%**\n\n` +
      `💡 *Actionable Suggestion:* Consider initiating an attendance advisory notice to parents of ${telemetry.lowestClass.name} via the Parent Broadcast Gateway.`;
  } else if (lower.includes("fee") || lower.includes("default") || lower.includes("overdue") || lower.includes("collection")) {

      `• **Total Reconciled:** ₹${telemetry.totalFeesCollected.toLocaleString("en-IN")} (${telemetry.collectionVelocity}% velocity)\n` +
      `• **Outstanding Overdue:** **₹${telemetry.totalFeesOverdue.toLocaleString("en-IN")}**\n` +

      `⚡ *Actionable Suggestion:* Automated payment reminders with UPI QR links can be queued for dispatch from the Accountant Command Center.`;
  } else if (lower.includes("risk") || lower.includes("warning") || lower.includes("early warning") || lower.includes("at-risk")) {
    responseText = `⚠️ **Student Early Warning Radar (${telemetry.earlyWarningStudents.length} Flagged):**\n\n` +
      telemetry.earlyWarningStudents.map((s, idx) =>
