```javascript
import { useContext, useState } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";

export default function Homework() {
  const { homework, uploadHomework, getClassHomework, classes, user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    class_id: "",
    subject: "",
    title: "",
    description: "",
    due_date: "",
    file_url: "",
  });

  const handleChange = (e) => {
    setFormData({ ...formData, [e.target.name]: e.target.value });
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    await uploadHomework(formData);
    setFormData({ class_id: "", subject: "", title: "", description: "", due_date: "", file_url: "" });
    showToast("Homework uploaded successfully!", "success");
  };

  const classHomework = formData.class_id ? getClassHomework(formData.class_id) : homework;

  return (
    <div className="p-8 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 to-slate-800 min-h-[100dvh]">
      <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-white mb-8">📚 Homework</h1>

      {/* Upload Form - Teacher Only */}
      {user?.role === "teacher" && (
        <div className="bg-slate-700/50 border border-slate-600/50 rounded-xl p-6 mb-8">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4">Upload Homework</h2>
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <select
                name="class_id"
                value={formData.class_id}
                onChange={handleChange}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-600/50 border border-slate-500/50 rounded-lg text-white"
              >
                <option value="">Select Class</option>
                {classes.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {c.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>

              <input
                type="text"
                name="subject"
                placeholder="Subject"
                value={formData.subject}
                onChange={handleChange}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-600/50 border border-slate-500/50 rounded-lg text-white"
              />
            </div>

            <input
              type="text"
              name="title"
              placeholder="Homework Title"
              value={formData.title}
              onChange={handleChange}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-slate-600/50 border border-slate-500/50 rounded-lg text-white"
            />

            <textarea
              name="description"
              placeholder="Description"
              value={formData.description}
              onChange={handleChange}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-slate-600/50 border border-slate-500/50 rounded-lg text-white"
            />

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <input
                type="date"
                name="due_date"
                value={formData.due_date}
                onChange={handleChange}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-600/50 border border-slate-500/50 rounded-lg text-white"
              />

              <input
                type="text"
                name="file_url"
                placeholder="File URL (optional)"
                value={formData.file_url}
                onChange={handleChange}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-600/50 border border-slate-500/50 rounded-lg text-white"
              />
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="w-full py-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-cyan-600 hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-cyan-700 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg transition"
            >
              📤 Upload Homework
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Homework List */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-4">📋 Your Homework</h2>
        {classHomework.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-slate-400">No homework yet.</p>
        ) : (
          classHomework.map((hw) => (
            <div
              key={hw.id}
              className="bg-slate-700/50 border border-slate-600/50 rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-cyan-500/50 transition"
            >
              <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">{hw.title}</h3>
                  <p className="text-slate-400">{hw.subject}</p>
                  <p className="text-slate-300 mt-2">{hw.description}</p>
                  {hw.due_date && (
                    <p className="text-red-400 mt-2">
                      📅 Due: {new Date(hw.due_date).toLocaleDateString()}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
                {hw.file_url && (
                  <a
                    href={hw.file_url}
                    target="_blank"
                    rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-lg transition"
                  >
                    📥 Download
                  </a>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
export default function Reports() {
  const { getFeeReport, getAttendanceReport, getMarksReport, classes } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [reportType, setReportType] = useState("fees");
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState("");
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState("");
  const [classId, setClassId] = useState("");
  const [reportData, setReportData] = useState(null);

  const handleGenerateReport = () => {
    if (!startDate || !endDate) {
      showToast("Please select both start and end date range.", "error");
      return;
    }

    let data;
    if (reportType === "fees") {
      data = getFeeReport(startDate, endDate, classId || null);
    } else if (reportType === "attendance") {
      data = getAttendanceReport(startDate, endDate, classId || null);
    } else if (reportType === "marks") {
      data = getMarksReport(classId || null);
    }

    setReportData(data);
  };

  const handleDownloadCSV = () => {
    if (!reportData) return;

    let csv = "";
    if (reportType === "fees") {
      csv = "Student ID,Amount,Status,Date\n";
      reportData.records.forEach((r) => {
        csv += `${r.student_id},${r.amount},${r.status},${r.date}\n`;
      });
    } else if (reportType === "attendance") {
      csv = "Date,Present,Absent,Percentage\n";
      csv += `${reportData.total_days},${reportData.present},${reportData.absent},${reportData.percentage}%\n`;
    } else if (reportType === "marks") {
      csv = "Student,Subject,Percentage,Grade\n";
      reportData.records.forEach((r) => {
        csv += `${r.student_id},${r.subject},${r.percentage},${r.grade}\n`;
      });
    }

    const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" });
    const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${reportType}-report.csv`;
    a.click();
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-8 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 to-slate-800 min-h-[100dvh]">
      <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-white mb-8">📊 Reports</h1>

      {/* Filter Section */}
      <div className="bg-slate-700/50 border border-slate-600/50 rounded-xl p-6 mb-8">
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4">Generate Report</h2>
        
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Report Type */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 mb-2">
              Report Type
            </label>
            <select
              value={reportType}
              onChange={(e) => setReportType(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-slate-600/50 border border-slate-500/50 rounded-lg text-white"
            >
              <option value="fees">💰 Fee Report</option>
              <option value="attendance">📋 Attendance Report</option>
              <option value="marks">📈 Marks Report</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Class Filter */}
          <div>
            <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 mb-2">
              Class (Optional)
            </label>
            <select
              value={classId}
              onChange={(e) => setClassId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-slate-600/50 border border-slate-500/50 rounded-lg text-white"
            >
              <option value="">All Classes</option>
              {classes.map((c) => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                  {c.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Date Range */}
          {reportType !== "marks" && (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 mb-2">
                  Start Date
                </label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={startDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setStartDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-slate-600/50 border border-slate-500/50 rounded-lg text-white"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 mb-2">
                  End Date
                </label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  value={endDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setEndDate(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2 bg-slate-600/50 border border-slate-500/50 rounded-lg text-white"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={handleGenerateReport}
            className="w-full py-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-cyan-600 hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-cyan-700 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg transition"
          >
            🔍 Generate Report
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Report Display */}
      {reportData && (
        <div className="bg-slate-700/50 border border-slate-600/50 rounded-xl p-6 space-y-4">
          {reportType === "fees" && (
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-4">💰 Fee Report</h2>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
                <div className="bg-slate-600/50 rounded-lg p-4">
                  <p className="text-slate-400">Total Fees</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-400">
                    ₹{reportData.total_fees.toFixed(2)}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-slate-600/50 rounded-lg p-4">
                  <p className="text-slate-400">Collected</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-400">
                    ₹{reportData.collected.toFixed(2)}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-slate-600/50 rounded-lg p-4">
                  <p className="text-slate-400">Pending</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-400">
                    ₹{reportData.pending.toFixed(2)}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {reportType === "attendance" && (
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-4">📋 Attendance Report</h2>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
                <div className="bg-slate-600/50 rounded-lg p-4">
                  <p className="text-slate-400">Total Days</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{reportData.total_days}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-slate-600/50 rounded-lg p-4">
                  <p className="text-slate-400">Present</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-400">{reportData.present}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-slate-600/50 rounded-lg p-4">
                  <p className="text-slate-400">Absent</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-400">{reportData.absent}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-slate-600/50 rounded-lg p-4">
                  <p className="text-slate-400">Percentage</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400">{reportData.percentage}%</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {reportType === "marks" && (
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white mb-4">📈 Marks Report</h2>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
                <div className="bg-slate-600/50 rounded-lg p-4">
                  <p className="text-slate-400">Total Students</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{reportData.total_students}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-slate-600/50 rounded-lg p-4">
                  <p className="text-slate-400">Total Marks</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{reportData.total_marks}</p>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-slate-600/50 rounded-lg p-4">
                  <p className="text-slate-400">Class Average</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-400">{reportData.class_average}%</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={handleDownloadCSV}
            className="w-full py-3 bg-gradient-to-r from-green-600 to-emerald-600 hover:from-green-700 hover:to-emerald-700 text-white font-semibold rounded-lg transition"
          >
            ⬇️ Download CSV
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
  const schoolId = user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const canManage = ["teacher", "principal", "trustee", "admin"].includes(userRole);

  const [events, setEvents] = useState([]);
  const [showAddModal, setShowAddModal] = useState(false);
  const [eventForm, setEventForm] = useState({
    title: "",
    date: "",
    type: "Exam",
    status: "Working Day",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem(`erp_calendar_${schoolId}`);
      if (stored) {
        setEvents(JSON.parse(stored));
      } else {
        setEvents([]);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setEvents([]);
    }
  }, [schoolId]);

  const handleAddEvent = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!eventForm.title.trim() || !eventForm.date.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide event title and date.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const newEv = {
      id: `ev_${Date.now()}`,
      title: eventForm.title.trim(),
      date: eventForm.date.trim(),
      type: eventForm.type,
      status: eventForm.status,
    };

    const updated = [...events, newEv];
    setEvents(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_calendar_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}

    showToast(`Event "${newEv.title}" added to school calendar!`, "success");
    setEventForm({ title: "", date: "", type: "Exam", status: "Working Day" });
    setShowAddModal(false);
  };

  const handleDeleteEvent = (id) => {

    setEvents(updated);
    try {

    } catch (e) {}
    showToast("Event removed from calendar.", "info");
  };

  return (

              >
                + Add Calendar Event
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* TODAY'S STATUS BANNER */}
        <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600/20 to-teal-600/10 border border-emerald-500/30 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl mb-8 flex justify-between items-center">
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { TableSkeleton } from "../Components/Skeleton";

export default function StudentHomework() {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [homeworkList, setHomeworkList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [completions, setCompletions] = useState({});

  const schoolId = (user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();
  const studentId = (user?.personal_code || user?.role_code || user?.roll_number || user?.id || "STU-101").toUpperCase();

  const loadCompletions = () => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_hw_completion_${schoolId}`);
      if (saved) {
        setCompletions(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setCompletions({});
      }
    } catch {
      setCompletions({});
    }
  };

  const fetchHomework = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    loadCompletions();
    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase
        .from("homework")
        .select("*")
        .eq("school_id", schoolId)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (error) throw error;
      setHomeworkList(data || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error fetching student homework:", err);
      // Fallback to local storage if offline
      try {
        const local = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`erp_homework_${schoolId}`) || "[]");
        setHomeworkList(local);
      } catch (e) {
        setHomeworkList([]);
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchHomework();
    const handleUpdate = () => loadCompletions();
    window.addEventListener("erp-homework-verification-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("erp-homework-verification-updated", handleUpdate);
  }, [user?.institution_code, user?.school_id]);

  const isHwCompleted = (hwId) => {
    if (!completions) return false;
    // Check if verified specifically for this student, or verified globally for the assignment
    if (completions[hwId] === true) return true;
    if (completions[hwId] && typeof completions[hwId] === "object" && (completions[hwId][studentId] === true || completions[hwId]["all"] === true)) {
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  };

  const completedCount = homeworkList.filter((h) => isHwCompleted(h.id)).length;
  const pendingCount = homeworkList.length - completedCount;

  return (
    <div className="relative text-slate-200 min-h-full pb-10 font-sans">
      <div className="fixed top-0 left-10 w-96 h-96 bg-blue-600/10 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none"></div>

      <div className="relative z-10 max-w-5xl mx-auto">
        <div className="mb-8 flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-blue-300 text-sm font-semibold mb-1 uppercase tracking-widest">
              Student Academic Portal
            </p>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-white">Curriculum Assignments & Homework 📚</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">
              Strict faculty verification system &bull; Student status: <span className="font-mono text-blue-400 font-bold">{studentId}</span>
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-emerald-300 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold">
              ✓ Verified: {completedCount}
            </span>
            <span className="bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-amber-300 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold">
              ⏳ Pending: {pendingCount}
            </span>
            <button
              onClick={fetchHomework}
              className="text-xs bg-blue-600/20 hover:bg-blue-600/30 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              🔄 Refresh
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {loading ? (
          <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/70 rounded-3xl p-6 border border-slate-700/60">
            <TableSkeleton rows={4} cols={3} />
          </div>
        ) : homeworkList.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/70 border border-slate-700/60 rounded-3xl p-16 text-center shadow-2xl">
            <span className="text-5xl block mb-4">🎉</span>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-2">No Homework Assigned</h3>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm max-w-md mx-auto">

                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center pt-2 flex-wrap gap-3">
                    <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">
                      Posted: {new Date(hw.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}

                    <div>

                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-900/20">

                          <span>⏳</span>
                          <span>Pending Faculty Verification</span>
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { getQuizzes } from "../utils/quizService";
import { getStudyMaterials } from "../utils/studyMaterialService";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";

export function formatMathText(text) {
  if (!text || typeof text !== "string") return text;
  return text
    .replace(/\$\$([^$]+)\$\$/g, "$1")
    .replace(/\$([^$]+)\$/g, "$1")
    .replace(/\\Delta/g, "Δ")
    .replace(/\\pm/g, "±")
    .replace(/\\sqrt\{([^}]+)\}/g, "√($1)")
    .replace(/\\sqrt/g, "√")
    .replace(/ax\^2/g, "ax²")
    .replace(/bx\^2/g, "bx²")
    .replace(/cx\^2/g, "cx²")
    .replace(/x\^2/g, "x²")
    .replace(/b\^2/g, "b²")
    .replace(/a\^2/g, "a²")
    .replace(/c\^2/g, "c²")
    .replace(/\^2/g, "²")
    .replace(/\^3/g, "³")
    .replace(/<=/g, "≤")
    .replace(/>=/g, "≥");
}

export default function StudentLMS() {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("lms"); // 'lms' or 'quizzes'
  const [quizzes, setQuizzes] = useState([]);
  const [loadingQuizzes, setLoadingQuizzes] = useState(true);

  // Dynamic study materials uploaded by faculty (Clean Slate)
  const [materials, setMaterials] = useState([]);
  const [loadingMaterials, setLoadingMaterials] = useState(true);

  // Quiz state
  const [selectedQuiz, setSelectedQuiz] = useState(null);
  const [currentQIndex, setCurrentQIndex] = useState(0);
  const [userAnswers, setUserAnswers] = useState({});
  const [scoreResult, setScoreResult] = useState(null);

  const schoolCode = user?.school_id || user?.institution_code;

  const loadLmsContent = async () => {
    setLoadingQuizzes(true);
    setLoadingMaterials(true);
    try {
      const [qData, mData] = await Promise.all([
        getQuizzes(schoolCode),
        getStudyMaterials(schoolCode),
      ]);
      setQuizzes(qData || []);
      setMaterials(mData || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error loading LMS data:", err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingQuizzes(false);
      setLoadingMaterials(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadLmsContent();
    window.addEventListener("erp-quizzes-updated", loadLmsContent);
    window.addEventListener("erp-study-materials-updated", loadLmsContent);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-quizzes-updated", loadLmsContent);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-study-materials-updated", loadLmsContent);
    };
  }, [schoolCode]);

  const handleStartQuiz = (quiz) => {
    setSelectedQuiz(quiz);
    setCurrentQIndex(0);
    setUserAnswers({});
    setScoreResult(null);
  };

  const handleSelectOption = (qIdx, optIdx) => {
    setUserAnswers((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [qIdx]: optIdx,
    }));
  };

  const handleSubmitQuiz = () => {
    if (!selectedQuiz || !selectedQuiz.questions || selectedQuiz.questions.length === 0) return;

    let correctCount = 0;
    const details = selectedQuiz.questions.map((q, idx) => {
      const selected = userAnswers[idx];
      const isCorrect = selected === q.correct_answer;
      if (isCorrect) correctCount += 1;
      return {
        question: q.question,
        options: q.options,
        selectedOption: selected !== undefined ? q.options[selected] : "Not Answered",
        correctOption: q.options[q.correct_answer],
        isCorrect,
        explanation: q.explanation || "Standard curriculum concept.",
      };
    });

    const total = selectedQuiz.questions.length;
    const percentage = Math.round((correctCount / total) * 100);

    setScoreResult({
      correctCount,
      total,
      percentage,
      details,
    });

    showToast(`Quiz submitted! You scored ${percentage}% (${correctCount}/${total})`, "success");
  };

  const handleDownloadResource = (mat) => {
    showToast(`Downloading "${mat.title}" (${mat.size})...`, "info");
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative text-slate-200 min-h-full pb-10 font-sans">
      <div className="fixed top-0 left-10 w-96 h-96 bg-purple-600/10 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none"></div>

      <div className="relative z-10 max-w-6xl mx-auto">
        {/* HEADER */}
        <div className="mb-8 flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-purple-300 text-sm font-semibold mb-1 uppercase tracking-widest">
              Student Academic Learning Management System
            </p>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-white">LMS Study Hub & Quizzes 📖</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">
              Interactive faculty study notes, term revision sheets, and dynamic automated test series
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2 bg-slate-800/80 p-1.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("lms")}
              className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === "lms"
                  ? "bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-purple-600/30"

              }`}
            >

            </button>
            <button

              }`}
            >
              ⚡ Interactive Quizzes ({quizzes.length})
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* TAB 1: STUDY MATERIALS */}
        {activeTab === "lms" ? (
          <div>
            {loadingMaterials ? (
              <div className="text-center py-12 text-slate-400">Loading syllabus study materials...</div>
            ) : materials.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-12 text-center bg-[#1E293B]/70 border border-slate-700/60 rounded-3xl text-slate-400 space-y-3">
                <div className="text-5xl opacity-60">📚</div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">No study notes or interactive quizzes uploaded by faculty yet.</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">

                {materials.map((mat) => (
```

```javascript
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { logSecurityAction } from "./auditLogger";

/**
 * Loads notices from Supabase or localStorage fallback with strict tenant isolation
 * Clean Slate: returns empty array if no notices have been published.
 */
export async function getNotices(schoolId) {
  const cleanSchoolId = schoolId ? String(schoolId).trim().toUpperCase() : null;

  try {
    if (supabase) {
      let query = supabase.from("notices").select("*");
      if (cleanSchoolId) {
        query = query.eq("school_id", cleanSchoolId);
      }
      const { data, error } = await query.order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
        return data;
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Notice DB load notice:", err);
  }

  // Fallback to tenant-scoped localStorage
  try {
    if (cleanSchoolId) {
      const savedTenant = localStorage.getItem(`erp_broadcasts_${cleanSchoolId}`);
      if (savedTenant) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(savedTenant);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
      }
    }

    const savedGlobal = localStorage.getItem("erp_institutional_notices");
    if (savedGlobal) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(savedGlobal);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        if (cleanSchoolId) {
          return parsed.filter(
            (n) => String(n.school_id || "").toUpperCase() === cleanSchoolId
          );
        }
        return parsed;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }

  // True clean slate: zero mock notices for newly registered schools
  return [];
}

/**
 * Publishes a new notice to Supabase and syncs local storage
 */
export async function publishNotice({ title, category, audience, content, date, schoolId, user }) {
  const cleanSchoolId = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();
  const newNotice = {
    id: `notice-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
    title: title.trim(),
    category: category || "Academic",
    audience: audience || "All",
    date: date || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    content: content.trim(),
    school_id: cleanSchoolId,
    author: user?.name || "Executive Administration",
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  // Try Supabase insert
  try {
    if (supabase) {
      await supabase.from("notices").insert([
        {
          title: newNotice.title,
          type: newNotice.category,
          audience: newNotice.audience,
          date: newNotice.date,
          content: newNotice.content,
          school_id: newNotice.school_id,
        },
      ]);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Notice insertion in Supabase notice:", err);
  }

  // Update tenant localStorage
  try {
    const tenantKey = `erp_broadcasts_${cleanSchoolId}`;
    const rawTenant = localStorage.getItem(tenantKey);
    const tenantList = rawTenant ? JSON.parse(rawTenant) : [];
    const updatedTenant = [newNotice, ...tenantList.filter((n) => n.id !== newNotice.id)];
    localStorage.setItem(tenantKey, JSON.stringify(updatedTenant));

    // Also update global cache
    const globalRaw = localStorage.getItem("erp_institutional_notices");
    const globalList = globalRaw ? JSON.parse(globalRaw) : [];
    const updatedGlobal = [newNotice, ...globalList.filter((n) => n.id !== newNotice.id)];
    localStorage.setItem("erp_institutional_notices", JSON.stringify(updatedGlobal));

    // Dispatch real-time live event for all active dashboards
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-notices-updated"));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("Storage notice sync error:", e);
  }

  // Log Security / Audit action
  try {
    logSecurityAction({
      action: "NOTICE_PUBLISHED",
      entityType: "CIRCULAR",
      entityId: newNotice.title,
      details: `Broadcasted ${newNotice.category} notice to ${newNotice.audience}: "${newNotice.title}"`,
      user,
      schoolId: cleanSchoolId,
    });
  } catch {
    // audit logger optional
  }

  return newNotice;
}

/**
 * Delete notice
 */
export async function deleteNotice(id, schoolId) {
  const cleanSchoolId = schoolId ? String(schoolId).trim().toUpperCase() : null;

  try {
    if (supabase) {
      await supabase.from("notices").delete().eq("id", id);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Notice delete error in DB:", err);
  }

  try {
    if (cleanSchoolId) {
      const tenantKey = `erp_broadcasts_${cleanSchoolId}`;
      const savedTenant = localStorage.getItem(tenantKey);
      if (savedTenant) {
        const filtered = JSON.parse(savedTenant).filter((n) => n.id !== id);
        localStorage.setItem(tenantKey, JSON.stringify(filtered));
      }
    }

    const saved = localStorage.getItem("erp_institutional_notices");
    if (saved) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
      const filtered = parsed.filter((n) => n.id !== id);
      localStorage.setItem("erp_institutional_notices", JSON.stringify(filtered));
    }

    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-notices-updated"));
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
}
```

```javascript
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { captureException } from "../telemetry/sentry";

/**
 * INDEXED-DB PERSISTENT OFFLINE MUTATION QUEUE
 * Replaces localStorage with client-side IndexedDB (idb pattern) and provides
 * device-side payload encryption for sensitive student and institutional data at rest.
 */

const DB_NAME = "AcademicOS_OfflineDB";
const DB_VERSION = 2;
const STORE_NAME = "offline_mutation_queue";
const KEY_STORE_NAME = "vault_keys";

let cachedPendingCount = 0;
let dbInstancePromise = null;
let deviceKeyCache = null;

/**
 * Generates a deterministic or cryptographically random UUID v4
 */
export function generateEventId() {
  if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID) {
    return crypto.randomUUID();
  }
  return "evt_" + Date.now() + "_" + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9);
}

/**
 * Open or initialize the IndexedDB instance with user indexing and vault key store
 */
function openDB() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined" || !window.indexedDB) {
    return Promise.reject(new Error("IndexedDB is unavailable in this environment"));
  }

  if (!dbInstancePromise) {
    dbInstancePromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const request = window.indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);

      request.onupgradeneeded = (event) => {
        const db = event.target.result;
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {
          const store = db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, { keyPath: "event_id" });
          store.createIndex("school_id", "school_id", { unique: false });
          store.createIndex("user_id", "user_id", { unique: false });
          store.createIndex("created_at", "created_at", { unique: false });
          store.createIndex("action_type", "action_type", { unique: false });
        } else {
          const store = request.transaction.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
          if (!store.indexNames.contains("user_id")) {
            store.createIndex("user_id", "user_id", { unique: false });
          }
        }

        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(KEY_STORE_NAME)) {
          db.createObjectStore(KEY_STORE_NAME, { keyPath: "id" });
        }
      };

      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
      request.onerror = () => {
        dbInstancePromise = null;
        reject(request.error);
      };
    });
  }

  return dbInstancePromise;
}

/**
 * Generates or retrieves a persistent, non-extractable device AES-GCM 256-bit CryptoKey.
 * Completely eliminates fixed hardcoded strings and static salts.
 */
async function getDeviceEncryptionKey() {
  if (deviceKeyCache) return deviceKeyCache;
  if (typeof crypto === "undefined" || !crypto.subtle) return null;

  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const stored = await new Promise((resolve) => {
      try {
        const tx = db.transaction(KEY_STORE_NAME, "readonly");
        const store = tx.objectStore(KEY_STORE_NAME);
        const req = store.get("device_master_key");
        req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result?.key || null);
        req.onerror = () => resolve(null);
      } catch {
        resolve(null);
      }
    });

    if (stored) {
      deviceKeyCache = stored;
      return deviceKeyCache;
    }

    // Generate cryptographically random 256-bit AES-GCM key
    const newKey = await crypto.subtle.generateKey(
      { name: "AES-GCM", length: 256 },
      false, // Non-extractable
      ["encrypt", "decrypt"]
    );

    // Persist CryptoKey directly into IndexedDB
    await new Promise((resolve) => {
      try {
        const tx = db.transaction(KEY_STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
        const store = tx.objectStore(KEY_STORE_NAME);
        store.put({ id: "device_master_key", key: newKey, created_at: new Date().toISOString() });
        tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        tx.onerror = () => resolve();
      } catch {
        resolve();
      }
    });

    deviceKeyCache = newKey;
    return deviceKeyCache;
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[OfflineQueue] Key generation/retrieval error:", e);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Encrypts payload at rest using AES-GCM-256 with a unique 12-byte initialization vector.
 * Insecure plaintext and Base64 fallbacks have been permanently removed.
 */
export async function encryptPayload(payload) {
  const key = await getDeviceEncryptionKey();
  if (!key || typeof crypto === "undefined" || !crypto.subtle) {
    throw new Error("Device encryption unavailable: WebCrypto AES-GCM-256 is required for sensitive offline data.");
  }

  const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const encrypted = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
    { name: "AES-GCM", iv },
    key,
    enc.encode(jsonStr)
  );

  return {
    ciphertext: Array.from(new Uint8Array(encrypted))
      .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
      .join(""),
    iv: Array.from(iv)
      .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
      .join(""),
    algorithm: "AES-GCM-256",
  };
}

/**
 * Decrypts AES-GCM-256 encrypted payload record.
 */
export async function decryptPayload(encryptedRecord) {
  if (!encryptedRecord) return null;
  if (encryptedRecord.algorithm !== "AES-GCM-256" || !encryptedRecord.iv) {
    // If payload is already raw object, return safely
    if (typeof encryptedRecord === "object" && !encryptedRecord.ciphertext) return encryptedRecord;
    throw new Error("Unrecognized encryption format or insecure payload rejected.");
  }

  const key = await getDeviceEncryptionKey();
  if (!key) throw new Error("Decryption key unavailable on device.");

  const iv = new Uint8Array(
    encryptedRecord.iv.match(/.{1,2}/g).map((byte) => parseInt(byte, 16))
  );
  const data = new Uint8Array(
    encryptedRecord.ciphertext.match(/.{1,2}/g).map((byte) => parseInt(byte, 16))
  );

  const decrypted = await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
    { name: "AES-GCM", iv },
    key,
    data
  );
  const dec = new TextDecoder();
  return JSON.parse(dec.decode(decrypted));
}

/**
 * Refreshes and synchronizes the pending count from IndexedDB
 */
export async function refreshPendingCount() {
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const count = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readonly");
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const req = store.count();
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || 0);
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });
    cachedPendingCount = count;
    return count;
  } catch {
    return cachedPendingCount;
  }
}

// Initial bootstrap of cached count
if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  refreshPendingCount().then((count) => {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("erp-offline-queue-updated", {
        detail: { pendingCount: count },
      })
    );
  }).catch(() => {});
}

/**
 * Returns count of pending offline mutations (synchronous for React state initializers)
 */
export function getPendingOfflineCount(schoolId = null) {
  return cachedPendingCount;
}

/**
 * Returns count of pending offline mutations asynchronously from IndexedDB
 */
export async function getPendingOfflineCountAsync(schoolId = null) {
  return await refreshPendingCount();
}

/**
 * Retrieves all raw mutations from IndexedDB, decrypting each payload
 */
export async function getOfflineQueue() {
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    const rawItems = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readonly");
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const req = store.getAll();
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });

    const decryptedItems = await Promise.all(
      rawItems.map(async (item) => {
        const decryptedPayload = await decryptPayload(item.encrypted_payload);
        return {
          ...item,
          payload: decryptedPayload,
        };
      })
    );

    return decryptedItems;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[OfflineQueue] Error reading from IndexedDB:", err);
    return [];
  }
}

/**
 * Enqueues a durable offline mutation into IndexedDB with payload encryption
 */
export async function enqueueOfflineMutation({
  schoolId = "CAMPUS-01",
  actionType = "attendance_mark",
  payload = {},
  eventId = null,
  userId = null,
  userEmail = null,
}) {
  const cleanSchool = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();

  const finalEventId =
    eventId ||
    payload.event_id ||
    (payload.studentId && payload.date
      ? `evt_${cleanSchool}_${payload.studentId}_${payload.date}`
      : generateEventId());

  try {
    const db = await openDB();

    // Check if event already exists (deduplication)
    const existing = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readonly");
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const req = store.get(finalEventId);
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });

    if (existing) {
      console.info(`[OfflineQueue] Event ${finalEventId} already queued in IndexedDB; deduplicated.`);
      return finalEventId;
    }

    // Encrypt payload before persisting at rest
    const encryptedPayload = await encryptPayload(payload);

    const record = {
      event_id: finalEventId,
      school_id: cleanSchool,
      user_id: userId || null,
      user_email: userEmail || null,
      action_type: actionType,
      encrypted_payload: encryptedPayload,
      payload_algorithm: encryptedPayload.algorithm,
      attempts: 0,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const req = store.put(record);
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });

    cachedPendingCount += 1;

    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent("erp-offline-queue-updated", {
          detail: {
            pendingCount: cachedPendingCount,
            schoolId: cleanSchool,
            userId: userId || null,
            latestEventId: finalEventId,
          },
        })
      );
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("[OfflineQueue] Failed to persist offline mutation into IndexedDB:", err);
  }

  return finalEventId;
}

/**
 * Flushes queued mutations from IndexedDB strictly matching the active authenticated tenant and user.
 * Prevents account-switch leaks and cross-tenant pollution.
 */
export async function flushOfflineMutationQueue(activeSchoolId = null, activeUserId = null) {
  if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && !navigator.onLine) {
    return { flushed: 0, pending: cachedPendingCount };
  }

  const allItems = await getOfflineQueue();
  if (allItems.length === 0) {
    cachedPendingCount = 0;
    return { flushed: 0, pending: 0 };
  }

  const cleanSchool = activeSchoolId ? activeSchoolId.toUpperCase().trim() : null;

  // Strict tenant & user binding: Only flush items belonging to the active school and user
  const queue = allItems.filter((item) => {
    if (cleanSchool && item.school_id && item.school_id !== cleanSchool) {
      return false; // Skip items from other schools
    }
    if (activeUserId && item.user_id && item.user_id !== activeUserId) {
      return false; // Skip items from other authenticated users
    }
    return true;
  });

  if (queue.length === 0) {
    return { flushed: 0, pending: allItems.length };
  }

  console.info(`[OfflineQueue] Flushing ${queue.length} tenant-authorized offline mutations to cloud...`);

  let flushedCount = 0;
  const db = await openDB();

  for (const item of queue) {
    try {
      let syncSuccess = false;

      if (item.action_type === "attendance_mark" && supabase) {
        const { school_id, payload } = item;
        const targetDate = payload.date || payload.attendance_date || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];

        const { data: existing, error: fetchErr } = await supabase
          .from("attendance")
          .select("id, records")
          .eq("school_id", school_id)
          .eq("date", targetDate)
          .maybeSingle();

        if (!fetchErr) {
          const currentRecords = Array.isArray(existing?.records) ? existing.records : [];
          let mergedRecords = [];

          if (Array.isArray(payload.records)) {
            const incomingIds = new Set(
              payload.records.map((r) => r.student_id || r.studentId || r.user_code || r.id)
            );
            const filteredCurrent = currentRecords.filter(
              (r) => !incomingIds.has(r.student_id || r.studentId || r.user_code || r.id)
            );
            const taggedIncoming = payload.records.map((r) => ({
              ...r,
              event_id: r.event_id || item.event_id,
              synced_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            }));
            mergedRecords = [...filteredCurrent, ...taggedIncoming];
          } else {
            const studentCode = payload.studentId || payload.student_id || payload.user_code;
            const filteredRecords = currentRecords.filter(
              (r) => (r.studentId || r.student_id || r.user_code) !== studentCode
            );
            const newRecord = {
              ...payload,
              event_id: item.event_id,
              synced_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            };
            mergedRecords = [...filteredRecords, newRecord];
          }

          if (existing?.id) {
            await supabase
              .from("attendance")
              .update({ records: mergedRecords, attendance_date: targetDate })
              .eq("id", existing.id);
          } else {
            await supabase.from("attendance").insert([
              {
                school_id,
                date: targetDate,
                attendance_date: targetDate,
                class_name: payload.class_name || payload.className || "General",
                class_id: payload.class_id || payload.classId || "Class-10A",
                records: mergedRecords,
              },
            ]);
          }
          syncSuccess = true;
        }
      } else {
        syncSuccess = true;
      }

      if (syncSuccess) {
        // Remove item from IndexedDB on successful sync
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
          const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
          const req = store.delete(item.event_id);
          req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
          req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
        });
        flushedCount++;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn(`[OfflineQueue] Failed to sync item ${item.event_id}:`, err);
      captureException(err, { context: "offlineSyncQueue.flush", eventId: item.event_id });
    }
  }

  await refreshPendingCount();

  if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("erp-offline-queue-updated", {
        detail: {
          pendingCount: cachedPendingCount,
          flushedCount,
        },
      })
    );
    window.dispatchEvent(
      new CustomEvent("erp-offline-sync-completed", {
        detail: { flushedCount, remaining: cachedPendingCount },
      })
    );
  }

  return { flushed: flushedCount, pending: cachedPendingCount };
}

/**
 * Purges the entire IndexedDB offline mutation queue on user sign-out
 * Prevents sensitive student and academic data from leaking on shared devices.
 */
export async function purgeOfflineQueue() {
  console.info("[OfflineQueue] Purging IndexedDB offline queue on global sign-out...");
  try {
    const db = await openDB();
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const tx = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, "readwrite");
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const req = store.clear();
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
      req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    });

    cachedPendingCount = 0;

    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.dispatchEvent(
        new CustomEvent("erp-offline-queue-updated", {
          detail: { pendingCount: 0, purged: true },
        })
      );
    }
    return { success: true, count: 0 };
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("[OfflineQueue] Error during purgeOfflineQueue:", err);
    cachedPendingCount = 0;
    return { success: false, error: err?.message };
  }
}

// Global auto-flusher on network reconnect
if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
  window.addEventListener("online", () => {
    console.info("[OfflineQueue] Network online event received; triggering auto-flush.");
    flushOfflineMutationQueue();
  });
}
```

```javascript
import React from 'react';
import { captureException } from '../telemetry/sentry';

export default class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = {
      hasError: false,
      error: null,
      errorInfo: null,
    };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, errorInfo) {
    console.error('[EduSaaS ErrorBoundary Caught]:', error, errorInfo);
    try {
      captureException(error, { component: this.props.viewName || 'ErrorBoundary', errorInfo });
    } catch (_) {
      // Ignore telemetry transport failures
    }
    this.setState({ errorInfo });
  }

  handleReset = () => {
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null });
  };

  handleSafeReset = () => {
    try {
      sessionStorage.clear();
    } catch (_) {
      // Ignore storage errors
    }
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null });
    window.location.href = '/login';
  };

  handleReload = () => {
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null, errorInfo: null });
    window.location.reload();
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      if (this.props.inline) {
        return (
          <div className="p-6 m-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/90 border border-rose-500/30 text-slate-100 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-rose-400 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">

              <p className="text-[11px] font-mono text-rose-300 break-words bg-slate-950 p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-800">

            <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">

                ↻ Retry Module
              </button>

              >
                Reload Page
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        );

      return (

          <div className="max-w-lg w-full bg-[#111827] border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 md:p-8 shadow-2xl">

              >
                🛡️ Return to Portal Login
```

```javascript
export default function Navbar({ onMenuToggle, title, subtitle, className = "" }) {
  const { user, tenant } = useContext(AppContext) || {};

  const [schoolLogo, setSchoolLogo] = useState(null);
  const [logoError, setLogoError] = useState(false);
  const [pendingQueueCount, setPendingQueueCount] = useState(0);
  const [isOnline, setIsOnline] = useState(typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.onLine : true);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchLogo = () => {
      try {
        const stored =
          localStorage.getItem(`erp_logo_${schoolCode}`) ||
          localStorage.getItem(`erp_school_logo_${schoolCode}`) ||
          tenant?.logoUrl;
        setSchoolLogo(stored || null);
        setLogoError(false);
      } catch {
        setSchoolLogo(null);
      }
    };

    const updateQueueStatus = () => {
      try {
        setPendingQueueCount(getPendingQueueCount(schoolCode));
      } catch {
        setPendingQueueCount(0);
      }
    };

    const handleOnline = () => {
      setIsOnline(true);
      updateQueueStatus();
    };

    const handleOffline = () => {
      setIsOnline(false);
      updateQueueStatus();
    };

    fetchLogo();
    updateQueueStatus();

    window.addEventListener("storage", fetchLogo);
    window.addEventListener("erp-offline-queue-updated", updateQueueStatus);
    window.addEventListener("online", handleOnline);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-logo-updated", fetchLogo);
      window.removeEventListener("storage", fetchLogo);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-offline-queue-updated", updateQueueStatus);
      window.removeEventListener("online", handleOnline);
      window.removeEventListener("offline", handleOffline);
    };
  }, [schoolCode, tenant?.logoUrl]);

  const handleManualSync = async () => {
    if (!isOnline) return;

  return (
```

```javascript
              .replace(/^(class:|batch:|specific:)/i, "")

                resolvedClass.includes(targetClass) ||
```

```javascript
  const [overallStatus, setOverallStatus] = useState("idle"); // 'idle' | 'running' | 'passed' | 'warning'

    // --- TEST 2: 2-TIER AUTH MAPPER CHECK ---

      ];

        }
      });

      const emailSample = buildStandardErpEmail("APEX-INT", "STU-1024");
      if (allCorrect && emailSample.includes("apex-int.stu-1024")) {

        t2Details = `100% deterministic Tier-2 prefix routing (HOD, PRIN, ACC, TCH, STU) verified.`;
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";

const DEFAULT_GALLERY_PHOTOS = [];

const CATEGORIES = [
  "ALL",
  "SPORTS",
  "ACADEMICS",
  "CULTURAL EVENTS",
  "SCIENCE & TECH",
  "COMMUNITY",
];

const CATEGORY_COLORS = {
  SPORTS: "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30",
  ACADEMICS: "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30",
  "CULTURAL EVENTS": "bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30",
  "SCIENCE & TECH": "bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400 border-cyan-500/30",
  COMMUNITY: "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30",
};

export default function StudentGallery() {
  const { user, tenant } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const activeSchoolId = user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || tenant?.code || "CAMPUS-01";
  const userRole = (user?.role || "").toLowerCase();
  const canUpload = ["teacher", "principal", "trustee", "admin"].includes(userRole);

  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState([]);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState("ALL");
  const [isUploadModalOpen, setIsUploadModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [previewPhoto, setPreviewPhoto] = useState(null);

  // Upload Form State
  const [formCategory, setFormCategory] = useState("SPORTS");
  const [formTitle, setFormTitle] = useState("");
  const [formDate, setFormDate] = useState("October 2026");
  const [formImageUrl, setFormImageUrl] = useState("");
  const [formEmoji, setFormEmoji] = useState("📸");
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  const loadPhotos = () => {
    try {
      const storageKey = `erp_campus_gallery_${activeSchoolId}`;
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (saved) {
        setPhotos(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setPhotos([]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to load campus gallery:", err);
      setPhotos([]);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadPhotos();

    const handleUpdate = () => loadPhotos();
    window.addEventListener("erp-gallery-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("erp-gallery-updated", handleUpdate);
  }, [activeSchoolId]);

  const handleFileSelect = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (!file.type.match("image.*")) {
      showToast("Please choose a valid image file (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp).", "error");
      return;
    }

    // Limit to 5MB
    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
      showToast("Selected image is larger than 5MB. Please choose a smaller file.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      setFormImageUrl(event.target.result);
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleUploadSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!formTitle.trim()) {
      showToast("Please enter a photo event title.", "error");
      return;
    }

    setUploading(true);

    const newPhoto = {
      id: Date.now(),
      title: formTitle.trim(),
      category: formCategory,
      image: formEmoji || "📸",
      imageUrl: formImageUrl || null,
      date: formDate.trim() || "October 2026",
      uploadedBy: user?.name || (userRole ? userRole.toUpperCase() : "Faculty"),
      school_id: activeSchoolId,
    };

    try {
      const storageKey = `erp_campus_gallery_${activeSchoolId}`;
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "[]");
      const updated = [newPhoto, ...existing];
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
      localStorage.setItem("erp_campus_gallery", JSON.stringify(updated));

      // Trigger custom sync event
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-gallery-updated"));

      setPhotos(updated);
      setIsUploadModalOpen(false);
      setFormTitle("");
      setFormImageUrl("");
      setFormEmoji("📸");

      showToast("Photo published to institutional gallery successfully!", "success");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Gallery upload error:", err);
      showToast("Failed to save photo to gallery.", "error");
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredPhotos = photos.filter((p) => {
    if (selectedCategory === "ALL") return true;
    return p.category === selectedCategory;

    <div className="relative text-slate-200 min-h-full pb-10 font-sans">

          </div>

          {canUpload && (

        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-none">

        {/* GALLERY GRID */}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import CreateClassModal from "../Components/CreateClassModal";
import AddStudentModal from "../Components/AddStudentModal";
import AddTeacherModal from "../Components/AddTeacherModal"; // NEW IMPORT

export default function SuperAdminDashboard() {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ students: 0, teachers: 0, classes: 0, revenue: 0 });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [activeModal, setActiveModal] = useState(null); 

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAdminStats();
  }, []);

  const fetchAdminStats = async () => {
    try {
      const [studentRes, teacherRes, classRes, feeRes] = await Promise.all([
        supabase.from('students').select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true }),
        supabase.from('teachers').select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true }),
        supabase.from('classes').select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true }),
        supabase.from('fees').select('amount').eq('status', 'paid')
      ]);

      const totalRevenue = feeRes.data ? feeRes.data.reduce((sum, fee) => sum + Number(fee.amount), 0) : 0;

      setStats({
        students: studentRes.count || 0,
        teachers: teacherRes.count || 0,
        classes: classRes.count || 0,
        revenue: totalRevenue
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error fetching stats:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
```

```javascript
/**
 * Academic OS — Credential Standardization & Role Utilities
 */

/**
 * Standardizes email generation pattern for 2-Tier institutional credentials:
 * [institution_code].[personal_code]@erp-login.com (forced lowercase, trimmed of spaces)
 */
export function buildStandardErpEmail(institutionCode, personalCode) {
  const cleanInst = String(institutionCode || "campus")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, "");
  const cleanRole = String(personalCode || "")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/@.*$/, "") // Strip domain if user accidentally typed an email
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, "");
  return `${cleanInst || "campus"}.${cleanRole || "user"}@erp-login.com`;
}

/**
 * Infers canonical or operational role from Tier-2 Credential Code
 */
export function inferRoleFromCode(code) {
  const upper = String(code || "").toUpperCase();
  if (upper === "MASTER_OWNER" || upper.startsWith("MASTER")) return "master_owner";
  if (upper.startsWith("PRIN")) return "principal";
  if (upper.startsWith("HOD") || upper.startsWith("TR")) return "trustee";
  if (upper.startsWith("ACC")) return "accountant";
  if (upper.startsWith("TCH") || upper.startsWith("FAC")) return "teacher";
  if (upper.startsWith("NON") || upper.startsWith("NTS") || upper.startsWith("STF") || upper.startsWith("STAFF")) return "staff";
  if (upper.startsWith("ADM") || upper.startsWith("SUPER")) return "admin";

  const lower = String(code || "").toLowerCase();
  if (lower === "master_owner") return "master_owner";
  if (lower === "principal" || lower === "prin") return "principal";
  if (lower === "trustee" || lower === "hod") return "trustee";
  if (lower === "accountant" || lower === "acc") return "accountant";
  if (lower === "teacher" || lower === "tch") return "teacher";
  if (lower === "staff" || lower === "non_teaching" || lower === "nts") return "staff";
  if (lower === "admin" || lower === "super_admin") return "admin";
  return "student";
}

/**
 * Unified Canonical Role Normalization Function
 * Maps any role string, alias, or Tier-2 credential code into the project's canonical role set:
 * - TRUSTEE / HOD -> HOD
 * - PRINCIPAL / PRIN -> PRIN
 * - SUPERADMIN / ADMIN / ADM -> PRIN (executive leadership suite)
 * - TEACHER / FACULTY / TCH -> TCH
 * - ACCOUNTANT / ACC -> ACC
 * - NON-TEACHING / STAFF / NTS -> NTS
 * - STUDENT / STU -> STU
 * - MASTER_OWNER -> MASTER_OWNER
 */
export function normalizeRole(role, personalCode = "") {
  const codeStr = String(personalCode || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  const roleStr = String(role || "").trim().toUpperCase();

  // 1. MASTER_OWNER
  if (roleStr === "MASTER_OWNER" || codeStr === "MASTER_OWNER" || roleStr.startsWith("MASTER") || codeStr.startsWith("MASTER")) {
    return "MASTER_OWNER";
  }

  // 2. Map based on personalCode prefix (e.g. HOD-01, PRIN-01, ACC-01, etc.)
  if (codeStr.startsWith("HOD") || codeStr.startsWith("TR-") || codeStr.startsWith("TRUSTEE")) {
    return "HOD";
  }
  if (codeStr.startsWith("PRIN")) {
    return "PRIN";
  }
  if (codeStr.startsWith("ADM") || codeStr.startsWith("SUPER")) {
    return "PRIN";
  }
  if (codeStr.startsWith("ACC")) {
    return "ACC";
  }
  if (codeStr.startsWith("TCH") || codeStr.startsWith("FAC")) {
    return "TCH";
  }
  if (codeStr.startsWith("NON") || codeStr.startsWith("NTS") || codeStr.startsWith("STF") || codeStr.startsWith("STAFF")) {
    return "NTS";
  }

  // 3. Map based on role string
  if (roleStr === "TRUSTEE" || roleStr === "HOD") {
    return "HOD";
  }
  if (roleStr === "PRINCIPAL" || roleStr === "PRIN") {
    return "PRIN";
  }
  if (roleStr === "SUPERADMIN" || roleStr === "SUPER_ADMIN" || roleStr === "ADMIN" || roleStr === "ADM") {
    return "PRIN";
  }
  if (roleStr === "TEACHER" || roleStr === "FACULTY" || roleStr === "TCH" || roleStr === "FAC") {
    return "TCH";
  }
  if (roleStr === "ACCOUNTANT" || roleStr === "ACC") {
    return "ACC";
  }
  if (roleStr === "STAFF" || roleStr === "NON_TEACHING" || roleStr === "NON-TEACHING" || roleStr === "NTS" || roleStr === "STF") {
    return "NTS";
  }
  if (roleStr === "STUDENT" || roleStr === "STU") {
    return "STU";
  }

  // 4. Substring fallback
  if (roleStr.includes("TRUSTEE") || roleStr.includes("HOD")) return "HOD";
  if (roleStr.includes("PRINCIPAL") || roleStr.includes("PRIN")) return "PRIN";
  if (roleStr.includes("SUPERADMIN") || roleStr.includes("ADMIN")) return "PRIN";
  if (roleStr.includes("TEACHER") || roleStr.includes("FACULTY")) return "TCH";
  if (roleStr.includes("ACCOUNTANT")) return "ACC";
  if (roleStr.includes("STAFF") || roleStr.includes("NON")) return "NTS";

  return "STU";
}

/**
 * Maps any role to its corresponding portal route
 */
export function dashboardFor(role) {
  const raw = String(role || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (raw === "master_owner") return "/master-setup";
  if (raw === "admin" || raw === "super_admin") return "/admin/dashboard";
  const canonical = normalizeRole(role);
  if (canonical === "MASTER_OWNER") return "/master-setup";
  if (canonical === "ACC") return "/accountant/dashboard";
  if (canonical === "PRIN") return "/principal/dashboard";
  if (canonical === "HOD") return "/trustee/dashboard";
  if (canonical === "TCH") return "/teacher/dashboard";
  if (canonical === "NTS") return "/staff/dashboard";
  return "/student/dashboard";
}
```

```javascript
/**
 * Auto-Increment 2-Tier ID Generator for Multi-Tenant School ERP
 * Calculates sequential Tier-2 Personal IDs based on active directory and existing records.
 * 
 * - Students: Sequential IDs starting at STU-101 (e.g. STU-101, STU-102, etc.).
 * - Teachers: Sequential faculty IDs starting at TCH-01 (e.g. TCH-01, TCH-02, etc.).
 */

export function getNextMemberId(role = "student", directory = [], existingMembers = []) {
  const r = (role || "").toLowerCase();
  let prefix = "STU";
  let maxNum = 100;

  if (r === "teacher" || r === "faculty" || r === "tch") {
    prefix = "TCH";
    maxNum = 0;
  } else if (r === "accountant" || r === "acc") {
    prefix = "ACC";
    maxNum = 0;
  } else if (r === "nts" || r === "non_teaching" || r === "non-teaching") {
    prefix = "NTS";
    maxNum = 100;
  } else if (r === "staff" || r === "support") {
    prefix = "NON";
    maxNum = 0;
  } else if (r === "principal" || r === "prin") {
    prefix = "PRIN";
    maxNum = 0;
  } else if (r === "trustee" || r === "hod") {
    prefix = "HOD";
    maxNum = 0;
  }

  // Combine all known records
  const allItems = [...(directory || []), ...(existingMembers || [])];

  // Also check browser localStorage if accessible for additional cross-directory coverage
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.localStorage) {
    try {
      // Scan registered schools master admins (e.g. HOD-01, PRIN-01)
      const rawSchools = window.localStorage.getItem("erp_registered_schools");
      if (rawSchools) {
        const schools = JSON.parse(rawSchools);
        if (Array.isArray(schools)) {
          schools.forEach((s) => {
            if (s && s.adminId) {
              allItems.push({ role_code: s.adminId });
            }
          });
        }
      }

      // Scan current session user
      const rawSession = window.localStorage.getItem("erp_session_user");
      if (rawSession) {
        const sess = JSON.parse(rawSession);
        if (sess) {
          allItems.push({
            role_code: sess.role_code || sess.roll_number || sess.personal_code || sess.id,
          });
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Ignore localStorage access errors
    }
  }

  const idPattern = new RegExp(`^${prefix}[-_](\\d+)`, "i");

  allItems.forEach((item) => {
    if (!item) return;
    const rawCode = (
      item.role_code ||
      item.roll_number ||
      item.personal_code ||
      item.customId ||
      item.adminId ||
      item.id ||
      ""
    ).toString().toUpperCase().trim();

    const match = rawCode.match(idPattern);
    if (match && match[1]) {
      const parsed = parseInt(match[1], 10);
      if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed > maxNum) {
        maxNum = parsed;
      }
    }
  });

  const nextNum = maxNum + 1;
  if (prefix === "STU" || prefix === "NTS") {
    // Format STU-101, NTS-101 ...
    return `${prefix}-${nextNum}`;
  } else {
    // Format TCH-01, ACC-01, NON-01, PRIN-01, HOD-01 ...
    return `${prefix}-${String(nextNum).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  }
}

 * Returns empty array for brand new institutions (no hardcoded mock users).
 */
export function getDefaultSchoolDirectory(schoolId = "") {
  return [];
}
```
