import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertCircle, Clock, ShieldAlert, ArrowRight, FileText, User, Lock } from "lucide-react";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";

export default function OperationalApprovalInbox({ schoolCode = "CAMPUS-01" }) {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const [approvalItems, setApprovalItems] = useState([]);
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState("all");
  const [processingId, setProcessingId] = useState(null);

  const cleanSchool = schoolCode.toUpperCase();

  useEffect(() => {
    loadApprovalItems();

    const handleUpdate = () => loadApprovalItems();
    window.addEventListener("erp-staff-leaves-updated", handleUpdate);
    window.addEventListener("erp-fee-reversals-updated", handleUpdate);
    window.addEventListener("erp-certificate-updated", handleUpdate);
    window.addEventListener("erp-grievances-updated", handleUpdate);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-staff-leaves-updated", handleUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-fee-reversals-updated", handleUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-certificate-updated", handleUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-grievances-updated", handleUpdate);
    };
  }, [cleanSchool]);

  const loadApprovalItems = async () => {
    const combined = [];

    // 1. Pending Staff Leaves
    try {
      const leavesRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_staff_leaves_${cleanSchool}`);
      const leaves = leavesRaw ? JSON.parse(leavesRaw) : [];
      leaves
        .filter((l) => (l.status || "").toLowerCase() === "pending")
        .forEach((l) => {
          combined.push({
            id: l.id,
            category: "LEAVE",
            title: `Staff Leave: ${l.applicantName || "Staff Member"}`,
            subtitle: `${l.leaveType} (${l.durationDays || 1} Day/s) • Reason: ${l.reason || "Personal"}`,
            requestedBy: l.applicantName || "Faculty/Staff",
            role: l.applicantRole || "Teacher",
            timestamp: l.appliedAt || l.created_at || "Recent",
            original: l,
          });
        });
    } catch {}

    // 2. Accountant Fee Reversal Requests (Maker-Checker)
    try {
      if (supabase) {
        try {
          const { data: dbReversals, error: dbRevErr } = await supabase
            .from("fee_reversal_requests")
            .select("*, fee_ledger ( student_name, class_name )")
            .eq("school_id", cleanSchool)
            .eq("status", "pending_approval")
            .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

          if (!dbRevErr && Array.isArray(dbReversals)) {
            dbReversals.forEach((r) => {
              combined.push({
                id: r.id,
                category: "REVERSAL",
                title: `Fee Reversal / Credit Note: ₹${Number(r.amount).toLocaleString()}`,
                subtitle: `Student: ${r.fee_ledger?.student_name || "Enrolled Scholar"} • Reason: ${r.reason}`,
                requestedBy: r.requester_name || "Accountant",
                role: r.requester_role || "Accountant",
                timestamp: r.created_at ? new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleDateString() : "Recent",
                original: {
                  ...r,
                  receiptId: r.entry_id,
                  studentName: r.fee_ledger?.student_name,
                  className: r.fee_ledger?.class_name,
                },
                isDbRecord: true,
              });
            });
          }
        } catch (revQueryErr) {
          console.warn("[ApprovalInbox] Supabase reversal query notice:", revQueryErr);
        }
      }

      // Merge local storage for offline tolerance (avoid duplicates)
      const existingDbIds = new Set(combined.map((c) => c.id));
      const reversalsRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_fee_reversals_${cleanSchool}`);
      const reversals = reversalsRaw ? JSON.parse(reversalsRaw) : [];
      reversals
        .filter((r) => (r.status || "").toLowerCase() === "pending_approval" && !existingDbIds.has(r.id))
        .forEach((r) => {
          combined.push({
            id: r.id,
            category: "REVERSAL",
            title: `Fee Reversal / Credit Note: ₹${Number(r.amount).toLocaleString()}`,
            subtitle: `Student: ${r.studentName} (${r.rollNumber || "ID"}) • Reason: ${r.reason}`,
            requestedBy: r.makerName || "Accountant",
            role: "Accountant",
            timestamp: r.requestedAt || "Recent",
            original: r,
            isDbRecord: false,
          });
        });
    } catch {}

    // 3. Pending Student Certificate Requests
    try {
      const certsRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_certificate_requests_${cleanSchool}`);
      const certs = certsRaw ? JSON.parse(certsRaw) : [];
      certs
        .filter((c) => (c.status || "").toUpperCase() === "PENDING")
        .forEach((c) => {
          combined.push({
            id: c.id,
            category: "CERTIFICATE",
            title: `Issue Certificate: ${c.certificate_type}`,
            subtitle: `Student: ${c.student_name} (${c.roll_number}) • Purpose: ${c.reason}`,
            requestedBy: c.student_name,
            role: "Student",
            timestamp: c.request_date || "Recent",
            original: c,
          });
        });
    } catch {}

    setApprovalItems(combined);
  };

  const handleApprove = async (item) => {
    if (processingId) return;
    setProcessingId(item.id);
    try {
      if (item.category === "LEAVE") {
        const leavesRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_staff_leaves_${cleanSchool}`);
        const leaves = leavesRaw ? JSON.parse(leavesRaw) : [];
        const updated = leaves.map((l) => (l.id === item.id ? { ...l, status: "Approved" } : l));
        localStorage.setItem(`erp_staff_leaves_${cleanSchool}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-staff-leaves-updated"));
        showToast(`Approved leave application for ${item.requestedBy}`, "success");
      } else if (item.category === "REVERSAL") {
        // Maker-Checker Fee Reversal Approval with Database Pessimistic Row Lock
        const uuidRegex = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
        if (!supabase) {
          showToast("Database connection unavailable. Reversal requires server-side pessimistic lock.", "error");
          return;
        }

        let rpcRes = null;
        if (item.isDbRecord && uuidRegex.test(String(item.id))) {
          // Dedicated Maker-Checker Approval RPC (PostgreSQL verifies caller is NOT the maker)
          rpcRes = await supabase.rpc("approve_fee_reversal", {
            p_request_id: item.id,
            p_notes: item.original.reason || "Maker-Checker Principal Approval",
          });
        } else {
          // Direct Entry Reversal RPC (PostgreSQL verifies caller has executive role & derives approver from auth.uid())
          const targetEntryId = item.original.receiptId || item.id;
          if (!targetEntryId || !uuidRegex.test(String(targetEntryId))) {
            showToast("Reversal rejected: Invalid transaction reference UUID. Cannot apply server row-lock.", "error");
            return;
          }

          rpcRes = await supabase.rpc("reverse_fee_entry", {
            p_entry_id: String(targetEntryId),
            p_reason: item.original.reason || "Maker-Checker Principal Approval",
            p_idempotency_key: `REV-${targetEntryId}`,
          });
        }

        const { data, error } = rpcRes || {};

        if (error) {
          console.error("Pessimistic lock RPC error:", error);
          showToast(`Reversal failed: ${error.message || "Database rejected reversal"}`, "error");
          return;
        }

        if (!data || !data.success) {
          const errMsg = data?.error || data?.message || "Fee entry already reversed or locked.";
          showToast(`Reversal rejected: ${errMsg}`, "error");
          return;
        }

        const revRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_fee_reversals_${cleanSchool}`);
        const reversals = revRaw ? JSON.parse(revRaw) : [];
        const updatedRev = reversals.map((r) =>
          r.id === item.id ? { ...r, status: "Approved", approvedAt: new Date().toISOString() } : r
        );
        localStorage.setItem(`erp_fee_reversals_${cleanSchool}`, JSON.stringify(updatedRev));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-fee-reversals-updated"));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-fee-ledger-updated"));

        showToast(
          `Reversal approved! Database pessimistic row-lock executed & Credit Note generated in fee ledger.`,
          "success"
        );
      } else if (item.category === "CERTIFICATE") {
        const certsRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_certificate_requests_${cleanSchool}`);
        const certs = certsRaw ? JSON.parse(certsRaw) : [];
        const updated = certs.map((c) => (c.id === item.id ? { ...c, status: "ISSUED" } : c));
        localStorage.setItem(`erp_certificate_requests_${cleanSchool}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-certificate-updated"));
        showToast(`Certificate "${item.original.certificate_type}" officially issued.`, "success");
      }

      loadApprovalItems();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Approval error:", err);
      showToast("Error processing approval", "error");
    } finally {
      setProcessingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleReject = async (item) => {
    try {
      if (item.category === "LEAVE") {
        const leavesRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_staff_leaves_${cleanSchool}`);
        const leaves = leavesRaw ? JSON.parse(leavesRaw) : [];
        const updated = leaves.map((l) => (l.id === item.id ? { ...l, status: "Rejected" } : l));
        localStorage.setItem(`erp_staff_leaves_${cleanSchool}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-staff-leaves-updated"));
      } else if (item.category === "REVERSAL") {
        if (supabase && item.isDbRecord) {
          try {
            await supabase.rpc("reject_fee_reversal", {
              p_request_id: item.id,
              p_rejection_reason: "Rejected by Principal",
            });
          } catch (rejErr) {
            console.warn("[ApprovalInbox] Reject RPC notice:", rejErr);
          }
        }
        const revRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_fee_reversals_${cleanSchool}`);
        const reversals = revRaw ? JSON.parse(revRaw) : [];
        const updated = reversals.map((r) => (r.id === item.id ? { ...r, status: "Rejected" } : r));
        localStorage.setItem(`erp_fee_reversals_${cleanSchool}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-fee-reversals-updated"));
      } else if (item.category === "CERTIFICATE") {
        const certsRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_certificate_requests_${cleanSchool}`);
        const certs = certsRaw ? JSON.parse(certsRaw) : [];
        const updated = certs.map((c) => (c.id === item.id ? { ...c, status: "REJECTED" } : c));
        localStorage.setItem(`erp_certificate_requests_${cleanSchool}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-certificate-updated"));
      }

      showToast(`Item rejected and sender notified.`, "info");
      loadApprovalItems();
    } catch (e) {
      showToast("Error rejecting item", "error");
    }
  };

  const filteredItems = approvalItems.filter((item) => {
    if (filterType === "all") return true;
    return item.category === filterType;
  });

  return (
    <div className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-[#131A2B] backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/90 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm dark:shadow-2xl space-y-4 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/90 pb-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-50 text-cyan-700 border border-cyan-200 dark:bg-cyan-500/20 dark:text-cyan-300 dark:border-cyan-400/30">
              Maker-Checker Gate
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-200 font-mono">Tenant: {cleanSchool}</span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white mt-1 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span>Unified Operational Approval Inbox</span>
            <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/30 font-bold">
              {approvalItems.length} Pending Actions
            </span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-200 mt-0.5">
            Single queue for Principal sign-off: Staff Leaves, Accountant Credit Notes, and Official Certificates.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
          {["all", "LEAVE", "REVERSAL", "CERTIFICATE"].map((cat) => (
            <button
              key={cat}
              onClick={() => setFilterType(cat)}
              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                filterType === cat
                  ? "bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 shadow-md shadow-cyan-500/20"
                  : "bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-600 dark:bg-[#0A0E1A] dark:text-slate-300 dark:border dark:border-slate-800/90 dark:hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              {cat === "all" ? "All Queue" : cat}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {filteredItems.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="py-10 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-10 h-10 text-emerald-500 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-80" />
          <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">All Clear! No Operational Approvals Pending</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300 mt-1 max-w-sm mx-auto">
            Staff leaves, accountant financial adjustments, and scholar document requests will appear here for 1-click executive decision.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2.5">
          {filteredItems.map((item) => (
            <div
              key={`${item.category}_${item.id}`}
              className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-[#0A0E1A] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/90 hover:border-cyan-400 dark:hover:border-cyan-500/30 transition-all flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-xs"
            >
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span
                    className={`text-[9px] uppercase font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                      item.category === "REVERSAL"
                        ? "bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/20 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/30"
                        : item.category === "LEAVE"
                        ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/20 dark:text-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/30"
                        : "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/20 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-500/30"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {item.category}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">{item.timestamp}</span>
                </div>
                <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{item.title}</h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">{item.subtitle}</p>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  <User className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" />
                  <span>Requester: {item.requestedBy} ({item.role})</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 self-end sm:self-center">
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleApprove(item)}
                  disabled={Boolean(processingId)}
                  className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 text-white text-xs font-black transition-all flex items-center gap-1 shadow-md shadow-emerald-900/30 ${
                    processingId === item.id
                      ? "opacity-50 cursor-wait"
                      : processingId
                      ? "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed"
                      : "hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-500 cursor-pointer hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                  }`}
                >
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{processingId === item.id ? "Processing..." : "Approve"}</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleReject(item)}
                  disabled={Boolean(processingId)}
                  className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-600/20 dark:border-rose-500/40 dark:text-rose-300 text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1 ${
                    processingId
                      ? "opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed"
                      : "hover:bg-rose-100 dark:hover:bg-rose-600/30 cursor-pointer hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                  }`}
                >
                  <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Reject</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useContext } from "react";
import { useNavigate, Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { logSecurityAction, AUDIT_ACTIONS } from "../utils/auditLogger";
import { buildStandardErpEmail } from "./Login";
import BrandLogo from "../Components/BrandLogo";
import { getDefaultSchoolDirectory } from "../utils/idGenerator";

export default function RegisterInstitution() {
  const { login } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [successData, setSuccessData] = useState(null);

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    institutionName: "",
    institutionCode: "",
    adminName: "",
    email: "",
    phone: "",
    password: "",
  });

  const handleNameChange = (name) => {
    // Auto-generate suggested code from name if user hasn't explicitly customized it
    const suggestedCode = name
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase()
      .replace(/[^A-Z0-9\s]/g, "")
      .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
      .slice(0, 16);

    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      institutionName: name,
      institutionCode: prev.institutionCodeManual ? prev.institutionCode : suggestedCode,
    }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!formData.institutionName || !formData.institutionCode || !formData.adminName || !formData.email || !formData.password) {
      showToast("Please fill in all mandatory institutional fields.", "error");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    const cleanCode = formData.institutionCode.trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9-]/g, "");

    try {
      // 1. Insert new school record into Supabase schools table
      const schoolPayload = {
        name: formData.institutionName.trim(),
        code: cleanCode,
        contact_email: formData.email.trim(),
        phone: formData.phone.trim(),
        brand_color: "#3B82F6",
      };

      let createdSchool = null;
      try {
        const { data: schoolData, error: schoolErr } = await supabase
          .from("schools")
          .insert([schoolPayload])
          .select("id, code, name")
          .single();

        if (!schoolErr && schoolData) {
          createdSchool = schoolData;
        } else if (schoolErr?.message?.includes("duplicate")) {
          // School code already taken; fetch existing
          const { data: existingSchool } = await supabase
            .from("schools")
            .select("id, code, name")
            .eq("code", cleanCode)
            .single();
          createdSchool = existingSchool;
        }
      } catch (dbErr) {
        console.warn("Notice inserting school into DB:", dbErr);
      }

      const schoolId = createdSchool?.id || `school-${Date.now().toString(36)}`;

      // 2. Register live Supabase Auth account if possible
      let authUser = null;
      try {
        const { data: authData, error: authErr } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
          email: formData.email.trim(),
          password: formData.password,
          options: {
            data: {
              full_name: formData.adminName.trim(),
              role: "trustee",
              role_code: "HOD-01",
              institution_code: cleanCode,
            },
          },
        });
        if (!authErr && authData?.user) {
          authUser = authData.user;
        }
      } catch (authException) {
        console.warn("Supabase Auth sign-up notice:", authException);
      }

      // 3. Provision master HOD entry in profiles table
      try {
        await supabase.from("profiles").insert([
          {
            id: authUser?.id || undefined,
            full_name: formData.adminName.trim(),
            role: "trustee",
            role_code: "HOD-01",
            school_id: schoolId,
          },
        ]);
      } catch (profErr) {
        console.warn("Profile table sync notice:", profErr);
      }

      // 4. Construct active session payload with standardized login email for HOD-01
      const mappedEmail = buildStandardErpEmail(cleanCode, "HOD-01");
      const registeredHod = {
        id: authUser?.id || `hod-${Date.now()}`,
        name: formData.adminName.trim(),
        email: mappedEmail,
        role: "trustee",
        role_code: "HOD-01",
        personal_code: "HOD-01",
        school_id: schoolId,
        institution_code: cleanCode,
        institution_name: formData.institutionName.trim(),
      };

      // Set active tenant and sync HOD + default members to local directory
      localStorage.setItem("erp_active_tenant", cleanCode);
      try {
        const defaultMembers = getDefaultSchoolDirectory(cleanCode);
        const existingDir = [
          {
            full_name: formData.adminName.trim(),
            role: "trustee",
            role_code: "HOD-01",
            roll_number: "HOD-01",
            personal_code: "HOD-01",
            school_id: cleanCode,
            email: mappedEmail,
          },
          ...defaultMembers,
        ];
        localStorage.setItem(`erp_directory_${cleanCode}`, JSON.stringify(existingDir));
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-directory-updated"));
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Local directory cache update notice:", e);
      }

      // 5. Audit Log
      logSecurityAction({
        action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.TENANT_SWITCH,
        entityType: "SCHOOL",
        entityId: cleanCode,
        details: `Self-service onboarding: Registered "${formData.institutionName}" (${cleanCode}) with Master HOD ${formData.adminName}`,
        user: registeredHod,
        schoolId: schoolId,
      });

      // Auto-establish session immediately
      if (typeof login === "function") {
        login(registeredHod);
      }
      localStorage.setItem("erp_session_user", JSON.stringify(registeredHod));

      setSuccessData({
        ...registeredHod,
        password: formData.password,
      });

      showToast(`School "${formData.institutionName}" registered successfully! Master HOD account activated.`, "success");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Institution registration error:", err);
      showToast(err.message || "Failed to register institution. Please verify connectivity and parameters.", "error");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleLaunchDashboard = () => {

  return (

      <div className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-xl">
        {/* BRAND LOGO HEADER */}
        <div className="text-center mb-8">

            <BrandLogo size="lg" className="shadow-xl shadow-indigo-600/30" />
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/20 inline-block mb-2">
            Multi-Tenant SaaS Onboarding
          </span>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-white tracking-tight">
            Register Your Institution
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1 max-w-md mx-auto">

          </p>
        </div>

        {/* REGISTRATION FORM OR SUCCESS MODAL */}
        <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-700/60 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-2xl">
          {successData ? (
            /* SUCCESS ONBOARDING PROVISION SCREEN */
            <div className="space-y-6 text-center py-4">
              <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-3xl mx-auto shadow-xl shadow-emerald-500/20 animate-bounce">
                🎉

              <div className="bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-5 text-left space-y-3 font-mono text-xs">

                    placeholder="••••••••••••"
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950/60 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl pl-12 pr-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 transition-all text-sm"
                    value={formData.password}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, password: e.target.value })}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* SUBMIT BUTTON */}
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={loading}
                className="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 via-indigo-600 to-purple-600 hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-purple-500 text-white font-black py-4 px-4 rounded-xl shadow-xl shadow-blue-600/30 disabled:opacity-50 transition-all mt-4 border border-blue-400/30 text-sm cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              >
                {loading ? (
                  <>
                    <div className="w-5 h-5 border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
                    <span>Provisioning School Partition...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <span>Register & Activate Campus Cloud 🚀</span>
                )}
              </button>

              <div className="text-center pt-2">
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">
                  Already have an institutional code?{" "}
                  <Link to="/login" className="text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 font-bold transition-colors">
                    Sign in to Portal →
                  </Link>
                </p>
              </div>
            </form>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { logSecurityAction } from "../utils/auditLogger";
import QRScannerModule from "../Components/QRScannerModule";

export default function StaffDashboard() {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const schoolId = user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";
  const staffId = user?.personal_code || user?.role_code || "NON-01";
  const staffName = user?.name || user?.full_name || "Support Staff Member";

  const [clockedIn, setClockedIn] = useState(false);
  const [clockTime, setClockTime] = useState(null);
  const [myProfile, setMyProfile] = useState(null);
  const [myLeaves, setMyLeaves] = useState([]);
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("roster"); // 'roster' | 'leaves' | 'contacts'

  // Leave Form
  const [leaveForm, setLeaveForm] = useState({
    leaveType: "Casual Leave",
    startDate: "",
    endDate: "",
    reason: "",
  });
  const [showLeaveModal, setShowLeaveModal] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // 1. Load staff profile from non-teaching registry
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_non_teaching_staff_${schoolId}`);
      if (raw) {
        const list = JSON.parse(raw);
        const match = list.find(
          (s) =>
            s.fullName?.toLowerCase() === staffName.toLowerCase() ||
            s.id === user?.id ||
            s.phone === user?.phone
        );
        if (match) {
          setMyProfile(match);
        } else {
          setMyProfile({
            fullName: staffName,
            category: "Campus Operations Personnel",
            shiftTiming: "General Shift (08:00 AM - 05:00 PM)",
            phone: user?.phone || "+91 98200 00000",
            salary: "₹18,000",
            status: "Active Duty",
          });
        }
      } else {
        setMyProfile({
          fullName: staffName,
          category: "Campus Operations Personnel",
          shiftTiming: "General Shift (08:00 AM - 05:00 PM)",
          phone: user?.phone || "+91 98200 00000",
          salary: "₹18,000",
          status: "Active Duty",
        });
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // 2. Check today's clock-in state
    try {
      const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
      const savedClock = localStorage.getItem(`erp_clockin_${schoolId}_${staffId}_${today}`);
      if (savedClock) {
        setClockedIn(true);
        setClockTime(savedClock);
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    // 3. Load leave requests for this staff
    try {
      const rawLeaves = localStorage.getItem(`erp_leave_requests_${schoolId}`);
      if (rawLeaves) {
        const allLeaves = JSON.parse(rawLeaves);
        setMyLeaves(
          allLeaves.filter(
            (l) =>
              l.staffId === staffId ||
              l.applicantName?.toLowerCase() === staffName.toLowerCase()
          )
        );
      } else {
        setMyLeaves([]);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setMyLeaves([]);
    }
  }, [schoolId, staffId, staffName]);

  const handleClockIn = () => {
    const nowTime = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
    const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
    setClockedIn(true);
    setClockTime(nowTime);

    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_clockin_${schoolId}_${staffId}_${today}`, nowTime);
      const attKey = `erp_staff_attendance_${schoolId}`;
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(attKey) || "[]");
      existing.unshift({
        staffId,
        staffName,
        date: today,
        time: nowTime,
        status: "Present / On Duty",
      });
      localStorage.setItem(attKey, JSON.stringify(existing));
    } catch (e) {}

    logSecurityAction({
      action: "Staff Duty Clock-In Logged",
      entityType: "ATTENDANCE",
      entityId: staffId,
      details: `${staffName} (${staffId}) clocked in at ${nowTime}`,
      user,
      schoolId,
    });

      return;
    }

      id: `leave_${Date.now()}`,
      schoolId,
      staffId,
      applicantName: staffName,
      category: myProfile?.category || "Non-Teaching Staff",
      leaveType: leaveForm.leaveType,
      startDate: leaveForm.startDate,
      endDate: leaveForm.endDate,
      reason: leaveForm.reason.trim(),
      status: "Pending Principal Review",
      appliedOn: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    };

      const key = `erp_leave_requests_${schoolId}`;

      all.unshift(newRequest);

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-leaves-updated"));
      setMyLeaves([newRequest, ...myLeaves]);

import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import CertificateManagementCard from "../Components/CertificateManagementCard";

const WEEKDAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"];

export default function TeacherClasses() {
  const { user, tenant } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const activeSchoolId = (
    user?.institution_code ||
    user?.school_id ||
    tenant?.code ||
    "CAMPUS-01"
  )
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase();

  const [classesList, setClassesList] = useState([]);
  const [schedule, setSchedule] = useState([]);
  const [activeDay, setActiveDay] = useState("Monday");
  const [selectedRosterClass, setSelectedRosterClass] = useState(null);
  const [rosterSearch, setRosterSearch] = useState("");
  const [rosterStudents, setRosterStudents] = useState([]);

  // Calculate assigned classroom batches dynamically (Zero mock batches)
  const calculateBatches = () => {
    let localDir = [];
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${activeSchoolId}`);
      if (raw) localDir = JSON.parse(raw);
    } catch (e) {}

    let timetable = [];
    try {
      const rawTt = localStorage.getItem(`erp_master_timetable_${activeSchoolId}`);
      if (rawTt) timetable = JSON.parse(rawTt);
    } catch (e) {}

    const teacherName = (user?.name || user?.full_name || "").toLowerCase().trim();
    const teacherCode = (user?.personal_code || user?.role_code || "").toLowerCase().trim();

    // Find all distinct classes explicitly assigned to this faculty member
    const assignedClassNames = new Set();

    // 1. Check user profile assigned_classes or class_name
    if (user?.assigned_classes) {
      const arr = Array.isArray(user.assigned_classes)
        ? user.assigned_classes
        : String(user.assigned_classes).split(",");
      arr.forEach((c) => c.trim() && assignedClassNames.add(c.trim()));
    }
    if (user?.class_name && user.class_name !== "Faculty") {
      assignedClassNames.add(user.class_name.trim());
    }

    // 2. Check master timetable periods where teacher matches
    timetable.forEach((item) => {
      const t = (item.teacher || "").toLowerCase();
      if ((teacherName && t.includes(teacherName)) || (teacherCode && t.includes(teacherCode))) {
        if (item.className) assignedClassNames.add(item.className.trim());
      }
    });

    // 3. Check directory member record for this teacher
    const currentInDir = localDir.find(
      (m) =>
        (m.role_code && m.role_code.toLowerCase() === teacherCode) ||
        (m.name && m.name.toLowerCase() === teacherName)
    );
    if (currentInDir?.assigned_classes) {
      const arr = Array.isArray(currentInDir.assigned_classes)
        ? currentInDir.assigned_classes
        : String(currentInDir.assigned_classes).split(",");
      arr.forEach((c) => c.trim() && assignedClassNames.add(c.trim()));
    }

    const normalize = (b) =>
      (b || "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .replace(/class\s*/i, "")
        .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");

    const dynamicBatches = Array.from(assignedClassNames).map((className, idx) => {
      const target = normalize(className);
      const count = localDir.filter((item) => {
        if ((item.role || "student").toLowerCase() !== "student") return false;
        const sNorm = normalize(item.class_name || item.class);
        return sNorm === target || sNorm.includes(target) || target.includes(sNorm);
      }).length;

      const ttSlot = timetable.find((t) => normalize(t.className) === target);

      return {
        id: idx + 1,
        name: className,
        subject: ttSlot?.subject || user?.subject || "Core Curriculum",
        timing: ttSlot?.timeWindow || "Assigned Period",
        room: ttSlot?.room || "Room 101",
        strength: count,
      };
    });

    setClassesList(dynamicBatches);
  };

  // Load master timetable schedule from localStorage
  const loadTimetable = () => {
    try {
      const rawTt = localStorage.getItem(`erp_master_timetable_${activeSchoolId}`);
      if (rawTt) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(rawTt);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
          setSchedule(parsed);
          return;
        }
      }
      setSchedule([]);
    } catch (e) {
      setSchedule([]);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    calculateBatches();
    loadTimetable();

    const handleUpdate = () => {
      calculateBatches();
      loadTimetable();
    };

    window.addEventListener("erp-directory-updated", handleUpdate);
    window.addEventListener("erp-timetable-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-directory-updated", handleUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-timetable-updated", handleUpdate);
    };
  }, [activeSchoolId, user]);

  // Load students for active roster batch from local directory
  const openRosterDrawer = (cls) => {
    setSelectedRosterClass(cls);
    setRosterSearch("");

    try {
      let localDir = [];
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${activeSchoolId}`);
      if (raw) {
        localDir = JSON.parse(raw);
      }

      const normalize = (b) =>
        (b || "")
          .toLowerCase()
          .replace(/class\s*/i, "")
          .replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "");
      const target = normalize(cls.name);

      const filtered = localDir
        .filter((item) => (item.role || "student").toLowerCase() === "student")
        .filter((item) => {
          const itemNorm = normalize(item.class_name || item.class);
          return itemNorm === target || itemNorm.includes(target) || target.includes(itemNorm);
        });

      setRosterStudents(filtered);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Roster load error:", err);
      setRosterStudents([]);
    }
  };

  const filteredRoster = rosterStudents.filter((s) => {
    const q = rosterSearch.toLowerCase();
    const name = (s.full_name || s.name || "").toLowerCase();
    const roll = (s.roll_number || s.personal_code || "").toLowerCase();
    return name.includes(q) || roll.includes(q);
  });

  const daySchedule = schedule.filter((item) => item.day === activeDay);

  return (
    <div className="relative text-slate-200 min-h-full pb-10 font-sans">
      <div className="fixed top-0 right-10 w-96 h-96 bg-blue-600/10 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none"></div>

      <div className="relative z-10 max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-10">
        {/* HEADER */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-blue-300 text-sm font-semibold mb-1 uppercase tracking-widest">Faculty Portal</p>
            <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-white">Classrooms & Master Timetable 👨‍🏫</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">Review assigned batches, inspect live student rosters, and view weekly period schedules</p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-700/80 px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl text-xs font-mono text-blue-300">
            Node: <strong>{activeSchoolId}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ASSIGNED CLASSROOM BATCHES GRID */}
        <div>
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
              <span>🏫</span> Assigned Classroom Batches ({classesList.length})
            </h2>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">Rosters sync in real-time with directory</span>
          </div>

          {classesList.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-10 text-center bg-[#1E293B]/70 border border-slate-700/60 rounded-3xl text-slate-400 space-y-2">
              <div className="text-4xl opacity-60">🏫</div>
              <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-white">No classes assigned to your faculty ID yet. Ask your HOD to assign batches.</h4>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
                When an administrator assigns classes to your faculty profile or configures the master timetable, your assigned batches and student rosters will appear here.
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5">
              {classesList.map((cls) => (
                <div
                  key={cls.id}
                  className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl flex flex-col justify-between group hover:border-blue-500/50 hover:bg-white/[0.08] transition-all"
                >
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
                      <span className="bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30 px-3 py-1 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider">
                        {cls.room}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400">Active</span>
                    </div>
                    <h3 className="text-2xl font-black text-white mb-1 group-hover:text-blue-300 transition-colors">
                      {cls.name}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-blue-300 text-xs font-semibold mb-3">{cls.subject}</p>

                    <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-3 border-t border-slate-800/80 text-xs text-slate-300">
                      <p className="flex justify-between">

                        <strong className="text-white">{cls.strength} Students</strong>
                      </p>
                      <p className="flex justify-between">
                        <span className="text-slate-400">Daily Slot:</span>
                        <span className="font-mono text-amber-300">{cls.timing}</span>
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => openRosterDrawer(cls)}
                    className="mt-6 w-full bg-slate-800 hover:bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl transition-all border border-slate-700 hover:border-blue-500 text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <span>👥</span> View Student Roster
                  </button>

              ))}

        </div>

        {/* WEEKLY MASTER TIMETABLE & CLASS SCHEDULE GRID */}
        <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">

import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { resolveSchoolUuid } from "../utils/supabaseHelpers";

  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState("homework"); // 'homework' or 'quiz'

  // Homework state
  const [classes, setClasses] = useState([]);
  const [homeworkList, setHomeworkList] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [hwCompletions, setHwCompletions] = useState({});
  const [verifyingHw, setVerifyingHw] = useState(null); // when open modal for student verification
  const [enrolledStudents, setEnrolledStudents] = useState([]);

  const activeSchool = (user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();

  const loadHwCompletions = () => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(`erp_hw_completion_${activeSchool}`);
      if (saved) {
        setHwCompletions(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setHwCompletions({});
      }
    } catch {
      setHwCompletions({});
    }

    try {
      const rawDir = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${activeSchool}`);
      if (rawDir) {
        const list = JSON.parse(rawDir);
        setEnrolledStudents(list.filter((m) => (m.role || "").toLowerCase() === "student"));
      } else {
        setEnrolledStudents([]);
      }
    } catch {
      setEnrolledStudents([]);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleVerification = (hwId, hwTitle) => {
    const isCurrentlyDone = Boolean(
      hwCompletions[hwId] === true ||
      (typeof hwCompletions[hwId] === "object" && hwCompletions[hwId]?.all === true)
    );

    const nextState = !isCurrentlyDone;
    const updated = {
      ...hwCompletions,
      [hwId]: nextState,
    };

    setHwCompletions(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_hw_completion_${activeSchool}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-homework-verification-updated"));
    } catch (e) {}

    showToast(
      nextState
        ? `Marked "${hwTitle}" as verified completed for all students! ✓`
        : `Reverted "${hwTitle}" to pending verification.`,
      "success"
    );
  };

  const handleToggleStudentVerification = (hwId, studentRoll) => {
    const currentEntry = typeof hwCompletions[hwId] === "object" ? hwCompletions[hwId] : {};
    const currentStudentState = Boolean(currentEntry[studentRoll]);
    const updatedEntry = {
      ...currentEntry,
      [studentRoll]: !currentStudentState,
    };

    const updated = {
      ...hwCompletions,
      [hwId]: updatedEntry,
    };

    setHwCompletions(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_hw_completion_${activeSchool}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-homework-verification-updated"));
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    title: "",
    subject: "",
    description: "",
    due_date: "",
    class_id: "",
  });

  // Quiz Builder state
  const [quizzesList, setQuizzesList] = useState([]);
  const [quizForm, setQuizForm] = useState({
    title: "",
    subject: "Mathematics",
    className: "Class 10 ICSE",
    duration: "15 mins",
  });
  const [draftQuestions, setDraftQuestions] = useState([]);
  const [currQ, setCurrQ] = useState({
    question: "",
    optionA: "",
    optionB: "",
    optionC: "",
    optionD: "",
    correctAnswer: 0,
    explanation: "",
  });

  // Fetch data on page load
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchClasses();
    fetchHomework();
    fetchQuizzes();
    loadHwCompletions();
  }, []);

  const fetchClasses = async () => {
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase.from("classes").select("*");
      if (data) setClasses(data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error fetching classes:", err);
    }
  };

  const fetchHomework = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    const activeSchool = user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";
    try {
      const schoolUuid = await resolveSchoolUuid(activeSchool);
      let query = supabase
        .from("homework")
        .select("*")
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (schoolUuid) {
        query = query.eq("school_id", schoolUuid);
      }

      const { data, error } = await query;

      if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
        setHomeworkList(data);
      } else {
        const local = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`erp_homework_${activeSchool}`) || "[]");
        setHomeworkList(local);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Error fetching homework:", err);
      const local = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`erp_homework_${activeSchool}`) || "[]");
      setHomeworkList(local);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchQuizzes = async () => {
    try {
      const qList = await getQuizzes(user?.school_id || user?.institution_code);
      setQuizzesList(qList || []);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error loading quizzes:", err);
      setQuizzesList([]);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!formData.title || !formData.class_id || !formData.subject) {
      showToast("Please fill in all required assignment details", "error");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    const activeSchool = user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";

    try {
      const schoolUuid = await resolveSchoolUuid(activeSchool);

      const payload = {
        school_id: schoolUuid,
        class_id: formData.class_id,
        teacher_id: user?.id && user.id.length === 36 ? user.id : null,
        title: formData.title.trim(),
        subject: formData.subject.trim(),
        description: formData.description.trim(),
        due_date: formData.due_date,
      };

      if (supabase) {
        const { error: hwErr } = await supabase.from("homework").insert([payload]);
        if (hwErr) {
          console.error("DB homework insert error:", hwErr);
          throw hwErr;
        }
      }

      // Persist to tenant local storage cache
      const local = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`erp_homework_${activeSchool}`) || "[]");
      const newLocalHw = {
        id: `hw_${Date.now()}`,
        ...payload,
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
      const updatedLocal = [newLocalHw, ...local];
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_homework_${activeSchool}`, JSON.stringify(updatedLocal));

      // Log security audit
      logSecurityAction({
        action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.HOMEWORK_PUBLISHED,
        entityType: "HOMEWORK",
        entityId: payload.title,
        details: `Assigned homework "${payload.title}" (${payload.subject}) for class`,
        user,
        schoolId: schoolUuid,
      });

      showToast(`Homework "${formData.title}" assigned successfully!`, "success");
      setFormData({ title: "", subject: "", description: "", due_date: "", class_id: "" });
      fetchHomework();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Database error assigning homework:", error);
      showToast(error.message || "Failed to publish homework assignment to database.", "error");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteHomework = async (id) => {
    const activeSchool = user?.school_id || user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01";
    try {
      if (supabase) {
        const { error: delErr } = await supabase.from("homework").delete().eq("id", id);
        if (delErr) {
          console.error("DB homework delete error:", delErr);
          throw delErr;
        }
      }

      try {
        const local = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`erp_homework_${activeSchool}`) || "[]");
        const updated = local.filter((hw) => hw.id !== id);
        localStorage.setItem(`erp_homework_${activeSchool}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      } catch (e) {}

      setHomeworkList((prev) => prev.filter((hw) => hw.id !== id));
      showToast("Assignment removed successfully.", "info");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error deleting homework:", err);
      showToast(err.message || "Failed to delete homework.", "error");
    }
  };

  // Helper to map class ID back to readable name
  const getClassName = (id) => {
    const cls = classes.find((c) => c.id === id);
    return cls ? `Class ${cls.name}` : "General Batch";
  };

  // Quiz Builder Handlers
  const handleAddQuestionToDraft = () => {
    if (!currQ.question.trim() || !currQ.optionA.trim() || !currQ.optionB.trim()) {
      showToast("Please enter question text and at least Options A and B.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const newQ = {
      id: draftQuestions.length + 1,
      question: currQ.question.trim(),
      options: [
        currQ.optionA.trim(),
        currQ.optionB.trim(),
        currQ.optionC.trim() || "None of the above",
        currQ.optionD.trim() || "All of the above",
      ],
      correct_answer: Number(currQ.correctAnswer),
      explanation: currQ.explanation.trim() || "Faculty verified answer key.",
    };

    setDraftQuestions([...draftQuestions, newQ]);
    setCurrQ({
      question: "",
      optionA: "",
      optionB: "",
      optionC: "",
      optionD: "",
      correctAnswer: 0,
      explanation: "",
    });
    showToast(`Question ${draftQuestions.length + 1} added to draft!`, "success");
  };

  const handleRemoveDraftQuestion = (idx) => {
    setDraftQuestions(draftQuestions.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
  };

  const handlePublishQuiz = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!quizForm.title.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide a Quiz Title / Topic.", "error");
      return;
    }

    if (draftQuestions.length === 0) {
      showToast("Please add at least 1 question to the quiz.", "error");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const schoolUuid = await resolveSchoolUuid(user?.school_id || user?.institution_code);

      await createQuiz({
        title: quizForm.title,
        subject: quizForm.subject,
        className: quizForm.className,
        duration: quizForm.duration,
        questions: draftQuestions,
        schoolId: schoolUuid,
        user,
      });

      showToast(`Interactive Quiz "${quizForm.title}" published to Student LMS!`, "success");
      setQuizForm({
        title: "",
        subject: "Mathematics",
        className: "Class 10 ICSE",
        duration: "15 mins",
      });
      setDraftQuestions([]);
      fetchQuizzes();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error publishing quiz:", err);
      showToast("Failed to publish quiz.", "error");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteQuiz = async (id) => {
    try {
      await deleteQuiz(id);
      setQuizzesList((prev) => prev.filter((q) => q.id !== id));
      showToast("Quiz removed from student LMS.", "info");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error deleting quiz:", err);
      showToast("Could not delete quiz.", "error");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative text-slate-200 min-h-full pb-10 font-sans">
      <div className="fixed top-0 left-10 w-96 h-96 bg-blue-600/10 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none"></div>

      <div className="relative z-10 max-w-6xl mx-auto">
        {/* HEADER & TAB SWITCHER */}
        <div className="mb-8 flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-blue-300 text-sm font-semibold mb-1 uppercase tracking-widest">
              Faculty Academic Suite
            </p>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-white">Publish Homework & LMS Quizzes 📚</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">
              Create curriculum assignments and interactive test series synchronized directly with student portals
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2 bg-slate-800/80 p-1.5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-700">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("homework")}
              className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === "homework"
                  ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/30"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              📝 Homework Manager
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab("quiz")}
              className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === "quiz"
                  ? "bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-purple-600/30"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              ⚡ Create Interactive Quiz ({quizzesList.length})
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* TAB 1: HOMEWORK MANAGER */}
        {activeTab === "homework" ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
            {/* LEFT: ASSIGNMENT FORM */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-1 bg-[#1E293B]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/60 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl h-fit">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white mb-6">Create Assignment</h2>
              <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                    Target Classroom Batch *
                  </label>
                  <select
                    required
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 font-bold"
                    value={formData.class_id}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, class_id: e.target.value })}
                  >
                    <option value="">Select a Classroom...</option>
                    {classes.map((cls) => (
                      <option key={cls.id} value={cls.id}>
                        Class {cls.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                    Subject *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g., Mathematics, Physics"
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-sm"
                    value={formData.subject}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, subject: e.target.value })}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                    Assignment Title *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g., Quadratic Equations Practice"
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-sm font-semibold"
                    value={formData.title}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, title: e.target.value })}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                    Submission Deadline *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    required
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 [color-scheme:dark] text-sm"
                    value={formData.due_date}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, due_date: e.target.value })}
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                    Instructions & Question Details
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    required
                    placeholder="Write assignment instructions, exercise numbers, or reference book pages..."
                    rows="3"
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 text-sm"
                    value={formData.description}
                    onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
                  ></textarea>
                </div>

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={submitting}
                  className="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-indigo-500 text-white font-extrabold py-4 px-4 rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-blue-600/30 disabled:opacity-50 transition-all mt-4 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {submitting ? "Publishing Assignment..." : "Publish Homework to Portal 🚀"}
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>

            {/* RIGHT: LIVE ASSIGNMENTS LIST */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-2">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
                <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Active Curriculum Assignments</h2>
                <button
                  onClick={fetchHomework}
                  className="text-xs bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 border border-slate-700 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-slate-300 font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  🔄 Refresh
                </button>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/60 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
                {loading ? (
                  <div className="p-6">
                    <TableSkeleton rows={4} cols={3} />
                  </div>
                ) : homeworkList.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="p-12 text-center text-slate-400">
                    <span className="text-4xl block mb-3 opacity-60">📂</span>
                    <p className="font-bold text-white text-base">No homework assigned yet.</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">
                      Assignments created here will instantly appear on the student portal.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="overflow-x-auto w-full">
                    <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse min-w-[550px]">
                      <thead>
                        <tr className="bg-slate-900/40 border-b border-slate-700/60 text-slate-400 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
                          <th className="p-5">Subject & Title</th>
                          <th className="p-5">Class Batch</th>
                          <th className="p-5">Deadline</th>
                          <th className="p-5 text-center">Faculty Verification</th>
                          <th className="p-5 text-right">Action</th>
                        </tr>
                      </thead>
                      <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-700/50 text-sm">
                        {homeworkList.map((hw) => {
                          const isVerified = Boolean(
                            hwCompletions[hw.id] === true ||
                            (typeof hwCompletions[hw.id] === "object" && hwCompletions[hw.id]?.all === true)
                          );

                          return (
                            <tr key={hw.id} className="hover:bg-slate-800/30 transition-colors">
                              <td className="p-5">
                                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-blue-400 uppercase tracking-wider block mb-0.5">
                                  {hw.subject}
                                </span>
                                <p className="font-bold text-white text-base">{hw.title}</p>
                                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1 line-clamp-1">{hw.description}</p>
                              </td>
                              <td className="p-5">
                                <span className="bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-slate-300 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold">
                                  {getClassName(hw.class_id)}
                                </span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="p-5 font-bold text-amber-400">{hw.due_date || "No deadline"}</td>
                              <td className="p-5 text-center">
                                <div className="inline-flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5">
                                  <button
                                    onClick={() => handleToggleVerification(hw.id, hw.title)}
                                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1 ${
                                      isVerified
                                        ? "bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 hover:bg-emerald-500/30"
                                        : "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 hover:bg-amber-500/30"
                                    }`}
                                    title="Toggle verified completion status for student portal"
                                  >
                                    <span>{isVerified ? "✓ Verified Completed" : "⏳ Mark Verified"}</span>
                                  </button>
                                  <button
                                    onClick={() => setVerifyingHw(hw)}
                                    className="text-[11px] text-blue-400 hover:text-blue-300 underline font-semibold cursor-pointer"
                                  >
                                    Verify per Student
                                  </button>
                                </div>
                              </td>
                              <td className="p-5 text-right">
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => handleDeleteHomework(hw.id)}
                                  className="text-rose-400 hover:text-rose-300 p-2 text-xs font-bold hover:bg-rose-500/10 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                                  title="Delete Assignment"
                                >
                                  🗑️
                                </button>
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          );
                        })}
                      </tbody>
                    </table>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* TAB 2: INTERACTIVE QUIZ BUILDER */
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
            {/* LEFT: QUIZ & QUESTION FORM */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-1 bg-[#1E293B]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/60 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl h-fit space-y-5">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Create Interactive Quiz</h2>

              {/* META INFO */}
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                    Quiz Topic / Title *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    placeholder="e.g., Quadratic Equations & Discriminant"
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500 text-sm font-semibold"
                    value={quizForm.title}
                    onChange={(e) => setQuizForm({ ...quizForm, title: e.target.value })}
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                      Subject
                    </label>
                    <select
                      className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500 text-xs font-bold"
                      value={quizForm.subject}
                      onChange={(e) => setQuizForm({ ...quizForm, subject: e.target.value })}
                    >
                      <option value="Mathematics">Mathematics</option>
                      <option value="Physics">Physics</option>
                      <option value="Chemistry">Chemistry</option>
                      <option value="Biology">Biology</option>
                      <option value="English">English</option>
                      <option value="Computers">Computers</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                      Class Batch
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500 text-xs font-bold"
                      value={quizForm.className}
                      onChange={(e) => setQuizForm({ ...quizForm, className: e.target.value })}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                    Duration
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g., 15 mins, 30 mins"
                    className="w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500 text-xs"
                    value={quizForm.duration}
                    onChange={(e) => setQuizForm({ ...quizForm, duration: e.target.value })}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* DYNAMIC QUESTION ADDITION */}
              <div className="border-t border-slate-800 pt-4 space-y-3">
                <p className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-400">
                  Add Question #{draftQuestions.length + 1}
                </p>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase mb-1">
                    Question Text *
                  </label>
                  <textarea
                    rows="2"
                    placeholder="Enter question prompt..."
                    className="w-full bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500"
                    value={currQ.question}
                    onChange={(e) => setCurrQ({ ...currQ, question: e.target.value })}

}

import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient.js";

/**
 * ENTERPRISE PARENT COMMUNICATION AUTOMATION ENGINE
 * Supports WhatsApp, SMS, and In-App alerts across 6 operational triggers:
 * 1. Absenteeism alerts
 * 2. Fee dues & payment reminders with Razorpay UPI links
 * 3. Examination result publications
 * 4. Daily homework assignments
 * 5. Institutional announcements & advisories
 * 6. Academic calendar event reminders
 */

const STORAGE_KEY = "erp_notification_history";

export const COMMUNICATION_CATEGORIES = [
  { id: "absence", label: "Attendance & Absence Alert", icon: "🚨" },
  { id: "fee_reminder", label: "Fee Due & UPI Payment Reminder", icon: "💰" },
  { id: "exam_result", label: "Examination Result & Grade Slip", icon: "📊" },
  { id: "homework", label: "Homework & Daily Assignment", icon: "📚" },
  { id: "announcement", label: "Institutional Broadcast Announcement", icon: "📢" },
  { id: "event", label: "Academic Event / Holiday Notice", icon: "📅" },
];

/**
 * Check provider connection status (Configured via secure server-side integrations)
 * Outbound WhatsApp/SMS gateway credentials must NEVER be exposed in the frontend bundle.
 */
export function getCommunicationGatewayStatus() {
  // Provider gateways are managed through secure serverless backend dispatch
  return {
    whatsappConfigured: false,
    smsConfigured: false,
    whatsappGateway: "Server Gateway (Awaiting WATI Server Credentials)",
    smsGateway: "Server Gateway (Awaiting Twilio Server Credentials)",
  };
}

/**
 * Dispatch automated parent notification with tenant audit & preference checking
 */
export async function dispatchParentNotification({
  schoolId = "CAMPUS-01",
  recipientPhone,
  recipientName = "Parent / Guardian",
  studentId,
  category = "announcement",
  message,
  channel = "whatsapp",
}) {
  const cleanSchool = String(schoolId).trim().toUpperCase();
  const cleanPhone = recipientPhone || "+91 98200 00000";
  const gateway = getCommunicationGatewayStatus();

  let deliveryStatus = "pending";
  let providerResponse = null;

  // 1. WhatsApp Delivery: Queued for server dispatch
  if (channel === "whatsapp") {
    // Gateway credentials are strictly server-side; client queues notification
    deliveryStatus = "queued";
    providerResponse = { note: "Queued for server-side WhatsApp dispatch" };
  }

  // 2. SMS Delivery: Queued for server dispatch
  if (channel === "sms") {
    // Gateway credentials are strictly server-side; client queues notification
    deliveryStatus = "queued";
    providerResponse = { note: "Queued for server-side SMS dispatch" };
  }

  if (channel === "in_app") {
    deliveryStatus = "delivered";
  }

  const notificationRecord = {
    id: `notif_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 5)}`,
    school_id: cleanSchool,
    recipient_phone: cleanPhone,
    recipient_name: recipientName,
    student_id: studentId || null,
    channel,
    category,
    message,
    delivery_status: deliveryStatus,
    provider_response: providerResponse,
    sent_at: deliveryStatus === "delivered" ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  // 3. Persist to Supabase if connected
  if (supabase) {
    try {
      await supabase.from("parent_notifications").insert([
        {
          school_id: cleanSchool,
          recipient_phone: cleanPhone,
          recipient_name: recipientName,
          student_id: studentId || null,
          channel,
          category,
          message,
          delivery_status: deliveryStatus,
          provider_response: providerResponse,
          sent_at: deliveryStatus === "delivered" ? new Date().toISOString() : null,
        },
      ]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[ParentNotif] Supabase persistence notice:", e);
    }
  }

  // 4. Update local storage history
  try {
    const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || "[]");
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify([notificationRecord, ...existing].slice(0, 100)));
  } catch (err) {}

  return notificationRecord;
}

/**
 * Automated Absence Alert Trigger
 */

  studentName,

    recipientName: `Parent of ${studentName}`,

}

 */
export async function notifyFeeReminder({

}) {
  const message = `💰 Fee Reminder: Term dues of ₹${Number(amountDue).toLocaleString("en-IN")} for ${studentName} (${rollNumber}) are due on ${dueDate}. Pay securely via online link: ${paymentUrl || "https://school.edu/pay"}`;
  return dispatchParentNotification({
    schoolId,
    recipientPhone: guardianPhone,
    recipientName: `Parent of ${studentName}`,

 */

  studentName,

}) {
  const message = `✅ Fee Receipt Confirmed: Payment of ₹${Number(amount).toLocaleString("en-IN")} received for ${studentName} (Invoice: ${invoiceNo}) at ${schoolName}. Formal fee receipt is available in the Student Portal.`;
  return dispatchParentNotification({
    schoolId,
    recipientPhone: guardianPhone,

    category: "fee_reminder",
    message,
    channel: "whatsapp",
  });
}

/**

 */

}

/**

 */

  return dispatchParentNotification({
    recipientPhone: to,

    channel: "whatsapp",

}

/**
 * Retrieve recent notification history
 */
export function getNotificationHistory() {
  try {

    return [];
