```javascript
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { logSecurityAction, AUDIT_ACTIONS } from "./auditLogger";

/**
 * Fetch quizzes from Supabase or localStorage with strict school_id isolation
 * Clean Slate: returns empty array if no faculty has created quizzes.
 */
export async function getQuizzes(schoolId) {
  const cleanSchoolId = schoolId ? String(schoolId).trim().toUpperCase() : null;

  try {
    if (supabase) {
      let query = supabase.from("lms_quizzes").select("*");
      if (cleanSchoolId) {
        query = query.eq("school_id", cleanSchoolId);
      }
      const { data, error } = await query.order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
        return data.map((d) => ({
          id: d.id,
          title: d.title,
          subject: d.subject,
          className: d.class_name || "General Batch",
          duration: d.duration || "15 mins",
          questions: Array.isArray(d.questions) ? d.questions : [],
          school_id: d.school_id,
        }));
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("LMS quiz load notice:", err);
  }

  // Fallback to tenant-scoped localStorage
  try {
    if (cleanSchoolId) {
      const savedTenant = localStorage.getItem(`erp_lms_quizzes_${cleanSchoolId}`);
      if (savedTenant) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(savedTenant);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) return parsed;
      }
    }

    const savedGlobal = localStorage.getItem("erp_lms_quizzes");
    if (savedGlobal) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(savedGlobal);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        if (cleanSchoolId) {
          return parsed.filter(
            (q) => String(q.school_id || "").toUpperCase() === cleanSchoolId
          );
        }
        return parsed;
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }

  // True clean slate: zero default mock quizzes
  return [];
}

/**
 * Publish a new interactive quiz created by teacher
 */
export async function createQuiz({
  title,
  subject,
  className,
  duration,
  questions,
  schoolId,
  user,
}) {
  const cleanSchoolId = (schoolId || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();
  const newQuiz = {
    id: `quiz-${Date.now().toString(36)}`,
    title: title.trim(),
    subject: subject.trim(),
    className: className || "General Batch",
    duration: duration || "15 mins",
    questions: questions || [],
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    created_by: user?.name || "Faculty Member",
    school_id: cleanSchoolId,
  };

  // Try Supabase insert
  try {
    if (supabase) {
      await supabase.from("lms_quizzes").insert([
        {
          school_id: cleanSchoolId,
          title: newQuiz.title,
          subject: newQuiz.subject,
          class_name: newQuiz.className,
          duration: newQuiz.duration,
          questions: newQuiz.questions,
        },
      ]);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Notice saving quiz to Supabase:", err);
  }

  // Sync to tenant-scoped localStorage
  try {
    const tenantKey = `erp_lms_quizzes_${cleanSchoolId}`;
    const rawTenant = localStorage.getItem(tenantKey);
    const tenantList = rawTenant ? JSON.parse(rawTenant) : [];
    const updatedTenant = [newQuiz, ...tenantList.filter((q) => q.id !== newQuiz.id)];
    localStorage.setItem(tenantKey, JSON.stringify(updatedTenant));

    // Global sync
    const globalRaw = localStorage.getItem("erp_lms_quizzes");
    const globalList = globalRaw ? JSON.parse(globalRaw) : [];
    const updatedGlobal = [newQuiz, ...globalList.filter((q) => q.id !== newQuiz.id)];
    localStorage.setItem("erp_lms_quizzes", JSON.stringify(updatedGlobal));

    // Real-time broadcast for Student LMS
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-quizzes-updated"));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("Error saving quiz to local storage:", e);
  }

  // Log Security audit
  try {
    logSecurityAction({
      action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.HOMEWORK_PUBLISHED,
      entityType: "LMS_QUIZ",
      entityId: newQuiz.title,
      details: `Created interactive quiz "${newQuiz.title}" (${newQuiz.subject}) with ${newQuiz.questions.length} questions for ${newQuiz.className}`,
      user,
      schoolId: cleanSchoolId,
    });
  } catch {
    // optional
  }

  return newQuiz;
}

/**
 * Delete a quiz
 */
export async function deleteQuiz(id, schoolId) {
  const cleanSchoolId = schoolId ? String(schoolId).trim().toUpperCase() : null;

  try {
    if (supabase) {
      await supabase.from("lms_quizzes").delete().eq("id", id);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Quiz delete DB notice:", err);
  }

  try {
    if (cleanSchoolId) {
      const tenantKey = `erp_lms_quizzes_${cleanSchoolId}`;
      const savedTenant = localStorage.getItem(tenantKey);
      if (savedTenant) {
        const filtered = JSON.parse(savedTenant).filter((q) => q.id !== id);
        localStorage.setItem(tenantKey, JSON.stringify(filtered));
      }
    }

    const saved = localStorage.getItem("erp_lms_quizzes");
    if (saved) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
      const filtered = parsed.filter((q) => q.id !== id);
      localStorage.setItem("erp_lms_quizzes", JSON.stringify(filtered));
    }

    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-quizzes-updated"));
  } catch {
    // ignore
  }
}
```

```javascript
export default function CertificateManagementCard({ mode = "teacher", title }) {
  const { user, tenant } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState(mode === "teacher" ? "PENDING" : "ALL");
  const [processingId, setProcessingId] = useState(null);

  const activeSchoolId = user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || tenant?.code || "CAMPUS-01";

  const loadRequests = () => {
    try {
      const storageKey = `erp_certificate_requests_${activeSchoolId}`;
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (saved) {
        setRequests(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        const initial = getDefaultCertificateRequests(activeSchoolId);
        localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(initial));
        localStorage.setItem("erp_certificate_requests", JSON.stringify(initial));
        setRequests(initial);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to read certificates storage:", err);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadRequests();

    const handleUpdate = () => loadRequests();
    window.addEventListener("erp-certificates-updated", handleUpdate);
    window.addEventListener("erp-certificate-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-certificates-updated", handleUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-certificate-updated", handleUpdate);
    };
  }, [activeSchoolId]);

  const updateCertificateStatus = async (certId, newStatus) => {
    setProcessingId(certId);
    try {
      // 1. Supabase update attempt
      if (supabase) {
        try {
          await supabase
            .from("certificate_requests")
            .update({ status: newStatus })
            .eq("id", certId);
        } catch (sErr) {
          console.warn("Supabase certificate update notice:", sErr);
        }
      }

      // 2. LocalStorage update
      const storageKey = `erp_certificate_requests_${activeSchoolId}`;
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "[]");
      const updated = existing.map((c) =>
        c.id === certId ? { ...c, status: newStatus } : c
      );
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
      localStorage.setItem("erp_certificate_requests", JSON.stringify(updated));

      // 3. Dispatch event & update state
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-certificates-updated"));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-certificate-updated"));
      setRequests(updated);

      showToast(
        `Certificate ${certId} ${newStatus === "APPROVED" ? "approved" : "rejected"} successfully!`,
        newStatus === "APPROVED" ? "success" : "info"
      );
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Status update error:", err);
      showToast("Updated certificate status locally.", "info");
    } finally {
      setProcessingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleDigitallySignAndIssue = async (cert) => {
    setProcessingId(cert.id);
    try {
      // 1. Issue cryptographically sealed certificate
      const issued = await issueOfficialCertificate({
        schoolId: activeSchoolId,
        certType: cert.certificate_type,
        studentId: cert.roll_number || cert.id,
        studentName: cert.student_name,
        className: cert.class_name,
        reason: cert.reason,
        issuedBy: user?.name || user?.full_name || "Principal Office",
      });

      // 2. Mark as approved in requests ledger with serial & code attached
      const storageKey = `erp_certificate_requests_${activeSchoolId}`;
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "[]");
      const updated = existing.map((c) =>
        c.id === cert.id
          ? {
              ...c,
              status: "APPROVED",
              serial_number: issued.serial_number,
              verification_code: issued.verification_code,
              verification_url: issued.verification_url,
            }
          : c
      );
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
      localStorage.setItem("erp_certificate_requests", JSON.stringify(updated));
      setRequests(updated);

      // 3. Generate & Download authentic PDF with official serial
      generateOfficialCertificatePDF({
        tenant: {
          name: tenant?.name || user?.institution_name || user?.school_name || "Institutional Campus",
          code: activeSchoolId,
          address: tenant?.address || "Flat number 201, Jivdani Chaya, near Rajshree Hospital, beside Kalavati Mandir, Mahim Manohar Highway, Palghar 401404",
        },
        student: {
          name: cert.student_name,
          roll_number: cert.roll_number,
          class_name: cert.class_name,
        },
        certificate: {
          id: issued.serial_number || cert.id,
          certificate_type: cert.certificate_type,
          reason: cert.reason,
          request_date: cert.request_date,
          issue_date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
          verification_url: issued.verification_url,
        },
      });

      showToast(
        `Digitally signed & issued ${cert.certificate_type} [${issued.serial_number}]! Verification QR Active.`,
        "success"
      );
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Sign & Issue PDF error:", err);
      showToast("Failed to digitally issue certificate PDF.", "error");
    } finally {
      setProcessingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleRevoke = async (cert) => {
    const reason = window.prompt("Reason for revoking this certificate:", "Administrative recall / Duplicate request");
    if (!reason) return;

    setProcessingId(cert.id);
    try {
      await revokeCertificate(activeSchoolId, cert.serial_number || cert.id, reason, user?.name || "Principal");
      await updateCertificateStatus(cert.id, "REJECTED");
      showToast(`Certificate ${cert.serial_number || cert.id} revoked successfully.`, "info");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Revoke error:", err);
      showToast("Revocation failed.", "error");
    } finally {
      setProcessingId(null);
    }
  };

  const pendingCount = requests.filter((r) => r.status === "PENDING").length;

  const filteredRequests = requests.filter((r) => {
    if (filter === "ALL") return true;
    return r.status === filter;
  });

  // Async PDF Batch Queue state
  const [batchJob, setBatchJob] = useState(null);
  const [batchProgress, setBatchProgress] = useState(0);

  const handleBatchIssueQueue = async () => {
    const targets = filteredRequests.length > 0 ? filteredRequests : requests;
    if (targets.length === 0) {
      showToast("No certificates available to batch compile.", "info");
      return;
    }

    try {
      setBatchJob({ status: "Queued" });
      setBatchProgress(15);

      const job = await enqueuePDFBatchJob({
        schoolId: activeSchoolId,
        jobType: "BATCH_CERTIFICATES",
        totalRecords: targets.length,
        payload: {
          certificateCount: targets.length,
          type: "Official Student Certificates Batch",
        },
        onProgress: (pct) => setBatchProgress(pct),
      });

      setBatchJob(job);
      showToast("Batch certificate job offloaded to Supabase pdf_jobs queue (Status: Queued)!", "info");

      listenToPDFBatchJob(job.id, activeSchoolId, (updated) => {
        setBatchJob(updated);
        if (updated.status === "Processing") {
          setBatchProgress(50);
        } else if (updated.status === "Completed") {
          setBatchProgress(100);
          showToast("Batch certificate compilation complete!", "success");
        }
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Batch issue error:", e);
      setBatchJob(null);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadCompletedBatch = () => {
    const targets = filteredRequests.length > 0 ? filteredRequests : requests;
    targets.forEach((cert) => {
      generateOfficialCertificatePDF({
        tenant: {
          name: tenant?.name || user?.institution_name || user?.school_name || "Institutional Campus",
          code: activeSchoolId,
          address: tenant?.address || "Palghar 401404",
        },
        student: {
          name: cert.student_name,
          roll_number: cert.roll_number,
          class_name: cert.class_name,
        },
        certificate: {
          id: cert.id,
          certificate_type: cert.certificate_type,
          reason: cert.reason,
          request_date: cert.request_date,
          issue_date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
        },
      });
    });
    showToast(`Downloaded batch of ${targets.length} official certificates!`, "success");
  };

  const cardTitle = title || "📜 Pending Student Certificates";

  return (
    <div className="bg-[#1E293B]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-slate-700/70 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden mb-10">
      {/* CARD HEADER */}
      <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-700/60 flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-4 bg-slate-800/40">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-xl">
            📜
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-white tracking-tight">{cardTitle}</h2>
              {pendingCount > 0 && (
                <span className="bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                  {pendingCount} Pending
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
              {mode === "teacher"
                ? "Review and verify student documents before principal sign-off"
                : "Authorize institutional certificates and generate official tamper-proof PDFs"}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* FILTERS */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-slate-900/60 p-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-700/70 text-xs">
          {mode !== "teacher" && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setFilter("ALL")}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                filter === "ALL"
                  ? "bg-purple-600 text-white shadow"
                  : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
              }`}
            >
              All ({requests.length})
            </button>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={() => setFilter("PENDING")}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              filter === "PENDING"
                ? "bg-amber-600 text-white shadow"
                : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            Pending ({pendingCount})
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setFilter("APPROVED")}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              filter === "APPROVED"
                ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow"
                : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
            }`}
          >
            Approved ({requests.filter((r) => r.status === "APPROVED").length})
          </button>

          {/* ASYNC BATCH QUEUE BUTTON */}
          {requests.length > 0 && (
            <button
              onClick={
                batchJob?.status === "Completed"
                  ? handleDownloadCompletedBatch
                  : handleBatchIssueQueue
              }
              disabled={batchJob?.status === "Queued" || batchJob?.status === "Processing"}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ml-2 ${
                batchJob?.status === "Completed"
                  ? "bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-black shadow-lg"
                  : "bg-cyan-500/20 hover:bg-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40"
              }`}
              title="Offload bulk certificate generation to Supabase pdf_jobs queue"
            >
              <span>⚡</span>
              <span>
                {batchJob?.status === "Queued" || batchJob?.status === "Processing"
                  ? `Compiling Batch (${batchProgress}%)...`
                  : batchJob?.status === "Completed"
                  ? "Download Batch PDF"
                  : "Async Batch Queue"}
              </span>
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* TABLE */}
      <div className="overflow-x-auto w-full">
        <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-slate-700/70 text-slate-400 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider bg-slate-900/40">
              <th className="p-4 pl-6">Student & Roll No</th>
              <th className="p-4">Certificate Type</th>
              <th className="p-4">Class</th>
              <th className="p-4">Request Date</th>
              <th className="p-4">Purpose / Reason</th>
              <th className="p-4 text-center">Status</th>
              <th className="p-4 pr-6 text-right">Actions</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-800/60 text-sm">
            {filteredRequests.length === 0 ? (
              <tr>
                <td colSpan="7" className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 italic">
                  No certificate requests found for this filter.
                </td>
              </tr>
            ) : (
              filteredRequests.map((cert) => (
                <tr key={cert.id} className="hover:bg-slate-800/30 transition-colors">
                  <td className="p-4 pl-6">
                    <p className="font-bold text-white text-sm">{cert.student_name}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs font-mono text-purple-300">{cert.roll_number}</p>
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-slate-200">{cert.certificate_type}</span>
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500">{cert.id}</p>
                    {cert.serial_number && (
                      <span className="inline-block mt-0.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30">
                        {cert.serial_number}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-xs font-medium text-slate-300 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {cert.class_name}
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {cert.request_date}
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-xs text-slate-300 max-w-[200px] truncate" title={cert.reason}>
                    {cert.reason}
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-center whitespace-nowrap">
                    {cert.status === "APPROVED" && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-extrabold bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
                        <span>✅</span> Approved
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {cert.status === "PENDING" && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-extrabold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30">
                        <span>⏳</span> Pending
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {cert.status === "REJECTED" && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-extrabold bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30">
                        <span>❌</span> Rejected
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                  <td className="p-4 pr-6 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    {mode === "teacher" ? (
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                        {cert.status === "PENDING" ? (
                          <>
                            <button
                              disabled={processingId === cert.id}
                              onClick={() => updateCertificateStatus(cert.id, "APPROVED")}
                              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600/30 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-emerald-300 hover:text-white border border-emerald-500/40 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer shadow disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-1"
                            >
                              <span>✅</span> Approve
                            </button>
                            <button
                              disabled={processingId === cert.id}
                              onClick={() => updateCertificateStatus(cert.id, "REJECTED")}
                              className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-rose-600/20 hover:bg-rose-600 text-rose-300 hover:text-white border border-rose-500/30 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-1"
                            >
                              <span>❌</span> Reject
                            </button>
                          </>
                        ) : cert.status === "APPROVED" ? (
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400">Approved</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-xs text-rose-400">Rejected</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      /* Principal / Trustee Action */
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                        {cert.verification_code && (
                          <a
                            href={`/verify-credential/${cert.verification_code}`}
                            target="_blank"
                            rel="noopener noreferrer"
                            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-cyan-500/10 hover:bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl transition-all flex items-center gap-1"
                            title="Open public cryptographic verification gateway"
                          >
                            <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3" />
                            <span>Verify</span>
                          </a>
                        )}
                        {cert.status === "PENDING" && (
                          <button
                            disabled={processingId === cert.id}
                            onClick={() => updateCertificateStatus(cert.id, "APPROVED")}
                            className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-600/30 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-emerald-300 hover:text-white border border-emerald-500/40 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer shadow disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-1"
                          >
                            <span>✅</span> Approve
                          </button>
                        )}
                        <button
                          disabled={processingId === cert.id}
                          onClick={() => handleDigitallySignAndIssue(cert)}
                          className="px-3.5 py-1.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-indigo-600 hover:from-purple-500 hover:to-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-extrabold rounded-xl transition-all shadow-md shadow-purple-600/30 cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-1.5"
                        >
                          <span>✍️</span> {cert.status === "APPROVED" ? "Re-Download (PDF)" : "Sign & Issue (PDF)"}
                        </button>
                        {cert.status === "APPROVED" && (
                          <button
                            disabled={processingId === cert.id}
                            onClick={() => handleRevoke(cert)}
                            className="p-1.5 bg-rose-500/10 hover:bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/30 rounded-xl transition-all"
                            title="Revoke Certificate"
                          >
                            <Ban className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </button>
                        )}
                        {cert.status === "PENDING" && (
                          <button
                            disabled={processingId === cert.id}
                            onClick={() => updateCertificateStatus(cert.id, "REJECTED")}
                            className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-rose-600/20 hover:bg-rose-600 text-rose-300 hover:text-white border border-rose-500/30 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-50 flex items-center gap-1"
                            title="Reject Request"
                          >
                            <span>❌</span> Reject
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ))
            )}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext } from "react";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { generateOfficialCertificatePDF } from "../utils/pdfGenerator";
import { ExternalLink, ShieldCheck } from "lucide-react";

export const getDefaultCertificateRequests = () => [];

export default function CertificateGenerator() {
  const { user, tenant } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();

  const [certType, setCertType] = useState("Bonafide Certificate");
  const [reason, setReason] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState([]);

  const activeSchoolId = user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || tenant?.code || "";
  const studentName = user?.name || user?.full_name || "Enrolled Student";
  const rollNumber = user?.personal_code || user?.role_code || user?.roll_number || "";
  const className = user?.class_name || "General Batch";

  // Load certificate requests for this school & student
  const loadRequests = () => {
    if (!activeSchoolId) return;
    try {
      const storageKey = `erp_certificate_requests_${activeSchoolId}`;
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(storageKey);
      if (saved) {
        setRequests(JSON.parse(saved));
      } else {
        setRequests([]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to load certificate requests:", err);
      setRequests([]);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadRequests();

    const handleUpdate = () => loadRequests();
    window.addEventListener("erp-certificates-updated", handleUpdate);
    window.addEventListener("erp-certificate-updated", handleUpdate);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-certificates-updated", handleUpdate);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-certificate-updated", handleUpdate);
    };
  }, [activeSchoolId]);

  const handleRequest = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!reason.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide the purpose for this certificate request.", "error");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    const newCert = {
      id: "CERT-" + Date.now().toString().slice(-6),
      student_name: studentName,
      roll_number: rollNumber,
      class_name: className,
      certificate_type: certType,
      reason: reason.trim(),
      status: "PENDING",
      request_date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
      school_id: activeSchoolId,
    };

    try {
      // 1. Supabase insert attempt
      if (supabase) {
        try {
          await supabase.from("certificate_requests").insert([newCert]);
        } catch (sErr) {
          console.warn("Supabase certificate insert notice:", sErr);
        }
      }

      // 2. Persist to localStorage
      const storageKey = `erp_certificate_requests_${activeSchoolId}`;
      const existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || "[]");
      const updated = [newCert, ...existing];
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(updated));
      localStorage.setItem("erp_certificate_requests", JSON.stringify(updated));

      // 3. Dispatch global sync event
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-certificates-updated"));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-certificate-updated"));

      setRequests(updated);
      setReason("");
      showToast(`Request for "${certType}" submitted to Principal's office!`, "success");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Certificate submission error:", err);
      showToast("Request submitted locally.", "info");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadPDF = (req) => {
    try {
      generateOfficialCertificatePDF({
        tenant: {
          name: tenant?.name || user?.institution_name || user?.school_name || "Institutional Campus",
          code: activeSchoolId,
          address: tenant?.address || "Flat number 201, Jivdani Chaya, near Rajshree Hospital, beside Kalavati Mandir, Mahim Manohar Highway, Palghar 401404",
        },
        student: {
          name: req.student_name || studentName,
          roll_number: req.roll_number || rollNumber,
          class_name: req.class_name || className,
        },
        certificate: {
          id: req.id,
          certificate_type: req.certificate_type,
          reason: req.reason,
          request_date: req.request_date,
          issue_date: req.request_date || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
        },
      });
      showToast(`Official ${req.certificate_type} PDF downloaded successfully!`, "success");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("PDF generation failed:", err);
      showToast("Failed to generate PDF certificate.", "error");
    }
  };

  // Filter requests for the current student
  const studentRequests = requests.filter(
    (r) =>
      r.roll_number === rollNumber ||
      r.student_name?.toLowerCase() === studentName.toLowerCase() ||
      !r.roll_number
  );

  return (
    <div className="relative text-slate-200 min-h-full pb-10 font-sans">
      <div className="fixed top-0 left-10 w-96 h-96 bg-blue-600/10 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none"></div>

      <div className="relative z-10 max-w-4xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        {/* HEADER */}
        <div className="text-center">
          <p className="text-blue-300 text-sm font-semibold mb-1 uppercase tracking-widest">
            Institutional Documents Vault
          </p>
          <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-white">
            Official Certificate Requests 📜
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1 max-w-lg mx-auto">
            Apply for Bonafide, Transfer, Character certificates, or Fee Clearance with instant digital signatures upon approval.
          </p>
        </div>
```

```javascript
        ...prev,
        institutionCode: paramSchool.toUpperCase().trim(),
      }));
    }

    // Load registered schools from Supabase
    const fetchSchools = async () => {
      try {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from("schools")
          .select("code, name")
          .order("name", { ascending: true });

        if (!error && data && data.length > 0) {
          // Merge unique schools
          const map = new Map();
          [...schools, ...data].forEach((s) => {
            if (s.code) map.set(s.code.toUpperCase(), s);
          });
          setSchools(Array.from(map.values()));

        console.warn("Notice loading schools list:", err);

    e.preventDefault();
    if (!formData.institutionCode || !formData.personalCode || !formData.fullName || !formData.email || !formData.password) {
      showToast("Please provide all required fields.", "error");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    const cleanInstCode = formData.institutionCode.trim().toUpperCase();
    const cleanPersonalCode = formData.personalCode.trim().toUpperCase();

    try {

      const schoolUuid = await resolveSchoolUuid(cleanInstCode);

      if (!supabase) {

      const { data: authData, error: authErr } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
        email: formData.email.trim(),

            full_name: formData.fullName.trim(),
            role: "student",
            role_code: cleanPersonalCode,

      });

      if (authErr) {

      if (!authUser) {
        showToast("Registration incomplete: No user returned from authentication service.", "error");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      // 3. Insert student profile row in Supabase
      try {

          },
```

```javascript
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

const metaEnv = typeof import.meta !== 'undefined' && import.meta.env ? import.meta.env : {};
const procEnv = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && globalThis.process && globalThis.process.env ? globalThis.process.env : {};

const supabaseUrl =
  metaEnv.VITE_SUPABASE_URL ||
  procEnv.VITE_SUPABASE_URL ||
  procEnv.SUPABASE_URL ||
  'https://lkcnausuvgdiwnsppakp.supabase.co';

const supabaseAnonKey =
  metaEnv.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ||
  procEnv.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ||
  procEnv.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ||
  'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6ImxrY25hdXN1dmdkaXduc3BwYWtwIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3OTEzMDMwMjcsImV4cCI6MjEwNjg3OTAyN30.QFmG6waeGtrK0dgGtzt0R6E9pSmvAL6Q9-XCnMyEWrw';

let client = null;
try {
  client = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
    auth: {
      persistSession: true,
      autoRefreshToken: true,
      detectSessionInUrl: false,
    },
  });
} catch (err) {
  console.warn('[Supabase Fallback]: Running in offline demo mode.', err);
}

export const supabase = client;
export default client;
```

```javascript
    if (p >= 70) return "B+";
    if (p >= 60) return "B";
    if (p >= 50) return "C";

      date: new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "2-digit", year: "numeric" }),
    };

    const updated = [newPaper, ...papers];
    setPapers(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_question_papers_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}

    // Automatically sync to Student LMS Study Vault
    try {
      publishStudyMaterial({
        title: newPaper.title,
        subject: user?.subject || "Curriculum Resource",
        className: newPaper.class,
        type: newPaper.format || "PDF",
        size: "2.4 MB",
        description: `Uploaded by ${user?.name || "faculty"} for ${newPaper.class} board preparation.`,
        schoolId,
        user,
      });
    } catch (err) {}

    showToast(`Resource "${newPaper.title}" published to Question Bank and Student LMS!`, "success");
    setPaperForm({ title: "", className: "Class 10-A", format: "PDF" });
    setShowPaperModal(false);
  };

  const handleDeletePaper = (id) => {
    const updated = papers.filter((p) => p.id !== id);
    setPapers(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_question_papers_${schoolId}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}
    showToast("Question paper removed.", "info");

  return (

                        const pct = (total / 3).toFixed(1);

                              />
                            </td>
                            <td className="p-4 text-center">
                              <input
                                type="number"
                                min="0"
                                max="100"
                                value={row.english}

                            <td className="p-4 text-center font-mono font-bold text-white">
                              {total} <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">/300</span>
                            </td>
                            <td className="p-4 text-center font-mono font-bold text-amber-300">

                                    ? "bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/30"
                                    : pct >= 40
                                    ? "bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30"
                                    : "bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/30"
                                }`}

                                {grade}

                            </td>
                            <td className="p-4 text-right pr-6">

          <div className="space-y-8">
            {/* STATS OVERVIEW */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl">
                <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Class Average Score</p>
                <p className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-emerald-400">82.4%</p>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1 block">Term evaluation standing</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl">
                <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Active Watchlist</p>
                <p className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-orange-400">{supportStudents.length} Students</p>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1 block">Remedial support active</span>
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl">
                <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Test Papers in Bank</p>
                <p className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-blue-400">{papers.length} Papers</p>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1 block">Faculty verified question banks</span>
              </div>

            {/* STUDENTS NEEDING EXTRA SUPPORT TABLE */}
```

```javascript
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient.js";
import { buildStandardErpEmail } from "./credentials.js";

/**
 * Role-Detection Helper Function
 * Strictly assigns roles based on 2-Tier Personal ID prefix:
 * - HOD-*, TR-*, TRUSTEE-* -> 'trustee'
 * - PRIN-*, PRINCIPAL-* -> 'principal'
 * - TCH-*, FAC-*, TEACHER-* -> 'teacher'
 * - ACC-*, ACCOUNTANT-* -> 'accountant'
 * - NON-*, STF-*, STAFF-* -> 'staff'
 * - ADM-*, SUPER-* -> 'admin'
 * Falls back to member's explicit role if valid, otherwise defaults to 'student'.
 */
export function detectRoleFromId(personalId = "", existingRole = "") {
  const cleanId = String(personalId || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (cleanId.startsWith("PRIN")) return "principal";
  if (cleanId.startsWith("HOD") || cleanId.startsWith("TR-") || cleanId.startsWith("TRUSTEE")) return "trustee";
  if (cleanId.startsWith("TCH") || cleanId.startsWith("FAC") || cleanId.startsWith("TEACHER")) return "teacher";
  if (cleanId.startsWith("ACC")) return "accountant";
  if (cleanId.startsWith("NON") || cleanId.startsWith("NTS") || cleanId.startsWith("STF") || cleanId.startsWith("STAFF")) return "staff";
  if (cleanId.startsWith("ADM") || cleanId.startsWith("SUPER")) return "admin";

  const cleanRole = String(existingRole || "").trim().toLowerCase();
  if (
    cleanRole === "trustee" ||
    cleanRole === "principal" ||
    cleanRole === "teacher" ||
    cleanRole === "accountant" ||
    cleanRole === "staff" ||
    cleanRole === "non_teaching" ||
    cleanRole === "admin"
  ) {
    return cleanRole;
  }

  return "student";
}

/**
 * Cloud-First Synchronization Service for Multi-Tenant School ERP
 * Guarantees that any school, student, or faculty created on a laptop
 * is immediately accessible and authenticatable on mobile devices globally.
 */

/**
 * 1. CLOUD-FIRST SCHOOL PROVISIONING
 * Saves school to Supabase (schools table) and master HOD admin to profiles.
 */
export async function provisionSchoolInCloud({
  institutionName,
  institutionCode,
  adminName,
  adminId = "HOD-01",
  adminRole,
  password = "password123",
  phone = "+91 9518388499",
  email = "",
  address = "Mahim Manohar Highway, Palghar 401404",
  institutionMode = "school", // 'school' | 'tuition'
}) {
  const cleanCode = (institutionCode || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9-]/g, "");
  const cleanAdminId = (adminId || "HOD-01").trim().toUpperCase();
  const cleanName = institutionName.trim();
  const cleanPass = password.trim() || "password123";
  const mappedEmail = email.trim() || buildStandardErpEmail(cleanCode, cleanAdminId);
  const strictAdminRole = detectRoleFromId(cleanAdminId, adminRole || "trustee");

  const initialMasterAdmin = {
    id: `hod_${Date.now()}`,
    name: adminName.trim(),
    full_name: adminName.trim(),
    role: strictAdminRole,
    role_code: cleanAdminId,
    roll_number: cleanAdminId,
    personal_code: cleanAdminId,
    class_name: "Executive Management",
    school_id: cleanCode,
    institution_code: cleanCode,
    institution_name: cleanName,
    email: mappedEmail,
    phone: phone.trim(),
    address: address.trim(),
    default_password: cleanPass,
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  let cloudSchoolId = null;
  let authUserId = null;

  if (supabase) {
    // A. Create Administrator in auth.users via Supabase Auth SignUp to satisfy foreign key constraints
    try {
      const { data: signUpData, error: signUpErr } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
        email: mappedEmail,
        password: cleanPass,
        options: {
          data: {
            full_name: adminName.trim(),
            role: strictAdminRole,
            role_code: cleanAdminId,
            school_code: cleanCode,
          },
        },
      });

      if (signUpData?.user?.id) {
        authUserId = signUpData.user.id;
        initialMasterAdmin.id = authUserId;
      } else if (signUpErr) {
        console.warn("[CloudSync] auth.signUp notice:", signUpErr.message);
        // If user already registered, sign in to retrieve valid auth ID
        try {
          const { data: signInData } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
            email: mappedEmail,
            password: cleanPass,
          });
          if (signInData?.user?.id) {
            authUserId = signInData.user.id;
            initialMasterAdmin.id = authUserId;
          }
        } catch (signInErr) {
          console.warn("[CloudSync] auth.signIn fallback notice:", signInErr.message);
        }
      }
    } catch (authErr) {
      console.warn("[CloudSync] Client auth.signUp exception:", authErr);
    }

    // B. Insert/Upsert into schools table with cloud-synchronized directory package
    try {
      const addressPayload = JSON.stringify({
        physicalAddress: address.trim(),
        directory: [initialMasterAdmin],
        masterAdminId: cleanAdminId,
        masterAdminName: adminName.trim(),
        defaultPassword: cleanPass,
        institutionMode,
        subscriptionStatus: "active",
        provisionedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      });

      const { data: schoolData, error: schoolErr } = await supabase
        .from("schools")
        .upsert(
          [
            {
              name: cleanName,
              code: cleanCode,
              phone: phone.trim(),
              address: addressPayload,
              city: "Palghar",
              state: "Maharashtra",
            },
          ],
          { onConflict: "code" }
        )
        .select()
        .single();

      if (schoolErr) {
        // Fallback with minimal core columns if extended columns are absent
        const { data: retrySchool, error: retryErr } = await supabase
          .from("schools")
          .upsert(
            [
              {
                name: cleanName,
                code: cleanCode,
                address: addressPayload,
              },
            ],
            { onConflict: "code" }
          )
          .select()
          .single();

        if (retryErr) {
          console.error("[CloudSync] schools table upsert error:", retryErr);
          throw new Error(`Database error in schools table: ${retryErr.message}`);
        }
        if (retrySchool) {
          cloudSchoolId = retrySchool.id;
        }
      } else if (schoolData) {
        cloudSchoolId = schoolData.id;
      }
    } catch (dbErr) {
      console.error("[CloudSync] schools table upsert error:", dbErr);
      throw dbErr;
    }

    // C. Insert master admin into profiles table linking exact auth.users(id)
    try {
      const profilePayload = {
        full_name: adminName.trim(),
        role: strictAdminRole,
        role_code: cleanAdminId,
        school_id: cloudSchoolId || undefined,
        email: mappedEmail,
        phone: phone.trim(),
        is_active: true,
        status: "active",
      };

      if (authUserId) {
        profilePayload.id = authUserId;
      }

      const { error: profErr } = await supabase
        .from("profiles")
        .upsert([profilePayload], { onConflict: "school_id,role_code" });

      if (profErr) {
        console.error("[CloudSync] profiles table upsert error:", profErr);
        throw new Error(`Database error in profiles table: ${profErr.message}`);
      }
    } catch (profErr) {
      console.error("[CloudSync] profiles table upsert error:", profErr);
      throw profErr;
    }
  }

  // D. Update Local Storage for Instant Responsiveness
  const defaultExpiry = new Date(Date.now() + 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString().split("T")[0];
  localStorage.setItem(`erp_directory_${cleanCode}`, JSON.stringify([initialMasterAdmin]));
  localStorage.setItem("erp_active_tenant", cleanCode);
  localStorage.setItem(`erp_institution_type_${cleanCode}`, institutionMode);
  localStorage.setItem(
    `erp_school_sub_${cleanCode}`,
    JSON.stringify({ status: "active", expiryDate: defaultExpiry })
  );

  try {
    const rawSchools = localStorage.getItem("erp_registered_schools") || "[]";
    const schoolsList = JSON.parse(rawSchools);
    const filtered = schoolsList.filter((s) => (s.code || "").toUpperCase() !== cleanCode);
    filtered.unshift({
      code: cleanCode,
      name: cleanName,
      adminName: adminName.trim(),
      adminId: cleanAdminId,
      institutionMode,
      institutionType: institutionMode,
      subscriptionStatus: "active",
      status: "active",
      expiryDate: defaultExpiry,
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      cloudId: cloudSchoolId,
    });
    localStorage.setItem("erp_registered_schools", JSON.stringify(filtered));
  } catch (e) {}

  // Reset tenant data partitions to ensure clean slate
  localStorage.removeItem(`erp_fee_structure_${cleanCode}`);
  localStorage.removeItem(`erp_fee_ledger_${cleanCode}`);
  localStorage.removeItem(`erp_notices_${cleanCode}`);
  localStorage.removeItem(`erp_transport_fleet_${cleanCode}`);
  localStorage.removeItem(`erp_cctv_nodes_${cleanCode}`);
  localStorage.removeItem(`erp_non_teaching_staff_${cleanCode}`);

  window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-directory-updated"));
  window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-schools-updated"));

  return {
    institutionName: cleanName,
    institutionCode: cleanCode,
    adminName: adminName.trim(),
    adminId: cleanAdminId,
    institutionMode,
    password: cleanPass,
    mappedEmail,
    portalUrl: `${typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.location.origin : ""}/portal?school=${cleanCode}`,
    cloudId: cloudSchoolId,
    authUserId,
  };
}

/**
 * 2. CLOUD-FIRST STUDENT & FACULTY ENROLLMENT
 * Writes student/teacher records directly into Supabase (profiles, students, teachers, schools cloud directory)
 * and updates local directory state so the UI refreshes instantly.
 */
export async function enrollMemberInCloud({ schoolCode, member }) {
  const cleanCode = (schoolCode || "CAMPUS-01").trim().toUpperCase();
  const cleanId = (member.role_code || member.roll_number || member.personal_code || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  const assignedRole = detectRoleFromId(cleanId, member.role);
  const isTeacher = assignedRole === "teacher";
  const memberWithRole = {
    ...member,
    role: assignedRole,
  };

  let cloudSchoolUuid = null;

  if (supabase) {
    try {
      // 1. Fetch current school record to get UUID and existing cloud directory
      const { data: schoolRecord } = await supabase
        .from("schools")
        .select("*")
        .ilike("code", cleanCode)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (schoolRecord) {
        cloudSchoolUuid = schoolRecord.id;

        // Extract existing cloud directory from school address payload
        let cloudDir = [];
        if (schoolRecord.address && schoolRecord.address.startsWith("{")) {
          try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(schoolRecord.address);
            if (Array.isArray(parsed.directory)) {
              cloudDir = parsed.directory;
            }
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        // Add or update this member in the cloud directory
        const filteredDir = cloudDir.filter(
          (m) => (m.role_code || m.roll_number || m.personal_code || "").toUpperCase() !== cleanId
        );
        const updatedCloudDir = [memberWithRole, ...filteredDir];

        const updatedPayload = JSON.stringify({
          physicalAddress: "Mahim Manohar Highway, Palghar 401404",
          directory: updatedCloudDir,
          lastUpdated: new Date().toISOString(),
        });

        // Write updated cloud directory back to schools table in Supabase
        await supabase
          .from("schools")
          .update({ address: updatedPayload })
          .eq("id", schoolRecord.id);
      }
    } catch (schoolSyncErr) {
      console.warn("[CloudSync] School cloud directory update notice:", schoolSyncErr);
    }

    // 2. Write to profiles table in Supabase
    try {
      await supabase.from("profiles").insert([
        {
          school_id: cloudSchoolUuid || undefined,
          full_name: memberWithRole.full_name || memberWithRole.name,
          role: assignedRole,
          role_code: cleanId,
        },
      ]);
    } catch (profErr) {
      console.warn("[CloudSync] profiles table insert notice:", profErr);
    }

    // 3. Write to students or teachers table in Supabase
    if (isTeacher) {
      try {
        await supabase.from("teachers").insert([
          {
            school_id: cloudSchoolUuid || undefined,
            name: memberWithRole.full_name || memberWithRole.name,
            email: memberWithRole.email || null,
            phone: memberWithRole.phone || null,
            subject: memberWithRole.subject || memberWithRole.department || "General Faculty",
          },
        ]);
      } catch (tchErr) {
        console.warn("[CloudSync] teachers table insert notice:", tchErr);
      }
    } else {
      try {
        await supabase.from("students").insert([
          {
            school_id: cloudSchoolUuid || undefined,
            name: memberWithRole.full_name || memberWithRole.name,
            roll_number: cleanId,
          },
        ]);
      } catch (stuErr) {
        console.warn("[CloudSync] students table insert notice:", stuErr);
      }
    }
  }

  // 4. Update Local Storage Directory for Instant Zero-Latency UI Updates
  try {
    const rawLocal = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${cleanCode}`) || "[]";
    const localDir = JSON.parse(rawLocal);
    const filteredLocal = localDir.filter(
      (m) => (m.role_code || m.roll_number || m.personal_code || "").toUpperCase() !== cleanId
    );
    const newLocal = [memberWithRole, ...filteredLocal];
    localStorage.setItem(`erp_directory_${cleanCode}`, JSON.stringify(newLocal));
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-directory-updated"));
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn("[CloudSync] Local storage update notice:", e);
  }

  return memberWithRole;
}

/**
 * 3. CLOUD-FIRST LOGIN VERIFICATION
 * Queries Supabase first (schools, profiles, students, teachers, cloud directory)
 * to authenticate users from ANY mobile or desktop browser globally.
 * Falls back to localStorage ONLY if offline or network unreachable.
 */
export async function verifyCloudLogin({ institutionCode, personalCode, password }) {
  const cleanInst = (institutionCode || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  const cleanPersonal = (personalCode || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  const inputPass = (password || "").trim();

  if (!cleanInst || !cleanPersonal || !inputPass) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: "Institution code, personal ID, and password are required.",
    };
  }

  // Live Supabase Auth verification is authoritative. Hardcoded/default credentials are prohibited.
  if (supabase) {
    try {
      const candidates = [
        buildStandardErpEmail(cleanInst, cleanPersonal),
        `${cleanInst.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")}.${cleanPersonal.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")}@gmail.com`,
      ];

      for (const candidateEmail of candidates) {
        const { data: authData, error: authErr } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
          email: candidateEmail,
          password: inputPass,
        });

        if (!authErr && authData?.user) {
          const authUser = authData.user;
          const appMeta = authUser.app_metadata || {};
          const userMeta = authUser.user_metadata || {};

          return {
            success: true,
            user: {
              id: authUser.id,
              email: authUser.email,
              name: userMeta.full_name || userMeta.name || cleanPersonal,
              role: appMeta.role || "STU",
              role_code: appMeta.role_code || cleanPersonal,
              school_id: cleanInst,
              institution_code: cleanInst,
              authUid: authUser.id,
            },
            source: "supabase_auth",
          };
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[CloudSync] Live credential verification error:", e);
    }
  }

  return {
    success: false,
    error: "Authentication failed. Invalid institutional credentials in Supabase Auth.",
  };
}

/**
 * 4. FETCH CLOUD DIRECTORY
 * Retrieves the complete member roster for an institution from Supabase cloud,
 * falls back to local storage if offline, and syncs local cache.
 */
export async function fetchCloudDirectory(schoolCode) {
  const cleanCode = (schoolCode || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!cleanCode) return [];

  if (supabase) {
    try {
      const { data: schoolRecord } = await supabase
        .from("schools")
        .select("*")
        .ilike("code", cleanCode)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (schoolRecord && schoolRecord.address && schoolRecord.address.startsWith("{")) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(schoolRecord.address);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed.directory) && parsed.directory.length > 0) {
            const normalizedDir = parsed.directory.map((m) => {
              const code = String(m.role_code || m.roll_number || m.personal_code || "").toUpperCase();
              return {
                ...m,
                role: detectRoleFromId(code, m.role),
              };
            });
            // Synchronize down to local cache
            localStorage.setItem(`erp_directory_${cleanCode}`, JSON.stringify(normalizedDir));
            return normalizedDir;
          }
        } catch (parseErr) {}
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[CloudSync] fetchCloudDirectory notice:", e);
    }
  }

  // Fallback to local storage
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${cleanCode}`);
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        return parsed.map((m) => {
          const code = String(m.role_code || m.roll_number || m.personal_code || "").toUpperCase();
          return {
            ...m,
            role: detectRoleFromId(code, m.role),
          };
        });
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  return [];
}

/**
 * 5. MASTER SUBSCRIPTION & EXPIRY CONTROLLER
 * Controls institution licensing, custom expiry dates, and the master kill-switch.
 */
export function getSchoolSubscription(schoolCode) {
  const cleanCode = String(schoolCode || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!cleanCode) {
    return {
      status: "active",
      expiryDate: "2027-12-31",
      isExpired: false,
      isSuspended: false,
      isBlocked: false,
    };
  }

  const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
  let status = "active";
  let expiryDate = "2027-12-31";

  // Check explicit tenant subscription key
  try {
    const rawSub = localStorage.getItem(`erp_school_sub_${cleanCode}`);
    if (rawSub) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(rawSub);
      if (parsed.status) status = parsed.status;
      if (parsed.expiryDate) expiryDate = parsed.expiryDate;
    } else {
      // Check erp_registered_schools
      const rawSchools = localStorage.getItem("erp_registered_schools");
      if (rawSchools) {
        const list = JSON.parse(rawSchools);
        const match = list.find((s) => (s.code || "").toUpperCase() === cleanCode);
        if (match) {
          if (match.subscriptionStatus) status = match.subscriptionStatus;
          if (match.expiryDate) expiryDate = match.expiryDate;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  const isSuspended = status.toLowerCase() === "suspended";
  const isExpired = Boolean(expiryDate && today > expiryDate);
  const isBlocked = isSuspended || isExpired;

  return {
    status,
    expiryDate,
    isSuspended,
    isExpired,
    isBlocked,
    today,
  };
}

export async function updateSchoolSubscription({ schoolCode, status, expiryDate }) {
  const cleanCode = String(schoolCode || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!cleanCode) return;

  const validStatus = status === "suspended" ? "suspended" : "active";
  const validExpiry = expiryDate || "2027-12-31";

  // Save to tenant key
  localStorage.setItem(
    `erp_school_sub_${cleanCode}`,
    JSON.stringify({ status: validStatus, expiryDate: validExpiry })
  );

  // Update erp_registered_schools
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem("erp_registered_schools") || "[]";
    const list = JSON.parse(raw);
    const updated = list.map((s) => {
      if ((s.code || "").toUpperCase() === cleanCode) {
        return {
          ...s,
          subscriptionStatus: validStatus,
          status: validStatus,
          expiryDate: validExpiry,
        };
      }
      return s;
    });
    localStorage.setItem("erp_registered_schools", JSON.stringify(updated));
  } catch (e) {}

  // Sync to Supabase cloud if connected
  if (supabase) {
    try {
      const { data: schoolRecord } = await supabase
        .from("schools")
        .select("id, address")
        .ilike("code", cleanCode)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (schoolRecord && schoolRecord.address && schoolRecord.address.startsWith("{")) {
        const payload = JSON.parse(schoolRecord.address);
        payload.subscriptionStatus = validStatus;
        payload.expiryDate = validExpiry;
        payload.lastSubscriptionUpdate = new Date().toISOString();
        await supabase
          .from("schools")
          .update({ address: JSON.stringify(payload) })
          .eq("id", schoolRecord.id);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[CloudSync] Subscription cloud sync notice:", err);
    }
  }

  window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-schools-updated"));
  return { status: validStatus, expiryDate: validExpiry };
}

export async function checkSchoolSubscriptionStatus(schoolCode) {
  const cleanCode = String(schoolCode || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!cleanCode) return { isBlocked: false, isSuspended: false, isExpired: false };

  // First check cloud if online
  if (supabase) {
    try {
      const { data: schoolRecord } = await supabase
        .from("schools")
        .select("id, address")
        .ilike("code", cleanCode)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (schoolRecord && schoolRecord.address && schoolRecord.address.startsWith("{")) {
        const payload = JSON.parse(schoolRecord.address);
        if (payload.subscriptionStatus || payload.expiryDate) {
          const cloudStatus = payload.subscriptionStatus || "active";
          const cloudExpiry = payload.expiryDate || "2027-12-31";
          const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
          const isSuspended = cloudStatus.toLowerCase() === "suspended";
          const isExpired = Boolean(cloudExpiry && today > cloudExpiry);

          // Sync locally
          localStorage.setItem(
            `erp_school_sub_${cleanCode}`,
            JSON.stringify({ status: cloudStatus, expiryDate: cloudExpiry })
          );

          return {
            status: cloudStatus,
            expiryDate: cloudExpiry,
            isSuspended,
            isExpired,
            isBlocked: isSuspended || isExpired,
            today,
          };
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  // Fallback to local subscription evaluator
  return getSchoolSubscription(cleanCode);
}

export async function getAllRegisteredSchools() {
  const schoolsMap = new Map();

  // 1. Seed standard defaults so the directory is never empty
  const defaultSchools = [
    {
      code: "PALGHAR-01",
      name: "Palghar International Academy",
      adminName: "Dr. Vikramaditya Singhania",
      adminId: "HOD-01",
      institutionMode: "school",
      subscriptionStatus: "active",
      expiryDate: "2027-12-31",
      createdAt: "2026-01-15T09:00:00.000Z",
    },
    {
      code: "TUITION-01",
      name: "Zenith IIT-JEE & Medical Hub",
      adminName: "Prof. Rajesh Verma",
      adminId: "HOD-01",
      institutionMode: "tuition",
      subscriptionStatus: "active",
      expiryDate: "2027-12-31",
      createdAt: "2026-02-01T10:30:00.000Z",
    },
  ];

  defaultSchools.forEach((s) => schoolsMap.set(s.code, s));

  // 2. Read local storage registered schools
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem("erp_registered_schools");
    if (raw) {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        parsed.forEach((s) => {
          if (s.code) {
            const cleanCode = s.code.toUpperCase();
            const sub = getSchoolSubscription(cleanCode);
            schoolsMap.set(cleanCode, {
              ...s,
              code: cleanCode,
              name: s.name || cleanCode,
              institutionMode: s.institutionMode || s.institutionType || "school",
              subscriptionStatus: sub.status,
              expiryDate: sub.expiryDate,
              isBlocked: sub.isBlocked,
              isSuspended: sub.isSuspended,
              isExpired: sub.isExpired,
            });
          }
        });
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {}

  // 3. Merge Supabase cloud schools
  if (supabase) {
    try {
      const { data: cloudSchools } = await supabase
        .from("schools")
        .select("id, code, name, address, created_at");

      if (cloudSchools && Array.isArray(cloudSchools)) {
        cloudSchools.forEach((cs) => {
          if (cs.code) {
            const cleanCode = cs.code.toUpperCase();
            let adminName = "Institution Trustee";
            let adminId = "HOD-01";
            let mode = "school";
            let subStatus = "active";
            let expDate = "2027-12-31";

            if (cs.address && cs.address.startsWith("{")) {
              try {
                const parsed = JSON.parse(cs.address);
                if (parsed.masterAdminName) adminName = parsed.masterAdminName;
                if (parsed.masterAdminId) adminId = parsed.masterAdminId;
                if (parsed.institutionMode) mode = parsed.institutionMode;
                if (parsed.subscriptionStatus) subStatus = parsed.subscriptionStatus;
                if (parsed.expiryDate) expDate = parsed.expiryDate;
              } catch (e) {}
            }

            const existing = schoolsMap.get(cleanCode);
            schoolsMap.set(cleanCode, {
              code: cleanCode,
              name: cs.name || existing?.name || cleanCode,
              adminName: existing?.adminName || adminName,
              adminId: existing?.adminId || adminId,
              institutionMode: existing?.institutionMode || mode,
              subscriptionStatus: existing?.subscriptionStatus || subStatus,
              expiryDate: existing?.expiryDate || expDate,
              createdAt: cs.created_at || existing?.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
              cloudId: cs.id,
            });
          }
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {}
  }

  // Ensure each school has up-to-date subscription status
  const result = Array.from(schoolsMap.values()).map((s) => {
    const sub = getSchoolSubscription(s.code);
    return {
      ...s,
      subscriptionStatus: sub.status,
      status: sub.status,
      expiryDate: s.expiryDate || sub.expiryDate,
      isBlocked: sub.isBlocked,
      isSuspended: sub.isSuspended,
      isExpired: sub.isExpired,
    };
  });

  return result;
}
```

```javascript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { logSecurityAction, AUDIT_ACTIONS } from "../utils/auditLogger";
import { buildStandardErpEmail } from "./Login";
import {
  provisionSchoolInCloud,
  detectRoleFromId,
  getAllRegisteredSchools,
  updateSchoolSubscription,
  getSchoolSubscription,
} from "../utils/cloudSyncService";
import BrandLogo from "../Components/BrandLogo";

export { detectRoleFromId };

export default function MasterSchoolSetup() {
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [isUnlocked, setIsUnlocked] = useState(
    () => sessionStorage.getItem("erp_master_gate_unlocked") === "true"
  );
  const [passkeyInput, setPasskeyInput] = useState("");
  const [passkeyError, setPasskeyError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [successData, setSuccessData] = useState(null);

  const [schoolsList, setSchoolsList] = useState([]);
  const [loadingSchools, setLoadingSchools] = useState(false);
  const [searchSchoolTerm, setSearchSchoolTerm] = useState("");

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    institutionName: "",
    institutionCode: "",
    institutionCodeManual: false,
    institutionMode: "school", // 'school' | 'tuition'
    adminName: "",
    adminRoleCode: "HOD-01",
    email: "",
    phone: "+91 9518388499",
    password: "password123",
    address: "Mahim Manohar Highway, Palghar 401404",
  });

  const loadSchools = async () => {
    setLoadingSchools(true);
    try {
      const token = sessionStorage.getItem("erp_master_token");
      let loadedFromApi = false;

      // 1. First attempt: Query secure Master API
      try {
        const resp = await fetch("/api/master/schools", {
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            Authorization: token ? `Bearer ${token}` : undefined,
            "x-master-token": token || undefined,
          },
        });
        if (resp.ok) {
          const resData = await resp.json();
          if (resData.success && Array.isArray(resData.schools)) {
            const mapped = resData.schools.map((s) => ({
              code: s.code,
              name: s.name,
              adminName: s.admin_name || s.adminName || "Trustee HOD",
              adminId: s.admin_id || s.adminId || "HOD-01",
              institutionMode: s.institution_mode || s.institutionMode || "school",
              subscriptionStatus: s.subscription_status || s.status || "active",
              expiryDate: s.subscription_expires_at
                ? s.subscription_expires_at.split("T")[0]
                : "2027-12-31",
              createdAt: s.created_at,
              isCloudPersisted: true,
            }));
            setSchoolsList(mapped);
            loadedFromApi = true;
          }
        }
      } catch (apiErr) {
        console.warn("Master API schools fetch notice:", apiErr);
      }

      // 2. Second attempt: Direct Supabase query
      if (!loadedFromApi && supabase) {
        try {
          const { data: cloudSchools, error: dbErr } = await supabase
            .from("schools")
            .select("*")
            .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

          if (!dbErr && Array.isArray(cloudSchools) && cloudSchools.length > 0) {
            const mapped = cloudSchools.map((s) => {
              let adminName = s.admin_name || "Trustee HOD";
              let adminId = s.admin_id || "HOD-01";
              if (s.address && s.address.startsWith("{")) {
                try {
                  const parsed = JSON.parse(s.address);
                  if (parsed.masterAdminName) adminName = parsed.masterAdminName;
                  if (parsed.masterAdminId) adminId = parsed.masterAdminId;
                } catch (e) {}
              }
              return {
                code: s.code,
                name: s.name,
                adminName,
                adminId,
                institutionMode: s.institution_mode || "school",
                subscriptionStatus: s.subscription_status || s.status || "active",
                expiryDate: s.subscription_expires_at
                  ? s.subscription_expires_at.split("T")[0]
                  : "2027-12-31",
                createdAt: s.created_at,
                isCloudPersisted: true,
              };
            });
            setSchoolsList(mapped);
            loadedFromApi = true;
          }
        } catch (dbErr) {
          console.warn("Direct Supabase schools query notice:", dbErr);
        }
      }

      // 3. Fallback: Unified local/cloud directory service
      if (!loadedFromApi) {
        const list = await getAllRegisteredSchools();
        setSchoolsList(list);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Error loading schools list:", e);
    } finally {
      setLoadingSchools(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isUnlocked) {
      loadSchools();
      window.addEventListener("erp-schools-updated", loadSchools);
      return () => window.removeEventListener("erp-schools-updated", loadSchools);
    }
  }, [isUnlocked]);

  const handleUnlockGateway = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const cleanPass = passkeyInput.trim();
    setPasskeyError("");

    if (!cleanPass) {
      setPasskeyError("Please enter the Master Operator Passkey.");
      return;

    // 1. Authoritative Master API authentication via HMAC-signed session
    try {
      const resp = await fetch("/api/master/auth", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ passkey: cleanPass }),

      const data = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));

      if (resp.ok && data.success && data.token) {
        sessionStorage.setItem("erp_master_token", data.token);
        sessionStorage.setItem("erp_master_gate_unlocked", "true");
        setIsUnlocked(true);
        showToast("Master Gateway Unlocked! Access Granted.", "success");
        return;
      } else {

      console.warn("Master API auth notice:", authErr);
      setPasskeyError("Unable to reach Master Authentication Gateway.");
      showToast("Master Gateway server unreachable.", "error");
    }
  };

  const handleLockGateway = () => {
    setIsUnlocked(false);

    setPasskeyInput("");
    showToast("Master Provisioning Gateway Locked.", "info");

    if (!token) {
      showToast("Master Session Token is missing or expired. Please re-authenticate.", "error");
      return;

    try {

        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          "x-master-token": token,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: "set_status",
          schoolCode: school.code,
          status: newStatus,
          expiryDate: school.expiryDate,
        }),
      });

      const resData = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!resp.ok || !resData.success) {
        showToast(resData.error || "Failed to update status in Supabase PostgreSQL", "error");
        return;
      }

      await updateSchoolSubscription({
        schoolCode: school.code,
        status: newStatus,
        expiryDate: school.expiryDate,
      });

      showToast(
        `School ${school.code} subscription set to ${newStatus.toUpperCase()}! ${newStatus === "suspended" ? "Access blocked." : "Access restored."}`,
        newStatus === "suspended" ? "error" : "success"
      );
      loadSchools();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Toggle subscription error:", err);
      showToast("Server communication error while updating status.", "error");
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateExpiry = async (schoolCode, newDate) => {
    const current = getSchoolSubscription(schoolCode);

    const token = sessionStorage.getItem("erp_master_token");
    if (!token) {
      showToast("Master Session Token is missing or expired. Please re-authenticate.", "error");
      return;
    }

    try {
      const resp = await fetch("/api/master/schools", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
          "x-master-token": token,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          action: "set_status",
          schoolCode,
          status: current.status,
          expiryDate: newDate,
        }),
      });

      const resData = await resp.json().catch(() => ({}));
      if (!resp.ok || !resData.success) {
        showToast(resData.error || "Failed to update expiry in Supabase PostgreSQL", "error");
        return;
      }

      await updateSchoolSubscription({

        status: current.status,

      loadSchools();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Update expiry error:", err);
      showToast("Server communication error while updating expiry.", "error");
    }
  };

  const handleNameChange = (name) => {
    const suggestedCode = name
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase()
      .replace(/[^A-Z0-9\s]/g, "")
      .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
      .slice(0, 14);

    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      institutionName: name,
      institutionCode: prev.institutionCodeManual ? prev.institutionCode : (suggestedCode ? `${suggestedCode}-01` : ""),
    }));
  };

  const handleProvisionSchool = async (e) => {

    if (!formData.institutionCode.trim()) {

                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* TABLE */}
            <div className="overflow-x-auto w-full">

                <thead>
```
