import ClassTestEntry from "../Components/ClassTestEntry";
import { getClassTestsForTeacher } from "../utils/classTestMarksService";

export default function TeacherDashboard() {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const [stats, setStats] = useState({
    classesCount: 0,
    studentsCount: 0,
    homeworkCount: 0,
    testsCreated: 0,
    testsAwaitingMarks: 0,
    testsPublished: 0,
  });
  const [classAttendanceTrend, setClassAttendanceTrend] = useState([]);
  const [examPerformanceData, setExamPerformanceData] = useState([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showScannerModal, setShowScannerModal] = useState(false);
  const [showTestModal, setShowTestModal] = useState(false);

  const handleGenerateSampleReport = () => {
    generateReportCardPDF({
      tenant: {
        name: user?.institution_name || "Institutional Campus",
        code: user?.institution_code || "CAMPUS-01",
      },
      student: {
        name: user?.name || "Student Member",
        roll_number: user?.personal_code || "ENR-01",
        class: user?.class_name || "Academic Batch",
      },
      academicTerm: "Term Comprehensive Examination",
      attendanceRate: "100%",
    });
    showToast("Official Academic Transcript PDF generated successfully!", "success");
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchTeacherStats = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      const schoolId = (user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();
      try {
        // 1. Local directory check
        let localDir = [];
        try {
          const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${schoolId}`);
          if (raw) localDir = JSON.parse(raw);
        } catch (e) {}

        const localStudents = localDir.filter((m) => (m.role || "student").toLowerCase() === "student");
        const studentSet = new Set(localStudents.map((s) => s.roll_number || s.personal_code || s.id));

        // 2. Classes set
        const classSet = new Set();
        localStudents.forEach((s) => {
          if (s.class_name) classSet.add(s.class_name);
        });

        let dbHomeworkCount = 0;

        if (supabase) {
          try {
            const [studentsRes, hwRes] = await Promise.all([
              supabase.from("students").select("id, roll_number, class_name").eq("school_id", schoolId),
              supabase.from("homework").select("id", { count: "exact" }).eq("school_id", schoolId),
            ]);
            if (studentsRes.data) {
              studentsRes.data.forEach((s) => {
                if (s.roll_number || s.id) studentSet.add(s.roll_number || s.id);
                if (s.class_name) classSet.add(s.class_name);
              });
            }
            dbHomeworkCount = hwRes.count ?? hwRes.data?.length ?? 0;
          } catch (dbErr) {
            console.warn("Teacher stats query notice:", dbErr);
          }
        }

        // Fetch real class tests for teacher
        let teacherTests = [];
        try {
          teacherTests = await getClassTestsForTeacher({ schoolId, actor: user });
        } catch {}

        const createdCount = teacherTests.length;
        const awaitingCount = teacherTests.filter((t) => t.status !== "published").length;
        const publishedCount = teacherTests.filter((t) => t.status === "published").length;

        setStats({
          classesCount: classSet.size,
          studentsCount: studentSet.size,
          homeworkCount: dbHomeworkCount,
          testsCreated: createdCount,
          testsAwaitingMarks: awaitingCount,
          testsPublished: publishedCount,
        });

        // 1. Fetch Class Attendance Trend
        let attPoints = [];
        try {
          const rawAtt = localStorage.getItem(`erp_attendance_${schoolId}`);
          if (rawAtt) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(rawAtt);
            const byDate = {};
            parsed.forEach((item) => {
              const d = item.date || item.created_at?.split("T")[0] || "Recent";
              if (!byDate[d]) byDate[d] = { date: d, present: 0, total: 0 };
              byDate[d].total += 1;
              if (String(item.status).toLowerCase() === "present") byDate[d].present += 1;
            });
            attPoints = Object.values(byDate)
              .slice(-7)
              .map((b) => ({
                date: b.date.length > 5 ? b.date.slice(5) : b.date,
                rate: b.total > 0 ? Math.round((b.present / b.total) * 100) : 0,
              }));
          }
        } catch {}
        setClassAttendanceTrend(attPoints);

        // 2. Fetch Examination Performance & Subject Marks from real tests
        const examPoints = teacherTests.slice(-6).map((t) => ({
          testName: t.title || t.subject || "Test",
          classAvg: t.highest_score !== null && t.max_score ? Math.round((Number(t.highest_score) / Number(t.max_score)) * 100) : 0,
        }));
        setExamPerformanceData(examPoints);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Error loading teacher stats:", err);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchTeacherStats();
    window.addEventListener("erp-directory-updated", fetchTeacherStats);
    window.addEventListener("erp-tests-updated", fetchTeacherStats);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("erp-directory-updated", fetchTeacherStats);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-tests-updated", fetchTeacherStats);
    };
  }, [user?.institution_code, user?.school_id]);

  const teacherActions = [
    {
      name: "Mark Attendance",
      desc: "Live daily roll call register",
      icon: "✅",
      color: "from-emerald-500/20 to-teal-500/10 text-emerald-400 border-emerald-500/30",
      path: "/teacher/attendance",
    },
    {
      name: "Publish Homework",
      desc: "Assignment manager & deadlines",
      icon: "📚",
      color: "from-blue-500/20 to-cyan-500/10 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30",
      path: "/teacher/homework",
    },
    {
      name: "Timed Online Exams",
      desc: "Author MCQ papers & view auto-scores",
      icon: "🎯",
      color: "from-purple-500/20 to-indigo-500/10 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30",
      path: "/teacher/exams",
    },
    {
      name: "Classroom Batches",
      desc: "Batch schedules & strength",
      icon: "🏫",
      color: "from-purple-500/20 to-fuchsia-500/10 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30",
      path: "/teacher/classes",
    },
    {
      name: "Analytics & Exam Papers",
      desc: "Student pass ratios & test sources",
      icon: "📊",
      color: "from-amber-500/20 to-orange-500/10 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/30",
      path: "/teacher/analytics",
    },
    {
      name: "Curriculum Planner",
      desc: "Term lesson plans & faculty tasks",
      icon: "📝",
      color: "from-indigo-500/20 to-blue-500/10 text-indigo-400 border-indigo-500/30",
      path: "/teacher/planner",
    },
    {
      name: "Staff Messenger",
      desc: "Direct 1-to-1 faculty & HOD coordination",
      icon: "💬",
      color: "from-blue-500/20 to-indigo-500/10 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30",
      path: "/teacher/messages",
    },
    {
      name: "Academic Calendar",
      desc: "Campus schedule, terms & holidays",
      icon: "📅",
      color: "from-slate-500/20 to-gray-500/10 text-slate-300 border-slate-500/30",
      path: "/admin/calendar",
    },
    {
      name: "Class Tests & Marks",
      desc: "Rapid grading grid & publish test scores",
      icon: "📝",
      color: "from-cyan-500/20 to-blue-500/10 text-cyan-400 border-cyan-500/30",
      action: "openTestEntry",
    },
    {
      name: "QR Gate & Library Scanner",
      desc: "Camera scan student ID cards for library issue / entry",
      icon: "📷",
      color: "from-cyan-500/20 to-teal-500/10 text-cyan-400 border-cyan-500/30",
      action: "openScanner",
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="relative text-slate-200 min-h-full pb-10 font-sans">
      <div className="fixed top-0 right-10 w-96 h-96 bg-emerald-600/10 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none"></div>

      <div className="relative z-10 max-w-6xl mx-auto">
        {/* INSTITUTIONAL NOTICEBOARD CIRCULAR BANNER */}
        <NoticeBanner role="Teacher" schoolId={user?.school_id || user?.institution_code} />

        {/* HEADER */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-800/50 hover:border-cyan-500/30 transition-all duration-500 hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(6,182,212,0.15)] rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-2xl mb-8 flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-4 animate-fade-in-up stagger-1">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
              <span className="bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest">
                Faculty Portal
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-bold">
                {user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || "Campus Portal"}
              </span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-slate-200 to-slate-400">
              Welcome back, {user?.name || "Faculty Member"} 👋
            </h1>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">
              Manage student attendance, publish homework tasks, and monitor curriculum progress
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowTestModal(true)}
              className="bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-600 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-500 hover:to-blue-500 text-white border border-cyan-400/30 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/20 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>📝</span> Record Class Test Marks
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => navigate("/teacher/classes")}
              className="bg-blue-600/20 hover:bg-blue-600/40 text-blue-300 border border-blue-500/40 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>🗓️</span> Weekly Timetable
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowScannerModal(true)}
              className="bg-cyan-600/20 hover:bg-cyan-600/40 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>📷</span> Scan ID Card (QR)
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleGenerateSampleReport}
              className="bg-purple-600/20 hover:bg-purple-600/40 text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/40 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl font-bold text-xs transition-all flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>📜</span> Report Card (PDF)
            </button>
            <div className="text-right bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800 p-3 rounded-2xl hidden sm:block">
              <p className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Today's Date</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-black text-white">
                {new Date().toLocaleDateString(undefined, { dateStyle: "medium" })}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* DAILY CAMPUS PULSE RADAR */}
        <div className="mb-8">
          <CampusPulseCard schoolCode={user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || "CAMPUS-01"} />
        </div>

        {/* STATS */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-6 gap-4 mb-10 animate-fade-in-up stagger-2">
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <StatSkeleton />
              <StatSkeleton />
              <StatSkeleton />
              <StatSkeleton />
              <StatSkeleton />
              <StatSkeleton />
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/50 hover:border-cyan-400 dark:hover:border-cyan-500/30 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-sm dark:shadow-xl flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 border border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-500/10 dark:text-blue-400 dark:border-blue-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shadow-inner shrink-0">
                  🏫
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Batches
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xl font-black bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-cyan-600 dark:from-blue-400 dark:to-cyan-400 tracking-tight">
                    {stats.classesCount}
                  </p>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">Assigned classes</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/50 hover:border-purple-400 dark:hover:border-purple-500/30 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-sm dark:shadow-xl flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-purple-50 text-purple-600 border border-purple-200 dark:bg-purple-500/10 dark:text-purple-400 dark:border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shadow-inner shrink-0">
                  👥
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Students
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xl font-black bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-600 to-pink-600 dark:from-purple-400 dark:to-pink-400 tracking-tight">
                    {stats.studentsCount}
                  </p>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">Enrolled scholars</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/50 hover:border-amber-400 dark:hover:border-amber-500/30 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-sm dark:shadow-xl flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 border border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shadow-inner shrink-0">
                  ⏳
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Homework
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xl font-black bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-600 to-orange-600 dark:from-amber-400 dark:to-orange-400 tracking-tight">
                    {stats.homeworkCount}
                  </p>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">Active tasks</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div
                onClick={() => setShowTestModal(true)}
                className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/50 hover:border-cyan-400 dark:hover:border-cyan-500/40 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-sm dark:shadow-xl flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-cyan-50 text-cyan-600 border border-cyan-200 dark:bg-cyan-500/10 dark:text-cyan-400 dark:border-cyan-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shadow-inner shrink-0">
                  📝
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Tests Created
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xl font-black text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400 tracking-tight">
                    {stats.testsCreated}
                  </p>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">Unit assessments</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div
                onClick={() => setShowTestModal(true)}
                className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/50 hover:border-amber-400 dark:hover:border-amber-500/40 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-sm dark:shadow-xl flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 border border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shadow-inner shrink-0">
                  📋
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Awaiting Marks
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xl font-black text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 tracking-tight">
                    {stats.testsAwaitingMarks}
                  </p>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">Draft tests</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div
                onClick={() => setShowTestModal(true)}
                className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/50 hover:border-emerald-400 dark:hover:border-emerald-500/40 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-sm dark:shadow-xl flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 border border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shadow-inner shrink-0">
                  ✅
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Published
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-xl font-black text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 tracking-tight">
                    {stats.testsPublished}
                  </p>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 block mt-0.5">Results visible</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* TEACHER DATA VISUALIZATIONS */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-10 animate-fade-in-up stagger-3">
          {/* CHART 1: ATTENDANCE TREND */}
          <div className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/50 hover:border-cyan-400 dark:hover:border-cyan-500/30 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm dark:shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-4">
              <div>
                <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-50 text-cyan-700 border border-cyan-200 dark:bg-cyan-500/10 dark:border-cyan-400/30 dark:text-cyan-300 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                  <span>📅</span> Roll Call Telemetry
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Class Attendance Pacing</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Daily class attendance percentage across the last 7 sessions</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {classAttendanceTrend.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="h-56 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 p-6 space-y-2 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-tech-grid rounded-2xl">
                <span className="text-2xl opacity-60">📅</span>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">No Roll Call Submitted Yet</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 max-w-xs">Mark attendance for assigned batches to view attendance trends.</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="h-56 w-full">
                <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                  <LineChart data={classAttendanceTrend} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: -10, bottom: 0 }}>
                    <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(148,163,184,0.15)" />
                    <XAxis dataKey="date" stroke="#94A3B8" fontSize={10} tickLine={false} />
                    <YAxis stroke="#94A3B8" fontSize={10} tickLine={false} domain={[0, 100]} tickFormatter={(v) => `${v}%`} />
                    <Tooltip
                      contentStyle={{
                        backgroundColor: "#0F172A",
                        borderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",
                        borderRadius: "1rem",
                        fontSize: "12px",
                        color: "#FFFFFF",
                      }}
                      formatter={(v) => [`${v}% Attendance`, "Rate"]}
                    />
                    <Line type="monotone" dataKey="rate" stroke="#06B6D4" strokeWidth={3} dot={{ r: 4, fill: "#06B6D4" }} activeDot={{ r: 6 }} />
                  </LineChart>
                </ResponsiveContainer>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* CHART 2: RECENT CLASS TEST PERFORMANCE */}
          <div className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/50 hover:border-purple-400 dark:hover:border-purple-500/30 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm dark:shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-4">
              <div>
                <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200 dark:bg-purple-500/10 dark:border-purple-500/30 dark:text-purple-300 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                  <span>📝</span> Evaluation Marks
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Class Examination Performance</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Average score percentage across recent tests</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {examPerformanceData.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="h-56 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 p-6 space-y-2 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-tech-grid rounded-2xl">
                <span className="text-2xl opacity-60">📝</span>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">No Test Records Logged</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 max-w-xs">Record class tests to monitor score averages across terms.</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="h-56 w-full">
                <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                  <BarChart data={examPerformanceData} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: -15, bottom: 0 }}>
                    <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(148,163,184,0.15)" />
                    <XAxis dataKey="testName" stroke="#94A3B8" fontSize={10} tickLine={false} />
                    <YAxis stroke="#94A3B8" fontSize={10} tickLine={false} domain={[0, 100]} tickFormatter={(v) => `${v}%`} />
                    <Tooltip
                      contentStyle={{
                        backgroundColor: "#0F172A",
                        borderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",
                        borderRadius: "1rem",
                        fontSize: "12px",
                        color: "#FFFFFF",
                      }}
                      formatter={(v) => [`${v}% Average`, "Score"]}
                    />
                    <Bar dataKey="classAvg" name="Average %" fill="#8B5CF6" radius={[6, 6, 0, 0]} />
                  </BarChart>
                </ResponsiveContainer>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* QUICK ACTIONS */}
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight mb-6">Classroom & Academic Controls</h2>

            >

            <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-ping"></span>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight">Faculty Academic Calendar & Attendance Alerts</h2>
          </div>
          <SchoolCalendar viewMode="teacher" assignedClass={user?.class_name || "Class 10-A"} />
        </div>

        {/* STUDENT CERTIFICATE REQUESTS APPROVAL WORKFLOW */}
        <CertificateManagementCard mode="teacher" />

        <ClassTestEntry
          isOpen={showTestModal}
          onClose={() => setShowTestModal(false)}
        />

          <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50">
            <div className="max-w-2xl w-full">
              <QRScannerModule

                mode="library"
                onClose={() => setShowScannerModal(false)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

      showToast("Cannot request reversal: Target entry lacks a verified database UUID. Please ensure ledger is synchronized.", "error");
      return;

    setSubmittingReversal(true);

      if (supabase) {

            p_entry_id: reversalTarget.id,
            p_amount: Number(reversalAmount),
            p_reason: reversalReason,
          });

          if (error) {
            showToast(`Reversal request rejected by server: ${error.message}`, "error");
            setSubmittingReversal(false);
            return;

            setSubmittingReversal(false);

  useEffect(() => {

  const handleAddTransaction = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!formData.student_name || !formData.amount) {
      showToast("Please provide student name and amount", "error");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    const newTxn = {
      id: `TXN-${Date.now()}`,
      school_id: schoolId,
      student_name: formData.student_name.trim(),
      class_name: formData.class_name.trim() || "Class 10-A",
      amount: Number(formData.amount),
      status: formData.status,
      payment_mode: formData.payment_mode,
      date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    };

    try {
      if (supabase) {
        const { error: insertErr } = await supabase.from("fee_ledger").insert([newTxn]);
        if (insertErr) {
          console.error("Supabase fee_ledger insert error:", insertErr);
          throw insertErr;
        }
      }

      try {
        const tenantKey = `erp_fee_ledger_${schoolId}`;
        const savedTenantRaw = localStorage.getItem(tenantKey);
        const tenantList = savedTenantRaw ? JSON.parse(savedTenantRaw) : [];
        tenantList.unshift(newTxn);
        localStorage.setItem(tenantKey, JSON.stringify(tenantList));

        const savedRaw = localStorage.getItem("erp_fee_ledger");
        const globalList = savedRaw ? JSON.parse(savedRaw) : [];
        globalList.unshift(newTxn);
        localStorage.setItem("erp_fee_ledger", JSON.stringify(globalList));
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Local storage write notice:", e);
      }

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-fee-ledger-updated"));
      showToast(`Transaction of ₹${Number(formData.amount).toLocaleString()} recorded!`, "success");
      setFormData({
        student_name: "",
        class_name: "",
        amount: "",
        status: "paid",
        payment_mode: "Cash / Cheque",
      });
      fetchLedger();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Fee transaction submission error:", err);
      showToast(err.message || "Failed to record transaction in database.", "error");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const getSchoolUpi = () => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_school_upi_${schoolId}`);
      if (raw) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
        if (parsed.upiId) return parsed.upiId;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    return `${schoolId.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")}.edu@okaxis`;
  };

  const handleSendWhatsAppReminder = (item) => {
    const upi = getSchoolUpi();
    const instName = user?.school_name || schoolId;
    const msg = `📢 *Institutional Fee Notice - ${instName}*\n\nDear Parent/Student *${item.student_name}* (${item.class_name}),\n\nThis is a notification that your academic fee balance of *₹${Number(item.amount).toLocaleString()}* is pending settlement.\n\n💳 *Payment Details:*\n• Official School UPI ID: \`${upi}\`\n• Reference / Note: Student Name & Roll No.\n\nKindly complete the settlement and forward the 12-digit UTR bank reference number to the Accounts Department.\n\n*Accounts & Finance Office*\n${instName}`;
    const url = `https://wa.me/?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`;
    window.open(url, "_blank");
  };

  const handleBroadcastWhatsApp = () => {
    const pendingRows = ledger.filter((r) => (r.status || "").toLowerCase() !== "paid");
    if (pendingRows.length === 0) {
      showToast("No pending fee defaulters found in the ledger!", "info");
      return;
    }
    const upi = getSchoolUpi();
    const instName = user?.school_name || schoolId;
    const totalPending = pendingRows.reduce((acc, r) => acc + (Number(r.amount) || 0), 0);
    const msg = `📢 *Institutional Fee Dues Advisory - ${instName}*\n\nAttention Parents and Guardians,\n\nOur treasury reconciliation shows pending fee balances across *${pendingRows.length} student records* totaling *₹${totalPending.toLocaleString()}*.\n\n💳 *Direct Settlement Mode:*\n• School UPI ID: \`${upi}\`\n• Online Portal: Pay via Razorpay SSL Gateway\n\nPlease ensure pending dues are cleared promptly to maintain uninterrupted academic portal access.\n\n*Accounts & Treasury Office*\n${instName}`;
    const url = `https://wa.me/?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`;
    window.open(url, "_blank");
  };

  const handleDownloadTaxInvoice = (item) => {
    try {
      generateFeeInvoicePDF({
        tenant: {
          name: user?.school_name || user?.institution_name || "Institutional Campus",
          code: schoolId,
          address: user?.address || "Flat number 201, Jivdani Chaya, Mahim Highway, Palghar 401404",
          email: user?.email || "accounts@campus.edu",
        },
        student: {
          name: item.student_name,
          roll_number: item.roll_number || item.id || "STU-001",
          class: item.class_name || "Class 10",
        },
        payment: {
          invoiceNo: `INV-${String(item.id || item.receipt_number || "REC001").slice(-6)}`,
          date: item.date || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
          amount: item.amount,
          payment_mode: item.payment_mode || "Cash / Cheque",
          transactionId: item.razorpay_payment_id || item.id || "TXN-DIRECT",
          title: "Tuition & Institutional Fee Settlement",
        },
      });
      showToast(`Tax invoice generated for ${item.student_name}!`, "success");
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Tax invoice error:", err);
      showToast("Failed to generate PDF tax invoice", "error");
    }
  };

  const handleApprovePayment = async (item) => {
    try {
      // 1. Update in Supabase fee_ledger & fees tables with strict row scoping
      if (supabase) {
        if (item.id && !String(item.id).startsWith("TXN-")) {
          const { error: upErr1 } = await supabase
            .from("fee_ledger")
            .update({ status: "completed" })
            .eq("id", item.id)
            .eq("school_id", schoolId);
          if (upErr1) throw upErr1;
        } else if (item.utr || item.razorpay_payment_id) {
          const { error: upErr2 } = await supabase
            .from("fee_ledger")
            .update({ status: "completed" })
            .eq("razorpay_payment_id", item.utr || item.razorpay_payment_id)
            .eq("school_id", schoolId);
          if (upErr2) throw upErr2;
        }

        if (item.student_id) {
          const { error: upErr3 } = await supabase
            .from("fees")
            .update({ status: "paid" })
            .eq("school_id", schoolId)
            .eq("student_id", item.student_id);
          if (upErr3) throw upErr3;
        }
      }

      // 2. Update local storage for immediate offline and UI reconciliation
      const updateLocalList = (key) => {
        try {
          const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
          if (raw) {
            const list = JSON.parse(raw);
            const updated = list.map((r) => {
              if (
                r.id === item.id ||
                (r.utr && (r.utr === item.utr || r.utr === item.razorpay_payment_id)) ||
                (r.razorpay_payment_id && (r.razorpay_payment_id === item.utr || r.razorpay_payment_id === item.razorpay_payment_id))
              ) {
                return { ...r, status: "paid" };
              }
              return r;
            });
            localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(updated));
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      };

      updateLocalList(`erp_fee_ledger_${schoolId}`);
      updateLocalList("erp_fee_ledger");

      // 3. Issue and download Official Tax Invoice PDF automatically
      try {
        generateFeeInvoicePDF({
          tenant: {
            name: user?.school_name || user?.institution_name || "Institutional Campus",
            code: schoolId,
            address: user?.address || "Flat number 201, Jivdani Chaya, Mahim Highway, Palghar 401404",
            email: user?.email || "accounts@campus.edu",
          },
          student: {
            name: item.student_name,
            roll_number: item.roll_number || item.id || "STU-001",
            class: item.class_name || "Class 10",
          },
          payment: {
            invoiceNo: `INV-${String(item.id || item.receipt_number || "REC001").slice(-6)}`,
            date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
            amount: item.amount,
            payment_mode: item.payment_mode || "School UPI QR",
            transactionId: item.utr || item.razorpay_payment_id || item.id || "TXN-VERIFIED",
            title: item.title || "Tuition & Institutional Fee Settlement",
          },
        });
      } catch (pdfErr) {
        console.warn("Auto-PDF generation notice:", pdfErr);
      }

      // 4. Send payment confirmed WhatsApp notification
      try {
        notifyFeePaymentConfirmed({
          studentName: item.student_name,
          amount: item.amount,
          invoiceNo: `INV-${String(item.id || Date.now()).slice(-6)}`,
          guardianPhone: item.phone || "9876543210",
          schoolName: user?.school_name || schoolId,
          date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
          paymentId: item.utr || item.razorpay_payment_id || "VERIFIED-UTR",
        });
      } catch (waErr) {}

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-fee-ledger-updated"));
      showToast(`Payment of ₹${Number(item.amount).toLocaleString()} approved! Official Tax Invoice generated & downloaded.`, "success");
      fetchLedger();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Payment approval error:", err);
      showToast("Error approving payment", "error");
    }
  };

  const handleRejectPayment = async (item) => {
    try {
      if (supabase) {
        const { error: rejErr } = await supabase
          .from("fee_ledger")
          .update({ status: "rejected" })
          .or(`id.eq.${item.id},razorpay_payment_id.eq.${item.utr || item.razorpay_payment_id}`);
        if (rejErr) throw rejErr;
      }

      const updateLocalList = (key) => {
        try {
          const raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
          if (raw) {
            const list = JSON.parse(raw);
            const updated = list.map((r) => {
              if (
                r.id === item.id ||
                (r.utr && (r.utr === item.utr || r.utr === item.razorpay_payment_id)) ||
                (r.razorpay_payment_id && (r.razorpay_payment_id === item.utr || r.razorpay_payment_id === item.razorpay_payment_id))
              ) {
                return { ...r, status: "rejected" };
              }
              return r;
            });
            localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(updated));
          }
        } catch (e) {}
      };

      updateLocalList(`erp_fee_ledger_${schoolId}`);
      updateLocalList("erp_fee_ledger");

      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-fee-ledger-updated"));
      showToast(`Payment receipt marked as rejected.`, "info");
      fetchLedger();
    } catch (err) {
      showToast("Error rejecting payment", "error");
    }
  };

  // Filtered transactions
  const filteredLedger = ledger.filter((item) => {
    let matchesStatus = true;
    const st = (item.status || "").toLowerCase();
    if (filterStatus === "paid") {
      matchesStatus = st === "paid" || st === "completed";
    } else if (filterStatus === "pending") {
      matchesStatus = st === "pending";
    } else if (filterStatus === "pending_verification") {
      matchesStatus = st === "pending_verification";
    }

    const matchesSearch =
      (item.student_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      (item.class_name || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      String(item.utr || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
      String(item.razorpay_payment_id || "").toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());

    return matchesStatus && matchesSearch;
  });

  return (
    <div className="relative text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 min-h-full pb-10 font-sans transition-colors duration-200">
      <div className="fixed top-0 left-10 w-96 h-96 bg-emerald-600/10 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none"></div>

      <div className="relative z-10 max-w-6xl mx-auto">

            <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">

            >
              💬 Staff Messenger
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => navigate("/accountant/payroll")}
              className="text-xs bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-500 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/20 cursor-pointer"
            >
              💵 Staff Payroll & Payslips
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={fetchLedger}
              disabled={loading}
              className="text-xs bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 dark:border-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold transition-all duration-200 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer shadow-sm"
            >
              {loading ? "Syncing..." : "🔄 Refresh Ledger"}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* FINANCIAL METRICS ROW */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 mb-8 animate-fade-in-up stagger-1">
          {loading ? (

                    <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: "11px", paddingTop: "6px" }} />
                  </PieChart>
                </ResponsiveContainer>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* CHART 4: PAYMENT STATUS BREAKDOWN */}
          <div className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/50 hover:border-indigo-400 dark:hover:border-indigo-500/30 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm dark:shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-4">
              <div>
                <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200 dark:bg-indigo-500/10 dark:border-indigo-500/30 dark:text-indigo-300 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                  <span>📊</span> Invoice Status
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Payment Status Roster</h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Total transaction counts by clearance stage</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {ledger.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="h-56 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 p-6 space-y-2 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-tech-grid rounded-2xl">
                <span className="text-2xl opacity-60">📊</span>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">No Invoices Available</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 max-w-xs">Invoices and receipts will appear in this status chart.</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="h-56 w-full">
                <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                  <BarChart data={paymentStatusData} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: -15, bottom: 0 }}>
                    <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(148,163,184,0.15)" />
                    <XAxis dataKey="status" stroke="#94A3B8" fontSize={10} tickLine={false} />
                    <YAxis stroke="#94A3B8" fontSize={10} tickLine={false} allowDecimals={false} />
                    <Tooltip
                      contentStyle={{
                        backgroundColor: "#0F172A",
                        borderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",
                        borderRadius: "1rem",
                        fontSize: "12px",
                        color: "#FFFFFF",
                      }}
                      formatter={(v) => [`${v} Transactions`, "Count"]}
                    />
                    <Bar dataKey="count" name="Transactions" radius={[6, 6, 0, 0]} />
                  </BarChart>
                </ResponsiveContainer>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 animate-fade-in-up stagger-2">
          {/* LEFT: MANUAL FEE ENTRY FORM */}
          <div className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/50 hover:border-emerald-400 dark:hover:border-emerald-500/30 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm dark:shadow-2xl h-fit">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Terminal Input</span>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Log Fee Settlement</h2>
              </div>
              <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 border border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:border-emerald-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold shadow-inner">
                ✍️
              </span>
            </div>
            <form onSubmit={handleAddTransaction} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                  Student Full Name *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="e.g., Rohan Mehta"
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 text-sm transition-all focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20"
                  value={formData.student_name}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, student_name: e.target.value })}
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                  Class / Section
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  required
                  placeholder="e.g., 10-A, 12-Sci"
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 text-sm transition-all focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20"
                  value={formData.class_name}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, class_name: e.target.value })}
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                  Amount (₹) *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  required
                  placeholder="e.g., 5000"
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 text-sm font-mono font-bold transition-all focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20"
                  value={formData.amount}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, amount: e.target.value })}
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                  Payment Status
                </label>
                <select
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 font-bold text-sm transition-all focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20"
                  value={formData.status}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, status: e.target.value })}
                >
                  <option value="paid">Paid (Receipt Cleared)</option>
                  <option value="pending">Pending (Defaulter Due)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                  Payment Mode
                </label>
                <select
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500 font-bold text-sm transition-all focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20"
                  value={formData.payment_mode}
                  onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, payment_mode: e.target.value })}
                >
                  <option value="School UPI QR">School UPI QR</option>
                  <option value="Cash / Cheque">Cash / Cheque</option>
                  <option value="Online (Razorpay)">Online (Razorpay)</option>
                  <option value="Bank Transfer (NEFT/UPI)">Bank Transfer (NEFT/UPI)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting}
                className="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 hover:from-emerald-500 hover:to-teal-500 text-white font-extrabold py-3.5 rounded-xl shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/30 transition-all duration-200 mt-4 disabled:opacity-50 cursor-pointer hover:-translate-y-0.5"
              >
                {submitting ? "Logging Transaction..." : "Record Transaction 🚀"}
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* RIGHT: BLOOMBERG-STYLE TREASURY LEDGER */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/50 hover:border-cyan-400 dark:hover:border-cyan-500/30 transition-all duration-300 rounded-3xl shadow-sm dark:shadow-2xl overflow-hidden h-fit">
            <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/80 bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-slate-950/40 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-50 dark:bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-200 dark:border-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase font-bold mb-1">
                      <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-pulse"></span>
                      <span>BLOOMBERG FINTECH TERMINAL</span>
                    </div>
                    <h2 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Live Institutional Treasury Ledger</h2>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleBroadcastWhatsApp}
                    title="Send WhatsApp notice to all pending fee defaulters"
                    className="bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-600/15 dark:hover:bg-emerald-600/25 dark:border-emerald-500/30 dark:text-emerald-300 font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all duration-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm cursor-pointer hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                  >
                    <span>📢</span>
                    <span>Broadcast WhatsApp</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setFilterStatus("all")}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      filterStatus === "all" ? "bg-cyan-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-cyan-600/30" : "bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-950/80 dark:border-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white"
                    }`}
                  >
                    All ({ledger.length})
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setFilterStatus("paid")}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      filterStatus === "paid" ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-emerald-600/30" : "bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-950/80 dark:border-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white"
                    }`}
                  >
                    Paid ({stats.totalPaidCount})
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setFilterStatus("pending")}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      filterStatus === "pending" ? "bg-amber-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-amber-600/30" : "bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-950/80 dark:border-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white"
                    }`}
                  >
                    Pending ({ledger.filter((r) => (r.status || "").toLowerCase() === "pending").length})
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setFilterStatus("pending_verification")}
                    className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer ${
                      filterStatus === "pending_verification"
                        ? "bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 font-black shadow-md shadow-amber-500/30"
                        : "bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 dark:bg-slate-950/80 dark:text-amber-400 dark:border-amber-500/30 dark:hover:bg-slate-900"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span>⚡ UPI Queue</span>
                    <span className="bg-amber-400/20 text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px]">
                      {stats.pendingVerificationCount || 0}
                    </span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* SEARCH INPUT */}
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search ledger by student name, class, or UTR number..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500 text-sm transition-all focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500/20"
              />
            </div>

            {loading ? (
              <div className="p-6">
                <TableSkeleton rows={5} cols={4} />
              </div>
            ) : filteredLedger.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="p-12 text-center text-slate-400 bg-tech-grid">
                <p className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-base">No transactions found.</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Transactions recorded here or paid online via Razorpay appear live.</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto w-full">
                <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-slate-950/60">
                      <th className="p-4 pl-6">Student & Class</th>
                      <th className="p-4">Amount</th>
                      <th className="p-4">Payment Mode</th>
                      <th className="p-4 text-center">Status</th>
                      <th className="p-4">Date</th>
                      <th className="p-4 text-right pr-6">Actions</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-200 dark:divide-slate-800/60 text-sm">
                    {filteredLedger.map((item, idx) => {
                      const isPaid = (item.status || "").toLowerCase() === "paid";
                      const isPendingVerification = (item.status || "").toLowerCase() === "pending_verification";

                      return (
                        <tr
                          key={item.id}
                          className={`hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/40 transition-colors duration-150 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800/40 ${
                            idx % 2 === 1 ? "bg-slate-50/40 dark:bg-slate-900/20" : "bg-transparent"
                          }`}
                        >
                          <td className="p-4 pl-6">
                            <p className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{item.student_name}</p>
                            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Class {item.class_name}</p>
                            {item.utr && (
                              <p className="text-[11px] font-mono text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400 mt-0.5">
                                UTR: {item.utr}
                              </p>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-4">
                            <span className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-base font-mono">
                              ₹{Number(item.amount).toLocaleString()}
                            </span>
                            {item.is_partial && (
                              <span className="block text-[10px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 font-medium">
                                Partial (Due: ₹{Number(item.remaining_balance || 0).toLocaleString()})
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-4 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 text-xs">
                            <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
                              <span className="bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-mono">
                                {item.payment_mode}
                              </span>
                              {(item.screenshot_data || item.screenshot) && (
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  onClick={() => setPreviewReceipt(item)}
                                  className="text-[11px] text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400 hover:underline font-semibold flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                                >
                                  <Eye className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  <span>View Screenshot</span>
                                </button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-4 text-center">
                            <span
                              className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-mono font-bold uppercase ${
                                isPaid
                                  ? "bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20 shadow-sm"
                                  : isPendingVerification
                                  ? "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20 animate-pulse shadow-sm"
                                  : "bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/20 shadow-sm"
                              }`}
                            >
                              {isPaid ? "Verified" : isPendingVerification ? "Pending Approval" : "Pending Due"}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-4 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs font-mono">{item.date}</td>
                          <td className="p-4 text-right pr-6">
                            {isPendingVerification ? (
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => handleApprovePayment(item)}
                                  className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-black transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1 shadow-md shadow-emerald-900/30 hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                                  title="Approve settlement and issue official Tax Invoice"
                                >
                                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  <span>Approve & Invoice</span>
                                </button>
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => handleRejectPayment(item)}
                                  className="px-2 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-600/20 dark:hover:bg-rose-600/30 dark:border-rose-500/40 dark:text-rose-300 text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                                  title="Reject transaction"
                                >
                                  <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  <span>Reject</span>
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            ) : isPaid ? (
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => handleDownloadTaxInvoice(item)}
                                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-600/20 dark:hover:bg-blue-600/30 dark:border-blue-500/40 dark:text-blue-300 text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                                  title="Download Tax Invoice PDF"
                                >
                                  <span>🧾</span>
                                  <span>Tax Invoice</span>
                                </button>
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => handleInitiateReversal(item)}
                                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200 dark:bg-amber-600/20 dark:hover:bg-amber-600/30 dark:border-amber-500/40 dark:text-amber-300 text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1 hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                                  title="Request Maker-Checker Credit Note / Reversal from Principal"
                                >
                                  <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  <span>Reversal</span>
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            ) : (
                              <button
                                onClick={() => handleSendWhatsAppReminder(item)}
                                className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-600/20 dark:hover:bg-emerald-600/30 dark:border-emerald-500/40 dark:text-emerald-300 text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm hover:-translate-y-0.5"
                                title="Send Reminder via WhatsApp"
                              >
                                <span>📲</span>
                                <span>Remind WhatsApp</span>
                              </button>
                            )}
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* PREDICTIVE FEE DEFAULTER RISK RADAR */}
        <FeeRiskRadar schoolCode={schoolId} />

        {/* 3-COLUMN BANK RECONCILIATION WORKBENCH & TALLY/GST ENGINE */}
        <BankReconciliationWorkbench schoolCode={schoolId} />
      </div>

      {/* MAKER-CHECKER REVERSAL & CREDIT NOTE REQUEST MODAL */}
      {reversalTarget && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1E293B] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full p-6 space-y-4 shadow-2xl relative">
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pb-3">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                  Maker-Checker Dual Control
                </span>
                <h3 className="font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-base">Request Fee Reversal / Credit Note</h3>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setReversalTarget(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg text-lg cursor-pointer"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleConfirmReversalRequest} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 space-y-1">
                <p className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm">{reversalTarget.student_name}</p>
                <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{reversalTarget.class_name} • Receipt: #{reversalTarget.id}</p>
                <p className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-mono font-bold">Original Settled Amount: ₹{Number(reversalTarget.amount).toLocaleString()}</p>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                  Adjustment Amount (₹) *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  required
                  value={reversalAmount}
                  onChange={(e) => setReversalAmount(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-400 font-bold"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                  Reason for Reversal / Adjustment *
                </label>
                <select
                  value={reversalReason}
                  onChange={(e) => setReversalReason(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-400"
                >
                  <option value="Scholarship / Fee Concession">Scholarship / Fee Concession Granted</option>
                  <option value="Duplicate Payment Refund">Duplicate Payment by Parent</option>
                  <option value="Incorrect Amount Entered">Clerical Error / Incorrect Billing</option>
                  <option value="Sibling Concession">Sibling Discount Adjustment</option>
                  <option value="Withdrawal Settlement">Mid-term Scholar Relocation / Transfer</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/20 border border-amber-300 dark:border-amber-500/30 text-[11px] text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200">

                <button

                >

      )}

      {/* SCREENSHOT LIGHTBOX MODAL */}

                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-mono">{previewReceipt.student_name} • {previewReceipt.class_name}</p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setPreviewReceipt(null)}
                className="text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg text-lg cursor-pointer"
              >

              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl p-4 text-center border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
              {previewReceipt.screenshot_data ? (
                <img
                  src={previewReceipt.screenshot_data}
                  alt="Payment Screenshot"
                  className="max-h-80 mx-auto rounded-xl object-contain border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700"
                />
              ) : (
                <div className="py-12 text-slate-400 flex flex-col items-center gap-2">
                  <ImageIcon className="w-12 h-12 stroke-[1.5]" />
                  <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">Attached File: {previewReceipt.screenshot || "Receipt_Proof.jpg"}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-500">Verified digital UTR reference attached below.</span>

              <div>

              <div>

                <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white text-sm">₹{Number(previewReceipt.amount).toLocaleString()}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-3 pt-2">
              {(previewReceipt.status || "").toLowerCase() === "pending_verification" && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleApprovePayment(previewReceipt);
                    setPreviewReceipt(null);
                  }}
                  className="flex-1 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-black py-3 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-emerald-900/30"
                >
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Approve & Issue Tax Invoice</span>
                </button>
              )}
              <button
                onClick={() => setPreviewReceipt(null)}
                className="bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:hover:bg-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold px-4 py-3 rounded-xl text-xs transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                Close Preview
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useContext, useRef } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import {
  ResponsiveContainer,
  BarChart,
  Bar,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
  Tooltip,
  CartesianGrid,
} from "recharts";
import NoticeBanner from "../Components/NoticeBanner";
