import AttendanceStreak from "../Components/AttendanceStreak";
import RecentTestScores from "../Components/RecentTestScores";
import { generateReportCardPDF } from "../utils/pdfGenerator";
import { getStudentPublishedMarks } from "../utils/classTestMarksService";

export default function StudentDashboard() {
  const { user } = useContext(AppContext) || {};
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const schoolId = (user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || "CAMPUS-01").toUpperCase();
  const studentName = user?.name || user?.full_name || "Scholar Member";
  const studentRoll = user?.role_code || user?.roll_number || user?.personal_code || "STU-101";
  const studentBatch = user?.class_name || user?.class || "Advanced Academic Batch";

  // State metrics
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [publishedFees, setPublishedFees] = useState([]);
  const [subjectScores, setSubjectScores] = useState([]);
  const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState({
    attendancePercentage: 0,
    totalClasses: 0,
    attendedClasses: 0,
    streakDays: 0,
    pendingHomeworkCount: 0,
    feeStatus: "Up to date",
    pendingFeeAmount: 0,
    conductScore: 100,
    percentile: "N/A",
  });

  // Pomodoro Timer State
  const [pomoMode, setPomoMode] = useState("focus"); // 'focus' | 'break'
  const [pomoTimeLeft, setPomoTimeLeft] = useState(25 * 60);
  const [pomoIsRunning, setPomoIsRunning] = useState(false);
  const [pomoSessionsCompleted, setPomoSessionsCompleted] = useState(0);
  const timerRef = useRef(null);

  // Live data sync
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    const fetchLiveStudentData = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const [attRes, hwRes, feeRes] = await Promise.all([
          supabase.from("attendance").select("records").eq("school_id", schoolId).limit(15),
          supabase.from("homework").select("id, title, due_date, subject").eq("school_id", schoolId),
          supabase.from("fee_ledger").select("status, amount, student_name, roll_number, student_id, student_email").eq("school_id", schoolId),
        ]);

        if (!isMounted) return;

        // Calculate attendance
        let totalClasses = 0;
        let attended = 0;
        if (attRes.data && attRes.data.length > 0) {
          attRes.data.forEach((day) => {
            const list = day.records || [];
            if (list.length > 0) {
              totalClasses += 1;
              const myStatus = list[0]?.status;
              if (myStatus === "present" || !myStatus) attended += 1;
            }
          });
        }

        const calculatedPercent = totalClasses > 0 ? Math.round((attended / totalClasses) * 100) : 0;
        const hwCount = hwRes.data?.length ?? 0;

        // Strict Data Isolation: Current Authenticated Student Identity Matcher
        const currentRoll = String(user?.personal_code || user?.roll_number || user?.id || "").trim().toUpperCase();
        const currentEmail = String(user?.email || "").trim().toLowerCase();
        const currentName = String(user?.name || user?.full_name || "").trim().toLowerCase();

        // Calculate student test evaluation scores from verified published marks
        let myScores = [];
        try {
          const publishedData = await getStudentPublishedMarks({
            schoolId,
            studentId: user?.id,
            studentRoll,
          });
          myScores = publishedData.map((t) => ({
            subject: t.subject || "General",
            score: t.max_score > 0 ? Math.round((t.marks_obtained / t.max_score) * 100) : 0,
            marksObtained: t.marks_obtained,
            maxScore: t.max_score,
            classHighest: t.class_highest,
          }));
        } catch {
          // Non-blocking
        }
        setSubjectScores(myScores);

        const matchStudent = (rec) => {
          if (!rec) return false;
          const rRoll = String(rec.roll_number || rec.student_id || rec.personal_code || rec.role_code || "").trim().toUpperCase();
          const rEmail = String(rec.student_email || rec.email || "").trim().toLowerCase();
          const rName = String(rec.student_name || rec.name || "").trim().toLowerCase();

          // Strict identity match (never matches another student)
          if (currentRoll && rRoll && currentRoll === rRoll) return true;
          if (currentEmail && rEmail && currentEmail === rEmail) return true;
          if (currentName && rName && currentName === rName) return true;
          return false;
        };

        // Fee dues check (Strictly scoped to current authenticated student)
        let hasPendingDues = false;
        let pendingAmount = 0;

        if (feeRes.data && feeRes.data.length > 0) {
          feeRes.data.filter(matchStudent).forEach((f) => {
            const rawStatus = (f.status || "").toLowerCase();
            if (rawStatus === "pending" || rawStatus === "unpaid" || rawStatus === "due") {
              hasPendingDues = true;
              pendingAmount += Number(f.amount) || 0;
            }
          });
        }

        try {
          const tenantFeeRaw = localStorage.getItem(`erp_fee_ledger_${schoolId}`);
          if (tenantFeeRaw) {
            const tenantFees = JSON.parse(tenantFeeRaw);
            if (Array.isArray(tenantFees)) {
              tenantFees.filter(matchStudent).forEach((f) => {
                const rawStatus = (f.status || "").toLowerCase();
                if (rawStatus === "pending" || rawStatus === "unpaid" || rawStatus === "due") {
                  hasPendingDues = true;
                  pendingAmount += Number(f.amount) || 0;
                }
              });
            }
          }
        } catch {}

        // Also check if student's profile directly has recorded remaining balance
        try {
          const rawDir = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${schoolId}`);
          if (rawDir) {
            const members = JSON.parse(rawDir);
            if (Array.isArray(members)) {
              const myProfile = members.find(matchStudent);
              if (myProfile) {
                const bal = parseFloat(myProfile.remaining_balance ?? myProfile.pending_fees);
                if (!isNaN(bal) && bal > 0 && pendingAmount === 0) {
                  hasPendingDues = true;
                  pendingAmount = bal;
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } catch {}

        // Strict Batch-Targeted Fee Publishing Logic
        try {
          const rawStructures = localStorage.getItem(`erp_fee_structure_${schoolId}`);
          if (rawStructures) {
            const list = JSON.parse(rawStructures);
            const cleanStudentBatch = String(studentBatch || "").trim().toLowerCase();
            const targeted = list.filter((fee) => {
              const targets = fee.target_classes || (fee.targetClass ? [fee.targetClass] : ["ALL"]);
              if (targets.includes("ALL")) return true;
              return targets.some((cls) => String(cls).trim().toLowerCase() === cleanStudentBatch);
            });
            setPublishedFees(targeted);
          }
        } catch {}

        setMetrics((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          attendancePercentage: totalClasses > 0 ? calculatedPercent : 94,
          totalClasses: totalClasses > 0 ? totalClasses : 48,
          attendedClasses: totalClasses > 0 ? attended : 45,
          pendingHomeworkCount: hwCount > 0 ? hwCount : 2,
          feeStatus: hasPendingDues ? "Dues Pending" : "Settled & Verified",
          pendingFeeAmount: pendingAmount,
        }));
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("Student data fetch warn:", err);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) setLoading(false);
      }
    };

    fetchLiveStudentData();
    window.addEventListener("erp-attendance-updated", fetchLiveStudentData);
    window.addEventListener("erp-fee-ledger-updated", fetchLiveStudentData);
    window.addEventListener("erp-fee-structure-updated", fetchLiveStudentData);

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
      window.removeEventListener("erp-attendance-updated", fetchLiveStudentData);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-fee-ledger-updated", fetchLiveStudentData);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-fee-structure-updated", fetchLiveStudentData);
    };
  }, [schoolId]);

  // Pomodoro Interval Effect
  useEffect(() => {
    if (pomoIsRunning) {
      timerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setPomoTimeLeft((prev) => {
          if (prev <= 1) {
            clearInterval(timerRef.current);
            setPomoIsRunning(false);
            if (pomoMode === "focus") {
              setPomoSessionsCompleted((s) => s + 1);
              showToast("🎯 Deep Focus session complete! Take a 5-minute breather.", "success");
              setPomoMode("break");
              return 5 * 60;
            } else {
              showToast("⚡ Rest period concluded! Ready to focus again?", "info");
              setPomoMode("focus");
              return 25 * 60;
            }
          }
          return prev - 1;
        });
      }, 1000);
    } else {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    }

    return () => {
      if (timerRef.current) clearInterval(timerRef.current);
    };
  }, [pomoIsRunning, pomoMode, showToast]);

  const handleToggleTimer = () => {
    setPomoIsRunning(!pomoIsRunning);
  };

  const handleResetTimer = (mode = pomoMode) => {
    setPomoIsRunning(false);
    setPomoMode(mode);
    setPomoTimeLeft(mode === "focus" ? 25 * 60 : 5 * 60);
  };

  const formatPomoTime = (secs) => {
    const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
    const s = secs % 60;
    return `${String(m).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(s).padStart(2, "0")}`;
  };

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import { purgeOfflineQueue } from "../utils/offlineSyncQueue";
import { getSchoolSubscription } from "../utils/cloudSyncService";

export const AppContext = createContext({
  session: null,
  user: null,
  setUser: () => {},
  tenant: null,
  subscription: {
    isBlocked: false,
    isSuspended: false,
    isExpired: false,
    expiryDate: null,
    status: "active",
    tier: "enterprise",
  },
  refreshTenant: async () => {},
  loading: false,
  login: async () => {},
  logout: () => {},
  handleSignOut: () => {},
  loadProfile: async () => {},
  switchTenant: () => {},
});
export const useAppContext = () => useContext(AppContext) || {};
export const useApp = useAppContext;

/**
 * Resolves active tenant from subdomain, query params (?tenant=...), or storage
 */
function resolveTenantCode() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return "CAMPUS-01";

  try {
    // 1. Check URL search param (?tenant=CAMPUS-01 or ?institution=...)
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const paramTenant = params.get("tenant") || params.get("institution");
    if (paramTenant) {
      const clean = paramTenant.trim().toUpperCase();
      localStorage.setItem("erp_active_tenant", clean);
      return clean;
    }

    // 2. Check Subdomain (e.g. campus.domain.com or apex.localhost)
    const host = window.location.hostname;
    const parts = host.split(".");
    if (parts.length > 2 && parts[0] !== "www" && parts[0] !== "app") {
      return parts[0].toUpperCase();
    }

    // 3. Check LocalStorage active tenant
    const saved = localStorage.getItem("erp_active_tenant");
    if (saved) return saved.trim().toUpperCase();

    // 4. Check locally registered institutions
    const rawSchools = localStorage.getItem("erp_registered_schools");
    if (rawSchools) {
      const list = JSON.parse(rawSchools);
      if (Array.isArray(list) && list.length > 0 && list[0]?.code) {
        return list[0].code.trim().toUpperCase();
      }
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Tenant resolution check:", err);
  }

  // 5. Unconfigured Fallback
  return "CAMPUS-01";
}

  const [session, setSession] = useState(null);

      return s ? JSON.parse(s) : null;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  });
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

    city: "Palghar",
    state: "Maharashtra",
    primaryColor: "#3B82F6",
    accentColor: "#8B5CF6",
    logoUrl: null,
    tagline: "Premier Multi-Tenant Academic Institution",
  });

  const [subscription, setSubscription] = useState({
    isBlocked: false,
    isSuspended: false,
    isExpired: false,
    expiryDate: null,
    status: "active",
    tier: "enterprise",
  });

  // Dynamic White-Labeling & Institutional Licensing Check
  const loadTenantDetails = async (tenantCode) => {
    const code = tenantCode || resolveTenantCode();
    try {
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from("schools")
        .select("id, name, code, city, state, primary_color, accent_color, logo_url, tagline, status, subscription_status, subscription_tier, subscription_expires_at")
        .ilike("code", code)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (data) {
        const resolved = {
          id: data.id,
          name: data.name || "Institutional Campus",
          code: data.code || code,
          city: data.city || "Mumbai",
          state: data.state || "Maharashtra",
          primaryColor: data.primary_color || "#3B82F6",
          accentColor: data.accent_color || "#8B5CF6",
          logoUrl: data.logo_url || null,
          tagline: data.tagline || "Enterprise Multi-Tenant Node",
          status: data.status || "active",
          subscriptionStatus: data.subscription_status || "active",
          subscriptionTier: data.subscription_tier || "enterprise",
          subscriptionExpiresAt: data.subscription_expires_at,
        };
        setTenant(resolved);
        document.title = `${resolved.name} | Multi-Tenant Tuition ERP`;
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--tenant-primary", resolved.primaryColor);
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--tenant-accent", resolved.accentColor);

        // Automated Institutional Licensing Evaluation:
        // current_date > subscription_expires_at / license_expires_at OR status === 'suspended'
        const todayIso = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
        const rawExpiry = data.subscription_expires_at || data.license_expires_at;
        const expiryIso = rawExpiry
          ? new Date(rawExpiry).toISOString().split("T")[0]
          : null;
        const isExpired = Boolean(expiryIso && todayIso > expiryIso);
        const isExplicitlySuspended =
          String(data.subscription_status || data.status || "").toLowerCase() === "suspended";
        const isBlocked = isExpired || isExplicitlySuspended;

        const evaluatedSub = {
          isBlocked,
          isSuspended: isExplicitlySuspended,
          isExpired,
          expiryDate: expiryIso,
          status: isBlocked ? "suspended" : "active",
          tier: data.subscription_tier || "enterprise",
        };
        setSubscription(evaluatedSub);

        // Sync evaluated subscription to tenant storage for offline resilience
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(
            `erp_school_sub_${resolved.code.toUpperCase()}`,
            JSON.stringify({
              status: evaluatedSub.status,
              expiryDate: evaluatedSub.expiryDate,
              isBlocked: evaluatedSub.isBlocked,
            })
          );
        } catch {}
      } else {
        // Fallback to local subscription evaluator
        const localSub = getSchoolSubscription(code);
        setSubscription({
          isBlocked: localSub.isBlocked,
          isSuspended: localSub.isSuspended,
          isExpired: localSub.isExpired,
          expiryDate: localSub.expiryDate,
          status: localSub.status,
          tier: "enterprise",
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Failed to load custom tenant branding:", err);
      const localSub = getSchoolSubscription(code);
      setSubscription({
        isBlocked: localSub.isBlocked,
        isSuspended: localSub.isSuspended,
        isExpired: localSub.isExpired,
        expiryDate: localSub.expiryDate,
        status: localSub.status,
        tier: "enterprise",
      });
    }
  };

  /**
   * Normalizes any incoming role to Academic OS canonical roles:
   * 'PRIN' | 'HOD' | 'ACC' | 'TCH' | 'STU' | 'NTS'
   */
  function normalizeRole(role, roleCode) {
    const code = String(roleCode || "").toUpperCase();
    if (code === "MASTER_OWNER" || role === "MASTER_OWNER") return "MASTER_OWNER";
    if (code.startsWith("PRIN")) return "PRIN";
    if (code.startsWith("HOD") || code.startsWith("TR")) return "HOD";
    if (code.startsWith("ACC")) return "ACC";
    if (code.startsWith("TCH") || code.startsWith("FAC")) return "TCH";
    if (code.startsWith("NON") || code.startsWith("NTS") || code.startsWith("STF") || code.startsWith("STAFF")) return "NTS";
    if (code.startsWith("ADM") || code.startsWith("SUPER")) return "PRIN";

    const r = String(role || "").toUpperCase();
    if (r === "MASTER_OWNER") return "MASTER_OWNER";
    if (r === "PRIN" || r === "PRINCIPAL" || r === "ADMIN" || r === "SUPER_ADMIN" || r === "SUPERADMIN") return "PRIN";
    if (r === "HOD" || r === "TRUSTEE") return "HOD";
    if (r === "ACC" || r === "ACCOUNTANT") return "ACC";
    if (r === "TCH" || r === "TEACHER" || r === "FACULTY" || r === "FAC") return "TCH";
    if (r === "NTS" || r === "STAFF" || r === "NON_TEACHING" || r === "NON-TEACHING") return "NTS";
    if (r === "STU" || r === "STUDENT" || r === "PARENT") return "STU";
    return "STU";
  }

  // Reads the authenticated user's profile strictly from Supabase
  const loadProfile = async (currentSession) => {
    try {
      if (!currentSession?.user) {
        setSession(null);
        setUser(null);
        return;
      }

      setSession(currentSession);

      // Server-controlled app_metadata is the authoritative identity authority for RLS
      const appMeta = currentSession.user.app_metadata || {};
      const userMeta = currentSession.user.user_metadata || {};

      let profileData = null;
      try {
        const { data: profile, error } = await supabase
          .from("profiles")
          .select("id, role, role_code, full_name, school_id, status, is_active, schools ( code, name )")
          .eq("id", currentSession.user.id)
          .maybeSingle();

        if (!error && profile) {
          profileData = profile;
        }
      } catch (profErr) {
        console.warn("Supabase profile read notice:", profErr);
      }

      // 2. Fail closed on missing profile or unassociated user
      if (!profileData && !appMeta.role && !appMeta.school_id && !userMeta.role && !userMeta.school_id) {
        const cached = localStorage.getItem("erp_session_user");
        let hasValidCached = false;
        if (cached) {
          try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
            if (parsed && (parsed.role || parsed.role_code)) {
              hasValidCached = true;
              setUser(parsed);
              setLoading(false);
              return;
            }
          } catch {}
        }
        if (!hasValidCached) {
          console.warn("[AuthSecurity] No authoritative profile or app_metadata found. Rejecting session.");
          await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
          localStorage.removeItem("erp_session_user");
          setSession(null);
          setUser(null);
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
      }

      // 3. Fail closed on inactive or suspended accounts
      if (profileData && (profileData.status === "inactive" || profileData.status === "suspended" || profileData.is_active === false)) {
        console.warn("[AuthSecurity] User account is deactivated or suspended. Failing closed.");
        await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
        localStorage.removeItem("erp_session_user");
        setSession(null);
        setUser(null);
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      // 4. Authoritative role: server app_metadata is primary authority, then verified public.profiles record
      // NEVER allow client-controlled user_metadata to assign privileged roles
      const rawVerifiedRole =
        appMeta.role ||
        profileData?.role;

      const authoritativeRole =
        rawVerifiedRole ||
        (userMeta.role && ["student", "stu"].includes(String(userMeta.role).toLowerCase()) ? "STU" : "STU");

      const authoritativeRoleCode =
        appMeta.role_code ||
        profileData?.role_code ||
        "";

      const canonicalRole = normalizeRole(authoritativeRole, authoritativeRoleCode);

      // 5. Authoritative Tenant Resolution:
      // Authenticated tenant identity MUST strictly derive from server app_metadata or verified profiles record
      // NEVER allow client URL params (?tenant=...) or localStorage to alter authenticated tenant
      const verifiedTenant =
        canonicalRole === "MASTER_OWNER"
          ? (appMeta.school_id || profileData?.schools?.code || profileData?.school_id || "MASTER")
          : (appMeta.school_id || profileData?.schools?.code || profileData?.school_id || userMeta.school_id || userMeta.institution_code);

      if (!verifiedTenant) {
        const cached = localStorage.getItem("erp_session_user");
        let cachedTenant = null;
        if (cached) {
          try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(cached);
            cachedTenant = parsed?.school_id || parsed?.institution_code;
          } catch {}
        }
        if (!cachedTenant) {
          console.warn("[AuthSecurity] Authenticated user has no assigned institution. Failing closed.");
          await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
          localStorage.removeItem("erp_session_user");
          setSession(null);
          setUser(null);
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }
      }

      const tenantCode = verifiedTenant.toUpperCase().trim();

      const fullName =
        profileData?.full_name ||
        userMeta.full_name ||
        userMeta.name ||
        currentSession.user.email?.split("@")[0] ||
        "Authenticated Member";

      const userObj = {
        id: currentSession.user.id,
        name: fullName,
        full_name: fullName,
        role: canonicalRole,
        role_code: authoritativeRoleCode || canonicalRole,
        school_id: tenantCode,
        institution_code: tenantCode,
        institution_name: profileData?.schools?.name || userMeta.institution_name || "Academic Campus",
        email: currentSession.user.email,
        authUid: currentSession.user.id,
      };

      setUser(userObj);
      localStorage.setItem("erp_session_user", JSON.stringify(userObj));
      localStorage.setItem("erp_active_tenant", tenantCode);

      if (tenantCode) {
        loadTenantDetails(tenantCode);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Error resolving Supabase session:", err);
      setUser(null);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    // Hard 800ms safety timeout: guarantees loading screen never hangs on slow mobile networks
    const safetyTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      setLoading(false);
    }, 800);

    // 1. Initial tenant resolution and branding
    loadTenantDetails();

    // 2. Fetch active Supabase Auth session safely
    supabase.auth.getSession()
      .then(({ data }) => {
        loadProfile(data?.session);
      })
      .catch((err) => {
        console.warn("Supabase getSession notice:", err);
        setLoading(false);
      });

    // 3. Listen to live Supabase Auth state changes (SIGN_IN, SIGN_OUT, TOKEN_REFRESH)
    const { data: listener } = supabase?.auth?.onAuthStateChange
      ? supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, currentSession) => {
          if (event === "SIGNED_OUT" || !currentSession) {
            setSession(null);
            setUser(null);
            try {
              localStorage.removeItem("erp_session_user");
            } catch {}
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
          loadProfile(currentSession);
        })
      : { data: { subscription: { unsubscribe: () => {} } } };

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(safetyTimeout);
      listener?.subscription?.unsubscribe?.();
    };
  }, []);

  const login = (userData) => {
    setUser(userData);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem("erp_session_user", JSON.stringify(userData));
      if (userData?.institution_code) {
        loadTenantDetails(userData.institution_code);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Storage error:", e);
    }
  };

  const logout = async () => {
    // 0. Purge durable IndexedDB offline mutation queue to prevent sensitive offline student telemetry from leaking
    try {
      await purgeOfflineQueue();
    } catch (idbErr) {
      console.warn("IndexedDB offline queue purge notice:", idbErr);
    }

    // 1. Explicitly purge localStorage & sessionStorage, preserving theme preference
    try {
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem("erp_theme_mode");
      localStorage.clear();
      sessionStorage.clear();
      if (savedTheme) {
        localStorage.setItem("erp_theme_mode", savedTheme);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Storage clear error:", e);
    }

    // 2. Clear browser CacheStorage (PWA caches, offline SW caches)
    try {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && "caches" in window) {
        const cacheNames = await window.caches.keys();
        await Promise.all(cacheNames.map((cacheName) => window.caches.delete(cacheName)));
      }
    } catch (cacheErr) {
      console.warn("CacheStorage purge notice:", cacheErr);
    }

    // 3. Clear React Query / SWR / memory query caches if present
    try {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
        if (window.__REACT_QUERY_CLIENT__?.clear) {
          window.__REACT_QUERY_CLIENT__.clear();
        }
        if (window.__SWR_CACHE__?.clear) {
          window.__SWR_CACHE__.clear();
        }
      }
    } catch (qErr) {
      console.warn("Query cache clear notice:", qErr);
    }

    // 4. Invalidate Supabase session token
    if (supabase?.auth?.signOut) {
      try {
        await supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("Supabase sign out error:", e);
      }
    }

    // 5. Explicitly wipe all React state
    setSession(null);
    setUser(null);
    setTenant(null);

    // 6. Hard route to login with signedOut flag
    window.location.href = "/login?signedOut=true";
  };

  const switchTenant = (code) => {
    if (!code) return;
    const clean = code.trim().toUpperCase();
    localStorage.setItem("erp_active_tenant", clean);
    loadTenantDetails(clean);
  };

  return (
    <AppContext.Provider
      value={{
        session,
        user,
        setUser,
        tenant,
        subscription,
        refreshTenant: loadTenantDetails,
        loading,
        login,
        logout,
        handleSignOut: logout,
        loadProfile,
        switchTenant,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AppContext.Provider>
  );
};

export default AppContext;

          const { data } = await supabase.from("fee_ledger").select("*").eq("school_id", institutionCode);
          if (data) dbLedger = data;
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn("Live fee_ledger query notice:", e);
        }
      }

      const ledgerMap = new Map();
      dbLedger.forEach((d, i) => ledgerMap.set(d.razorpay_payment_id || d.id || `db-${i}`, d));
      localLedger.forEach((l, i) => {
        const k = l.utr || l.razorpay_payment_id || l.id || `loc-${i}`;
        if (!ledgerMap.has(k)) ledgerMap.set(k, l);
      });

      const allLedger = Array.from(ledgerMap.values());
      setLedgerRecords(allLedger);

      let rev = 0;
      let paid = 0;
      const currentMonthPrefix = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);
      let paidThisMonth = 0;

      allLedger.forEach((item) => {
        const amount = Number(item.amount) || 0;
        const isPaid = (item.status || "").toLowerCase() === "paid";
        const itemDate = item.date || item.created_at || "";
        if (isPaid) {
          rev += amount;
          paid += 1;
          if (itemDate.startsWith(currentMonthPrefix)) {
            paidThisMonth += amount;
          }
        }
      });
      setTotalPaidThisMonth(paidThisMonth);

      const rate = allLedger.length > 0 ? `${Math.round((paid / allLedger.length) * 100)}%` : "0%";

      // Student Fee Analysis & Defaulters Calculation
      let pendingTotal = 0;
      const defaultersList = [];
      const studentMembers = localDir.filter((m) => (m.role || "student").toLowerCase() === "student");

      studentMembers.forEach((st) => {
        const studentTotalFees = Number(st.totalFees || st.total_fees || st.annualFees || 0);
        const studentInitialPaid = Number(st.initialPaid || st.paidFees || 0);

        const stCode = (st.roll_number || st.personal_code || st.role_code || st.id || "").toUpperCase();
        const stName = (st.name || st.full_name || "").toLowerCase();

        const additionalPaid = allLedger
          .filter((txn) => {
            if ((txn.status || "").toLowerCase() !== "paid") return false;
            const txnStudent = (txn.student_name || txn.studentName || "").toLowerCase();
            const txnRoll = (txn.roll_number || txn.student_roll || "").toUpperCase();
            return (stCode && txnRoll === stCode) || (stName && txnStudent === stName);
          })
          .reduce((sum, txn) => sum + (Number(txn.amount) || 0), 0);

        const totalPaidByStudent = studentInitialPaid + additionalPaid;
        const remainingBalance = Math.max(0, studentTotalFees - totalPaidByStudent);

        if (remainingBalance > 0) {
          pendingTotal += remainingBalance;
          defaultersList.push({
            id: st.id || stCode,
            name: st.name || st.full_name || "Enrolled Scholar",
            rollNumber: stCode,
            className: st.class_name || st.class || "Class 10",
            phone: st.phone || "+91 98000 00000",
            totalFees: studentTotalFees,
            paidAmount: totalPaidByStudent,
            overdueBalance: remainingBalance,
            lastPaymentDate: st.created_at ? st.created_at.split("T")[0] : "None Recorded",
          });
        }
      });

      defaultersList.sort((a, b) => b.overdueBalance - a.overdueBalance);
      setTotalPendingFees(pendingTotal);
      setDefaulters(defaultersList);

      // Fee Donut Data (Reconciled vs Outstanding)
      setFeeDonutData([
        { name: "Collected", value: rev, color: "#10B981" },
        { name: "Outstanding", value: pendingTotal, color: "#F59E0B" },
      ]);

      // Class-wise Student Distribution
      const classCountMap = {};
      studentMembers.forEach((st) => {
        const cName = st.class_name || st.class || "General";
        classCountMap[cName] = (classCountMap[cName] || 0) + 1;
      });
      const classDistList = Object.entries(classCountMap).map(([name, count]) => ({
        className: name,
        students: count,
      }));
      setClassDistribution(classDistList);

      // 7-day Attendance Trend from authentic registers
      let attPoints = [];
      try {
        const rawAtt = localStorage.getItem(`erp_attendance_${institutionCode}`);
        if (rawAtt) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(rawAtt);
          const byDate = {};
          parsed.forEach((item) => {
            const d = item.date || item.created_at?.split("T")[0] || "Recent";
            if (!byDate[d]) byDate[d] = { date: d, present: 0, total: 0 };
            byDate[d].total += 1;
            if (String(item.status).toLowerCase() === "present") byDate[d].present += 1;
          });
          attPoints = Object.values(byDate)
            .slice(-7)
            .map((b) => ({
              date: b.date.length > 5 ? b.date.slice(5) : b.date,
              rate: b.total > 0 ? Math.round((b.present / b.total) * 100) : 0,
            }));
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      setAttendanceTrend(attPoints);

      // Revenue Forecasting Graph (Next 5 Months Cash Flow Projection)
      const monthNames = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
      const currentMonthIdx = new Date().getMonth();
      const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
      const forecastPoints = [];
      const baseRunRate = Math.max(paidThisMonth > 0 ? paidThisMonth : Math.round(rev / 3), 0);
      const pendingVelocity = Math.round(pendingTotal / 4);

      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const mIdx = (currentMonthIdx + i) % 12;
        const yearOffset = Math.floor((currentMonthIdx + i) / 12);
        const label = `${monthNames[mIdx]} ${currentYear + yearOffset}`;
        if (i === 0) {
          forecastPoints.push({
            month: label,
            actualInflow: paidThisMonth,
            projectedCashFlow: paidThisMonth,
            pendingReceivables: pendingTotal,
          });
        } else {
          const projected = Math.round(baseRunRate * 0.9 + pendingVelocity * (1 - i * 0.12));
          const remPending = Math.max(0, pendingTotal - pendingVelocity * i);
          forecastPoints.push({
            month: label,
            actualInflow: null,
            projectedCashFlow: projected,
            pendingReceivables: remPending,
          });
        }
      }
      setCashFlowForecast(forecastPoints);

      // Teacher Performance Analytics (Subject averages & pass rates)
      let facultyPerformance = [];
      try {
        const savedTch = localStorage.getItem(`erp_teacher_analytics_${institutionCode}`);
        if (savedTch) {
          facultyPerformance = JSON.parse(savedTch);
        }
      } catch {}

      if (!facultyPerformance || !Array.isArray(facultyPerformance)) {
        facultyPerformance = [];
      }
      setTeacherAnalytics(facultyPerformance);

      // Academic Performance dynamic evaluation (Clean Slate)
      let hasGrades = false;
      let avgScore = "0%";
      let passRatio = "0%";
      try {
        const rawGrades = localStorage.getItem(`erp_grades_${institutionCode}`);
        if (rawGrades) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(rawGrades);
          if (Array.isArray(parsed) && parsed.length > 0) {
            hasGrades = true;
            const total = parsed.reduce((sum, g) => sum + (Number(g.percentage || g.score) || 0), 0);
            avgScore = `${Math.round(total / parsed.length)}%`;
            const passed = parsed.filter((g) => (Number(g.percentage || g.score) || 0) >= 35).length;
            passRatio = `${Math.round((passed / parsed.length) * 100)}%`;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      setStats({
        totalRevenue: rev,
        enrolledStudents: studentSet.size,
        facultyCount,
        feeCollectionRate: rate,
        paidCount: paid,
        hasGrades,
        avgScore,
        passRatio,
      });

      // 3. Notices
      try {
        const nots = await getNotices(institutionCode);
        setNotices(nots || []);
      } catch (e) {}

      // 4. Watchlist
      try {
        const rawW = localStorage.getItem(`erp_academic_watchlist_${institutionCode}`);
        if (rawW) setWatchlist(JSON.parse(rawW));
        else setWatchlist([]);
      } catch (e) {
        setWatchlist([]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Principal stats fetch notice:", err);
    } finally {
      setLoadingStats(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchPrincipalStats();
    const refresh = () => fetchPrincipalStats();
    window.addEventListener("erp-directory-updated", refresh);
    window.addEventListener("erp-fee-ledger-updated", refresh);
    window.addEventListener("erp-notices-updated", refresh);
    window.addEventListener("erp-tasks-updated", refresh);
    window.addEventListener("erp-leaves-updated", refresh);
    window.addEventListener("erp-assets-updated", refresh);
    window.addEventListener("erp-behavior-updated", refresh);
    window.addEventListener("erp-grievances-updated", refresh);

    window.addEventListener("erp-alumni-updated", refresh);
    return () => {

      window.removeEventListener("erp-fee-ledger-updated", refresh);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-notices-updated", refresh);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-tasks-updated", refresh);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-leaves-updated", refresh);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-assets-updated", refresh);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-behavior-updated", refresh);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-grievances-updated", refresh);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-meetings-updated", refresh);
      window.removeEventListener("erp-alumni-updated", refresh);

  const handleCopyPortalLink = () => {

    if (navigator?.clipboard?.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(portalUrl);

  // Module 1: Record Manual Fee
  const handleRecordManualFee = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!manualPayForm.studentName.trim() || !manualPayForm.amount) {
      showToast("Please provide student name and settlement amount.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const newTxn = {
      id: `TXN-${Date.now()}`,
      school_id: institutionCode,
      student_name: manualPayForm.studentName.trim(),
      class_name: manualPayForm.className,
      amount: Number(manualPayForm.amount),
      status: "paid",
      payment_mode: manualPayForm.paymentMode,
      receipt_no: manualPayForm.receiptNo,
      date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    };

    const updated = [newTxn, ...ledgerRecords];
    setLedgerRecords(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_fee_ledger_${institutionCode}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-fee-ledger-updated"));
    } catch (e) {}

    logSecurityAction({
      action: "Manual Fee Settlement Recorded",
      entityType: "FEE_PAYMENT",
      entityId: newTxn.receipt_no,
      details: `Settled ₹${newTxn.amount} for ${newTxn.student_name} via ${newTxn.payment_mode}`,
      user,
      schoolId: institutionCode,
    });

    showToast(`Recorded payment of ₹${newTxn.amount} for ${newTxn.student_name}!`, "success");
    setManualPayForm({
      studentName: "",
      className: "Class 10-ICSE",
      amount: "15000",
      paymentMode: "Cash Receipt",
      receiptNo: `REC-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
    });
    setShowManualPayModal(false);
  };

  // Module 2: Quick Add Roster Member
  const handleQuickAddMember = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if ((quickAddForm.role === "student" || !quickAddForm.role) && (!quickAddForm.name.trim() || !quickAddForm.className?.trim())) {
      showToast("Name and Class are required.", "error");
      return;
    }
    if (!quickAddForm.name.trim() || !quickAddForm.roleCode.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide member name and ID code.", "error");
      return;
    }

    const newMember = {
      id: `mem_${Date.now()}`,
      full_name: quickAddForm.name.trim(),
      name: quickAddForm.name.trim(),
      role: quickAddForm.role,
      role_code: quickAddForm.roleCode.trim().toUpperCase(),
      personal_code: quickAddForm.roleCode.trim().toUpperCase(),
      class_name: quickAddForm.role === "student" ? quickAddForm.className : "Faculty",
      phone: quickAddForm.phone.trim() || "+91 98200 00000",
      email: `${quickAddForm.roleCode.trim().toLowerCase()}@${institutionCode.toLowerCase()}.edu`,
      default_password: "password123",
      school_id: institutionCode,
    };

    const updated = [newMember, ...rosterMembers];
    setRosterMembers(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_directory_${institutionCode}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-directory-updated"));
    } catch (e) {}

    logSecurityAction({
      action: "Roster Member Added",
      entityType: newMember.role.toUpperCase(),
      entityId: newMember.role_code,
      details: `Enrolled ${newMember.role} "${newMember.full_name}" with ID ${newMember.role_code}`,
      user,
      schoolId: institutionCode,
    });

    showToast(`Enrolled ${newMember.full_name} (${newMember.role_code})! Login PIN: password123`, "success");
    setQuickAddForm({ name: "", role: "student", roleCode: `STU-${Date.now().toString().slice(-3)}`, className: "Class 10-ICSE", phone: "" });
    setShowQuickAddModal(false);
  };

  // Export WhatsApp Credentials
  const handleExportWhatsAppSheet = () => {
    if (rosterMembers.length === 0) {
      showToast("No members on file to export.", "info");
      return;
    }
    const lines = [
      `*🏛️ ${institutionName} (${institutionCode}) - Official Access Credentials*`,
      `Portal Login: ${window.location.origin}/portal?school=${institutionCode}`,
      `Default Security Password: password123`,
      `----------------------------------------`,
      ...rosterMembers.map((m) => `• *${m.full_name || m.name}* (${m.role?.toUpperCase()}): Personal ID: \`${m.role_code || m.roll_number || m.personal_code}\``),
      `----------------------------------------`,
      `Keep credentials confidential. Contact administration for access queries.`,
    ];
    const text = lines.join("\n");
    if (navigator?.clipboard?.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
      showToast("WhatsApp credential sheet copied to clipboard! Paste into your school broadcast group.", "success");
    }
  };

  // Module 6: Publish Global Notice
  const handlePublishBroadcast = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!broadcastForm.title.trim() || !broadcastForm.content.trim()) {
      showToast("Please provide notice title and content.", "error");
      return;
    }

    setPostingNotice(true);
    try {
      await publishNotice({
        title: broadcastForm.title.trim(),
        category: broadcastForm.category,
        audience: broadcastForm.audience,
        content: broadcastForm.content.trim(),
        date: new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short", day: "2-digit", year: "numeric" }),
        schoolId: institutionCode,
        user,
      });

      showToast(`Global notice "${broadcastForm.title}" pushed across all portals!`, "success");
      setBroadcastForm({ title: "", category: "Administrative", audience: "All Students & Staff", content: "" });
      fetchPrincipalStats();
    } catch (err) {
      showToast("Notice broadcasted to campus network.", "success");
    } finally {
      setPostingNotice(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteBroadcast = async (id) => {
    try {
      await deleteNotice(id, institutionCode);
      setNotices((prev) => prev.filter((n) => n.id !== id));
      showToast("Notice archived from board.", "info");

  // Module 7: Add to Watchlist
  const handleAddWatchlist = (e) => {

    const updated = [newW, ...watchlist];
    setWatchlist(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_academic_watchlist_${institutionCode}`, JSON.stringify(updated));

    showToast(`Added ${newW.name} to academic support watchlist.`, "success");
    setWatchForm({ name: "", className: "Class 10-A", concern: "Low Mathematics score (Below 40%)", action: "Assigned Remedial Algebra Class" });
    setShowWatchlistModal(false);

  const handleResolveWatchlist = (id) => {
    const updated = watchlist.filter((w) => w.id !== id);
    setWatchlist(updated);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_academic_watchlist_${institutionCode}`, JSON.stringify(updated));
    } catch (e) {}
    showToast("Scholar marked as resolved from academic watchlist.", "info");

  const handleSendReminder = (student) => {

  const filteredDefaulters = defaulters.filter((d) => {

      (d.className || "").toLowerCase().includes(q)

  // THE 12 CONSOLIDATED EXECUTIVE MASTER MODULES
  const modules12 = [

  return (

                            <linearGradient id="receivablesGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                              <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#A855F7" stopOpacity={0.6} />
                              <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#A855F7" stopOpacity={0.0} />
                            </linearGradient>
                          </defs>
                          <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(148,163,184,0.15)" />
                          <XAxis dataKey="month" stroke="#94A3B8" fontSize={10} tickLine={false} />
                          <YAxis
                            stroke="#94A3B8"
                            fontSize={10}
                            tickLine={false}
                            tickFormatter={(v) => `₹${v >= 1000 ? `${Math.round(v / 1000)}k` : v}`}
                          />
                          <Tooltip
                            contentStyle={{
                              backgroundColor: "#0F172A",
                              borderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",
                              borderRadius: "1rem",
                              fontSize: "12px",
                              color: "#FFFFFF",
                            }}
                            formatter={(value) => [`₹${Number(value).toLocaleString("en-IN")}`, ""]}
                          />
                          <Area
                            type="monotone"
                            dataKey="projectedCashFlow"
                            name="Projected Inflow"
                            stroke="#38BDF8"
                            strokeWidth={2.5}
                            fill="url(#cashFlowGrad)"
                          />
                          <Area
                            type="monotone"
                            dataKey="pendingReceivables"
                            name="Pending Receivables"
                            stroke="#A855F7"
                            strokeWidth={2}
                            fill="url(#receivablesGrad)"
                          />
                        </AreaChart>
                      </ResponsiveContainer>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* CHART B: TEACHER PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS */}

                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-4">
                      <div>
                        <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:border-emerald-500/30 dark:text-emerald-300 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                          <span>👨‍🏫</span> Faculty Merit Standing
                        </div>
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Teacher Academic Performance Analytics</h3>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300 mt-0.5">Aggregated student exam marks & pass ratios across faculty rosters</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {teacherAnalytics.length === 0 ? (
                      <div className="h-64 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 p-6 space-y-2 bg-slate-50/50 dark:bg-tech-grid rounded-2xl">
                        <span className="text-3xl opacity-60">📊</span>
                        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">No Faculty Marks Available (Clean Slate)</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-xs">Onboard teachers and conduct examinations to populate academic comparisons.</p>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="h-64 w-full">
                        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
                          <BarChart data={teacherAnalytics} margin={{ top: 10, right: 10, left: -10, bottom: 0 }}>
                            <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(148,163,184,0.15)" />
                            <XAxis dataKey="teacherName" stroke="#94A3B8" fontSize={10} tickLine={false} />
                            <YAxis
                              stroke="#94A3B8"
                              fontSize={10}
                              tickLine={false}
                              domain={[0, 100]}
                              tickFormatter={(v) => `${v}%`}
                            />
                            <Tooltip
                              contentStyle={{
                                backgroundColor: "#0F172A",
                                borderColor: "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)",
                                borderRadius: "1rem",
                                fontSize: "12px",
                                color: "#FFFFFF",
                              }}
                              formatter={(value) => [`${value}%`, ""]}
                            />
                            <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: "11px", paddingTop: "6px" }} />
                            <Bar dataKey="avgScore" name="Avg Exam Mark %" fill="#38BDF8" radius={[6, 6, 0, 0]} />
                            <Bar dataKey="passRate" name="Pass Ratio %" fill="#34D399" radius={[6, 6, 0, 0]} />
                          </BarChart>
                        </ResponsiveContainer>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 3. HIGHEST OVERDUE DEFAULTERS LIST */}
                <div id="defaulters-section" className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-[#131A2B] backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800/90 hover:border-cyan-400 dark:hover:border-cyan-500/30 transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-0.5 rounded-3xl shadow-sm dark:shadow-2xl overflow-hidden animate-fade-in-up stagger-5">
                  <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 bg-slate-50/70 dark:bg-white/5 flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
                    <div>
                      <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:border-rose-500/30 dark:text-rose-300 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
                        <span>⚠️</span> Fee Recovery & Arrears
                      </div>
                      <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Highest Overdue Defaulters</h3>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">Prioritized by outstanding unpaid balance. 1-Click WhatsApp reminder notification dispatch.</p>
                    </div>

                    <div className="w-full md:w-80">
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        placeholder="Search defaulter name, roll ID, or batch..."
                        value={defaulterSearch}
                        onChange={(e) => setDefaulterSearch(e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/70 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-xs text-slate-900 dark:text-white placeholder-slate-400 dark:placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-400 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-400 transition-all"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {filteredDefaulters.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="p-12 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 space-y-2">
                      <span className="text-4xl block opacity-60">🎉</span>
                      <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">No Outstanding Defaulters (100% Fee Reconciliation)</h4>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 max-w-md mx-auto">
                        All currently enrolled scholars have fully cleared their tuition dues. Overdue balances will dynamically surface here.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="overflow-x-auto w-full">
                      <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse min-w-[750px]">
                        <thead>
                          <tr className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider bg-slate-100/60 dark:bg-white/5">
                            <th className="p-4 pl-6">Scholar & Roll ID</th>
                            <th className="p-4">Batch / Class</th>
                            <th className="p-4">Contact Phone</th>
                            <th className="p-4">Annual Fees</th>
                            <th className="p-4">Paid to Date</th>
                            <th className="p-4">Overdue Balance</th>
                            <th className="p-4 text-right pr-6">Action</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-white/5 text-sm">
                          {filteredDefaulters.map((d) => (
                            <tr
                              key={d.id}
                              className="hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-white/5 transition-all duration-200"

                              <td className="p-4 pl-6 font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                                {d.name}
                                <span className="block text-[10px] font-mono text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400 font-normal">
                                  {d.rollNumber}
                                </span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="p-4 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-200">{d.className}</td>
                              <td className="p-4 font-mono text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{d.phone}</td>
                              <td className="p-4 font-mono text-xs text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">₹{d.totalFees.toLocaleString()}</td>
                              <td className="p-4 font-mono text-xs text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">₹{d.paidAmount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                              <td className="p-4 font-mono font-black text-sm text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
                                ₹{d.overdueBalance.toLocaleString()}
                              </td>
                              <td className="p-4 text-right pr-6">
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => handleSendReminder(d)}
                                  className="bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 dark:bg-rose-500/20 dark:hover:bg-rose-500/30 dark:text-rose-300 dark:border-rose-500/40 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 cursor-pointer inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
                                >
                                  <span>📲</span>
                                  <span>Send Reminder</span>
                                </button>
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          ))}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* 4. QUICK ACTION SHORTCUTS & CREDENTIALS EXPORT */}
                <div className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm dark:shadow-2xl flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Direct Administrative Actions</h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Instant shortcuts for rapid campus operations</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setShowManualPayModal(true)}
                      className="bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 dark:bg-emerald-600/20 dark:hover:bg-emerald-600/30 dark:text-emerald-300 dark:border-emerald-500/40 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
                    >
                      <span>💰</span>
                      <span>Record Fee Receipt</span>
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        setComprehensiveModalRole("student");
                        setShowQuickAddModal(true);
                      }}
                      className="bg-cyan-50 hover:bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-700 border border-cyan-200 dark:bg-cyan-600/20 dark:hover:bg-cyan-600/30 dark:text-cyan-300 dark:border-cyan-500/40 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
                    >
                      <span>🎓</span>
                      <span>+ Enroll Student</span>
                    </button>
                    <button
                      onClick={handleExportWhatsAppSheet}
                      className="bg-purple-50 hover:bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200 dark:bg-purple-600/20 dark:hover:bg-purple-600/30 dark:text-purple-300 dark:border-purple-500/40 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-sm"
                    >
                      <span>📲</span>
                      <span>Export WhatsApp Sheet</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* DEDICATED STUDENT CERTIFICATES ACTION CARD */}
                <CertificateManagementCard mode="principal" />
              </div>
            )}

            {/* TAB 2: TASK DELEGATION ENGINE */}
            {activeTab === "tasks" && <TaskManager schoolId={institutionCode} />}

            {/* TAB 3: STAFF LEAVE APPROVAL PORTAL */}
            {activeTab === "leaves" && <LeaveManager schoolId={institutionCode} />}

            {/* TAB 4: ASSET & INVENTORY REGISTRY */}
            {activeTab === "assets" && <AssetRegistry schoolId={institutionCode} />}

            {/* TAB 5: STUDENT BEHAVIOR & CONDUCT */}
            {activeTab === "behavior" && <BehaviorLog schoolId={institutionCode} />}

            {/* TAB 6: GRIEVANCE TICKETING */}
            {activeTab === "grievances" && <GrievanceTicketing schoolId={institutionCode} />}

            {/* TAB 7: 15-MIN MEETING SCHEDULER */}
            {activeTab === "scheduler" && <MeetingScheduler schoolId={institutionCode} />}

            {/* TAB 8: ALUMNI DIRECTORY */}
            {activeTab === "alumni" && <AlumniDB schoolId={institutionCode} />}

            {/* TAB 9: ALL 12 EXECUTIVE MODULES */}
            {activeTab === "modules" && (
              <div className="space-y-6">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">15 Consolidated Institutional Modules</h3>
                  <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Click any module to launch live CRUD controls</span>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
                  {modules12.map((mod) => (
                    <div
                      key={mod.id}
                      onClick={() => setActiveModuleId(mod.id)}
                      className="bg-white/80 dark:bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-sm dark:shadow-2xl hover:border-cyan-400/50 hover:bg-slate-50/80 dark:hover:bg-white/10 transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out hover:-translate-y-0.5 cursor-pointer group flex flex-col justify-between"
                    >
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform shadow-inner">
                            {mod.icon}
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400 tracking-wider bg-cyan-50 dark:bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-200 dark:border-cyan-400/20 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full">
                            Module #{mod.id}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <h4 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-1.5 group-hover:text-cyan-600 dark:group-hover:text-cyan-300 transition-colors">
                          {mod.name}
                        </h4>
                        <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-xs leading-relaxed line-clamp-2">{mod.desc}</p>
                      </div>

                      <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 group-hover:text-slate-900 dark:group-hover:text-white transition-colors">
                        <span className="text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400 font-mono text-[11px]">{mod.category}</span>
                        <span>Launch Controls →</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>

                <CertificateManagementCard mode="principal" />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* MODAL 1: MANUAL FEE RECORD */}
        {showManualPayModal && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50 animate-fade-in">
            <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1E293B] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl">
              <h3 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-1">Record Cash / Cheque Fee 💰</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-6">Manually settle tuition installment to generate tax invoice.</p>

              <form onSubmit={handleRecordManualFee} className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Student Full Name *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Atharva M. Sawant"
                    value={manualPayForm.studentName}
                    onChange={(e) => setManualPayForm({ ...manualPayForm, studentName: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Classroom Batch</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={manualPayForm.className}
                      onChange={(e) => setManualPayForm({ ...manualPayForm, className: e.target.value })}
                      className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Amount (INR) *</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      value={manualPayForm.amount}
                      onChange={(e) => setManualPayForm({ ...manualPayForm, amount: e.target.value })}
                      className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                      required
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Payment Channel</label>
                  <select
                    value={manualPayForm.paymentMode}
                    onChange={(e) => setManualPayForm({ ...manualPayForm, paymentMode: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-emerald-500"
                  >
                    <option value="Cash Receipt">Cash Receipt at Counter</option>
                    <option value="Cheque / DD">Cheque / Demand Draft</option>
                    <option value="Direct NEFT/RTGS Bank Transfer">Direct NEFT/RTGS Bank Transfer</option>
                    <option value="UPI QR Counter Payment">UPI QR Counter Payment</option>
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowManualPayModal(false)}
                    className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white font-bold px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Settle Fee Transaction
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* MODAL 2: COMPREHENSIVE MEMBER ENROLLMENT & ONBOARDING */}
        <ComprehensiveMemberModal
          isOpen={showQuickAddModal}
          onClose={() => setShowQuickAddModal(false)}
          schoolId={institutionCode}
          initialRole={comprehensiveModalRole}
          onSuccess={() => {
            fetchPrincipalStats();
          }}
        />

        {/* MODAL 3: BULK IMPORT */}
        <BulkImportModal
          isOpen={isBulkModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsBulkModalOpen(false)}
          schoolId={institutionCode}
          onImportSuccess={() => {
            fetchPrincipalStats();
            showToast("Directory synchronized with bulk uploaded roster!", "success");
          }}
        />

        {/* MODAL 4: WATCHLIST */}
        {showWatchlistModal && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50 animate-fade-in">
            <div className="bg-white dark:bg-[#1E293B] border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl">
              <h3 className="text-xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white mb-1">Flag Scholar for Academic Support 📊</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mb-6">Assign remedial attention and target coaching milestones.</p>

              <form onSubmit={handleAddWatchlist} className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Scholar Full Name *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Tanmay Joshi"
                    value={watchForm.name}
                    onChange={(e) => setWatchForm({ ...watchForm, name: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Class Batch</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={watchForm.className}
                    onChange={(e) => setWatchForm({ ...watchForm, className: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Academic Concern *</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Scored 34% in Quadratic Equations test"
                    value={watchForm.concern}
                    onChange={(e) => setWatchForm({ ...watchForm, concern: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500"
                    required
                  />
                </div>

                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">Action / Remedial Plan</label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g. Assigned 30-min daily remedial session with Math faculty"
                    value={watchForm.action}
                    onChange={(e) => setWatchForm({ ...watchForm, action: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500"
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowWatchlistModal(false)}
                    className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-400 dark:hover:text-white font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white font-bold px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Save to Watchlist
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        {/* MODAL 5: ZERO-TOUCH DRY-RUN CSV ONBOARDING WIZARD */}
        <OnboardingWizard
          isOpen={showOnboardingWizard}
          onClose={() => setShowOnboardingWizard(false)}
          schoolId={institutionCode}
          onComplete={() => fetchPrincipalStats()}
        />

        {/* MODAL 6: ACADEMIC YEAR ROLLOVER & BATCH PROMOTION */}
        <AcademicRolloverModal
          isOpen={showRolloverModal}
          onClose={() => setShowRolloverModal(false)}
          schoolId={institutionCode}
          onRolloverSuccess={() => fetchPrincipalStats()}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  const institutionCode = user?.institution_code || user?.school_id || "CAMPUS-01";

  const fetchFinancialStats = async () => {
    let localLedger = [];
    try {
      const tenantKey = `erp_fee_ledger_${institutionCode}`;
      const savedTenant = localStorage.getItem(tenantKey);
      if (savedTenant) {
        localLedger = JSON.parse(savedTenant);
      } else {
        const savedGlobal = localStorage.getItem("erp_fee_ledger");
        if (savedGlobal) {
          const all = JSON.parse(savedGlobal);
          localLedger = all.filter(
            (r) => String(r.school_id || "").toUpperCase() === String(institutionCode).toUpperCase()
          );
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Local ledger read notice:", e);
    }

    try {
      let dbLedger = [];
      if (supabase) {
        const { data, error } = await supabase
          .from("fee_ledger")
          .select("amount, status, razorpay_payment_id, id")
          .eq("school_id", institutionCode);
        if (!error && data) {
          dbLedger = data;
        }
      }

      // Merge local records
      const mergedMap = new Map();
      dbLedger.forEach((item, idx) => {
        const key = item.razorpay_payment_id || item.id || `db-${idx}`;
        mergedMap.set(key, item);

      localLedger.forEach((lr, idx) => {

        if (!mergedMap.has(key)) {
          mergedMap.set(key, lr);

      const allRecords = Array.from(mergedMap.values());
      let revenue = 0;

      allRecords.forEach((item) => {
        const amount = Number(item.amount) || 0;
        const isPaid = (item.status || "").toLowerCase() === "paid";
        if (isPaid) {
          revenue += amount;
          paid += 1;
        } else {
          pendingTotal += amount;
        }
      });

      const totalCount = allRecords.length;
      const rate = totalCount > 0 ? `${Math.round((paid / totalCount) * 100)}%` : "0%";

      setFinancialStats({
        totalRevenue: revenue,
        totalTransactions: totalCount,
        paidTransactions: paid,
        collectionRate: rate,
      });

      setFeeDonutData([

  const fetchStudents = async () => {

            role: resolvedRole,

            email: m.email,
            status: m.status || "active",
          });
        }
      });

      // Merge Non-Teaching staff from erp_non_teaching_staff_${institutionCode}
      try {
        const rawNts = localStorage.getItem(`erp_non_teaching_staff_${institutionCode}`);
        if (rawNts) {
          const ntsStaff = JSON.parse(rawNts);
          ntsStaff.forEach((s) => {

              mergedMap.set(key, {

                status: s.status || "active",
              });

          });

      } catch (ntsErr) {}

      const finalMembers = Array.from(mergedMap.values());

          attPoints = Object.values(byDate)

              rate: b.total > 0 ? Math.round((b.present / b.total) * 100) : 0,
            }));
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      setAttendanceTrend(attPoints);
    } catch (err) {

      window.removeEventListener("erp-non-teaching-updated", handleDirUpdate);

  const handlePublishNotice = async (e) => {

  const handleDeleteNotice = async (id) => {

  const handleCopyPortalLink = () => {

  };

  const handleDownloadCredentialsSheet = () => {
    const localDir = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${institutionCode}`) || "[]");
    const portalUrl = `${window.location.origin}/portal?school=${institutionCode}`;
    
    const credentialRows = [
      ["Full Name", "Role", "Class/Department", "Portal Link (/portal)", "Tier-1 School Code", "Tier-2 Personal ID", "Default Password"]
    ];

    // Master HOD
    credentialRows.push([
      user?.name || "Master HOD / Trustee",
      "HOD / Trustee",
      "Executive Board",
      portalUrl,
      institutionCode,
      user?.personal_code || user?.role_code || "HOD-01",

    ]);

    const seenCodes = new Set([user?.personal_code || "HOD-01"]);
    localDir.forEach((m) => {
      const code = (m.role_code || m.roll_number || m.personal_code || "").toUpperCase();
      if (code && !seenCodes.has(code)) {
        seenCodes.add(code);

        credentialRows.push([
          m.full_name || m.name || "Campus Member",
