          m.class_name || m.class || (resolvedRole === "trustee" || resolvedRole === "principal" ? "Executive Management" : "General"),
          portalUrl,
          institutionCode,
          code,
          m.default_password || "password123"
        ]);
      }
    });

    students.forEach((st, idx) => {
      const code = (st.roll_number || st.personal_code || `STU-${1001 + idx}`).toUpperCase();
      if (!seenCodes.has(code)) {
        seenCodes.add(code);
        const resolvedRole = detectRoleFromId(code, st.role);
        credentialRows.push([
          st.name || st.full_name,
          resolvedRole,
          st.class_name || st.class || (resolvedRole === "trustee" || resolvedRole === "principal" ? "Executive Management" : "General"),
          portalUrl,
          institutionCode,
          code,
          "password123"
        ]);
      }
    });

    exportToCSV({
      filename: `${institutionCode.toLowerCase()}_student_teacher_credentials`,
      headers: credentialRows[0],
      rows: credentialRows.slice(1),
    });
    showToast(`Downloaded credentials sheet for ${credentialRows.length - 1} campus members!`, "success");
  };

  const localDirForCalc = (() => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${institutionCode}`) || "[]");
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  })();
  const nextSuggestedId = getNextMemberId(newStudent.role, localDirForCalc, students);

  const handleQuickAddMember = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if ((newStudent.role === "student" || !newStudent.role) && (!newStudent.name?.trim() || !newStudent.class?.trim())) {
      showToast("Name and Class are required.", "error");
      setFormError("Name and Class are required.");
      return;
    }
    if (!newStudent.name || !newStudent.name.trim()) {
      showToast("Name and Class are required.", "error");
      setFormError("Name and Class are required.");
      return;
    }

    setSubmitting(true);
    setFormError(null);

    const isTeacher = newStudent.role === "teacher";
    const generatedCode = nextSuggestedId;
    const defaultPassword = "password123";
    const mappedEmail = buildStandardErpEmail(institutionCode, generatedCode);

    // Collision Guard: verify unique Personal ID
    const isDuplicate = students.some(
      (s) => (s.roll_number || s.personal_code || s.role_code || "").toUpperCase() === generatedCode.toUpperCase()
    );
    if (isDuplicate) {
      showToast(`Collision Guard: Member ID "${generatedCode}" already exists in ${institutionCode}.`, "error");
      setFormError(`Collision Guard: Member ID "${generatedCode}" already exists.`);
      setSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const memberRecord = {
        id: `mem_${isTeacher ? "tch" : "stu"}_${Date.now()}`,
        name: newStudent.name.trim(),
        full_name: newStudent.name.trim(),
        role: newStudent.role || (isTeacher ? "teacher" : "student"),
        role_code: generatedCode,
        roll_number: generatedCode,
        personal_code: generatedCode,
        school_id: institutionCode,
        class_name: newStudent.class?.trim() || (isTeacher ? "Faculty" : "Class 10-ICSE"),
        department: isTeacher ? (newStudent.subject?.trim() || "General Faculty") : undefined,
        subject: isTeacher ? (newStudent.subject?.trim() || "General Faculty") : undefined,
        phone: newStudent.phone || "+91 9800000000",
        email: mappedEmail,
        default_password: defaultPassword,
        status: "active",
        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      };

      // Cloud-First Enrollment into Supabase (profiles, students/teachers, schools cloud directory)
      await enrollMemberInCloud({
        schoolCode: institutionCode,
        member: memberRecord,
      });

      logSecurityAction({
        action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.STUDENT_ADMITTED,
        entityType: isTeacher ? "TEACHER" : "STUDENT",
        entityId: generatedCode,
        details: `Quick-added ${newStudent.role} "${newStudent.name.trim()}" with Code ${generatedCode}`,
        user,
        schoolId: institutionCode,
      });

      showToast(`Added ${newStudent.role} "${newStudent.name}" with ID: ${generatedCode}! Login PIN: ${defaultPassword}`, "success");
      setNewStudent({ name: "", class: "", subject: "", role: "student", phone: "" });
      fetchStudents();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Error adding member:", err);
      setFormError(err.message || "Failed to add member.");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleArchiveMember = async (st) => {
    const personalCode = (st.roll_number || st.personal_code || st.role_code || st.id || "").toUpperCase();
    const isArchived = (st.status || "").toLowerCase() === "archived";
    const nextStatus = isArchived ? "active" : "archived";

    try {
      const rawDir = localStorage.getItem(`erp_directory_${institutionCode}`);
      let dir = rawDir ? JSON.parse(rawDir) : [];
      let foundInDir = false;
      dir = dir.map((m) => {
        const mCode = (m.roll_number || m.personal_code || m.role_code || m.id || "").toUpperCase();
        if (mCode === personalCode) {
          foundInDir = true;
          return { ...m, status: nextStatus };
        }
        return m;
      });
      if (!foundInDir) {
        dir.push({ ...st, status: nextStatus });
      }
      localStorage.setItem(`erp_directory_${institutionCode}`, JSON.stringify(dir));

      try {
        if (supabase) {
          await supabase
            .from("profiles")
            .update({ status: nextStatus })
            .or(`role_code.eq.${personalCode},id.eq.${st.id}`);
          await supabase
            .from("students")
            .update({ status: nextStatus })
            .or(`roll_number.eq.${personalCode},id.eq.${st.id}`);
        }
      } catch (sbErr) {
        console.warn("Supabase archive sync notice:", sbErr);
      }

      logSecurityAction({
        action: isArchived ? "MEMBER_REACTIVATED" : "MEMBER_ARCHIVED",
        entityType: (st.role || "MEMBER").toUpperCase(),
        entityId: personalCode,
        details: `Trustee ${isArchived ? "reactivated" : "safely archived"} ${st.role || "member"} "${st.name || st.full_name}" (${personalCode}) - historical logs preserved`,
        user,
        schoolId: institutionCode,
      });

      showToast(
        isArchived
          ? `Reactivated ${st.name || personalCode}! Active status restored.`
          : `Safely archived ${st.name || personalCode}. Historical audit and fee records preserved.`,
        "success"
      );

      fetchStudents();
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("erp-directory-updated"));
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Archive error:", err);
      showToast("Failed to update member status", "error");
    }
  };

  const filteredStudents = students.filter((u) => {
    const roleCode = (u.roll_number || u.personal_code || u.role_code || "").toUpperCase();
    const resolvedRole = detectRoleFromId(roleCode, u.role);
    if (memberFilter === "student") {
      return (
        resolvedRole === "student" &&
        !roleCode.startsWith("HOD-") &&
        !roleCode.startsWith("PRIN-") &&
        !roleCode.startsWith("TR-") &&
        !roleCode.startsWith("ACC-") &&
        !roleCode.startsWith("TCH-") &&
        !roleCode.startsWith("FAC-") &&
        !roleCode.startsWith("NTS-") &&
        !roleCode.startsWith("NON-")
      );
    }
    if (memberFilter === "teacher") {
      return (
        resolvedRole === "teacher" ||
        roleCode.startsWith("TCH-") ||
        roleCode.startsWith("FAC-")
      );
    }
    if (memberFilter === "staff") {
      return (
        resolvedRole === "staff" ||
        resolvedRole === "non_teaching" ||
        roleCode.startsWith("NTS-") ||
        roleCode.startsWith("NON-") ||
        roleCode.startsWith("STAFF-")
      );
    }
    return true;
  });

  return (
    <div className="relative text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200 min-h-full pb-10 font-sans transition-colors duration-200">
      <div className="fixed top-0 right-10 w-96 h-96 bg-purple-600/10 dark:bg-purple-600/10 rounded-full blur-[120px] pointer-events-none"></div>

      <div className="relative z-10 max-w-6xl mx-auto">
        <div className="mb-8 flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-4">
          <div>
            <p className="text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-300 text-sm font-semibold mb-1 uppercase tracking-widest">Executive Suite</p>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-tight">HOD / Trustee & Principal Command Center 🏛️</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">Unified institutional audit, financial growth, and academic student management</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
            <button
              onClick={handleCopyPortalLink}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-600/20 dark:hover:bg-blue-600/30 dark:text-blue-300 dark:border-blue-500/30 text-xs font-bold shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5"
              title="Copy direct member portal link to share on WhatsApp"
            >
              <span>🔗</span>
              <span>Copy Direct Member Portal Link (/portal)</span>
            </button>

}

import React, { useState, useContext, useEffect } from "react";
import { useNavigate, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { AppContext } from "../context/AppContext";
import { useToast } from "../context/ToastContext";
import { supabase } from "../supabaseClient";
import BrandLogo from "../Components/BrandLogo";
import ThemeToggle from "../Components/ThemeToggle";
import { verifyCloudLogin, checkSchoolSubscriptionStatus } from "../utils/cloudSyncService";
import {
  Building2,
  User,
  Lock,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  AlertCircle,
  ArrowRight,
  ShieldCheck,
  RefreshCw,
  Sparkles,
} from "lucide-react";
import { buildStandardErpEmail, inferRoleFromCode, dashboardFor, normalizeRole } from "../utils/credentials";

export { buildStandardErpEmail, inferRoleFromCode, dashboardFor, normalizeRole };

export default function Login({ isDirectPortal = false }) {
  const { user, setUser, login } = useContext(AppContext);
  const { showToast } = useToast();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();

  const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const isDirect = isDirectPortal || location.pathname === "/portal";
  const savedTenant = typeof localStorage !== "undefined" ? localStorage.getItem("erp_active_tenant") : "";
  const initialSchool =
    searchParams.get("school") ||
    searchParams.get("tenant") ||
    searchParams.get("code") ||
    savedTenant ||
    "";

  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    institutionCode: initialSchool ? initialSchool.toUpperCase() : "",
    personalCode: "",
    password: "",
  });
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [suspendedNotice, setSuspendedNotice] = useState(null);

  // Fast auto-route if persistent session already exists
  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
    if (params.get("signedOut") === "true") return;
    try {
      const active =
        user ||
        (() => {
          const s = localStorage.getItem("erp_session_user");
          return s ? JSON.parse(s) : null;
        })();

      if (active && (active.role || active.role_code)) {
        const dest = dashboardFor(active.role || inferRoleFromCode(active.role_code || active.roll_number));
        navigate(dest, { replace: true });
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignored
    }
  }, [user, location.search, navigate]);

  const handleLogin = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");

    const cleanInst = formData.institutionCode.trim().toUpperCase();
    const rawPersonal = formData.personalCode.trim();
    const isEmail = rawPersonal.includes("@");
    const cleanPersonal = rawPersonal.replace(/@.*$/, "").toUpperCase();
    const pass = formData.password.trim();

    // Validation checks
    if (!cleanInst) {
      setError("Please provide your Institution Access Code (e.g. PALGHAR-01, DEL-01).");
      return;
    }

    if (!pass) {
      setError("Please enter your security password.");
      return;
    }

    if (!isEmail && !cleanPersonal) {
      setError("Please provide your Personal Credential ID (e.g. PRIN-01, HOD-01, TCH-01, ACC-01, STU-01).");
      return;
    }

    if (isEmail && !rawPersonal) {
      setError("Please enter your email address and password.");
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    // 0. Subscription & Master Kill-Switch Check
    if (cleanInst) {
      try {
        const sub = await checkSchoolSubscriptionStatus(cleanInst);
        if (sub && sub.isBlocked) {
          setLoading(false);
          setSuspendedNotice({
            schoolCode: cleanInst,
            isSuspended: sub.isSuspended,
            isExpired: sub.isExpired,
            expiryDate: sub.expiryDate,
          });
          showToast(
            sub.isSuspended
              ? `Campus node ${cleanInst} is SUSPENDED by platform administrator.`
              : `Campus node ${cleanInst} license expired on ${sub.expiryDate}.`,
            "error"
          );
          return;
        }
      } catch (subErr) {
        console.warn("Subscription check notice:", subErr);
      }
    }

    const standardizedEmail = buildStandardErpEmail(cleanInst, cleanPersonal);
    const emailAlt = `${cleanInst.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")}.${cleanPersonal.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, "")}@gmail.com`;

    let authUser = null;
    let explicitAuthError = null;

    // STEP 1: Supabase Auth (Primary Identity Provider)
    if (supabase) {
      const candidates = isEmail
        ? [rawPersonal.toLowerCase()]
        : [standardizedEmail, emailAlt];

      for (const candidateEmail of candidates) {
        try {
          const { data: authData, error: authErr } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
            email: candidateEmail,
            password: pass,
          });

          if (!authErr && authData?.user) {
            authUser = authData.user;
            break;
          }

          if (authErr) {
            const msg = (authErr.message || "").toLowerCase();
            const status = authErr.status;

            if (msg.includes("email not confirmed") || msg.includes("not confirmed")) {
              explicitAuthError = "Email not confirmed. Please check your inbox and confirm your email before logging in.";
              break;
            } else if (msg.includes("disabled") || msg.includes("banned")) {
              explicitAuthError = "This account has been disabled. Please contact your campus administrator.";
              break;
            } else if (msg.includes("rate limit") || status === 429) {
              explicitAuthError = "Too many failed attempts. Please wait a few moments before trying again.";
              break;
            }
          }
        } catch (authErr) {
          console.warn("Supabase auth attempt notice:", authErr);
        }
      }
    }

    // If explicit non-credential auth error occurred (e.g. email unconfirmed)
    if (explicitAuthError) {
      setError(explicitAuthError);
      showToast(explicitAuthError, "error");
      setLoading(false);
      return;
    }

    // If Supabase Auth successfully authenticated the user
    if (authUser) {
      try {
        const { data: profile } = await supabase
          .from("profiles")
          .select("id, role, role_code, full_name, school_id, schools ( code, name )")
          .eq("id", authUser.id)
          .maybeSingle();

        const appMeta = authUser.app_metadata || {};
        const userMeta = authUser.user_metadata || {};

        // Cross-tenant protection
        const profileSchool = (profile?.schools?.code || profile?.school_id || appMeta.school_id || userMeta.school_id || "").toUpperCase();
        if (cleanInst && profileSchool && profileSchool !== cleanInst && profileSchool !== "ALL") {
          const msg = `Cross-tenant access denied: Account belongs to ${profileSchool}, not ${cleanInst}.`;
          setError(msg);
          showToast(msg, "error");
          setLoading(false);
          return;
        }

        const rawRole = profile?.role || appMeta.role || userMeta.role || inferRoleFromCode(cleanPersonal);
        const resolvedRole = inferRoleFromCode(rawRole);
        const fullName = profile?.full_name || userMeta.full_name || userMeta.name || cleanPersonal;

        const sessionPayload = {
          id: authUser.id,
          name: fullName,
          full_name: fullName,
          role: resolvedRole,
          role_code: profile?.role_code || appMeta.role_code || cleanPersonal,
          personal_code: profile?.role_code || cleanPersonal,
          school_id: profile?.school_id || appMeta.school_id || cleanInst || "default-school",
          institution_code: profile?.schools?.code || cleanInst || "CAMPUS-01",
          institution_name: profile?.schools?.name || cleanInst || "Academic Campus",
          email: authUser.email,
          authUid: authUser.id,
        };

        // Synchronously store session before routing
        try {
          localStorage.setItem("erp_session_user", JSON.stringify(sessionPayload));
          localStorage.setItem("erp_active_tenant", cleanInst || sessionPayload.institution_code);
        } catch {}

        if (typeof setUser === "function") setUser(sessionPayload);
        if (typeof login === "function") login(sessionPayload);

        showToast(`Welcome back, ${fullName}!`, "success");
        setLoading(false);
        const targetRoute = dashboardFor(resolvedRole);
        navigate(targetRoute, { replace: true });
        return;
      } catch (postAuthErr) {
        console.warn("Post-auth profile resolution notice:", postAuthErr);
        // Resilient fallback: Authentication already succeeded with valid Supabase authUser!
        const fallbackRole = inferRoleFromCode(cleanPersonal);
        const fallbackPayload = {
          id: authUser.id,
          name: cleanPersonal,
          full_name: cleanPersonal,
          role: fallbackRole,
          role_code: cleanPersonal,
          personal_code: cleanPersonal,
          school_id: cleanInst || "CAMPUS-01",
          institution_code: cleanInst || "CAMPUS-01",
          institution_name: cleanInst || "Academic Campus",
          email: authUser.email,
          authUid: authUser.id,
        };
        try {
          localStorage.setItem("erp_session_user", JSON.stringify(fallbackPayload));
          localStorage.setItem("erp_active_tenant", cleanInst || "CAMPUS-01");
        } catch {}

        if (typeof setUser === "function") setUser(fallbackPayload);
        if (typeof login === "function") login(fallbackPayload);

        showToast(`Welcome back, ${cleanPersonal}!`, "success");
        setLoading(false);
        const targetRoute = dashboardFor(fallbackRole);
        navigate(targetRoute, { replace: true });
        return;
      }
    }

    // STEP 2: Cloud Directory & Multi-Tenant Provisioning Package
    if (cleanInst) {
      try {
        const cloudResult = await verifyCloudLogin({
          institutionCode: cleanInst,
          personalCode: cleanPersonal,
          password: pass,
        });

        if (cloudResult && cloudResult.success && cloudResult.user) {
          const userObj = cloudResult.user;
          const userRole = inferRoleFromCode(userObj.role || cleanPersonal);
          const sessionPayload = {
            ...userObj,
            role: userRole,
            school_id: userObj.school_id || cleanInst,
            institution_code: cleanInst,
            institution_name: userObj.institution_name || cleanInst,
          };

          try {
            localStorage.setItem("erp_session_user", JSON.stringify(sessionPayload));
            localStorage.setItem("erp_active_tenant", cleanInst);
          } catch {}

          if (typeof setUser === "function") setUser(sessionPayload);
          if (typeof login === "function") login(sessionPayload);

          showToast(`Access granted: ${sessionPayload.name || sessionPayload.full_name || cleanPersonal}`, "success");
          setLoading(false);
          const targetRoute = dashboardFor(userRole);
          navigate(targetRoute, { replace: true });
          return;
        }

        if (cloudResult && cloudResult.error && cloudResult.error.toLowerCase().includes("password")) {
          const msg = "Invalid credentials. The password you entered is incorrect.";
          setError(msg);
          showToast(msg, "error");

      }
    }

            >

            </button>

      )}

  );
}

                {!isCollapsed && <span className="truncate">{link.name}</span>}

        </nav>

        {/* User Profile & Sign Out Footer */}
        <div className="p-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800/90 bg-slate-50/80 dark:bg-[#131A2B]/70 flex-shrink-0 mt-auto transition-colors">
          {!isCollapsed ? (

              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate">{user.name || user.full_name}</p>

                  {personalCode || "ACTIVE"}
                </span>
              </div>

          ) : (
            <div className="text-center mb-2">
              <span className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
                {roleType.slice(0, 3)}
              </span>

          )}

          <button
            onClick={onSignOut}
            title="Sign Out"
            className={`w-full bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 dark:bg-rose-500/10 dark:hover:bg-rose-500/20 dark:text-rose-400 font-extrabold py-2 px-2 rounded-xl transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out hover:-translate-y-0.5 border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-500/20 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs cursor-pointer ${
              isCollapsed ? "px-1" : ""
            }`}
          >
            <span>🚪</span>
            {!isCollapsed && <span>Sign Out</span>}

}

const PUBLIC_ROUTES = [
  "/",
  "/login",
  "/portal",

  "/terms",
  "/privacy",

  "/refund-policy",

];

const AppLayout = ({ children }) => {
  const location = useLocation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const isPublicPage =
    PUBLIC_ROUTES.includes(location.pathname) ||
    location.pathname.startsWith("/verify-credential");

  const canonicalRole = normalizeRole(user?.role, user?.role_code || user?.roll_number || user?.id);
  const isMasterUser = canonicalRole === "MASTER_OWNER" || location.pathname === "/master-setup";

  // 1. GLOBAL INSTITUTIONAL SUSPENSION & LICENSING LOCK (ROOT ROUTER LEVEL)
  // If a school's status or subscription_status is marked suspended or its license has expired,
  // all users (Students, Teachers, Accountants, Principals) are immediately blocked from dashboard access.
  // MASTER_OWNER role is strictly exempted so they can manage and renew institutions via /master-setup.
  if (!isPublicPage && !isMasterUser && subscription?.isBlocked) {
    return (
      <SuspensionNoticeBarrier
        tenant={tenant}
        subscription={subscription}
        onLogout={logout}
      />
    );
  }

  const [installPrompt, setInstallPrompt] = React.useState(null);
  const [isInstalled, setIsInstalled] = React.useState(false);
  const [showInstallPill, setShowInstallPill] = React.useState(true);

  // Mobile Swipe-to-Refresh & Persistent Session Auto-Router:
  // If user opens `/`, `/login`, or `/portal` while a valid session is stored in localStorage,
  // strictly bypass login and auto-route them directly to their respective dashboard.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
      if (searchParams.get("signedOut") === "true") return;

      const currentPath = location.pathname;
      if (currentPath === "/" || currentPath === "/login" || currentPath === "/portal") {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem("erp_session_user");
        if (saved) {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
          if (parsed && (parsed.role || parsed.role_code)) {
            const dest = dashboardFor(
              parsed.role ||
                inferRoleFromCode(parsed.role_code || parsed.roll_number)
            );
            navigate(dest, { replace: true });
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("Session auto-route check:", e);
    }
  }, [location.pathname, location.search, navigate]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const handleBeforeInstall = (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setInstallPrompt(e);
      setShowInstallPill(true);
    };

    const handleAppInstalled = () => {
      setIsInstalled(true);
      setInstallPrompt(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener("beforeinstallprompt", handleBeforeInstall);
    window.addEventListener("appinstalled", handleAppInstalled);

    if (
      window.matchMedia("(display-mode: standalone)").matches ||
      window.navigator.standalone === true
    ) {
      setIsInstalled(true);
    }

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("beforeinstallprompt", handleBeforeInstall);
      window.removeEventListener("appinstalled", handleAppInstalled);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleInstallClick = async () => {
    if (installPrompt) {
      installPrompt.prompt();
      const choice = await installPrompt.userChoice;
      if (choice.outcome === "accepted") {
        setInstallPrompt(null);
      }
    } else {
      showToast("To install on iOS or mobile browser: Tap Share (or Menu 3-dots) and choose 'Add to Home Screen' 📱", "info", 6000);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="h-[100dvh] w-screen overflow-hidden flex bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0A0E1A] text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 font-sans relative transition-colors duration-200">
      {!isPublicPage && <Sidebar />}
      <main
        className={`flex-1 h-full overflow-y-auto ${
          isPublicPage ? "p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8" : "p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 pt-20 md:pt-8 pb-24 md:pb-8"
        }`}
      >
        {children}
      </main>

      {/* PERSISTENT SLEEK PWA INSTALL FLOATING PILL */}
      {!isInstalled && showInstallPill && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-20 md:bottom-6 right-4 md:right-6 z-50 flex items-center gap-2 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600/95 via-indigo-600/95 to-purple-600/95 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 text-white px-4 py-2.5 rounded-full shadow-2xl shadow-blue-500/40 text-xs font-bold transition-all hover:scale-105">
          <button
            onClick={handleInstallClick}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <span className="text-base">📲</span>
            <span>Install App</span>
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping"></span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowInstallPill(false)}
            className="text-white/60 hover:text-white ml-1 text-sm font-bold cursor-pointer"
            title="Dismiss"
          >
            ✕
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* UNIVERSAL GLOBAL COMMAND PALETTE (Ctrl + K) */}
      <CommandPalette />
    </div>
  );
};
